pmid-20015364.summary_en: This study compares microRNA (miRNA) regulation in two embryonal carcinoma stem cell lines, NTera2 (differentiating) and 2102Ep (undifferentiated), with ovarian serous carcinoma patient samples using qPCR. 2102Ep cells overlapped substantially with ovarian serous carcinoma in miRNA biosynthesis and mature miRNA expression, notably the miR-17/92 family and clusters on chromosomes 14 and 19. Undifferentiated 2102Ep cells maintained biosynthesis gene expression and avoided differentiation, whereas tumor samples showed decreased biosynthesis and chromosome 14 clustering. The authors suggest these miRNAs could be manipulated to generate lower-grade tumors.

pmid-20016238.summary_ja: セミノーマの46歳男性が、シスプラチン併用化学療法の第2サイクル中に急性脳梗塞を発症した症例報告。脳出血を除外後に全身性血栓溶解療法を行い、左内頸動脈閉塞と中大脳動脈領域の梗塞が判明した。後遺症として失語と片麻痺が残り、後にてんかんを発症した。腫瘍は完全寛解を維持した。シスプラチン関連の虚血性脳卒中はまれだが重篤となりうるため、予防策が議論されている。
pmid-20016238.summary_en: A 46-year-old man with seminoma developed acute ischemic stroke with right hemiparesis and global aphasia during the second cycle of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. After intracerebral bleeding was excluded, systemic thrombolysis was performed, revealing acute occlusion of the left internal carotid artery with middle cerebral artery infarction. He recovered slowly but had persistent moderate aphasia and partial hemiparesis, and later developed symptomatic epilepsy, while the tumor remained in complete remission. The authors review the literature and discuss precautions to reduce this rare but potentially disabling complication.

pmid-20019899.summary_ja: ノルウェーJanus血清バンクのコホート内症例対照研究で、診断前血清中の有機塩素化合物と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクを検討。症例49例と対照51例を比較した。症例ではp,p'-DDEやクロルデン類が高値だったが、統計的に有意なオッズ比は得られなかった。セミノーマでは一部のPCB濃度に有意な差がみられた。DDEやクロルデン、一部のPCBとのリスク関連について限定的な根拠を示した。
pmid-20019899.summary_en: This nested case-control study within the Norwegian Janus Serum Bank cohort examined prediagnostic serum concentrations of organochlorine compounds and testicular germ cell tumor risk. Forty-nine cases were matched to 51 controls. Cases had elevated p,p'-DDE and chlordane levels, though no odds ratios reached statistical significance. Seminoma cases had significantly lower concentrations of PCB congeners 44, 49, and 52 and higher concentrations of several others. The authors conclude there is qualified evidence linking DDE and chlordane exposure, and possibly some PCB congeners, to testicular germ cell tumor risk.

pmid-20028501.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマの49歳男性が、PEB療法2コース後に胸部下行大動脈と腎動脈下の腹部大動脈に血栓を生じた症例報告。大動脈閉塞は約30%で、四肢の虚血症状はなかった。抗凝固療法により、化学療法終了6か月後に血栓は完全に消失した。シスプラチン併用化学療法が血栓形成の強い誘因と考えられ、若年者でも動脈血栓症に注意が必要とされる。
pmid-20028501.summary_en: A 49-year-old man with advanced testicular seminoma developed thrombotic deposits in the thoracic and infrarenal abdominal aorta after two cycles of PEB chemotherapy. Aortic occlusion was about 30%, with no clinical signs of limb malperfusion. Anticoagulation was started, and the deposits had completely resolved six months after chemotherapy ended. With no other predisposing factors, the authors attribute the event to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. They describe it as the first case of endo-aortic thrombosis during chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumor and urge providers to be aware of arterial thrombosis even in young patients.

pmid-20030207.summary_ja: 本総説は、NR1/NR2 NMDA受容体に対する抗体によって生じる治療反応性脳炎である抗NMDA受容体脳炎を解説している。若年女性に多く、卵巣奇形腫との関連が強く、精神症状、けいれん、カタトニアを呈する。著者らは、この抗体がGABA作動性介在ニューロン上のNMDA受容体機能を低下させ、グルタミン酸およびドパミンの調節異常を引き起こすと提唱している。奇形腫陽性例では免疫療法と併用した早期の腫瘍摘出が推奨され、抵抗性の患者では探索的開腹術により微小な奇形腫を発見しうる。
pmid-20030207.summary_en: This review describes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a treatment-responsive encephalitis caused by antibodies against the NR1/NR2 NMDA receptor. It typically affects young women and is strongly associated with ovarian teratoma, presenting with psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and catatonia. The authors propose that the antibodies reduce NMDA receptor function on GABAergic interneurons, leading to glutamate and dopamine dysregulation. Early tumor resection with immunotherapy is recommended in teratoma-positive cases, and exploratory laparotomy may help find microscopic teratoma in refractory patients.

pmid-20037417.summary_ja: 73歳男性の原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告。食欲不振で受診し、残存胃と膵臓の間に9cm大の腫瘍を認めた。内視鏡生検では低分化腺癌とされたが、切除標本で絨毛癌と診断され、hCG免疫染色が陽性であった。胃全摘を含む拡大手術後45日で皮膚転移が出現し、術後60日で死亡した。極めて稀で予後不良であり、生検のみでは診断が困難な場合があることを示す。
pmid-20037417.summary_en: A 73-year-old man presented with appetite loss and a 9 cm abdominal mass between the residual stomach and pancreas. Endoscopic biopsy suggested poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma, but resection revealed choriocarcinoma with hCG-positive immunostaining. Despite total gastrectomy with extended resection, skin metastasis appeared 45 days later, and the patient died 60 days after surgery. The report highlights the rarity and poor prognosis of primary gastric choriocarcinoma and the diagnostic pitfall of relying on biopsy alone.

pmid-20041106.summary_ja: 妊娠13週で卵巣の未熟奇形腫（grade 3）と診断された25歳初産婦の症例。妊娠21週で卵巣摘除術を行い、妊娠中にBEP療法を3コース実施した。妊娠36週で軽度の腺性尿道下裂を伴う男児を出産し、児はそれ以外は正常であった。妊娠初期以降の未熟奇形腫の管理は非妊娠例と同様に行え、母体・胎児ともに安全であると結論している。
pmid-20041106.summary_en: A 25-year-old primigravida was diagnosed with a grade 3 ovarian immature teratoma at 13 weeks of gestation. She underwent oophorectomy at 21 weeks and then received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) during pregnancy, until 37 weeks. She delivered a male infant with mild glandular hypospadias at 36 weeks, and the infant was otherwise normal. The authors conclude that management of immature teratoma after the first trimester is similar to that in non-pregnant patients and can be safe for both mother and fetus.

pmid-20047465.summary_ja: 順遺伝学的スクリーニングで同定されたゼブラフィッシュの変異系統を報告する。生後約7か月で高頻度に精巣腫瘍を自然発生し、常染色体優性遺伝した。精巣組織構造が破綻し、精母細胞分化が失われた原始的な精原細胞様細胞が蓄積する。放射線照射により腫瘍細胞はアポトーシスを起こし腫瘍は縮小した。胚細胞の制御機構の解析や新規治療法の検討に有用なモデルとされる。
pmid-20047465.summary_en: The authors identified a zebrafish mutant line from a forward genetic screen for cancer susceptibility. The fish develop highly penetrant, heritable testicular germ cell tumors at a median age of 7 months, with dominant inheritance. Histology shows disrupted testicular architecture and accumulation of primitive spermatogonial-like cells with loss of spermatocytic differentiation. Radiation induces apoptosis and tumor regression. The authors propose the model as a platform for understanding germ cell regulation and for testing new therapeutic approaches for germ cell tumors.

pmid-20048566.summary_ja: 47歳男性が左鼠径部の疼痛を伴う腫瘤で受診した。左精巣は陰嚢内に触知されていなかった。CTとドプラ超音波で血流の乏しい約5cmの腫瘤を認めた。精巣摘除術で、腫瘤と精索が外腹斜筋腱膜を通って脱出し捻転していた。組織学的に停留精巣由来のセミノーマと診断された。停留精巣に生じた精巣がんが鼠径管から脱出し捻転した稀な症例である。
pmid-20048566.summary_en: A 47-year-old man presented with a painful inguinal mass; he had never recognized the left testis in the scrotum. CT and Doppler ultrasound showed a 5 cm mass with inadequate blood flow. Orchiectomy revealed torsion of the mass and spermatic cord, which had prolapsed through the external oblique aponeurosis. Histology confirmed seminoma arising in an undescended testis. The report describes a rare presentation of testicular cancer in cryptorchidism, with torsion and inguinal prolapse.

pmid-20049088.summary_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）で、初診時に高カルシウム血症を認めた。腫瘍切除後も中等度の高カルシウム血症が7日間持続し、その後も7日間軽度上昇が続いた。PTHrPは検出されず、腫瘍組織に1α水酸化酵素の発現を認めたが、1,25(OH)2D3の上昇はなかった。切除後に遷延する高カルシウム血症の新たな機序が示唆される。
pmid-20049088.summary_en: A 13-year-old girl with an ovarian dysgerminoma presented with hypercalcemia. After tumor resection, moderate hypercalcemia persisted for 7 days, and calcium remained mildly elevated for another 7 days, longer than typically reported. PTHrP was undetectable. Tumor tissue expressed 1alpha-hydroxylase, but 1,25(OH)2D3 was not elevated. The authors suggest a previously undescribed mechanism of persistent hypercalcemia after resection, with implications for tumor biology and therapy.

pmid-20057969.summary_ja: 精巣の混合性胚細胞腫瘍が純粋絨毛癌として転移性に発症した症例。血清β-hCGが高値で、多発肺転移を認めた。BEP療法の後、自家末梢血幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法を順次実施した。2年間の持続寛解が得られた。非セミノーマ型の中でも攻撃的な亜型で最適な治療は確立していないが、大量化学療法が有効な選択肢となり得ると述べている。
pmid-20057969.summary_en: A patient with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor presented with metastatic pure choriocarcinoma involving multiple lung metastases, with high serum beta-hCG. After BEP combination chemotherapy, the patient received sequential high-dose chemotherapy with autologous peripheral stem cell rescue and remained in continuous remission for 2 years. The authors note that the optimal management of this aggressive non-seminomatous variant is undefined and suggest high-dose chemotherapy as an effective option.

pmid-20061587.summary_ja: 生後1週以内の女児新生児に、発作性喘鳴・無呼吸・チアノーゼが出現した。喉頭鏡検査で咽頭上部の腫瘤が認められ、MRIで確認された。外科的切除を行い、病理組織学的検査で鼻咽頭奇形腫と診断された。フォローアップ中、患児は良好な経過をたどっている。
pmid-20061587.summary_en: This case report describes a term female neonate who presented within the first week of life with episodic stridor, apnea, and cyanosis. Laryngoscopy revealed a mass that MRI confirmed. The mass was surgically excised and diagnosed on histopathology as nasopharyngeal teratoma. The infant is doing well on follow-up. The report documents its presentation, imaging, surgical management, and favorable outcome, illustrating a rare cause of neonatal airway obstruction.

pmid-20062623.summary_ja: 32歳男性の精巣腫瘍例。セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫から成る混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、体細胞型の肉腫成分を伴っていた。高位精巣摘除術とBEP化学療法を受けたが、2コース後に治療を中断した。腫瘍マーカーは正常化したものの、後腹膜の再発と肺転移が生じた。
pmid-20062623.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with a testicular mixed germ cell tumor comprising seminoma, yolk sac tumor, and teratoma, with a somatic-type sarcomatous (rhabdomyosarcomatous) component. He presented with scrotal swelling, and metastases involved retroperitoneal lymph nodes and the psoas muscle. After orchidectomy and BEP chemotherapy, he discontinued treatment after two cycles. Tumor markers normalized, but retroperitoneal relapse and lung metastases subsequently developed.

pmid-20062626.summary_ja: 肝奇形腫に腹膜グリオーマ症を伴った症例の報告。腹膜グリオーマ症は奇形腫の腹膜播種の存在を示唆する所見である。壁の石灰化、均一性、明瞭な境界から、画像上は最も多い鑑別診断である包虫嚢胞が疑われた。肝奇形腫はまれだが、不明な肝嚢胞の評価では念頭に置くべきである。
pmid-20062626.summary_en: This case report describes a hepatic teratoma associated with peritoneal gliomatosis, a finding that indicates ongoing peritoneal spread of teratoma. Wall calcifications, homogeneity, and a well-defined border led radiologists toward an echinococcal cyst, the most common differential diagnosis. The authors emphasize that hepatic teratoma should be considered when evaluating unclear hepatic cysts, even though it is very rare, with only 25 cases previously published.

pmid-20126588.summary_ja: 30歳男性の5cm大の精巣腫瘍。古典型セミノーマに、8mmの紡錘形細胞からなる結節が併存していた。結節は低悪性度の核異型を示し、増殖活性は最大20%であった。胚細胞腫瘍の他の成分は認めず、低悪性度肉腫成分を伴う純粋な古典型セミノーマの初報告とされる。
pmid-20126588.summary_en: The authors describe a 30-year-old man with a 5 cm testicular tumor showing classical seminoma and a separate 8 mm nodule composed of spindle cells with low-grade atypia and up to 20% proliferative activity. The nodule was separated from the tunica albuginea by seminiferous tubules containing intratesticular germ cell neoplasia, and no other germ cell tumor components were present. This is presented as the first report of pure classical seminoma with an associated low-grade sarcomatous component.

pmid-20136036.summary_ja: 22歳女性が、風邪様症状の後に記憶障害、妄想、幻覚、精神運動興奮を呈し、統合失調症が疑われた。その後、痙攣、ジスキネジア、中枢性低換気を生じた。脳画像は正常だったが、腹部CTで卵巣奇形腫が疑われる充実性腫瘍が認められた。脳脊髄液と血清で抗NMDA受容体抗体が陽性であった。ガンマグロブリン療法と奇形腫の摘出により、後遺症なく回復した。
pmid-20136036.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman who developed short-term memory loss, delusions, hallucinations, and psychomotor excitement after a cold-like illness, initially suspected to be schizophrenia. She later developed convulsions, dyskinesias, and central hypoventilation. Brain imaging was normal, but abdominal CT revealed a solid tumor, likely an ovarian teratoma. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were positive in CSF and serum. Gamma globulin therapy and removal of the teratoma led to full recovery without sequelae.

pmid-20364752.summary_ja: パキスタンのNawabshah病院で2007年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患30例を後方視的に解析した症例集積である。胞状奇胎が70%を占め、侵入性疾患23.3%、絨毛癌6.6%であった。発生頻度は出生1000対28と高値であった。76.6%が化学療法を受け、96.7%が完全回復し、1例は脳転移により死亡した。
pmid-20364752.summary_en: This retrospective descriptive case series from Nawabshah Medical College Hospital, Pakistan, reviewed 30 gestational trophoblastic disease cases admitted in 2007. Hydatidiform mole accounted for 70%, invasive disease for 23.3%, and choriocarcinoma for 6.6%. The GTD frequency was 28 per 1000 live births, higher than national and international reports. Most patients received chemotherapy, and 96.7% recovered fully, while one patient died from brain metastasis.

pmid-20512293.summary_ja: ターナー症候群におけるY染色体の関与を総説し、性腺芽腫などの性腺腫瘍のリスク上昇との関連を検討した。性腺芽腫の約60%はディスジャーミノーマへ、他の悪性胚細胞腫瘍へも移行しうる。X・Y染色体のモザイク現象は一般的であり、核型にかかわらずY染色体配列をPCRで検出し、性腺病変を予防することが必要と結論している。
pmid-20512293.summary_en: This review examines Y-chromosome material in Turner syndrome, which is linked to increased risk of gonadal tumors, especially gonadoblastoma. Gonadoblastoma can transform into invasive dysgerminoma in about 60% of cases and into other malignant germ cell tumors. The authors note that X and Y chromosome mosaicism is common and that gonadoblastoma prevalence estimates vary. They conclude that PCR screening for Y-chromosome sequences, regardless of karyotype, is needed to prevent gonadal lesions.

pmid-20531999.summary_ja: 前縦隔腫瘤、痙攣性疾患、精神遅滞を呈した症例である。CTガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。染色体解析でXXY核型が確認され、クラインフェルター症候群と縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。性染色体異常を背景に、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と神経症状が併存した点が特徴である。
pmid-20531999.summary_en: This case report describes a patient presenting with an anterior mediastinal mass, seizure disorder, and mental retardation. CT-guided fine-needle aspiration of the mass revealed a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Chromosomal analysis showed an XXY karyotype, leading to diagnoses of Klinefelter syndrome and mediastinal germ cell tumor. The case illustrates an association between a mediastinal germ cell tumor, a sex chromosome abnormality and neurological symptoms.

pmid-20596986.summary_ja: 23歳男性の副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫（SNTCS）症例である。奇形腫と癌肉腫の特徴を併せ持つ高悪性度腫瘍で、診断は3回目の生検で確定した。術前化学療法4サイクル後の切除標本では、原始神経外胚葉成分に広範な神経細胞成熟が認められ、未分化細胞は消失していた。SNTCSにおける化学療法誘発性の成熟の報告は初めてである。
pmid-20596986.summary_en: This report describes a 23-year-old man with sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma (SNTCS), a highly malignant tumor combining teratoma and carcinosarcoma features. The diagnosis was made on the third biopsy. After four cycles of neoadjuvant chemotherapy, resection showed extensive neuronal maturation in the primitive neuroectodermal component, with complete absence of undifferentiated cells. The authors describe chemotherapy-induced maturation in SNTCS, which had not previously been reported.

pmid-20640096.summary_ja: 妊娠35週の超音波検査で指摘された10 cm大の頸部奇形腫の胎児に対し、EXIT手技の麻酔管理を報告した。胎児を部分娩出して子宮-胎盤循環を維持したうえで気道確保と腫瘤切除を行い、乳児は術後7日目に合併症なく退院した。母体・胎児の安全性、子宮弛緩、胎児の不動化が重要であると結論づけている。
pmid-20640096.summary_en: This case report describes anaesthetic management of ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) for a fetus with a 10 cm cervical teratoma, detected by ultrasonography at 35 weeks. Under general anaesthesia with controlled ventilation, the fetus was partially delivered to preserve placental circulation, allowing fetal laryngoscopy and tracheal intubation before mass excision. The infant was extubated on postoperative day four and discharged without complications on day seven. The authors emphasize maternal-fetal safety, uterine relaxation, and fetal immobility as key principles for EXIT.

pmid-20668609.summary_ja: 18歳男性に発生した稀な胸腺セミノーマの症例報告である。前縦隔腫瘤を切除したが、術後8か月間フォローアップを受けなかった。その後、局所再発と肺・大動脈周囲リンパ節への転移で再来し、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる化学療法が行われた。術後の定期的なフォローアップの重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-20668609.summary_en: This case report describes a rare primary thymic seminoma in an 18-year-old man who presented with chest pain, dyspnea, and dysphagia. Imaging revealed an anterior mediastinal mass, which was resected and histologically diagnosed as seminoma. The patient did not attend follow-up for eight months and later presented with local recurrence and metastases to the lungs and para-aortic and peri-aortic nodes. He was treated with cisplatin, bleomycin, and etoposide, and the report highlights the importance of adherence to surveillance.

pmid-20737043.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後の難治性胚細胞腫瘍の症例に、スニチニブリンゴ酸塩を投与した報告である。文献から治療標的を同定し、本剤を選択した。胚細胞腫瘍に対するスニチニブの使用は初めての報告であり、有望な活性が示された。従来治療に抵抗性の症例に対する分子標的療法の選択肢となり得ることを示唆している。
pmid-20737043.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with refractory germ cell tumor, including disease refractory after bone marrow transplantation, treated with sunitinib malate. Targets were identified from the literature and sunitinib was selected for the patient. The authors state this is the first reported use of sunitinib in a germ cell tumor, and they observed promising activity. The report suggests that targeted agents may offer a therapeutic option for patients with refractory disease where conventional treatment has failed.

pmid-20740176.summary_ja: 妊娠後期の若年女性が喀血と呼吸不全で受診し、転移性肺絨毛癌と診断された症例報告である。胸部X線所見からの診断の難しさが論じられている。絨毛癌は化学療法への感受性が高いため、早期診断が重要である。生殖年齢の女性で非典型的な胸部X線所見を認めた場合には、絨毛癌を鑑別に含めるべきと提言されている。
pmid-20740176.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman in her third trimester who presented with hemoptysis and respiratory failure and was diagnosed with metastatic pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The authors discuss the diagnostic difficulty posed by the chest radiograph findings, which were bilateral pulmonary infiltrates, and briefly review current treatment approaches. Because choriocarcinoma is highly responsive to chemotherapy, early recognition is critical. They recommend that choriocarcinoma be considered in women of reproductive age with unusual chest radiographs.

pmid-21319013.summary_ja: 口腔底から右頸部に及ぶ新生児奇形腫が、3回の切除後に悪性転化した症例である。最終切除から3か月後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇と、胎児性癌・卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍が確認された。JEB療法8コースと再発腫瘤の切除で完全寛解を得た。新生児期の頭頸部奇形腫は完全切除と多職種による管理が重要と述べられている。
pmid-21319013.summary_en: This report describes a full-term neonate with a cervicofacial teratoma of the floor of the mouth and right neck that was initially diagnosed as mature teratoma after three resections. Three months after the last surgery, the neck mass enlarged rapidly, serum alpha-fetoprotein rose, and biopsy showed a germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor components. Eight courses of JEB chemotherapy with resection of recurrent masses achieved complete regression without compromising growth or cosmesis. The authors stress multidisciplinary management and complete excision of neonatal head and neck teratomas to reduce malignant change risk.

pmid-21686482.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で胃に連続する腫瘤として検出された新生児の巨大胃未熟奇形腫の症例である。腫瘤は妊娠34週から37週の間に増大した。生後10日目に切除され、病理組織学的にグレードIIIの未熟奇形腫と診断された。補助療法なしで良好に回復し、9か月後も再発を認めていない。出生前診断の有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-21686482.summary_en: This case report describes a giant immature teratoma of the stomach in a neonate, first detected by prenatal ultrasonography at 34 weeks as an echogenic mass that grew from 4.5 to 7 cm. Delivery was by elective caesarean section at 37 weeks, and differential diagnosis on neonatal imaging included nephroblastoma, neuroblastoma, pancreatoblastoma, and teratoma. Surgical excision on day 10 revealed grade III immature gastric teratoma arising from the posterior stomach wall. The infant recovered well without adjuvant therapy and remained free of recurrence at nine months.

pmid-21686767.summary_ja: 12歳の女児が未熟奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症で発症した症例報告である。一次および二次化学療法に反応せず、経過は異常に難治であった。遺伝子検査でLi-Fraumeni症候群に関連するTP53変異（R248W）が確認され、父親にも同じ変異がみられた。典型的でない腫瘍像であっても遺伝学的検討が重要であることが強調され、同意のうえで家族の検査が提案されている。
pmid-21686767.summary_en: This case report describes a 12-year-old girl with a strong family history of malignancy who presented with immature teratoma and gliomatosis peritonei. Despite first- and second-line chemotherapy, the disease followed an unusually refractory course. Genetic testing revealed a Li-Fraumeni syndrome-associated TP53 variant (CGG>TGG, R248W), which was also found in her father. The authors emphasize that genetic study is valuable even when a tumor presentation is atypical for a familial cancer syndrome, and they recommend family screening with consent.

pmid-21686771.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴う辺縁系脳炎の症例報告である。血清と脳脊髄液の両方から海馬神経細胞膜に対する抗体が検出された。血漿交換と大量静注免疫グロブリン療法により臨床症状は速やかに回復した。卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍が自己免疫性の脳炎を引き起こしうること、そして免疫抑制療法が神経症状の可逆的な改善をもたらしうることを示す症例である。
pmid-21686771.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with limbic encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. Antibodies against the membranes of hippocampal neurons were detected in both serum and cerebrospinal fluid. Treatment with plasmapheresis and high-dose intravenous immunoglobulin led to rapid clinical recovery. The case illustrates a paraneoplastic neurological syndrome in which an ovarian germ cell tumor triggers autoimmune encephalitis, and it highlights that immunosuppressive therapy can produce rapid, reversible neurological recovery.

pmid-21686882.summary_ja: 早産児（30週）の女児に生じた、経口腔へ突出する広範な鼻咽腔奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍が気道を完全に閉塞したため、直ちに気管挿管を要した。腫瘍は外切開を用いず経口的に切除され、病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と診断された。新生児における鼻咽腔奇形腫の稀な発症形式について、治療と鑑別診断を含めて文献的に考察している。
pmid-21686882.summary_en: This report describes a premature 30-week-old girl with an extensive nasopharyngeal teratoma protruding from the oral cavity, causing complete airway obstruction that required immediate intubation. The tumor was resected transorally without external incisions. Histology revealed a mature teratoma. The authors discuss management and differential diagnosis and review the literature on this rare neonatal presentation, noting that teratomas are otherwise the most common congenital tumors.

pmid-21687015.summary_ja: 60歳女性の胆嚢に原発した胚様奇形腫の症例報告である。病理組織学的検査で胚様体、合胞体栄養膜細胞、成熟および未熟な神経外胚葉・中胚葉成分が認められた。胆嚢上皮には内胚葉性腫瘍を示唆する上皮内変化と増殖性変化がみられた。成人臓器に原始的な腫瘍が生じる機序として、発生期に休眠していた細胞が腫瘍形成時に再活性化する可能性を提案している。
pmid-21687015.summary_en: This report describes a primary embryoid teratomatous neoplasm of the gallbladder in a 60-year-old woman. Histopathology showed embryoid bodies, syncytiotrophoblasts, and mature and immature neuroectodermal and mesodermal elements. The overlying gallbladder epithelium showed in situ and proliferative changes suggesting an endodermal tumor. Ultrasonography and MRI of other abdominal and pelvic organs were normal. The authors propose that primitive neoplasms can arise in adult organs from dormant embryonic cells reactivated during oncogenesis.

pmid-21772904.summary_ja: 30代の女性2例に発生した、純粋原発性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告である。極めて稀な疾患で、妊娠性または非妊娠性の起源をもつ可能性がある。妊娠黄体の存在は妊娠性由来を示唆するが、確定診断には遺伝学的解析が必要とされる。本報告では、この稀な卵巣腫瘍について起源を判定することの難しさを浮き彫りにしている。
pmid-21772904.summary_en: This report describes two women in their thirties with pure primary ovarian choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare entity of gestational or nongestational origin. The authors note that a corpus luteum of pregnancy may suggest a gestational origin, but definitive diagnosis would require genetic analysis. The two cases are presented to highlight the diagnostic challenge of determining the origin of this rare ovarian tumor.

pmid-21772911.summary_ja: 流産と胞状奇胎、絨毛癌を鑑別するためにp63とKi-67の免疫組織化学染色を評価した研究である。非水腫性流産14例、部分胞状奇胎12例、完全胞状奇胎12例、絨毛癌12例を対象とした。絨毛癌では細胞性栄養膜細胞のKi-67発現が高度であり、流産および部分胞状奇胎ではびまん性の陽性所見は認められなかった。細胞性栄養膜細胞のKi-67標識指数が最も有用な指標であると結論づけている。
pmid-21772911.summary_en: This study evaluated p63 and Ki-67 immunohistochemistry to distinguish spontaneous abortion from hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinoma. Samples from 14 nonhydropic abortions, 12 partial moles, 12 complete moles, and 12 choriocarcinomas were examined. Ki-67 labeling was severe in cytotrophoblasts of all choriocarcinomas, whereas no abortion or partial mole showed diffuse Ki-67 labeling. The authors conclude that the Ki-67 labeling index in cytotrophoblastic cells is the best marker for differentiating these lesions, outperforming p63.

pmid-21789067.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんの導入化学療法後に後腹膜に残存する腫瘤の管理を概説する総説である。シスプラチン併用化学療法と化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清（PC-RPLND）の組み合わせにより、長期生存率は80%を超えている。小さな残存腫瘤の扱い、残存組織型の予測因子、郭清範囲、腫瘍マーカー上昇例での役割、陽電子放射断層撮影の位置づけなど、残された論争点を検討している。現行のガイドラインもまとめている。
pmid-21789067.summary_en: This review examines management of the residual retroperitoneal mass after induction chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. Multidisciplinary care combining cisplatin-based chemotherapy with postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) has raised long-term survival above 80%. The authors discuss persistent controversies, including management of small residual masses, predictors of residual histology, the extent of PC-RPLND, its role with elevated tumor markers, and positron emission tomography. They summarize current guidelines.

pmid-21938149.summary_ja: 27歳男性が、精巣の胎児性癌の初発症状として胸壁皮下腫瘤を呈した細胞診症例である。穿刺吸引細胞診（FNAC）で診断され、その後に精巣原発巣が同定された。散在性の細胞や微小腺腔様のパターンなど、胎児性癌の細胞形態学的特徴が示されている。胎児性癌の皮下転移は稀で、進行した病態を示すことが多い。早期診断における細胞診の役割が強調されている。
pmid-21938149.summary_en: This cytology report describes a 27-year-old man whose first presentation of testicular embryonal carcinoma was a chest wall subcutaneous mass. Fine needle aspiration cytology established the diagnosis, and the testicular primary was identified afterward. The authors describe the cytomorphological features of embryonal carcinoma, including dispersed cells and microglandular aggregates, and emphasize the role of cytology in early diagnosis. Subcutaneous metastases of embryonal carcinoma are rare and usually indicate advanced disease.

pmid-21938161.summary_ja: 34歳の経産婦に生じた両側卵巣ディスジャーミノーマの細胞診症例である。腹部腫瘤、腹水、腹痛を呈し、尿中および血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇していた。超音波ガイド下経腹穿刺吸引細胞診で、合胞体栄養膜巨細胞を伴うディスジャーミノーマと診断された。両側卵巣摘出術の病理組織学的検査で確定診断された。卵巣の胚細胞悪性腫瘍の術前診断におけるFNACの有用性を示している。
pmid-21938161.summary_en: This cytology report describes a 34-year-old multiparous woman with bilateral ovarian dysgerminoma presenting with an abdominal lump, ascites, abdominal pain, and elevated urinary and serum hCG. Ultrasound-guided transabdominal fine needle aspiration showed dysgerminoma with syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. Bilateral oophorectomy confirmed the diagnosis on histopathology. The authors note that about 2% of nonpregnant patients with dysgerminoma have elevated hCG, illustrating the value of FNAC in the preoperative diagnosis of ovarian germ cell malignancy.

pmid-21938171.summary_ja: 33歳男性に生じた精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍（成熟奇形腫60%、卵黄嚢腫瘍40%）で、縦隔転移を呈した細胞診症例である。当初は悪性リンパ腫や気管支腫瘍と誤診されたが、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値を契機に精巣病変が見つかり、精巣摘除術で確定した。前縦隔からのFNAC標本の細胞形態学的特徴を記述し、胚細胞腫瘍や卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分を示唆する所見として考察している。
pmid-21938171.summary_en: This cytology report describes a 33-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis (60% mature teratoma, 40% yolk sac tumor) presenting with a mediastinal metastasis. Initially misdiagnosed as lymphoma or bronchial tumor, the patient was ultimately diagnosed after elevated AFP prompted scrotal ultrasonography and orchiectomy. The authors describe cytopathological features of anterior mediastinal FNAC specimens, which showed discohesive, pleomorphic small nuclei with cytoplasmic microvacuoles, suggesting germ cell and yolk sac tumor components.

pmid-22439034.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の一つである胞状奇胎の管理についてレビューしている。完全・部分胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などを含む。転移が広範囲でも治癒しうる点を強調し、経膣超音波検査とβ-hCGの定期測定の重要性に言及している。現在の化学療法により、多くの悪性例で妊孕性を温存しつつ治癒が得られると述べている。
pmid-22439034.summary_en: This review covers management of molar pregnancy within gestational trophoblastic disease, which includes complete and partial hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Although rare, GTD can be cured even with widespread metastases. The authors highlight the role of transvaginal ultrasound and routine beta-hCG monitoring, and note that current chemotherapy allows most women with malignant disease to be cured while preserving fertility.

pmid-23139473.summary_ja: 頭頸部に生じる奇形腫を総説している。多くは頸部に発生し、口咽頭(epignathus)が次いで多い部位である。臨床像、挙動、臨床的意義を解説し、歯科医や関連専門医が認識すべき点を強調している。三胚葉由来の組織から成り、成熟度にばらつきがあることも述べている。起源が不明瞭で組織像も多様なため、予測しにくい経過をたどることがある。
pmid-23139473.summary_en: This article reviews head and neck teratomas, which are most often cervical, with the oropharynx (epignathus) as the second most common site. It describes their clinical presentation, behavior, and clinical significance. Teratomas are composed of tissues from all three germ layers with variable maturity. Because of their obscure origin, bizarre histology, and unpredictable course, the authors stress that dental surgeons and specialists should recognize these lesions.

pmid-24591863.summary_ja: 三次病院で9年間に治療された異所性妊娠101例のうち、卵管破裂を伴う胞状奇胎は5例のみであった。全例が急性腹症を呈し、緊急手術を要した。組織学的には輪状の栄養膜増殖と水腫性変性がみられた。診断には厳密な組織学的基準が重要であり、悪性化を防ぐためヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の連続測定が必要と述べている。
pmid-24591863.summary_en: This report analyzes patients with ectopic gestation treated over nine years at a tertiary hospital. Of 101 ectopic pregnancies, five were ruptured tubal hydatidiform moles, all presenting with acute abdominal symptoms that required emergency surgery. Histology showed circumferential trophoblastic proliferation and hydropic degeneration. The authors stress strict histologic criteria for diagnosis and serial hCG monitoring to detect malignant trophoblastic disease early.

pmid-27582828.summary_ja: 妊娠中期に重度の血小板減少を呈した26歳の患者の症例報告で、卵巣奇形腫を合併していた。妊娠の6~7%で血小板減少症が合併することが背景として示される。妊娠中に特発性血小板減少症と卵巣奇形腫が併存する稀な症例であることを強調している。治療経過や転帰については要旨に詳細な記載はない。
pmid-27582828.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old patient with severe thrombocytopenia in the second trimester of pregnancy, associated with an ovarian teratoma. Thrombocytopenia complicates roughly 6-7% of pregnancies. The case highlights the rare coexistence of idiopathic thrombocytopenia and ovarian teratoma during pregnancy. The abstract provides limited detail on management or outcome.

pmid-16685735.summary_ja: Currarino症候群の家系で、仙骨奇形腫から末梢性原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍への悪性転化を来した症例を報告する。仙骨前部腫瘤、仙骨形成不全、肛門直腸奇形の三徴が特徴である。詳細な家族歴の聴取により早期診断や過剰治療の回避が可能だったと考察している。
pmid-16685735.summary_en: This report describes Currarino syndrome, a rare genetic disorder with presacral mass, sacral agenesis, and anorectal anomalies, in a family with multigenerational teratomas and spinal abnormalities. The index patient had a sacral teratoma that showed unusual malignant transformation into a peripheral primitive neuroectodermal tumour. The authors emphasise that a detailed family history at presentation could have enabled earlier diagnosis and possibly avoided intensive treatment with late sequelae.

pmid-17243131.summary_ja: Apert症候群の13歳女児に卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が発生した症例である。FGFR2遺伝子に典型的なc.758C>G変異を認めた。腫瘍細胞では軽度の染色体の増減が確認された。FGFR2変異の腫瘍発生への関与が示唆されるが、単一症例では因果関係は証明できない。
pmid-17243131.summary_en: This report describes a 13-year-old girl with Apert syndrome who developed an ovarian dysgerminoma. Sequencing of FGFR2 exon 7 revealed the classic Apert c.758C>G (p.Pro253Arg) mutation. Genomic analysis of the tumour cells showed low-level chromosomal gains and losses. The authors describe this as only the second report linking Apert syndrome with cancer and propose that FGFR2 mutations may play a role in tumorigenesis, though a single case cannot establish causation.

pmid-17401599.summary_ja: 腹腔内停留精巣に生じたセミノーマの症例報告である。画像上は腸間膜または後腹膜の腫瘤と類似していた。腫瘤を還流する蔓状静脈叢とその内部の血栓の同定が、停留精巣における精巣癌の診断に重要な役割を果たしうると述べている。鑑別診断の観点からも示唆に富む。
pmid-17401599.summary_en: This case report describes a seminoma arising in an intraabdominal undescended testis. On imaging, the tumor mimicked a mesenteric or retroperitoneal mass. The authors highlight that identifying the pampiniform plexus draining the mass, and a thrombus within it, can aid diagnosis of testicular carcinoma in an undescended testis. The report emphasizes that recognizing venous drainage patterns can distinguish undescended testicular tumors from other abdominal masses, which matters for accurate diagnosis and surgical planning.

pmid-17466041.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の卵巣類内膜腺癌に卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴った症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍領域はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。手術と化学療法の後、20か月間無腫瘍で経過した。体細胞癌が胚外胚細胞への分化を獲得しうることを示唆する。
pmid-17466041.summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with ovarian endometrioid adenocarcinoma containing a yolk sac tumor component. The yolk sac tumor areas expressed alpha-fetoprotein but were negative for CA125 and sex-hormone receptors. The yolk sac component was negative for cytokeratin 7 and epithelial membrane antigen. She received surgery and combination chemotherapy, and remained tumor-free for 20 months. The authors suggest that somatic carcinomas may acquire extraembryonic germ cell differentiation.

pmid-17466047.summary_ja: 英国の施設による、病期I卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して補助化学療法を行わない厳重サーベイランスの安全性の検討である。37例の中央値6年の観察で、再発は非ディスジャーミノーマで36%、ディスジャーミノーマで22%であった。再発例の多くは白金製剤で救済可能であった。
pmid-17466047.summary_en: This review from a UK center evaluates surveillance without routine adjuvant chemotherapy for stage I ovarian germ cell tumors. Among 37 patients followed for a median of 6 years, relapse occurred in 36% of stage IA nondysgerminomatous tumors and 22% of dysgerminomas. Most relapses were cured with platinum-based chemotherapy, and disease-specific survival was 94%. More than half of patients who underwent fertility-sparing surgery later conceived. The authors question routine adjuvant chemotherapy for nondysgerminomatous tumors.

pmid-17554793.summary_ja: ブラジルの小児・思春期胚細胞腫瘍106例を後方視的に解析した研究である。病期、転移状況、診断時の手術方法が予後因子であった。最新のTCG-91プロトコルで5年全生存期間(全生存率)は80.6%に改善した。シスプラチンとエトポシドによるリスク適応型治療が有効であった。
pmid-17554793.summary_en: This retrospective study from Brazil reviews 106 children and adolescents with germ cell tumors treated across three protocol periods. Stage, metastatic status, and surgical approach at diagnosis were key prognostic factors. Five-year overall survival rose from 42.9% and 53.9% in the early periods to 80.6% in the most recent TCG-91 protocol. That protocol used a risk-adapted approach with only cisplatin and etoposide, and the authors conclude that complex three-agent regimens may not be necessary for selected patients.

pmid-17619944.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症で染色体は男性型の31歳女性の症例報告である。鼠径ヘルニアと推定された腫瘤が、表題ではセミノーマとされている。早期診断の重要性と、ヘルニアとして誤診された場合の影響を論じる。標準治療は両側精巣摘除とホルモン補充療法である。
pmid-17619944.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old phenotypic female with complete androgen insensitivity, who was chromosomally male and presented with a presumed inguinal hernia. The title identifies the lesion in this patient as a seminoma. The authors discuss the importance of early diagnosis, the consequences of misdiagnosis, and whether such patients have been appropriately managed in the past. Standard management includes bilateral orchidectomy and hormone replacement therapy.

pmid-17653741.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫（病期IIIc）の妊婦に対し、妊娠29週から分娩まで、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンを2コース投与した経過を報告している。母体は1.5年間再発を認めず、児に奇形や神経発達の異常は認められなかった。妊娠後期の化学療法曝露に関する文献的考察も含まれる。
pmid-17653741.summary_en: This case report describes a pregnant woman with stage IIIc ovarian immature teratoma who received two cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin from the 29th week of gestation until delivery. The patient showed no recurrence of ovarian cancer over 1.5 years. Her infant had no major or minor malformations and showed normal neurological development during follow-up. The authors also review the limited literature on chemotherapy exposure during pregnancy and suggest that third-trimester administration may be feasible.

pmid-17662077.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後の精巣限局性胚細胞腫瘍に対する治療戦略を総説した論文である。臨床病期Iのセミノーマでは放射線療法、サーベイランス、化学療法が、非セミノーマでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清、サーベイランス、化学療法が選択肢となる。生存率に明確な差が乏しいことから、副作用や生活の質が重視される。補助化学療法の知見や予後因子にも言及している。
pmid-17662077.summary_en: This review examines management options for testis-confined germ cell tumours after orchidectomy. Clinical stage I seminomas may be managed with radiotherapy, surveillance, or chemotherapy, while stage I nonseminomas may undergo retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, surveillance, or chemotherapy. Because survival outcomes are likely similar across approaches, the authors emphasize acute and late toxicity, acceptability, and quality of life as key decision factors. The review also discusses adjuvant chemotherapy evidence in seminoma and nonseminoma, prognostic factors, and future directions.

pmid-17701427.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の稀な疾患を総説した論文である。血清hCGが低値で変動しやすく、絨毛癌や妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍、潜在性妊娠性絨毛性疾患との鑑別が難しい。胚細胞腫瘍も鑑別診断として考慮すべきである。治療は外科手術が基本で、EMA/COを第一選択とし、抵抗性例にはEMA/EPを用いる。
pmid-17701427.summary_en: This review covers placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare neoplasm arising from intermediate trophoblasts. Its low and variable serum hCG makes it difficult to distinguish from choriocarcinoma, gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, or quiescent gestational trophoblastic disease. PSTT may follow normal or molar pregnancy and ranges from benign to fatal. Germ cell tumors must be included in the differential diagnosis. Surgery is central, with EMA/CO as first-line chemotherapy and EMA/EP for refractory cases.

pmid-17703093.summary_ja: 腹腔鏡下に捻転を解除した卵巣に骨盤内膿瘍が生じた症例報告である。卵巣は完全に壊死しており、内部に予期せず類皮嚢腫（成熟奇形腫）が存在していた。壊死卵巣に残存した組織成分が膿瘍形成の原因と考えられる。著者らは、腹腔鏡手術の終了前に捻転解除した卵巣を十分に検査し、壊死が残り類皮嚢腫が疑われる場合は速やかに摘出することを推奨している。
pmid-17703093.summary_en: This case report describes pelvic abscess formation in an ovary that had been detorted laparoscopically and was found to contain an unsuspected dermoid cyst, a mature teratoma. The ovary was completely necrotic, and tissue components not cleared by the peritoneal immune system likely led to abscess development. The authors recommend thorough inspection of detorsed ovaries before ending laparoscopic surgery. If an ovary remains necrotic and a dermoid cyst is suspected, prompt removal is advised to prevent this complication.

pmid-17716791.summary_ja: 上顎・口蓋・蝶形骨に由来する稀な先天性上咽頭奇形腫（エピグナトス）の2症例報告である。腫瘍は口から突出し、上気道閉塞や出生直後の死亡の原因となりうる。両症例とも三胚葉すべてに由来する組織を含んでいた。画像所見と術中所見から、蝶形骨前部から発生し、頭蓋内との交通のない蝶形骨洞裂隙を生じたことが示された。
pmid-17716791.summary_en: This report describes two cases of epignathus, a rare congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma arising from the upper jaw, palate, and sphenoid bone. These tumours protrude through the mouth and can cause upper airway obstruction and early neonatal death. Both cases contained tissues derived from all three germ layers, including dental bud, fat, muscle, mucosal epithelium, and normal skin with fine hair. Imaging and surgery showed that both originated from the anterior sphenoid bone, causing a sphenoidal sinus cleft without intracranial communication.

pmid-17764111.summary_ja: 南オランダ（1970〜2004年）の精巣がん罹患率は1989年まで安定し、その後は年4〜6%増加した。増加は主に限局性腫瘍によるもので、セミノーマでは35〜39歳、非セミノーマでは20〜24歳で最も顕著だった。APC解析では1945年以降の出生コホートとの強い相関が示され、幼少期の未知の危険因子が示唆された。死亡率は1970年の10万人年あたり1.0から2005年の0.3へ低下し、1979〜1986年には年12%の急減があった。
pmid-17764111.summary_en: This registry-based study of testicular cancer in southern Netherlands (1970–2004) found incidence stable until 1989, then rising 4–6% annually, mainly from localised tumours. The largest increases occurred in seminoma patients aged 35–39 and non-seminoma patients aged 20–24. Age-period-cohort analysis indicated birth-cohort effects, with incidence rising in cohorts since 1950 and most strongly correlated with cohorts since 1945, suggesting an unidentified early-life exposure. Mortality fell from 1.0 to 0.3 per 100,000, with a steep 12% annual decline during 1979–1986.

pmid-17828545.summary_ja: 6歳女児の仙骨部皮下腫瘤は、仙尾部奇形腫由来と考えられる腺癌と診断された。画像検査では所属リンパ節を伴う巨大腫瘍が示され、FDG-PETで高い集積を認めた。化学療法の反応は不良で、腫瘍は外科的に切除された。術後5か月のPETで腹膜、肝、肺への転移が判明した。この年齢の小児で仙尾部奇形腫の体細胞性悪性転化が報告された初の例とされる。
pmid-17828545.summary_en: A six-year-old girl presented with a subcutaneous sacral mass, biopsied as an adenocarcinoma most likely arising from a sacrococcygeal teratoma. Imaging showed a large tumour with regional nodal involvement, and chemotherapy produced a poor response. Surgical removal was followed by widespread peritoneal, hepatic and pulmonary metastases on PET imaging five months later. The authors note that somatic malignant transformation of a sacrococcygeal teratoma has not previously been reported in a child of this age.

pmid-17853266.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の再発に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎により、長期間持続するカタトニアを呈した40歳男性の症例報告である。当初セミノーマと診断された腫瘍が、7年の無症状期間後に再発していた。ハロペリドールとロラゼパムが最も有効で、腫瘍の反復切除や血漿交換療法も一部症状を軽減した。腫瘍の制御により患者は完全に回復した。
pmid-17853266.summary_en: A 40-year-old man had paraneoplastic encephalitis causing long-lasting catatonia, linked to a testicular neoplasm that recurred after a seven-year symptom-free interval. MRI was unremarkable, while FDG-PET showed frontal and left temporal hypometabolism. Repeated tumour resections and plasmapheresis partially relieved symptoms, and haloperidol and lorazepam were most effective. Electroconvulsive therapy gave temporary benefit, and symptoms worsened with further recurrences until the tumour was controlled and the patient recovered fully.

pmid-17882443.summary_ja: 53歳女性が付属器腫瘤に対して子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術を受け、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。術後の超音波検査で見つかった甲状腺の0.5cmの結節に対し甲状腺全摘術が行われたが、病理では良性の結節性過形成であった。1年間再発はない。稀少性のため管理は統一されておらず、再発率の上昇が報告されるため、サイログロブリンによる長期フォローアップの必要性が示されている。
pmid-17882443.summary_en: A 53-year-old woman underwent hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for an adnexal mass and was diagnosed with malignant struma ovarii. Thyroid ultrasound revealed a 0.5 cm nodule, which after total thyroidectomy was pathologically benign nodular hyperplasia. She remained disease-free for one year. The authors emphasise that the rarity of malignant struma ovarii means management is not standardised, and that long-term thyroglobulin follow-up is necessary because recurrence rates appear to be rising.

pmid-17890867.summary_ja: 53歳女性の巨大骨盤内腫瘤例で、両側卵管卵巣摘出術と病期分類を施行。甲状腺機能は正常だったが、病理組織学的に卵巣甲状腺腫由来の乳頭状甲状腺癌（悪性卵巣甲状腺腫）と診断された。若年者で病期Ia例では片側卵巣摘出と完全な外科的病期分類を考慮し、サイログロブリンや陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)による長期フォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-17890867.summary_en: A 53-year-old woman presented with a large pelvic mass and underwent bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with staging surgery. Although she was clinically euthyroid, histopathology revealed papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, a rare malignant monodermal ovarian teratoma. No metastases or nodal involvement were found. The authors recommend unilateral oophorectomy with complete surgical staging in young patients with stage Ia disease. They also suggest long-term surveillance with serum thyroglobulin, radioiodine scanning, or PET/CT to detect recurrence in selected patients.

pmid-17898324.summary_ja: 当初「若年性急性非ヘルペス性脳炎」と診断された日本人女性4例が、抗NMDA受容体脳炎と確定診断された。精神症状、低換気、不随意運動などが認められ、2例は長期の人工呼吸を要した。3例では卵巣奇形腫が病理組織学的に確認された。腫瘍摘出なしでも認知機能は回復したが、症状の重篤さと持続期間から腫瘍摘出の必要性が示唆されている。
pmid-17898324.summary_en: Four Japanese women initially diagnosed with juvenile acute nonherpetic encephalitis were later found to have anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. All experienced psychosis, hypoventilation, orofacial dyskinesias, and immunotherapy-resistant involuntary movements, and two required prolonged mechanical ventilation. Antibodies against NR1/NR2 heteromers were detected in archived samples. An ovarian teratoma was pathologically confirmed in three patients. Most recovered cognitively without tumor resection, although the authors argue that the severity and duration of symptoms support tumor removal.

pmid-17934297.summary_ja: 在胎児期に診断された大きな仙尾部奇形腫を伴う、妊娠27週1日の極早産児の症例報告。極早産児の大きな仙尾部奇形腫は予後不良とされるが、分娩計画、出生後の安定化、外科的切除を多職種で集中的に計画することで良好な転帰が得られた。多職種連携の重要性を示した。
pmid-17934297.summary_en: This case report describes an extremely premature infant (27 weeks and 1 day of gestation) with a large sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed antenatally and complicated by cardiac decompensation. Large sacrococcygeal teratomas in very premature infants are generally associated with a very poor outcome. A favorable result was achieved through intensive multidisciplinary planning of delivery, postnatal stabilization, and surgical resection. The report highlights the value of coordinated neonatal, obstetric, and surgical care.

pmid-17935122.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のHMGA1・HMGA2発現を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。HMGA1はセミノーマと胎児性癌で、HMGA2は胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍で発現し、組織型ごとに異なる分化状態を反映した。ウェスタンブロットとRT-PCRで確認され、組織学的鑑別診断が困難な症例で診断補助に有用な可能性が示された。
pmid-17935122.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined HMGA1 and HMGA2 expression across post-pubertal testicular tumours, including seminomas, teratomas, embryonal carcinomas, and mixed tumours with yolk sac components. HMGA1 was expressed in seminomas and embryonal carcinomas but lost in yolk sac tumours and teratomas. HMGA2 was limited to embryonal and yolk sac carcinomas. Expression patterns, confirmed by Western blot and RT-PCR, reflect differentiation state and may aid diagnosis when histological differential diagnosis is difficult.

pmid-17943970.summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍211例220検体のKIT遺伝子変異を解析した研究。活性化変異はセミノーマに限局し、片側例5.1%、両側例3.1%で検出された。両側性疾患とKIT変異の関連は認められず、KIT変異による対側腫瘍の予測に疑問を投げかけた。文献的考察も含む。
pmid-17943970.summary_en: Analysis of KIT mutations in 220 tumours from 211 patients with testicular and extragonadal germ cell tumours. Activating exon 17 mutations were found in 5.1% of unilateral and 3.1% of bilateral testicular tumours, all in seminomas. A pineal germinoma and a testicular seminoma from the same patient shared a mutation. The authors found no increased KIT mutation frequency in bilateral disease, challenging the idea that KIT status predicts contralateral tumours. A literature review is included.

pmid-17943972.summary_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍74例をBACアレイで解析し、12p増加が共通する主要な変化であることを示した。胎児性癌、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍では組織型特異的なコピー数変化が認められた。候補となる癌遺伝子と癌抑制遺伝子も同定され、組織学的分化がゲノム進化を駆動する可能性が提唱された。
pmid-17943972.summary_en: Using 1 Mb BAC array copy-number profiling and expression analysis of 74 adult male germ cell tumours, the authors identified 12p gain as the defining alteration, along with candidate oncogenes and tumour suppressor genes. Histology-specific copy-number changes were found in embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, and yolk sac tumours, with several genes previously linked to these histologies. The study proposes that histologic differentiation may drive genomic evolution of germ cell tumours.

pmid-17944924.summary_ja: 44歳女性の子宮頸部傍組織、子宮傍組織、付属器周囲軟部組織に生じた類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍の症例報告。腹腔鏡手術に続き、エトポシド・メトトレキサート・ダクチノマイシンによる化学療法4コースが施行された。特徴的な増殖様式と免疫組織化学的プロファイル、非栄養膜性病変との鑑別のポイントを考察した。
pmid-17944924.summary_en: A case report of an epithelioid trophoblastic tumour arising in the paracervix, parametrium, and periadnexal soft tissue of a 44-year-old woman. The patient underwent laparoscopic surgery followed by four courses of etoposide, methotrexate, and dactinomycin chemotherapy. The authors describe the tumour's distinctive growth pattern and immunohistochemical profile, and discuss features that help distinguish epithelioid trophoblastic tumour from nontrophoblastic lesions.

pmid-17975539.summary_ja: 60歳以上の男性に発生した精巣胚細胞腫瘍50例を病理学的に再検討した研究。82%がセミノーマで、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は18%だった。若年者と比べ腫瘍径が大きく、病期が進んだ状態で発見されていた。脈管侵襲や精巣網浸潤が多く、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍は47%に認められた。高齢者は進行した状態で受診することが多いと結論づけている。
pmid-17975539.summary_en: This pathological review analyzed 50 malignant germ cell tumours in men aged 60 years or older. Most (82%) were seminomas, while 18% were mixed or non-seminomatous germ cell tumours, and all non-seminomatous histologies were represented. The tumours were larger (median 6 cm) and more advanced than in younger men, with frequent vascular and rete testis invasion. Intratubular germ cell neoplasia was present in only 47% of assessable cases. The authors conclude that elderly patients present at later stages, although most tumours are seminomas.

pmid-18001800.summary_ja: 臨床病期I高リスク非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の44例に、精巣摘除術後の補助化学療法として改変ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンを1サイクル施行した長期成績である。中央値99か月の追跡で35例が無病であった。1サイクル投与は再発リスクを低下させ、副作用は少なく、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代替となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-18001800.summary_en: This long-term follow-up study assessed one cycle of adjuvant modified bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin in 44 patients with high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis treated by orchiectomy. Most patients remained disease-free at a median 99 months. One patient died after salvage therapy, and late effects included tinnitus and involuntary childlessness. The authors conclude one cycle effectively reduces relapse risk with minimal side effects and may be a valuable alternative to retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-18006222.summary_ja: 日本人患者の両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例と片側性腫瘍39例について、c-kit遺伝子のエクソン11および17の変異を解析した。片側性腫瘍の7例（18%）に変異を認めたが、両側性腫瘍では変異は検出されなかった。c-kit変異は、日本人では両側発症を予測しない可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-18006222.summary_en: This study examined c-kit exon 11 and 17 mutations, including codon 816, in 12 bilateral and 39 unilateral testicular germ cell tumours from Japanese patients. c-kit mutations were found in 7 of 39 unilateral tumours, mostly at codon 816 in exon 17, while none were detected in bilateral tumours. The authors conclude that c-kit mutation presence in TGCTs may not predict bilateral disease in Japanese patients, unlike previous European findings.

pmid-18008088.summary_ja: セミノーマ由来とされる2つの細胞株TCam-2とJKT-1を、ゲノムワイドな遺伝子発現解析で正常精巣、セミノーマ、胎児性癌と比較した。TCam-2は古典的セミノーマに、JKT-1は胎児性癌に近い発現パターンを示した。TCam-2はセミノーマの有用なin vitroモデルであるが、JKT-1の胚細胞由来性には疑問があると結論づけている。
pmid-18008088.summary_en: This study compares two reported seminoma-derived cell lines, TCam-2 and JKT-1, with normal testis, seminoma and embryonal carcinoma using genome-wide expression arrays. TCam-2 clustered with classical seminoma, whereas JKT-1 clustered with embryonal carcinoma and lacked expression of most germ cell tumour genes. RT-PCR, Western blot and immunohistochemistry confirmed the seminoma-like profile of TCam-2. The authors conclude TCam-2 is a suitable in vitro model for seminoma, while JKT-1's germ cell origin is doubtful.

pmid-18021220.summary_ja: 1985年から2006年に北京協和医院で治療された産褥性絨毛癌123例の後方視的解析である。多剤併用全身化学療法により87.8%が完全寛解に達した。FIGO 2000の低リスク群は高リスク群より寛解率が高く、病期が進むほど寛解率は低下した。妊娠から治療開始までの期間が短いほど予後が良好であると結論づけている。
pmid-18021220.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 123 postpartum choriocarcinoma patients treated at Peking Union Medical College Hospital over 20 years reports a complete remission rate of 87.8% with multiagent systemic chemotherapy. Patients in the FIGO 2000 low-risk group achieved remission in 95.8% versus 82.7% in high-risk patients. Remission rates declined with higher FIGO stage, from 100% in stage I to 62.5% in stage IV. The authors conclude prognosis is good with multiagent chemotherapy, and shorter time from pregnancy to treatment improves outcome.

pmid-18029289.summary_ja: 32歳女性が傍腫瘍性脳炎を発症し、経膣超音波検査で両側卵巣腫大を指摘された症例報告である。両側卵管卵巣摘出術と病期分類の結果、FIGO病期Ib・Grade 1の未熟奇形腫と診断された。手術後に神経症状は著明に改善した。原因不明の脳炎を呈する若年女性では卵巣病変の除外が重要であると述べている。
pmid-18029289.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with paraneoplastic encephalitis whose transvaginal ultrasound showed enlarged ovaries. Bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy with complete staging revealed FIGO stage Ib grade 1 immature teratoma. Her neurological condition improved significantly after surgery. The authors recommend that young women presenting with encephalitis of unknown origin be referred to gynaecology to exclude ovarian pathology, since surgical removal of the teratoma can lead to clinical recovery.

pmid-18032452.summary_ja: 18歳女性の抗NMDA受容体脳炎症例で、卵巣奇形腫を早期に摘出し、血漿交換とステロイドを併用したところ神経症状は速やかに改善し、完全に回復した。血清抗体価は早期に低下し、脳脊髄液中の抗体価が臨床転帰とより良く相関した。抗NMDA受容体脳炎の診断後は奇形腫の検索と摘出を速やかに検討すべきと述べている。
pmid-18032452.summary_en: This report describes an 18-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis whose psychiatric symptoms, unresponsiveness, dyskinesias, hypoventilation and seizures improved promptly after early removal of an ovarian teratoma, followed by plasma exchange and corticosteroids. Serial serum antibody titres to NR1/NR2B heteromers fell early, while CSF titres correlated better with clinical outcome. The patient's antibodies reacted with NMDAR-expressing tumour areas. The authors recommend prompt search for and removal of teratoma after diagnosis of anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis.

pmid-18039775.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト精巣セミノーマ由来のJKT-1細胞において、BSA結合型17β-エストラジオールが膜結合型経路を介してERK1/2およびPKAを非ゲノム的に活性化し、細胞増殖を促進することを示した。ERβが関与し、古典的ER拮抗薬では抑制されなかった。
pmid-18039775.summary_en: This study shows that estrogens promote proliferation of human testicular seminoma cells (JKT-1) through a rapid, non-genomic mechanism. BSA-conjugated 17β-estradiol activated ERK1/2 and PKA via a membrane-associated pathway, phosphorylating CREB and pRb. Pertussis toxin blocked the effect. JKT-1 cells lacked ERα but expressed ERβ, which was not membrane-localized, and classical ER antagonists did not reverse the response. The findings suggest a mechanism linking estrogen exposure to testicular germ cell cancer progression.

pmid-18043135.summary_ja: 若年の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者が、シスプラチンを含む併用化学療法中に脳血管障害を発症した症例を報告する。明らかな血栓症リスク因子はなかった。胚細胞腫瘍では血栓塞栓症は稀だが、化学療法の血管毒性により重大な合併症となりうることを示し、予後良好な患者でも血管合併症のモニタリングが必要であることを示唆している。
pmid-18043135.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor, without known thrombotic risk factors, who suffered a cerebrovascular accident during cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy. The authors note that thromboembolism is infrequent in germ cell tumors but can be a serious complication owing to the vascular toxicity of chemotherapeutic agents. The event illustrates the need to monitor for vascular complications during treatment, even in patients with a good prognosis and no identified risk factors.

pmid-18045648.summary_ja: 性腺外および転移性の胚細胞腫瘍93例で、OCT3/4、c-kit、PLAP、D2-40などの免疫染色マーカーの有用性を比較した。OCT3/4は胎児性癌の鑑別に、D2-40はセミノーマの同定に優れた。上皮膜抗原は非セミノーマのうち奇形腫の識別に有用であった。
pmid-18045648.summary_en: This study tested germ cell immunohistochemical markers (OCT3/4, c-kit, PLAP, D2-40, AP-2gamma, CD30, EMA) in 93 extragonadal and metastatic germ cell tumors, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, teratoma, and yolk sac tumor. OCT3/4 best distinguished embryonal carcinoma from other tumors, while D2-40 was strongly reactive in seminoma. Epithelial membrane antigen identified teratoma among nonseminomas. The authors recommend OCT3/4 and D2-40 for pathologic discrimination of extragonadal germ cell tumors, particularly seminoma versus embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-18045770.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清(PC-RPLND)の適応、手術手技、転帰を文献レビューした。セミノーマでは化学療法後のPETが陽性の場合に限り、非セミノーマでは腫瘍マーカーが陰性または横ばいの残存病変に適応とされる。再発率は約12%で、やり直し手術や晩期再発では約45%に上昇する。
pmid-18045770.summary_en: This literature review addresses postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) in advanced testicular germ cell tumors. PC-RPLND is indicated for residual seminoma masses only if PET is positive after chemotherapy, and for all residual lesions in nonseminoma with negative or plateauing markers. Relapse is about 12% after PC-RPLND, rising to about 45% with redo surgery or late relapse. Loss of antegrade ejaculation is the main long-term complication. The authors conclude that PC-RPLND should be performed only at experienced tertiary centers.

pmid-18048383.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ患者199例を前向きに収集し、補助カルボプラチン単剤療法の長期安全性を評価した。中央値9年の追跡で、全死亡、循環器疾患死、非精巣の二次がんは一般人口の期待値を超えなかった。一方、対側精巣がんの長期的な増加が認められた。
pmid-18048383.summary_en: This prospective cohort of 199 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant single-agent carboplatin had a median follow-up of 9 years. Overall mortality, circulatory death, and nontestis second cancers did not exceed population expectations. However, contralateral testicular cancer risk was increased. The authors conclude that long-term safety concerns about single-agent carboplatin are largely reassuring and that the findings help guide long-term follow-up planning.

pmid-18050305.summary_ja: 最初のセミノーマ由来細胞株とされるTCam-2の起源と特性を、染色体解析、発現プロファイル、免疫染色により検証した。12p獲得を伴う異数性は精巣胚細胞腫瘍に典型的である。KIT、OCT3/4、PLAP、NANOGの陽性とCD30、SOX2の陰性からセミノーマ由来と確認された。BRAF V600E変異は胚細胞腫瘍では稀であり、in vitroでの増殖を可能にしたと考えられる。
pmid-18050305.summary_en: This study characterized TCam-2, the first reported seminoma-derived cell line, to verify its origin. Cytogenetic analyses showed aneuploidy with 12p gain, typical of testicular germ cell tumors. Expression profiling, imprinting analysis, and immunohistochemistry (KIT, OCT3/4, PLAP, NANOG, absence of CD30 and SOX2) supported seminoma identity. TCam-2 carries a BRAF V600E mutation, rare in germ cell tumors, which likely enables its propagation in vitro. The authors conclude TCam-2 is a well-characterized model of seminoma.

pmid-18058805.summary_ja: ヒト精漿中の2種類の細胞質イソクエン酸脱水素酵素(IDPc)アイソフォームは、最も頻度の高い精巣胚細胞がんである精巣セミノーマの男性で変化していた。精巣がんの高リスク群である分泌性無精子症の男性でも同様の変化が認められた。著者らは、IDPcが精巣セミノーマの有望な精漿バイオマーカーになる可能性を提案している。無精子症におけるこれらの変化が、後にセミノーマを発症することを予測するかどうかは不明である。
pmid-18058805.summary_en: Two cytoplasmic isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDPc) isoforms in seminal plasma were altered in men with testicular seminoma, the most common testicular germ cell cancer. The same changes were seen in secretory azoospermic men, a group at high risk for testicular cancer. The authors propose IDPc as a promising seminal plasma biomarker for testicular seminoma. Whether these changes in azoospermia predict later seminoma development remains unknown.

pmid-18060397.summary_ja: 2歳6か月の男児の盲腸内に生じた非典型的な胎児様奇形腫を報告した。胎児様奇形腫は胎児に類似する高度に組織化された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、通常は女性の卵巣腫瘤として報告される。男性例は2例のみで、盲腸の奇形腫は過去5例のみであった。小児においても性腺外の腸管に奇形腫が生じうることを示す。
pmid-18060397.summary_en: This report describes an atypical fetiform teratoma arising within the cecum of a 2.5-year-old boy. Fetiform teratoma is a highly organized form of mature cystic teratoma that resembles a fetus, usually reported in women and typically as ovarian masses. Only two male cases were previously described, and only five prior teratomas involved the cecum. The case shows that teratomas can arise in extragonadal intestinal sites in children.

pmid-18066564.summary_ja: 42歳女性の子宮内膜類内膜腺癌で、多核巨細胞を伴う絨毛癌様分化が局所的に認められた症例報告です。免疫組織化学でhCGが強陽性でしたが、血清hCGは上昇していませんでした。子宮全摘・両側付属器摘出・リンパ節郭清後、転移は認められず6か月時点で無病でした。小型で血清hCGが上昇しない場合は経過が緩徐な可能性があると論じています。
pmid-18066564.summary_en: This case report describes an endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the endometrium in a 42-year-old woman, with focal choriocarcinomatous differentiation featuring multinucleated giant cells and pleomorphic tumor cells. Immunohistochemistry showed strong hCG positivity, although serum hCG was not elevated. Total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and lymph node dissection was performed. Metastatic workup was negative, and the patient remained disease-free at six months. The authors review the literature and note that such tumors may follow an indolent course when small and without elevated serum hCG.

pmid-18066589.summary_ja: 30歳女性の右卵巣に生じた5cmの単房性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。皮膚、呼吸器・腸管上皮、軟骨など通常の成分に加え、PSA陽性の前立腺組織、球尿道腺様構造、精嚢が認められました。卵巣奇形腫に男性副生殖腺成分が伴う例は英文文献で初めての報告とされています。良性病変で、手術により切除されました。
pmid-18066589.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with a 5 cm unilocular cystic mature teratoma of the right ovary. Beyond typical mature tissues including skin, respiratory and intestinal epithelium, cartilage, muscle, and nervous tissue, the tumor contained prostatic acini positive for PSA and acid phosphatase, Cowper-like glands, and seminal vesicles with fibromuscular stroma. The authors state this is the first English-literature report of seminal vesicles associated with prostatic tissue and bulbourethral glands in a mature ovarian teratoma. The lesion was benign and was removed surgically.

pmid-18068165.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者48名(セミノーマ19名、非セミノーマ29名)の精子を対照群と比較した前向き研究です。TUNEL法で評価した精子核のDNA断片化率は、いずれの群でも約12%で差はありませんでした。精子濃度は両がん群で低下していました。組織型によってDNA断片化が増えることはないと結論づけています。
pmid-18068165.summary_en: This prospective controlled study compared sperm nuclear apoptotic DNA fragmentation, measured by TUNEL assay, in 48 men with testicular cancer (29 non-seminoma, 19 seminoma) assessed after orchiectomy and before adjuvant therapy, versus fertile controls. Both testicular cancer groups had lower sperm concentration and, in non-seminoma, lower motility and morphology than controls. DNA fragmentation rates, about 12%, did not differ among groups. The authors conclude that the presence of seminoma or non-seminoma is not associated with increased sperm DNA fragmentation.

pmid-18077314.summary_ja: 正常、ゴナドトロピン抑制、および精巣腫瘍を含む成人ヒト精巣におけるアクチビン受容体サブユニットの局在を免疫組織化学などで検討した研究です。セミノーマの一部ではActRIIAが強く発現していました。非セミノーマではActRIIAはほぼ陰性でした。ゴナドトロピン抑制により精原細胞とセルトリ細胞でActRIIAが増加しました。主要な標的は精原細胞とセルトリ細胞と結論づけています。
pmid-18077314.summary_en: This study localizes activin receptor subunits (ALK2, ALK4, ActRIIA, ActRIIB) in normal, gonadotropin-deprived, and tumor-containing adult human testis using immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization. ALK2, ALK4 and ActRIIB were found in Sertoli cells, spermatogonia, and in carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and non-seminoma cells. ActRIIA was largely absent in normal testis and non-seminoma but strongly expressed in some seminoma cells. Gonadotropin deprivation increased ActRIIA in spermatogonia and Sertoli cells. Spermatogonia and Sertoli cells are the primary activin targets.

pmid-18093814.summary_ja: 初回化学療法を先行した転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍33例を後方視的に検討した研究です。全体の36%で精巣に生存腫瘍が残存し、非セミノーマ性では52.9%でした。純粋セミノーマでは残存腫瘍は認められず、この群では遅延精巣摘除術が不要となる可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-18093814.summary_en: This study reviewed 33 patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumor treated with primary chemotherapy before orchidectomy. Viable tumor persisted in the testis in 36% of patients, including 52.9% with non-seminomatous disease but none with pure seminoma. Delayed orchidectomy may be unnecessary in pure seminoma patients who achieve response to chemotherapy.

pmid-18097551.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍130例の精巣摘除標本でGnT-V発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究です。GnT-V陽性率は病期の進行とともに低下しました。病期I非セミノーマ性GCTでは、GnT-V陰性例で再発リスクが高いことが示されました。
pmid-18097551.summary_en: This study analyzed GnT-V expression in 130 orchiectomy specimens of testicular germ cell tumors and found it declined with stage and in seminoma. In stage I non-seminomatous tumors, GnT-V-negative cases had a higher recurrence risk. Oligosaccharide analysis confirmed downregulation of beta1-6 branching in tumors. GnT-V may serve as a recurrence predictor for stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.

pmid-18097623.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対する5種類のヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害剤（HDACI）の作用を検討した。いずれもBeWo細胞の増殖を抑制し、S期の細胞割合を減少させてG0/G1期を増加させた。アネキシンV染色とミトコンドリア膜電位の消失によりアポトーシスの誘導も確認された。ヒストンH3・H4のアセチル化の増加や関連遺伝子発現の変化も認められ、絨毛癌の治療に有効である可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-18097623.summary_en: This study examined five histone deacetylase inhibitors (HDACIs) in the BeWo choriocarcinoma cell line. The cells were sensitive to growth inhibition by all five agents. HDACI exposure shifted cells away from S phase toward G0/G1 arrest and induced apoptosis, shown by annexin V staining and loss of mitochondrial membrane potential. Treatment also increased acetylation of histone H3 and H4 and altered expression of genes linked to growth, malignant phenotype, and apoptosis. The authors suggest HDACIs may be particularly effective for choriocarcinoma treatment.

pmid-18154843.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、胎児性癌とセミノーマの混合型胚細胞腫瘍の22歳患者を対象とする。内科的・外科的治療に抵抗性で、腫瘍マーカーの上昇と左下葉転移の増大を認めた。左下葉切除後に左側乳び胸を生じ、保存的治療が無効であったため、ロボット支援下に右側胸管結紮術が施行された。乳び胸の他の治療選択肢についても概説している。
pmid-18154843.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old patient with mixed embryonal carcinoma and seminoma germ cell cancer, refractory to medical and surgical therapy, with rising tumor markers and a growing left lower lobe lung metastasis. After left lower lobectomy, left-sided chylothorax developed and conservative management failed. A robotic right-sided thoracic duct ligation was then performed. The paper also reviews other treatment options for chylothorax.

pmid-18155815.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、精巣絨毛癌が鼻部の皮膚転移として初発した症例を報告する。絨毛癌の皮膚転移はまれで、既報は11例とされる。本例は頭頸部への皮膚転移としては2例目で、皮膚転移が初発所見であった3例目にあたる。文献レビューでは、紅色または紫色の硬い皮下結節を呈し、特徴的な組織像を示すことが報告されている。
pmid-18155815.summary_en: This case report describes testicular choriocarcinoma presenting as a cutaneous metastasis to the nose, the second such case reported in the head and neck. Skin metastasis of choriocarcinoma is rare, with only 11 prior cases reported. In this patient, skin involvement was the first finding at presentation. The accompanying review summarizes reported cases, which typically showed firm, reddish or violaceous subcutaneous nodules with characteristic histology.

pmid-18156809.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の病理診断で臨床上問題となる誤診を取り上げた総説である。セミノーマは放射線療法が有効な例が多く、正確な鑑別が治療方針に直結する。診断は主に光学顕微鏡での観察によるが、疑いが残る場合は免疫染色を併用する。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、セルトリ細胞腫瘍、絨毛癌、精巣炎、リンパ腫、類皮嚢腫と奇形腫などとの鑑別が論じられている。
pmid-18156809.summary_en: This pathology review addresses common, clinically important misdiagnoses in testicular tumors, mainly distinguishing seminoma from its mimics. Accurate diagnosis matters because seminoma is commonly treated with radiation, unlike most other testicular malignancies. Diagnosis usually relies on light microscopy, with immunostains used when doubt persists. Differential diagnoses discussed include embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, Sertoli cell tumor, choriocarcinoma, orchitis, lymphoma, dermoid cyst versus teratoma, and spermatocytic seminoma.

pmid-18162339.summary_ja: 閉経後の56歳女性が腹痛・悪心・嘔吐を主訴に受診した症例報告である。超音波検査で子宮の拡大と嚢胞状変化を認め、血清β-hCGは5000を超えた。その後、188,000 U/mLから0まで低下した。全子宮摘出術と両側卵管卵巣摘除術が施行され、病理で完全胞状奇胎と診断された。閉経後女性の良性完全胞状奇胎の報告としては4例目であり、この年代でも本疾患を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-18162339.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old postmenopausal woman with abdominal pain, nausea, and vomiting. Ultrasound showed an enlarged uterus with cystic areas, and serum beta-hCG exceeded 5000. Beta-hCG later fell from 188,000 to zero. Total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was performed, and pathology confirmed a complete hydatidiform mole. The authors describe this as the fourth reported benign complete mole in a postmenopausal woman and stress that the diagnosis should be considered in this group.

pmid-18162782.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマ23例について、組織学的特徴、免疫組織化学および蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーション（FISH）による12p染色体異常の検出を検討した。全例でリンパ球浸潤を認め、全例でOCT4の核内染色が陽性であった。22例（96%）で12p染色体異常が検出された。上皮マーカーは一部の腫瘍細胞のみを染色し、CD30とCK20は陰性であった。OCT4染色と12p FISHは縦隔セミノーマの診断に有用であるとしている。
pmid-18162782.summary_en: This study assessed 23 primary mediastinal seminomas using histology, immunohistochemistry, and dual-color FISH for chromosome 12p abnormalities. Lymphocytic infiltration was seen in all cases, and OCT4 nuclear staining was present in every tumor. Chromosome 12p abnormalities were found in 22 of 23 seminomas (96%). Epithelial markers stained only a minority of tumor cells, and CD30 and CK20 were negative. The authors conclude that OCT4 staining and 12p FISH are valuable for diagnosing mediastinal seminoma, and that caution is needed when interpreting cytokeratins.

pmid-18164407.summary_ja: 子宮内膜の漿液性癌に絨毛癌様成分を伴った症例の報告である。p53染色は漿液性成分と細胞栄養膜細胞で陽性であったが、合胞体栄養膜細胞では陰性であった。p53遺伝子解析では、絨毛癌様成分にエクソン8のヘテロ接合性変異、漿液性成分にエクソン7のホモ接合性欠失が認められた。これらの所見から、多方向性の分化は共通の幹細胞に由来する可能性があると考察している。
pmid-18164407.summary_en: This paper reports a case of endometrial serous carcinoma with a choriocarcinomatous component. p53 staining was present in the serous component and cytotrophoblastic cells but absent in syncytiotrophoblastic cells. Molecular analysis showed a heterozygous exon 8 mutation in the choriocarcinomatous component and a homozygous exon 7 deletion in the serous component. The authors propose that these multidirectional differentiations may arise from a common stem cell.

pmid-18164856.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法の二次がんリスクを、照射野（傍大動脈、ダブルレッグ、拡大照射野）と線量（20Gy、30Gy）ごとにモデル化した研究である。傍大動脈照射は、ダブルレッグ照射と比べて二次がんリスクを約半分から3分の2に低減すると推定された。20Gyは30Gy以下のリスクが期待される。成熟した追跡データが不足する中、患者との治療選択の議論に有用と結論づけている。
pmid-18164856.summary_en: This modeling study estimates secondary cancer risk after radiotherapy for stage I testicular seminoma. It compares para-aortic, dogleg, and extended field techniques at 20 and 30 Gy, using organ equivalent dose models applied to voxel-based phantom dose distributions. Para-aortic irradiation reduced estimated secondary cancer risk by roughly one-half to two-thirds compared with dogleg fields, independent of the dose-response model. Twenty Gy was expected to yield equal or lower risk than 30 Gy. Because mature patient follow-up data are lacking, the authors suggest organ equivalent dose estimates can help guide treatment discussions with patients.

pmid-18172902.summary_ja: 臨床病期IS非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍24例の単施設解析である。初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を受けた7例中6例に生存する胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。化学療法後の後腹膜では、14例中6例（43%）に奇形腫または生存する胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。著者らは、cIS期NSGCT患者は補助的PC-RPLNDの恩恵を受けると結論づけている。
pmid-18172902.summary_en: This Memorial Sloan-Kettering series of 24 men with clinical stage IS nonseminomatous germ cell tumor compares primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with induction chemotherapy. Six of seven patients who underwent primary RPLND had viable germ cell tumor, and most who did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed systemically. Teratoma or viable GCT was found in the retroperitoneum in 6 of 14 patients after chemotherapy (43%). Among those undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND, teratoma was present in 6 of 7. The authors conclude that patients with cIS NSGCT will benefit from adjuvant PC-RPLND. Median follow-up was 35 months.

pmid-18177785.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍後に残存する後腹膜腫瘤の組織型を予測する多項ロジスティック回帰法を示した診断研究の方法論論文である。良性組織、成熟奇形腫、生存癌の確率を同時に推定でき、ROC面積は二項モデルと同等であった。臨床で使いやすいスコア表も提示されている。複数の鑑別診断を同時に扱う手法の有用性を論じている。
pmid-18177785.summary_en: This methodological diagnostic research paper demonstrates polytomous logistic regression for predicting the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses after treatment of nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Using data from that setting, the model estimates probabilities of benign tissue, mature teratoma, and viable cancer simultaneously. Its discrimination, measured by ROC areas, was similar to two sequential dichotomous models. The authors provide a simple score chart for calculating predicted probabilities and argue that modeling multiple differential diagnoses together better serves clinical practice.

pmid-18184265.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎から妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）へ進展する例では、自然退縮例に比べ前立腺幹細胞抗原（PSCA）が過剰発現していた。免疫組織化学などで検証され、絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍でも高発現が見られた。研究では増殖・アポトーシス指標やp53関連因子との相関も確認され、PSCAはGTNの発症マーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
pmid-18184265.summary_en: This study identified prostate stem cell antigen (PSCA) as differentially overexpressed in hydatidiform moles that progressed to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia compared with those that regressed spontaneously. PSCA RNA and protein were verified by real-time PCR and immunohistochemistry in 58 specimens, and high expression was also seen in choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumours. PSCA expression correlated with proliferation and apoptosis indices and with p53-related markers, suggesting a role in p53-linked growth regulation. The findings suggest PSCA as a potential marker of GTN development.

pmid-18190641.summary_ja: 精巣カルチノイドの既報62例を総説し、原発性、他部位からの転移性、精巣奇形腫内に発生したものの3群に分類した。原発例の一部は転移し、死亡例のほとんどに転移があった。全例で精巣摘除術が行われ、他の原発巣の除外が重要とされる。限局例の予後は良好である。
pmid-18190641.summary_en: This review compiled 62 previously reported cases of carcinoid tumours of the testis, classified as primary testicular carcinoid, metastasis from another site, or carcinoid arising within a testicular teratoma. Seven patients with primary tumours developed metastases, and nine patients died, nearly all with metastatic disease. All patients underwent orchidectomy. Diagnostic work-up to exclude other primary sites is recommended, with urinary 5-HIAA, somatostatin receptor scintigraphy, CT and video-capsule endoscopy as useful tools. Localized tumours have an excellent prognosis after orchidectomy.

pmid-18191324.summary_ja: 欧州胚細胞がんコンセンサスグループ第2回会議の報告書第I部であり、胚細胞がんのエビデンスに基づくガイドラインを更新している。原発精巣腫瘍の臨床像と治療、精巣上皮内腫瘍の管理、組織学的分類、病期分類と予後因子、病期Iのセミノーマと非セミノーマの治療を扱う。2004年の勧告の大部分は有効であり、臨床試験による改良と生存者のニーズへの配慮が加えられたと述べられている。
pmid-18191324.summary_en: This is part I of the second European Germ Cell Cancer Consensus Group (EGCCCG) report, updating evidence-based guidelines for germ cell cancer. It covers clinical presentation and treatment of the primary testicular tumour, management of testicular intraepithelial neoplasia, histological classification, staging and prognostic factors, and treatment of stage I seminoma and non-seminoma. The authors note that most 2004 recommendations remain valid, with refinements from recent trials and attention to the needs of survivors.

pmid-18192582.summary_ja: ウサギで自然発生した絨毛癌の初めての報告である。3歳の雌ウサギで子宮壁の腫瘤が見つかり、卵巣子宮摘出術が行われた。腫瘍は栄養膜細胞、合胞体栄養膜細胞、細胞性栄養膜細胞の3種から成り、免疫組織化学でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性を示し、絨毛癌と診断された。
pmid-18192582.summary_en: This veterinary case report describes the first documented spontaneous choriocarcinoma in a rabbit. A 3-year-old female presented with an abdominal mass in the uterine wall, and ovariohysterectomy was performed. The tumour contained trophoblastic, syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic cells. Immunohistochemistry was positive for cytokeratin, and syncytiotrophoblasts were positive for human chorionic gonadotropin, confirming the diagnosis. The report is relevant as a choriocarcinoma in an animal with oncologic features.

pmid-18199269.summary_ja: 屠殺された2頭のラバに、両側の悪性セミノーマと腰下リンパ節への転移が見られた症例報告である。組織学的には大型で丸みを帯びた多角形の細胞が多く、分裂像も多数認められた。ラバでの両側性悪性セミノーマと転移の報告は初めてとされ、獣医病理学の症例として対象とした。
pmid-18199269.summary_en: Two cases of bilateral malignant seminoma with sublumbar lymph node metastases are described in mules slaughtered for routine reasons. Histology showed predominantly large round to polyhedral cells with frequent mitoses, and the diagnosis was malignant seminoma with metastasis. The authors state this is the first report of bilateral malignant seminoma with metastases in mules. The paper is a veterinary pathology report, relevant as a seminoma case in an animal.

pmid-18206479.summary_ja: 単一施設で8年間に治療された小児後腹膜奇形腫6例の後方視的検討です。多くは生後6か月未満で、腫瘍は大動脈や下大静脈を取り囲んでいました。完全切除には主要血管の結紮を含む広範囲切除が必要でした。全例良性で、再発は1例、2例に持続性高血圧が残りました。外科的管理の難しさが強調されています。
pmid-18206479.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review describes six children with retroperitoneal teratoma treated by one surgeon over eight years. Most patients were infants, and tumors encased the aorta and vena cava. Complete excision required extensive resection and major vessel ligation. All tumors were benign, one recurred, and two children had persistent hypertension. The authors conclude that operative management of retroperitoneal teratomas is complex and vessel ligation may be necessary for complete excision.

pmid-18207171.summary_ja: 進行期セミノーマで化学療法後の残存・再発腫瘤20例を対象とした前向き多施設研究です。FDG-PETは生存腫瘍をすべて検出し偽陰性はなかった一方、偽陽性は9例にみられました。3cmを超える腫瘤でも生存腫瘍を除外でき、不要な外科的切除の回避に役立つ可能性があります。ただし陽性所見のみで手術を決めるべきではないと結論しています。
pmid-18207171.summary_en: This prospective multicenter study evaluated FDG-PET for detecting viable tumor in residual or recurrent masses after chemotherapy in 20 patients with advanced seminoma. All patients with viable tumor were correctly identified by PET, with no false negatives, although nine patients had false-positive results. The negative predictive value was 1.0 and the positive predictive value was 0.25. The authors conclude that FDG-PET can exclude viable disease even in masses larger than 3 cm, which may help avoid unnecessary surgical resection, but that a positive PET alone should not drive surgical decisions.

pmid-18207192.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理で、持続する低値の血清hCGが誤解を招く問題を扱った研究です。24例を血清・尿の並行測定と別法による測定で評価し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の基準で偽陽性を同定しました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の17例中12例は偽陽性、5例は真陽性でした。新たな分類とアルゴリズムの導入後は不要な治療や精査が行われなくなり、過剰治療の回避に役立ちました。
pmid-18207192.summary_en: This urology study addresses persistently low serum hCG levels that can mislead clinicians managing testicular germ cell tumors. Twenty-four patients with low elevated hCG were evaluated using parallel serum and urine hCG measurements and a second assay, and false-positive cases were identified using gestational trophoblastic disease criteria. Of 17 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, 12 were false-positive and 5 were true-positive. After the algorithm was applied, no unnecessary treatments or intensive examinations were performed. The authors propose this classification to avoid overtreatment.

pmid-18214583.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫13例のCT所見を後方視的に検討した画像研究です。腫瘍は平均11.4cmで、すべて片側性、平滑な辺縁を示しました。多嚢胞性構造が多く、造影前に高吸収の内容物を認めたものは84.6%でした。嚢胞壁の増強は無いか軽度でした。典型像を知ることで、この稀な卵巣腫瘍の診断に役立つと結論づけています。
pmid-18214583.summary_en: This retrospective imaging study reviewed CT scans of 13 pathologically proven struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. Tumors averaged 11.4 cm and were all unilateral with smooth margins. Most showed multicystic architecture, and 85% had high-attenuation contents on precontrast scans. Cyst wall enhancement was absent or moderate in most cases. The authors conclude that struma ovarii typically appears as a smooth, multicystic mass with precontrast high attenuation and little or moderate wall enhancement, features that may help radiologists recognize this uncommon tumor.

pmid-18221571.summary_ja: 無症状の嚢胞性頸部腫瘤を呈した19歳男性の症例報告です。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、頸部の嚢胞性病変が胸腔内の充実性腫瘤と連続していることが示されました。穿刺細胞診では類皮嚢腫が疑われました。頸部と経胸骨の併用アプローチで切除し、病理で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定しました。5年間のフォローアップで再発はありません。病態が不明な頸部・縦隔腫瘤には外科的治療が重要と述べています。
pmid-18221571.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old man with an asymptomatic cystic neck mass that proved to be an anterior mediastinal teratoma extending into the neck. CT showed a multiseptate cystic neck lesion continuous with a solid intrathoracic mass containing calcification. Aspiration cytology suggested a dermoid cyst. The tumor was excised through combined cervical and trans-sternal approaches, and histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. After five years of follow-up, the patient remained symptom-free without recurrence. The authors emphasize surgical treatment of cervical and mediastinal masses of uncertain nature to prevent catastrophic complications.

pmid-18222228.summary_ja: シスプラチン時代の25年間に、縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後手術を受けた158例を後方視的に検討した単施設研究です。手術死亡は6%で、多くが呼吸不全によるものでした。ブレオマイシンを含まないレジメンで肺合併症が減少しました。生存に関わる因子は化学療法後の病理像、残存する胚細胞がん、術後の腫瘍マーカー上昇でした。
pmid-18222228.summary_en: This single-institution review analyzed 158 patients who underwent postchemotherapy surgery for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors over 25 years in the cisplatin era. Operative mortality was 6%, mainly from respiratory failure, and regimens without bleomycin were associated with fewer pulmonary complications. Independent predictors of survival included postchemotherapy pathology (complete necrosis versus teratoma), persistent germ cell or nongerm cell cancer, and elevated postoperative tumor markers. Patients with complete necrosis had excellent long-term survival, supporting aggressive surgery for persistent cancer in operable patients.

pmid-18222229.summary_ja: 1988年から2005年に原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で根治的切除を受けた21例を後方視的に検討した。化学療法後の手術で、完全一塊切除は76.2%で可能だった。5年全生存率は63.6%。診断時のβ-hCG高値と不完全切除が予後不良因子であり、完全切除が長期生存に重要であった。
pmid-18222229.summary_en: This retrospective review of 21 patients who underwent curative resection for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor between 1988 and 2005 assessed surgery after chemotherapy. Complete en bloc excision was achieved in 76.2% of patients. Five-year overall survival was 63.6% and disease-free survival 61.1%. Elevated beta-hCG at diagnosis and incomplete resection were independent predictors of poor overall survival, indicating that complete resection is essential for long-term survival.

pmid-18222293.summary_ja: 右中葉に生じた巨大な悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は稀であり、肺実質原発の悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍はさらに稀である。術前化学療法の後、腫瘍を完全に外科的切除し、治療に成功した。術前化学療法と完全切除の組み合わせが有効であることを示している。本症例は、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療選択を考えるうえで参考になる。
pmid-18222293.summary_en: This case report describes a huge malignant yolk sac tumor arising in the right middle lobe of the lung, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. The patient received neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by complete surgical resection of the tumor and was successfully treated. The report highlights that malignant yolk sac tumors can arise primarily in the lung parenchyma, and that preoperative chemotherapy followed by complete resection can achieve a favorable outcome.

pmid-18223326.summary_ja: 本研究は、ステロイド合成酵素であるHSD3B1がトロホブラスト病変の免疫組織化学マーカーとして有用かを検討した。胞状奇胎や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍など、ほぼすべてのトロホブラスト病変で陽性であった。子宮・肺・乳房の非トロホブラスト性癌では、陽性はごくわずか(1%未満)であった。鑑別診断に有用であると結論付けている。
pmid-18223326.summary_en: This study evaluated HSD3B1, a steroidogenic enzyme, as an immunohistochemical marker for trophoblastic lesions.
