The authors discuss their management approach for this complex case.

pmid-18475033.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘍を有する31歳男性が、黒色便と高度貧血で受診し、空腸絨毛癌の転移と診断された症例報告である。血清β-hCGは4,396 ng/mLと高値で、精巣は正常であった。術後20日目に脳転移と気管浸潤により死亡した。縦隔原発の絨毛癌が消化管に転移した稀な症例として、文献レビューとともに報告されている。
pmid-18475033.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with a 7-cm mediastinal tumor who presented with melena and severe anemia. Gastrointestinal endoscopy found no bleeding source, but emergency laparotomy revealed a jejunal tumor with liver and mesenteric metastases. Histopathology confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma, with serum beta-hCG markedly elevated at 4,396 ng/mL and normal testes. Brain metastases and tracheal invasion developed, and the patient died on postoperative day 20. The report is accompanied by a literature review of male choriocarcinoma metastasizing to the gastrointestinal tract.

pmid-18478339.summary_ja: 1982年から2004年のオーストラリアの癌登録データを用い、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織型別発生率の推移を解析した研究である。セミノーマは全体の58%を占め、年2.6%の増加を示した。増加はセミノーマで非セミノーマより顕著であった。出生時前後の病因因子や防御因子の変化が一因である可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-18478339.summary_en: This population-based study uses Australian cancer registry data from 1982 to 2004 to analyze incidence trends of testicular germ cell cancer by histology. Among 10,528 cases, 58% were seminomas. Overall incidence rose 2.6% per year, faster for seminomas (3.4%) than non-seminomas (1.4%). Age peaks differed by subtype, and non-seminomas showed a U-shaped birth cohort pattern. The authors compare these trends with the United States and Europe and suggest that changing etiologic or protective factors around birth may partly explain them.

pmid-18484480.summary_ja: 5歳女児の仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。腫瘍内に肉腫様成分を認めた、まれな悪性胚細胞腫瘍である。完全切除の後、肉腫プロトコルに基づく補助化学療法が行われた。性腺外奇形腫は仙尾部に多く発生することが述べられている。本症例は、悪性奇形腫の臨床経過と治療選択を示す貴重な報告である。
pmid-18484480.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-year-old girl with sacrococcygeal teratoma containing sarcomatous elements, a rare malignant form of germ cell tumor. The tumor was completely resected, and the patient received adjuvant chemotherapy according to sarcoma protocols. The report notes that extragonadal teratomas most often arise in the sacrococcygeal region.

pmid-18485586.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胎盤と絨毛癌由来のトロホブラスト細胞株におけるAPC遺伝子プロモーターのメチル化を解析した。全ての絨毛癌由来細胞株でAPC-1aのメチル化が増加していた。これは妊娠性腫瘍の発生にAPCの過剰メチル化が関与する可能性を示唆する。胎盤トロホブラストの浸潤におけるWntシグナルの役割を支持する知見も得られている。
pmid-18485586.summary_en: This study examined APC promoter methylation in human placenta and choriocarcinoma-derived trophoblast cell lines. Full-term placenta showed hypomethylation of the APC-1b promoter and monoallelic methylation of APC-1a, without parent-of-origin effects. All choriocarcinoma-derived cell lines showed increased APC-1a methylation, suggesting that APC hypermethylation contributes to gestational tumours. The findings also support a role for Wnt signalling in trophoblast invasion.

pmid-18487497.summary_ja: 4歳の非妊娠アカゲザルに発生した卵巣の悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告である。肺と肝臓に転移を認めた。組織学的には典型的な絨毛癌像ではなく、中間型トロホブラスト細胞が主体であった。免疫染色で胎盤性ラクトゲンと絨毛性ゴナドトロピンが陽性で、他の胚細胞分化は認められなかった。妊娠歴がないことから、非妊娠関連性の腫瘍と考えられている。
pmid-18487497.summary_en: This veterinary case report describes a non-gestational malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor of the ovary in a 4-year-old nonpregnant rhesus monkey, with lung and liver metastases. Histology showed predominantly intermediate trophoblastic cells rather than the classic choriocarcinoma pattern. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated placental lactogen and chorionic gonadotropin expression, and no other germ cell differentiation was found.

pmid-18489135.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胚性幹細胞(HUES-7)と胎児性癌細胞株(NT2/D1)の細胞膜タンパク質をプロテオミクス解析で比較した。それぞれ237種と219種の特異的な膜タンパク質を同定した。HedgehogおよびWnt経路の構成因子に発現差が認められた。染色体12pに由来するタンパク質は胎児性癌細胞でのみ検出され、精巣がんとの関連が示唆された。
pmid-18489135.summary_en: This proteomics study identified plasma membrane proteins in human embryonic stem cells (HUES-7) and human embryonal carcinoma cells (NT2/D1) without tedious cell fractionation. It identified 237 and 219 specific proteins, respectively, and found differentially expressed Hedgehog and Wnt pathway members. Chromosome 12p proteins duplicated in testicular cancer were uniquely found in embryonal carcinoma cells, which may help explain how these cells differ from benign stem cells.

pmid-18491254.summary_ja: 本総説は、胚細胞腫瘍の形成に関する最近の知見をまとめたものである。胚細胞腫瘍は、有糸分裂から減数分裂への異常な切り替えを経て原始胚細胞から生じ、減数分裂中のエラーが腫瘍性形質転換を促進すると提案している。また、オンコマイR(miRNA)やオンコピーR(piRNA)などの低分子RNAの役割を、マウス、線虫、ショウジョウバエ、ヒトのデータから考察している。
pmid-18491254.summary_en: This review summarizes recent insights into germ cell tumor formation. It proposes that germ cell tumors originate from primordial germ cells through an aberrant mitosis-to-meiosis switch, and that meiotic errors promote tumorigenic transformation. The review also discusses the roles of small RNAs, including oncomirs (miRNAs) and oncopirs (piRNAs), drawing on data from mice, nematodes, fruit flies, and humans.

pmid-18497549.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性30例を後方視的に検討し、血清腫瘍マーカーと組織マーカーの予後的価値を評価した研究である。術前の血清CA 125高値は進行性疾患と関連した。AP-2γとOct-3/4はディスジャーミノーマに陽性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫では多くが陰性であった。これらの組織マーカーは鑑別診断に有用と考えられる。
pmid-18497549.summary_en: This retrospective study of 30 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated serum AFP, hCG, and CA 125, along with tissue CA 125, AP-2gamma, and Oct-3/4 immunohistochemistry. Overall survival was 73%. Elevated preoperative serum CA 125 predicted progressive disease. Dysgerminomas and a germinoma cell line expressed AP-2gamma and Oct-3/4, while most yolk sac tumors and immature teratomas were negative. The authors suggest these tissue markers can aid differential diagnosis.

pmid-18498036.summary_ja: 小児の成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫14例について、ガリウム67の集積機序を検討した研究である。陽性5例は主に後腹膜や卵巣の成熟奇形腫であった。成熟奇形腫の集積は腫瘍内石灰化に一致し、未熟奇形腫では腫瘍内にびまん性に集積した。良性奇形腫で集積比が高いことが示され、CTとの対比により成熟成分と悪性・未熟成分の鑑別に役立つと結論された。
pmid-18498036.summary_en: This study investigated why mature and immature teratomas in 14 children take up gallium-67. Gallium scintigraphy and CT were compared with autoradiography and radiography of resected specimens. Five tumors showed uptake, mostly mature teratomas of retroperitoneal or ovarian origin. In mature teratomas, uptake corresponded to intralesional calcifications, whereas the immature teratoma showed diffuse uptake. The authors conclude that uptake ratios in benign teratoma are high and that scintigraphy with CT can help distinguish malignant or immature components from mature tissue.

pmid-18499177.summary_ja: 無精子症の男性145例を後方視的に検討し、34%に精巣の超音波異常を認めた研究である。セミノーマは1例のみで、その他の病変の多くは良性であった。腫瘍マーカーが陰性で5mm未満の病変は、直ちに根治的精巣摘除術を行わず連続超音波検査で経過観察してよいと提案された。拡大する病変や大きな病変は組織学的検査を考慮すべきである。
pmid-18499177.summary_en: This retrospective study of 145 azoospermic men found that 34% had incidental testicular sonographic abnormalities. Only one seminoma was identified, and it presented as a mass on routine ultrasound. Most lesions, especially those under 5 mm with negative tumor markers, were benign. The authors suggest that such lesions may be followed with serial scrotal ultrasound rather than immediately treated by radical orchiectomy, while enlarging or larger lesions should prompt histological examination.

pmid-18503827.summary_ja: パラフィン包埋組織を用いた胚細胞腫瘍の12p増加を検出する間期FISH法の臨床的妥当性を検討。12p12.1のBACプローブと12番染色体セントロメアプローブを用い、混合型胚細胞腫瘍やディスジャーミノーマを含む14症例で評価した。胚細胞腫瘍とそこから生じた非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍は全例で陽性、正常対照は全例陰性だった。新生の悪性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の再発を鑑別するのに有用と考えられる。
pmid-18503827.summary_en: This study validates an interphase FISH assay for 12p copy-number gain in paraffin-embedded germ cell tumors, using a BAC probe at 12p12.1 and a centromere 12 control. Among 14 tumor cases, including malignant mixed germ cell tumors and dysgerminomas, all germ cell tumors and non-germ cell malignancies arising from them showed 12p overrepresentation, while normal controls were negative. The authors suggest the assay can help distinguish de novo malignancy from germ cell tumor recurrence.

pmid-18504383.summary_ja: 1990年から2006年に出生した直径10cmを超える大型仙尾部奇形腫の新生児9例を後方視的に検討。6例が生存し、うち4例は早期の胎児水腫を伴っていた。生存例と死亡例の平均在胎週数に有意差はなく、最大の腫瘍を有した児は生存しなかった。早産のリスクは、腫瘍増大や子宮内治療のリスクと比較して判断すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-18504383.summary_en: This retrospective review of nine live-born infants with very large sacrococcygeal teratomas (over 10 cm) from 1990 to 2006 examined whether gestational age at delivery affects outcome. Six infants survived, four of them with early hydrops. Survivors' mean gestational age did not differ significantly from nonsurvivors' (32.2 vs 31.7 weeks). Infants with the largest tumors did not survive. The authors conclude that preterm delivery risks must be weighed against tumor enlargement and in utero intervention risks.

pmid-18504568.summary_ja: 1993年から2006年に上腹部もしくは後腹膜の奇形腫と診断された乳児12例（全例良性）を後方視的に検討。多くで脂肪やカルシウムといった典型的な画像所見が認められた。一方、下大静脈などの主要血管を画像で明確に同定できた例は少なく、血管の変位や包埋がほぼ全例で見られた。術前の血管評価は不正確になりやすく、手術計画に反映すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-18504568.summary_en: This retrospective review of 12 infants with primary upper abdominal or retroperitoneal teratomas, all benign, describes typical radiological features such as fat and calcification. Ultrasound and CT showed these features in most infants, but the inferior vena cava and other major vessels could often not be clearly identified, and encasement or distortion was common. The authors emphasize that preoperative vascular delineation is often imprecise and should inform surgical planning.

pmid-18505054.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対し2年前に右鼠径精巣摘除と化学療法を受けた35歳男性が、左上顎歯肉の腫脹を呈した。病理組織学的に転移性胎児性癌と診断され、胸腹部画像では唯一の転移巣だった。化学療法により良好な反応を示している。歯肉転移は稀で反応性病変と鑑別が難しく、混合型では侵襲性の高い成分が転移しうることを強調している。
pmid-18505054.summary_en: A 35-year-old man presented with a swelling in the left maxillary gingiva, two years after orchidectomy and chemotherapy for testicular mixed germ cell tumor. Histopathology revealed metastatic embryonal carcinoma, the only metastatic site on chest and abdominal imaging. He was responding to chemotherapy. The authors note that gingival metastases are rare and can mimic reactive lesions, and that the more aggressive component of mixed testicular tumors may be the one that metastasizes.

pmid-18505349.summary_ja: チェコ共和国の病院ベースの症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスク因子をセミノーマと非セミノーマ別に検討した。萎縮精巣、停留精巣、前立腺がんの家族歴などがリスク上昇と関連し、5歳以降の精巣固定術の遅れはセミノーマのリスクと特に関連した。環境要因と遺伝的素因の両方が関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-18505349.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study in the Czech Republic examined risk factors for testicular germ cell cancer, analyzing seminoma and non-seminoma separately. It included 356 cases and 317 age-matched controls. Atrophic testis, cryptorchidism, family history of prostate cancer, and smoking were associated with increased risk, while maternal age over 20 years and moderate recreational sport reduced risk. Delayed orchidopexy after age 5 was linked particularly to seminoma. The authors conclude that both environmental exposures and genetic inheritance likely contribute to risk.

pmid-18506939.summary_ja: 85歳男性の胃がん症例で、絨毛癌、小細胞(神経内分泌)癌、管状腺癌の3成分が混在していた。絨毛癌成分はβ-hCGとヒト胎盤性ラクトゲンに陽性であった。全胃切除術などを受けたが、初診から約2か月後に肝不全で死亡した。3つの組織所見を併せ持つ胃がんの初めての報告であり、予後は極めて不良とされる。
pmid-18506939.summary_en: This case report describes an 85-year-old man with a gastric tumor containing three components: choriocarcinoma, small cell (neuroendocrine) carcinoma, and tubular adenocarcinoma. Choriocarcinomatous foci stained positive for beta-hCG and placental lactogen, while small cell foci expressed synaptophysin, NSE, and chromogranin A. The patient underwent total gastrectomy with lymph node dissection and partial liver resection but died about two months after first presentation from hepatic failure. The authors note this is the first reported case of gastric cancer with all three histologic features and that prognosis is very poor.

pmid-18514799.summary_ja: SEERデータベースを用いて絨毛癌患者646例を解析し、後の乳癌発生率を一般集団と比較した。乳癌発症は2例のみで、発生率比は0.21と低下していた(79%減少)。高濃度のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)曝露が乳癌に対して保護的に作用する可能性が示唆された。症例数が少なく、結論には限界がある。
pmid-18514799.summary_en: This SEER registry analysis of 646 women aged 15 to 54 with choriocarcinoma assessed subsequent breast cancer risk. Only two patients developed breast cancer, giving an incidence rate ratio of 0.21 compared with the general population (95% CI 0.145 to 0.327), a 79% reduction regardless of age and race. The authors suggest that high hCG exposure from choriocarcinoma may be protective against breast cancer, though the small number of events limits firm conclusions.

pmid-18515985.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍131例と正常精巣20例で、アポトーシス抑制因子livinのスプライシング変異体を解析した。livin βは約半数、αは約3割で発現し、正常精巣では検出されなかった。発現は組織型により異なり、セミノーマで多く、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では胎児性癌成分に限局していた。治療標的としての可能性が示唆された。
pmid-18515985.summary_en: This study measured splicing variants of the apoptosis inhibitor livin in 131 testicular germ cell tumors and 20 normal testes using real-time RT-PCR and Western blot. Livin beta was detected in about half of the tumors and alpha in roughly a quarter, while neither variant appeared in normal testis. Expression differed by histology, being more frequent in seminomas than in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, where it was confined to embryonal carcinoma components. The authors propose livin as a potential therapeutic target in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-18516921.summary_ja: 20歳女性が急性腹症で受診し、副腎腫瘍の自然破裂による後腹膜出血と診断された。肝臓と肺にも多発病変があった。開腹手術で副腎・腫瘍・腎臓を一括切除し、病理学的に絨毛癌と確定した。副腎転移の自然破裂で発症した稀な絨毛癌の症例報告である。
pmid-18516921.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman presented with an acute abdomen caused by spontaneous retroperitoneal hemorrhage from a ruptured adrenal mass, with multiple liver lesions and pulmonary nodules. Exploratory laparotomy confirmed rupture, and the adrenal gland, tumor, and kidney were resected en bloc. Pathology showed choriocarcinoma. The report describes an unusual presentation of choriocarcinoma as an adrenal metastasis with spontaneous rupture, highlighting that such metastatic disease can present as a surgical emergency.

pmid-18516924.summary_ja: 72歳女性が肉眼的血尿で受診し、膀胱腫瘍を認めた。当初は尿路上皮癌と診断されたが、最終的に原発性膀胱絨毛癌(pT3a、pN1)と分類された。MVAC療法を施行しhCG-βは正常化したが、術後11か月で肺転移が出現し、12か月後に死亡した。
pmid-18516924.summary_en: A 72-year-old woman presented with macrohematuria and a bladder tumor initially diagnosed as urothelial carcinoma containing syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells. Final pathology classified it as primary choriocarcinoma of the bladder, and serum hCG-beta was slightly elevated. She underwent cystohysterectomy with an ileal conduit and received MVAC chemotherapy, with hCG normalizing after two courses. Multiple lung metastases appeared 11 months after surgery, and she died 12 months postoperatively from widespread metastases.

pmid-18519683.summary_ja: 小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍27例を対象に遺伝子発現を網羅的に解析し、成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍と比較した。組織型(卵黄嚢腫瘍とセミノーマ)が発現パターンを決める主要因であり、小児と成人の腫瘍は特に卵黄嚢腫瘍で明確に分かれた。小児セミノーマは多能性関連遺伝子が豊富で、年齢による臨床的差異を反映していた。
pmid-18519683.summary_en: This study compared global gene expression of 27 pediatric malignant germ cell tumors, including 18 yolk sac tumors and 9 seminomas, with adult testicular germ cell tumor data. Histologic type was the dominant discriminator, with yolk sac tumors and seminomas clearly separating, and pediatric and adult tumors segregating especially for yolk sac tumors. Pediatric seminomas were enriched for pluripotency-associated genes, whereas pediatric yolk sac tumors showed differentiation and proliferation signatures, reflecting clinical differences between age groups.

pmid-18521105.summary_ja: 51歳男性が精巣外傷後の不快感で受診し、両側精巣セミノーマ(臨床病期I)と診断された。左右とも根治的精巣摘除術を施行し、右側は脈管侵襲を伴っていた。テストステロン補充療法を開始し、腹部への補助放射線療法(25Gy)を行った。24か月のフォローアップ中に病変の再発は認めなかった。
pmid-18521105.summary_en: A 51-year-old man with minor testicular trauma and persistent discomfort was found to have bilateral testicular seminomas, clinically stage I. He underwent radical left orchiectomy, then radical right orchiectomy after an equivocal frozen section; the right tumor showed vascular invasion. Testosterone replacement was started, and he received adjuvant abdominal radiotherapy to 25 Gy. He showed no evidence of disease over 24 months of follow-up. The report illustrates management of synchronous bilateral testicular seminoma.

pmid-18521477.summary_ja: 精巣の良性胚細胞腫瘍である類表皮嚢胞が両側に認められた症例。特徴的な超音波検査所見により、根治的精巣摘除術ではなく精巣温存の核出術を行えた。両側発生は極めて稀で、既報は3例のみとされる。典型的な所見の認識は不要な精巣摘除術の回避に有用である。
pmid-18521477.summary_en: This report describes a case of bilateral testicular epidermoid cysts, a rare benign germ cell tumor. Characteristic ultrasound findings allowed testis-sparing enucleation instead of radical orchiectomy. The authors note that bilateral occurrence is very rare, with only three previous reports. Recognizing typical sonographic features is important for avoiding unnecessary orchiectomy and preserving testicular tissue in benign lesions.

pmid-18524796.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者32例と健常者38例で血清IGF系因子を測定した。未治療例ではIGF-IIとIGFBP-2が有意に高値であった。治療により低下し、αフェトプロテインやhCGの推移と相関した。再発例では再上昇した。未治療例ではIGFBP-3の蛋白分解の亢進も示唆され、IGFBP-2は治療効果や再発の監視を補助するマーカーとなる可能性が示された。
pmid-18524796.summary_en: This study measured serum IGF system components in 32 untreated patients with non-seminomatous germ cell cancer and 38 healthy controls. IGF-II and IGFBP-2 were significantly elevated in patients. IGFBP-2 levels fell with successful treatment, tracking the decline of AFP and hCG, and rose markedly in patients with recurrent disease. Intact IGFBP-3 bands were reduced in untreated patients, suggesting increased proteolysis. IGFBP-2 may serve as a supplementary marker for monitoring response and recurrence.

pmid-18525461.summary_ja: 新生児期の肝芽腫2例と胚細胞腫瘍5例で、AFPのL3分画の有用性を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍と肝芽腫ではAFPとL3分画がともに上昇した。未熟奇形腫ではL3は約10%で術後に低下し、悪性転化例ではAFPとともに上昇した。成熟奇形腫ではL3は0.5%未満であった。L3分画は新生児期の悪性度評価に有用とされた。
pmid-18525461.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic utility of the AFP L3 fraction in two hepatoblastoma and five neoinfantile germ cell tumor cases. In hepatoblastoma and yolk sac tumor, both total AFP and L3 fraction were elevated. In neonatal immature teratoma, total AFP was high but L3 was about 10% and decreased after surgery. One immature teratoma with malignant transformation showed parallel rises in total AFP and L3. In mature teratoma, L3 remained below 0.5% despite high total AFP. The authors conclude that L3 is useful for assessing malignant potential during the neoinfantile period.

pmid-18537954.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍87例を対象に、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(LRPLND)と補助化学療法の15年間の成績を検討した。リンパ節転移陽性例は24%で、全例が補助化学療法を受け、再発はなかった。病理病期Iで補助治療を受けなかった例の9%に遠隔再発がみられた。合併症は少なく、良好な腫瘍学的成績が示され、厳重なフォローアップを回避できるとされた。
pmid-18537954.summary_en: This prospective 15-year series of 87 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumours evaluated laparoscopic RPLND with adjuvant chemotherapy for node-positive disease. Positive nodes occurred in 24%, and all received two cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin. Distant relapse occurred in 9% of pathological stage I patients who did not receive adjuvant treatment, but no node-positive patients relapsed. Complications were low. The authors conclude that laparoscopic RPLND with selective adjuvant chemotherapy gives excellent oncological outcomes while avoiding intensive follow-up.

pmid-18541896.summary_ja: 英国小児がん研究グループの小児頭蓋外成熟奇形腫・未熟奇形腫351例について、特徴、治療、再発危険因子を検討した。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は成熟奇形腫99%、未熟奇形腫95.1%であった。不完全切除、腫瘍破裂、非性腺部位(特に仙尾部)、若年、病期・悪性度の高さ、腹膜神経膠腫症が予後不良と関連した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の再発にはカルボプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンが有効であったが、奇形腫では効果がなかった。
pmid-18541896.summary_en: This UK Children's Cancer Study Group series of 351 children with mature or immature extracranial teratoma examined clinical features, treatment and relapse risk. Incomplete resection was more common in immature teratoma. Five-year overall survival was 99% for mature and 95.1% for immature teratoma. Poorer outcomes were linked to incomplete resection, rupture, nongonadal (especially sacrococcygeal) site, young age, higher stage and grade, and gliomatosis peritonei. Carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin was effective for yolk sac tumor relapse but not for mature or immature teratoma.

pmid-18542063.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップについて文献を検討し、実用的なガイドラインを提示した。国際的な統一見解がないため、各病期のセミノーマと非セミノーマにおける7つの典型的な場面を抽出した。再発を安全かつ確実に検出し、不必要な害や医療資源の浪費を避けることを目的とする。他施設でも利用・改変しやすい形式で示され、今後の試験にも役立つとされた。
pmid-18542063.summary_en: This review of testicular germ cell tumour follow-up identifies seven common management scenarios for seminoma and nonseminoma across stages. Because no international consensus exists on post-treatment follow-up, the authors reviewed the literature and proposed comprehensive protocols. The guidelines aim to detect relapse promptly and reliably while avoiding harm and optimizing risk-benefit ratios and use of resources. The protocols are presented as pragmatic and adaptable for other centres and future trials.

pmid-18547965.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍由来の細胞株NOY1・NOY2を初めて樹立し、ヌードマウス内でも腫瘍形態とAFP陽性を維持することを示した。Nkx2.5 siRNAによりNOY1の細胞生存率は約50%低下し、新たな分子標的として有望であることが示唆された。
pmid-18547965.summary_en: This study establishes NOY1 and NOY2, the first human ovarian yolk sac tumor cell lines, derived from a 28-year-old woman's salpingo-oophorectomy specimen. Xenografts maintained in nude mice reproduced solid and glandular YST morphology with AFP expression. siRNA knockdown of Nkx2.5 reduced NOY1 cell viability by about 50%, suggesting Nkx2.5 as a potential molecular target for novel therapy of ovarian YST. The cell line offers a useful model for studying this rare, highly malignant tumor.

pmid-18549490.summary_ja: 妊娠第2三半期に類皮嚢腫が破裂した27歳の初産婦で、肉芽腫性腹膜炎が生じ、進行卵巣癌に類似した所見を呈した。31週での帝王切開後に腸管切除を受けたが、組織学的に悪性所見はなく、1年後には回復した。妊娠中の破裂後合併症としてまれであり、術中迅速凍結切片が診断に有用となりうると述べている。
pmid-18549490.summary_en: A 27-year-old primigravida had a dermoid cyst rupture during surgical removal in the second trimester. She developed granulomatous peritonitis with diffuse peritoneal reaction, abdominal distension, weight loss over 8 kg, and sebaceous leakage from the wound, mimicking disseminated ovarian carcinoma. Preterm cesarean delivery at 31 weeks was followed by bowel resection for suspected malignant infiltration, which histology did not confirm. She recovered well by one year. The authors highlight this rare complication and suggest frozen section may aid diagnosis.

pmid-18553238.summary_ja: 不正出血と肺腫瘤で受診した35歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の症例である。子宮全摘とEMA-CO療法3コース後もPETで陽性を示した肺結節に対し楔状切除を行い、臨床的寛解を維持している。化学療法後にPET陽性の残存病変を有する症例において、手術が救済的役割を果たしうることを示唆している。
pmid-18553238.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman with placental-site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) presented with irregular bleeding and a lung mass. Diagnosis was made by frozen section of curettage material. After hysterectomy and three cycles of EMA-CO chemotherapy, PET showed a persistent lung nodule, which was resected by wedge resection. She remains in clinical remission. The report suggests that surgical resection can play a role in salvaging patients with PET-positive residual disease after chemotherapy.

pmid-18554661.summary_ja: 軍事医療施設で20年間に診断された精巣がん338例(胚細胞腫瘍330例)を、SEERおよび全国がんデータベースと比較した。病期Iの割合が増加し、セミノーマは減少した。病期Iセミノーマでは放射線療法から化学療法への移行が、非セミノーマでは補助化学療法の増加と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の減少が認められた。5年がん特異的生存率は97.7%であった。
pmid-18554661.summary_en: This 20-year single-institution review of 338 testicular cancers (330 germ cell tumors) from a military medical facility compares local trends with SEER and National Cancer Database data. Stage I disease rose from 57% to 75%, and seminomas declined. Adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma decreased while chemotherapy increased; for nonseminomatous tumors, adjuvant chemotherapy rose and staging retroperitoneal lymph node dissection fell. Five-year cancer-specific survival was 97.7%. Patients were younger than in national data.

pmid-18557266.summary_ja: 本論文は、胎児・新生児に最も多い胚細胞腫瘍である仙尾部奇形腫(SCT)を、看護の視点から概説しています。早産、分娩停止、高拍出性心不全など、適切な管理がなければ生命に関わる胎児病態を取り上げています。出生前診断、治療選択肢、最新の研究動向も含め、SCTと診断された胎児・新生児のケアに携わる医療者への指針を示しています。
pmid-18557266.summary_en: This nursing-focused article reviews sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), the most common germ cell neoplasm of the fetus and neonate. It describes fetal pathophysiology, including premature labor, dystocia, and high-output cardiac failure, which can be life-threatening without appropriate management. Clinical manifestations, prenatal diagnosis, and therapeutic approaches for the fetus and newborn are addressed, along with current research. The article aims to guide practitioners caring for fetuses or infants diagnosed with SCT.

pmid-18560398.summary_ja: 9cmの左卵巣腫瘤を有する25歳女性の症例報告です。卵巣甲状腺腫に乳頭状甲状腺癌の微小病巣を認め、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断されました。左卵巣摘出術などの後、内分泌科でサイロキシン療法を受けています。1年後のフォローアップの超音波検査で再発はなく、甲状腺機能は正常範囲でした。
pmid-18560398.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with a 9 cm left ovarian mass, diagnosed as malignant struma ovarii with microscopic foci of papillary thyroid carcinoma. Thyroid function and serum thyroglobulin were normal. She underwent left oophorectomy, omental biopsy, and lymph node sampling, followed by endocrinology referral and thyroxine therapy to suppress TSH. Follow-up pelvic ultrasonography one year later showed no recurrence, and thyroglobulin remained normal.

pmid-18563734.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、1988〜2001年に診断された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性760例を解析しています。病期I-IIが多く、未熟奇形腫が最も多い組織型でした。妊孕性温存手術は約41%に施行され、経時的に増加していました。妊孕性温存手術と標準手術で生存率に差はなく、進行期と卵黄嚢腫瘍が予後不良因子でした。
pmid-18563734.summary_en: This SEER-based analysis examined 760 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors diagnosed from 1988 to 2001, focusing on demographics, survival, and surgical trends. Most patients presented with stage I-II disease, and immature teratoma was the most common histology. Fertility-preserving surgery was performed in about 41% of patients, with rising use over time. Survival was similar between fertility-preserving and standard surgery. Advanced stage and yolk sac tumor histology predicted poorer survival.

pmid-18565226.summary_ja: 34歳女性が、広範な転移を伴う絨毛癌の初発症状として急性硬膜下血腫を呈し、減圧開頭術を要した症例です。血腫組織には絨毛癌を認めませんでしたが、脳脊髄液の所見から頭蓋内転移が強く示唆されました。脳脊髄液と血清のβ-hCG比が診断に有用であったと述べ、絨毛癌の神経系転移の多様な症状を概説しています。
pmid-18565226.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman whose first presentation of widely metastatic choriocarcinoma was an acute subdural hematoma requiring decompressive craniectomy. Histology of the hematoma tissue showed no choriocarcinoma, but diffuse metastatic disease and cerebrospinal fluid findings strongly suggested intracranial metastasis. The authors note that the CSF to serum beta-hCG ratio aided diagnosis and review the neurologic manifestations of choriocarcinoma metastasis and the neurosurgeon's role.

pmid-18567286.summary_ja: 30歳女性の原発性肺絨毛癌の症例報告です。極めてまれな性腺外原発の腫瘍です。外科的切除と複数回の併用化学療法を行い、β-hCGの推移を追跡して1年後に完全寛解に至りました。性腺外絨毛癌は治療抵抗性が強く、外科的切除が第一選択であり、β-hCGが術後管理に有用であると考察しています。
pmid-18567286.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare extragonadal tumor. She underwent surgical resection followed by multiple cycles of combination chemotherapy. Serial beta-hCG monitoring during follow-up showed complete remission after one year. The authors note that extragonadal choriocarcinomas respond poorly to treatment, that surgery is the first-line option, and that beta-hCG is a reliable marker for postoperative management.

pmid-18568732.summary_ja: 生後6週の女児が腹部腫瘤と脊髄圧迫で受診し、当初は先天性神経芽腫と診断された。神経芽腫の治療開始後の組織検査で胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。脊髄へ広範に進展した砂時計型の後腹膜奇形腫で、小児例としては初の報告である。新生児の腹骨盤内腫瘤と脊髄病変を伴う場合、奇形腫を鑑別に挙げる重要性が示されている。
pmid-18568732.summary_en: A 6-week-old girl presented with an abdominal mass and spinal cord compression, initially suspected to be congenital neuroblastoma. After neuroblastoma therapy had started, histology revealed a germ cell tumour. The tumour was a pelvic-to-retroperitoneal dumbbell-shaped teratoma with extensive spinal involvement. The authors describe it as the first reported paediatric case of this configuration, emphasising teratoma as an important differential diagnosis for neonatal abdominopelvic masses with spinal extension.

pmid-18570724.summary_ja: 27歳男性が、松果体部胚細胞腫瘍の治療から9年後に精巣胚性癌を発症した。中枢神経系胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍が生じた初めての症例で、同種の報告としては4例目にあたる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の患者では、異時性の精巣腫瘍は極めて稀である。本例は、長期フォローアップと患者自身による自己検診の重要性を示している。
pmid-18570724.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with embryonal carcinoma of the testis developed the tumour 9 years after treatment of a pineal region germ cell tumour. The authors report the fourth case of a primary germ cell tumour occurring after CNS germ cell tumour treatment, and the first involving a non-seminomatous testicular tumour. Metachronous testicular tumours after extragonadal germ cell tumours are rare. The case highlights the need for long-term follow-up and patient self-examination.

pmid-18571705.summary_ja: SEERデータベースの613例を解析し、卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリンパ節転移率は18.1%であった。転移率は組織型によって異なり、ディスジャーミノーマで28%と最も高かった。リンパ節転移は独立した予後不良因子であり（ハザード比2.87）、5年生存率は82.8%対95.7%であった。リンパ節郭清の意義を示し、補助療法の個別化に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-18571705.summary_en: Using SEER data (1988 to 2004) on 613 ovarian malignant germ cell tumour patients who underwent lymphadenectomy, the authors found lymph node metastasis in 18.1%. Prevalence varied by histology: dysgerminoma 28%, mixed germ cell tumours 16%, and malignant teratoma 8%. Lymph node involvement independently predicted poorer survival (hazard ratio 2.87), with five-year survival of 82.8% versus 95.7%. The authors suggest lymphadenectomy and nodal status may aid risk stratification and adjuvant therapy decisions.

pmid-18573447.summary_ja: 59歳患者に発生した、悪性転化を伴う巨大縦隔奇形腫の症例である。成熟奇形腫と非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍から成る極めて稀な病態である。嚢胞内に多発結節を伴う嚢胞性腫瘤として描出され、包虫症との鑑別が必要であった。CT、MRI、術中所見および病理所見を提示し、画像で悪性変化を認識することの難しさを示している。
pmid-18573447.summary_en: A 59-year-old patient had a giant mediastinal teratoma with malignant transformation, a very rare entity comprising a mature teratoma and a non-germ-cell malignancy. Imaging showed a cystic mass with multiple nodules within the cyst, which required differentiation from hydatid disease. The authors describe CT, MRI, operative and pathologic findings, emphasising that radiologic recognition of malignant change in mediastinal teratomas can be challenging.

pmid-18573789.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、著明な血管増殖とWagner-Meissner様小体を認めた症例の報告である。血管増殖は神経成分の豊富な他の腫瘍に類似する。Wagner-Meissner様小体は神経成分の特殊な分化を示すと考えられる。卵巣奇形腫でこの所見が報告されたのは初めてと思われ、新たな組織学的知見である。
pmid-18573789.summary_en: The authors present an ovarian mature cystic teratoma showing florid vascular proliferation and Wagner-Meissner-like corpuscles. The vascular changes resemble those seen in other tumours with a prominent neural component. The corpuscles are interpreted as evidence of specialised neural differentiation. To the authors' knowledge, such corpuscles have not previously been described in ovarian teratomas, making this a novel histopathological observation.

pmid-18574129.summary_ja: AIDSを合併した女性が転移性絨毛癌と呼吸不全を発症したが、再発を経ても生存した。絨毛癌は免疫不全患者で死亡率が高い。著明に上昇したヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のβサブユニットは、in vitro研究の一部とは異なり、HIV複製を抑制する明らかな作用を示さなかった。転移による呼吸不全を伴っても救命可能であることを示す症例である。
pmid-18574129.summary_en: A woman with AIDS developed metastatic choriocarcinoma and respiratory failure, yet survived despite relapse. Choriocarcinoma carries high mortality in immunocompromised patients, while prognosis is generally good in immunocompetent individuals. The markedly elevated beta-subunit of hCG did not appear to inhibit HIV replication, contrary to some in vitro findings. The case shows that survival is possible even with life-threatening respiratory failure from metastatic disease.

pmid-18574669.summary_ja: 全身性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移に対し全脳放射線療法を受けた後、再発を繰り返す多発性放射線壊死を生じた症例である。ワルファリンによる抗凝固療法が奏効した可能性がある。放射線壊死の診断から10年後も神経脱落症状なく生存している。胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移患者に生じうる稀な晩期合併症であり、治療選択肢の一つとして示唆される。
pmid-18574669.summary_en: A patient with a systemic germ cell tumour and brain metastases developed relapsing multifocal radiation necrosis after whole brain radiotherapy. Anticoagulation with warfarin may have provided therapeutic benefit. The patient remained alive without neurological deficit ten years after the diagnosis of radiation necrosis. The report illustrates a rare late complication of cranial radiotherapy in germ cell tumour patients with brain metastasis, with warfarin a possible though uncertain treatment option.

pmid-18575279.summary_ja: 1984〜2007年にラジャヴィティ病院で治療された悪性胚細胞腫瘍60例を後方視的に検討した。補助化学療法後のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の低下パターンを解析し、初回と2回目の化学療法の間のAFP低下が生存と関連することを示した。維持化学療法のコース数も無増悪生存期間と全生存期間に影響した。AFP低下は独立した予後因子であり、治療方針の指標になりうると結論づけている。
pmid-18575279.summary_en: This retrospective study of 60 patients with malignant germ cell tumors treated at Rajavithi Hospital between 1984 and 2007 examined how serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) fell after adjuvant chemotherapy. AFP became negative after about three courses on average, and two maintenance courses were then given. A drop in AFP between the first and second courses was associated with survival, with about 70% accuracy and 83.3% sensitivity. The number of maintenance courses significantly affected progression-free interval and overall survival. The authors conclude that AFP regression is an independent prognostic factor that may guide treatment.

pmid-18575713.summary_ja: 最適手術後に再発した卵巣未熟奇形腫に備え、グレードIIの腫瘍から初代培養細胞とヌードマウス移植モデルを作製し薬剤感受性を比較した。初代細胞はタキサン系やアントラサイクリン系に高感受性を示したが、ヌードマウス由来細胞は多くの薬剤で感受性が低下していた。再発細胞は耐性を獲得しやすく、補助化学療法の有用性を支持する結果である。
pmid-18575713.summary_en: Because ovarian immature teratomas are often treated with surgery alone, the authors established primary cell cultures and nude mouse xenografts from a grade II tumor and compared drug sensitivity. Primary cells were highly sensitive to paclitaxel, docetaxel and anthracyclines, while nude mouse-passaged cells were generally less sensitive and showed reduced smooth muscle actin expression. The authors suggest recurrent cells may be more chemoresistant, supporting adjuvant chemotherapy after optimal surgery. They propose paclitaxel/carboplatin or docetaxel/carboplatin as alternatives to BEP or PBV regimens, particularly to reduce reproductive toxicity.

pmid-18577900.summary_ja: 18歳男性の巨大卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。腫瘍が気管と左主気管支を圧迫し、仰臥位で高度の呼吸困難があった。経皮的心肺補助(PCPS)下に換気を維持しつつ、吸引器を用いて腫瘍を切除した。呼吸困難を伴う縦隔腫瘍の手術において、これらの器具が有用であると著者らは提案している。
pmid-18577900.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man with a giant yolk sac tumor that compressed the trachea and left main bronchus and caused severe dyspnea when supine. The tumor was resected under percutaneous cardiopulmonary support (PCPS) for ventilation, and a vacuum aspiration device was used to aid removal. The authors suggest that PCPS and vacuum aspiration devices are useful for operating on mediastinal tumors that cause dyspnea.

pmid-18578862.summary_ja: 治療済み病期Iaのセミノーマの男性で、フォローアップ中にβ-hCGの上昇を認めた症例報告。病期の再評価を行ったが転移は認められなかった。患者はボディビルダーで、アンドロゲン乱用による離脱症状を抑える目的で外因性β-hCGを注射していたことが判明した。診断から8年後も健在である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往があり、ステロイドを使用している可能性のある若年男性では、注意深い腫瘍マーカーの評価が重要と強調している。
pmid-18578862.summary_en: This case report describes a man with a treated stage Ia seminoma whose routine follow-up showed elevated beta-hCG, which prompted restaging that could have led to chemotherapy. The metastatic workup was negative. The patient, a bodybuilder, admitted injecting exogenous beta-hCG to reduce withdrawal symptoms from androgen abuse. He remained well eight years after diagnosis. The authors emphasize vigilant screening of young men with a history of testicular germ cell tumors who may use steroids.

pmid-18580319.summary_ja: 原発性無月経と右付属器腫瘤を主訴とした16歳の46XY表現型女性の症例。完全型性腺異形成があり、SRY遺伝子の異常は認められなかった。両側性の性腺に性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、成熟奇形腫が認められ、右側性腺には卵黄嚢腫瘍と横紋筋芽細胞成分を伴う未熟奇形腫も存在した。リンパ節転移はなく、術後15か月無病であった。SRY遺伝子の状態にかかわらず性腺摘出を推奨すると結論づけている。
pmid-18580319.summary_en: A 16-year-old phenotypic female with a 46,XY karyotype, complete gonadal dysgenesis, and no SRY alterations presented with primary amenorrhea and a right adnexal mass. Bilateral gonads contained gonadoblastoma mixed with dysgerminoma and mature teratoma. The right gonad also contained yolk sac tumor and immature teratoma with rhabdomyoblastic components. No regional lymph node metastasis was found, and she was disease-free at 15 months. The authors argue for gonadectomy in gonadal dysgenesis regardless of SRY status.

pmid-18580681.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘤を呈した24歳と69歳の男性のセミノーマ2例で、目立つ印環細胞を認めた。1例は混合型胚細胞腫瘍の成分、もう1例は純粋型であった。印環細胞は細胞質に空胞を有し、粘液染色、サイトケラチン、αフェトプロテインは陰性、OCT3/4とCD117は陽性で、セミノーマ由来と考えられた。30例の検討では43%に稀な印環細胞がみられた。転移などと誤認しないよう注意が必要と述べている。
pmid-18580681.summary_en: The authors describe two seminomas with conspicuous signet ring cells, from a 24-year-old and a 69-year-old man presenting with testicular masses. One tumor was a component of a mixed germ cell tumor, and the other was pure. The signet ring cells made up about 70% and 10% of the tumors and had cytoplasmic vacuoles, with glycogen identified in one case. They were negative for mucicarmine, cytokeratin and AFP, but positive for OCT3/4 and CD117. In a review of 30 seminomas, rare inconspicuous signet ring cells were found in 43%.

pmid-18581767.summary_ja: 本研究はドイツの一施設で1994年から2006年に治療された卵巣類皮嚢腫67例を検討したものです。大半は嚢腫摘出術で、一部で卵管卵巣摘出術や部分卵巣切除術が行われ、開腹移行例はありませんでした。長期的な術後合併症は認められませんでした。妊娠を希望した43例中37例で妊娠が成立し、子宮内妊娠率は83.7%でした。著者らは国際的なプロトコルに基づく治療の必要性を述べています。
pmid-18581767.summary_en: This study from a German hospital reviews 67 women with ovarian dermoid cysts, also called mature cystic teratomas, treated laparoscopically between 1994 and 2006. Most underwent cyst removal, with a few requiring salpingo-oophorectomy or partial oophorectomy, and none needed conversion to laparotomy. No long-term complications were seen. Among 43 women who desired pregnancy, 37 conceived, giving an intrauterine pregnancy rate of 83.7 percent, with one ectopic pregnancy. The authors conclude that management should follow international protocols.

pmid-18581770.summary_ja: 本研究は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(卵巣類皮嚢腫)の診断補助として血清CA 19-9を検討したものです。手術を受けた43例のうち86%で術前のCA 19-9が上昇していました。CA 19-9値は腫瘍の径および重量と強い正の相関を示しました。著者らは、超音波検査やコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)とあわせ、血清CA 19-9が有用な腫瘍マーカーになりうると提案しています。
pmid-18581770.summary_en: This clinical study evaluated serum CA 19-9 as a diagnostic aid for mature cystic teratomas, also known as ovarian dermoid cysts. Among 43 patients operated on at one clinic, 86 percent had elevated preoperative CA 19-9 levels. CA 19-9 correlated strongly with tumor diameter and weight. Right-sided tumors were most common. The authors suggest that, alongside ultrasonography and computed tomography, serum CA 19-9 may be a useful tumor marker for diagnosing dermoid cysts.

pmid-18581775.summary_ja: 本症例報告は24歳女性の良性卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)を扱っています。嚢胞壁の各面に歯が1本ずつ付着していたことが特徴です。類皮嚢腫は毛包や皮脂腺などを含む成熟奇形腫の典型像を示します。腫瘍は腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫摘出術で切除されました。本報告は類皮嚢腫内の不規則な歯牙構造という稀な所見を示し、この腫瘍の典型的な肉眼像を示しています。
pmid-18581775.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with a benign ovarian cystic teratoma, or dermoid cyst, in which a tooth was attached to each wall of the cyst. Mature teratomas contain tissues from all three germ layers, including hair follicles and skin glands, which is typical of this tumor. The mass was removed laparoscopically by ovarian cystectomy. The report highlights the unusual finding of irregular dental structures within a dermoid cyst and illustrates the characteristic gross appearance of these tumors.

pmid-18581776.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、妊娠32週に超音波検査で出生前診断された1型仙尾部奇形腫を扱っています。胎児の仙骨部に14×12cmの充実性・嚢胞性腫瘤を認めました。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では骨盤内・腹腔内への進展はなく、1型と判断されました。胎児の心機能低下があり、妊娠34週で帝王切開が行われました。生後10日目に腫瘤は切除されました。著者らは、出生前診断、フォローアップ、分娩の時期と方法が予後の指標になると結論づけています。
pmid-18581776.summary_en: This case report describes a type I sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed prenatally at 32 weeks of gestation by ultrasound, showing a 14 by 12 centimeter mass in the fetal sacral region. Magnetic resonance imaging showed no intrapelvic or intraabdominal extension, consistent with type I. Because of signs of cardiac compromise, cesarean delivery was performed at 34 weeks. The infant was stabilized and the mass was excised successfully at ten days of age. The authors conclude that prenatal detection, ultrasound follow-up, and timing and mode of delivery are key prognostic factors.

pmid-18584410.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、12歳時に卵巣甲状腺腫で卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた22歳女性の再発例です。8年後に腹膜、肝臓、横隔膜などへの転移が認められ、濾胞型の乳頭状甲状腺癌様の所見を示しました。rh-TSHを用いたヨウ素131療法を2回施行し、保存的手術と併用されました。著者らは、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫における妊孕性温存法として、GnRHアナログや卵巣組織凍結保存の有用性についても考察しています。
pmid-18584410.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with recurrent struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma, who had undergone salpingo-oophorectomy at age 12. Eight years later she presented with widespread peritoneal, hepatic, and diaphragmatic metastases with features of follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma. She was treated with conservative surgery and two administrations of iodine-131 after recombinant TSH stimulation. The authors also discuss GnRH analogs and ovarian tissue cryopreservation as options for preserving fertility in malignant struma ovarii.

pmid-18588453.summary_ja: 本総説は、セミノーマ型胚細胞腫瘍の大半を占める臨床病期I精巣セミノーマの治療選択肢を検討したものです。病期Iは治療法にかかわらず高い治癒率が得られるため、治療関連の副作用の軽減が注目されています。1990年代半ば以降の標準治療である傍大動脈後腹膜リンパ節への補助放射線療法と、カルボプラチン単剤による補助化学療法を比較しています。また、直ちに補助療法を希望しない患者には、精巣摘除後のサーベイランスも選択肢になると述べています。
pmid-18588453.summary_en: This review explores treatment options for clinical stage I testicular seminoma, the most common presentation of seminomatous germ cell tumors. Men with stage I disease have excellent cure rates regardless of approach, so attention has shifted toward reducing treatment-related morbidity. The authors compare adjuvant radiotherapy to para-aortic retroperitoneal nodes, the standard since the mid-1990s, with adjuvant single-agent carboplatin, which shows promising short-term data. They also discuss surveillance after orchidectomy as an option for motivated patients who wish to avoid immediate adjuvant therapy.

pmid-18588616.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が線毛呼吸上皮由来の高分化型腺癌へ悪性転化した症例報告である。術前に造影CTとMRIで悪性転化が疑われ、免疫組織化学により呼吸上皮由来と考えられた。28か月の経過観察で無病であった。著者らは、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた呼吸上皮性腺癌の報告としては3例目であり、造影画像は術前診断に、免疫組織化学は起源の同定に有用と述べている。
pmid-18588616.summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation into well-differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from ciliated respiratory epithelium. Malignancy was suspected preoperatively by contrast-enhanced CT and MRI, and immunohistochemistry supported the respiratory origin. After 28 months of follow-up the patient remained disease-free. The authors note this is only the third reported case of respiratory-epithelial adenocarcinoma arising in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, and conclude that contrast-enhanced imaging aids preoperative diagnosis while immunohistochemistry helps determine tumor origin.

pmid-18592797.summary_ja: 31歳の未経妊女性で、卵巣の類皮嚢腫からCA19-9の著明な上昇（1000 U/ml）を伴う扁平上皮癌が発生した症例を報告する。卵管転移によりFIGO 病期IIaと判定された。片側付属器切除などの外科的切除後、シスプラチンとパクリタキセルによる化学療法を6コース実施し、CA19-9は6か月後に正常化して再発は認めていない。
pmid-18592797.summary_en: A 31-year-old nulliparous woman with a dermoid cyst of the ovary and markedly elevated CA19-9 (1000 U/ml) was found to have squamous cell carcinoma arising in the mature cystic teratoma, staged FIGO IIa due to tubal metastasis. Treatment comprised unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, appendectomy, and lymphadenectomy, followed by six cycles of cisplatin and paclitaxel. CA19-9 normalized to 22.3 U/ml by six months, and she remained recurrence-free. The authors note that such tumors are rare in young patients and that management should be individualized.

pmid-18592802.summary_ja: 妊娠12週の女性で増大する付属器腫瘤が見つかり、摘出したところ未熟卵巣奇形腫（病期Ia、grade 1）と診断された症例を報告する。術中迅速診断は陰性であったが、臨床的な疑いから右付属器切除と外科的病期分類を実施し、化学療法は回避できた。妊娠34週で帝王切開を施行し、2年後も無病である。
pmid-18592802.summary_en: This report describes a Stage I immature ovarian teratoma discovered during pregnancy. A growing adnexal mass was removed at 12 weeks of gestation; although frozen section was negative, clinical suspicion prompted salpingo-oophorectomy and surgical staging. Final histology showed Stage Ia, grade 1 immature teratoma, and chemotherapy was avoided. Cesarean section was performed at 34 weeks with peritoneal biopsies. The patient remained disease-free two years after surgery. The authors conclude that frozen section is useful, but surgical staging should be performed when clinical suspicion exists.

pmid-18593919.summary_ja: 本研究は、キットリガンド遺伝子Kitlが小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍のヒトモデルである129/Svマウスにおいて、TGCT感受性の修飾因子であるかを検討した。Kitlが唯一の従来型欠失遺伝子であるSlgb欠失では、ヘテロ接合体でTGCT発生率が上昇し、KitlがSteel遺伝子座の修飾因子であることが示唆された。著者らはまた、可溶性KITLが膜結合型キットリガンドの用量効果を補完すると提案している。
pmid-18593919.summary_en: This study tested whether the kit ligand gene Kitl is a modifier of testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) susceptibility in the 129/Sv mouse model of pediatric TGCT. The authors examined the small Steel grizzle-belly (Slgb) deletion, which removes only Kitl among conventional genes. Slgb/+ heterozygotes showed increased TGCT incidence, and fine mapping indicated Kitl is the only conventional gene deleted, identifying it as the likely modifier at the Steel locus. The authors also propose that soluble KITL compensates for a dosage effect of transmembrane kit ligand.

pmid-18594467.summary_ja: 7歳女児のCowden症候群に卵巣未分化胚細胞腫（ディスジャーミノーマ）が発生した初めての症例を報告する。PTENの生殖細胞系列ナンセンス変異（Q219X）が確認され、腫瘍ではPTENのヘテロ接合性消失が認められた。PTENがディスジャーミノーマの発生に関与する可能性を示し、Cowden症候群の表現型に新たな要素を加えるものである。
pmid-18594467.summary_en: The authors report the first case of ovarian dysgerminoma in Cowden syndrome, in a 7-year-old girl with a germline PTEN nonsense mutation (Q219X). Prior features included a hamartomatous extremity mass, gastrointestinal polyposis, and papillary thyroid carcinoma diagnosed at age 23. Loss of PTEN heterozygosity was identified in the dysgerminoma. The case highlights the difficulty of classifying Cowden syndrome given overlapping polyposis phenotypes, and shows PTEN's involvement in dysgerminoma pathogenesis, which expands the syndrome's phenotypic spectrum.

pmid-18598836.summary_ja: 48歳男性の副鼻腔および前頭蓋底に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。前頭蓋底切除術と術後放射線療法を施行し、治療から7年後も無病生存を維持している。画像所見と組織学的特徴を検討し、小児の既報3例をレビューしている。頭頸部の胚細胞腫瘍はまれであり、性腺外発生例として貴重な報告である。
pmid-18598836.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old man with yolk sac carcinoma of the sinonasal tract extending to the anterior skull base, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. He underwent anterior craniofacial resection followed by postoperative radiotherapy and remained free of disease seven years later. The authors discuss the radiological and histological features of this tumor and review three previously reported pediatric cases of yolk sac tumor arising in the same region.

pmid-18600368.summary_ja: 9か月の乳児に発生した巨大な多嚢胞性の心膜内腫瘤の症例報告である。心エコーとコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で心囊液貯留を伴う病変を評価し、外科的に切除した。病理組織学的検査により未熟奇形腫と診断された。乳児の心膜に生じた性腺外奇形腫のまれな症例であり、術前評価における画像検査の役割を示す報告である。
pmid-18600368.summary_en: A 9-month-old infant presented with a huge multicystic intrapericardial mass accompanied by pericardial effusion. Echocardiography and computed tomography delineated the lesion, which was resected surgically. Histopathological examination established the diagnosis of immature teratoma. The report highlights an unusual extragonadal teratoma arising in the pericardium of an infant and the role of imaging in its preoperative evaluation.

pmid-18603694.summary_ja: 若年女性に発生した類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)の症例報告である。子宮、子宮傍組織、右卵巣を侵す卵巣腫瘤として発見された。当初絨毛癌と誤診され、不適切な治療により進行した。病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学により胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍や癌は除外された。10か月後に肺と脳に転移し、緩和的化学療法を受けている。ETTは手術が主体であり、絨毛癌との鑑別が重要である。
pmid-18603694.summary_en: A young woman with an epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) involving the uterus, parametrium and right ovary initially presented with an ovarian mass. The tumor was misdiagnosed as choriocarcinoma, leading to inappropriate treatment and progression. Histology and immunohistochemistry excluded placental site trophoblastic tumor and carcinoma. Ten months later she developed lung and brain metastases and is receiving palliative chemotherapy. The authors stress that ETT is primarily treated surgically and must be distinguished from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-18618728.summary_ja: 35歳女性の骨盤内腫瘤に対し、捺印細胞診と術中迅速凍結切片で高悪性度未熟卵巣奇形腫と診断した症例報告。捺印細胞診の所見は組織像と完全に一致した。他の小円形細胞腫瘍との鑑別点を文献的に整理し、補助的検査を併用することで正確な診断が可能であることを示している。
pmid-18618728.summary_en: A case report of a 35-year-old woman with a pelvic mass, diagnosed intraoperatively as high-grade immature ovarian teratoma using imprint cytology and frozen section. The cytologic features fully matched histology. The authors review the literature and outline features that distinguish this tumor from other ovarian small round cell neoplasms, including neuroblastoma, small cell carcinoma of the hypercalcemic type, and primitive neuroectodermal tumor. They note that ancillary studies can aid accurate diagnosis.

pmid-18622385.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学的に5-メチルシトシン(5mC)を検出し、著者らは未分類の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)およびそれに伴う浸潤性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の全体的メチル化を評価した。大多数のIGCNUおよびセミノーマでは、セミノーマ成分を含む混合型を含め、5mCの染色は欠如または著明に低下していたが、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では強く染色された。メチル化の消失はDNMT1の発現とは無関係であった。本知見は、大半の精巣胚細胞腫瘍が発生時の5mC消去を経たIGCNU細胞に由来し、その後のデノボメチル化は組織学的分化と関連していることを支持する。
pmid-18622385.summary_en: Using immunohistochemistry for 5-methylcytosine (5mC), the authors assessed global DNA methylation in intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified (IGCNU) and associated invasive testicular germ cell tumors. 5mC staining was absent or markedly reduced in most IGCNU and seminomas, including mixed tumors with seminomatous components, but robust in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Methylation loss was independent of DNMT1 expression. The findings support a model in which most testicular germ cell tumors arise from IGCNU cells that underwent developmental 5mC erasure, with subsequent de novo methylation tracking histologic differentiation.

pmid-18628091.summary_ja: 卵巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を含む63例(精巣腫瘍を比較対象に含む)でグリピカン3(GPC3)の免疫反応性を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌は全例陽性で、未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫は一部のみ陽性、胎児性癌とジャーミノーマは陰性であった。GPC3は主に卵黄嚢腫瘍と絨毛癌で発現し、診断困難な胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に有用となりうる。
pmid-18628091.summary_en: The authors examined glypican 3 (GPC3) immunoreactivity in germ cell tumors from 63 patients, including ovarian and extragonadal primary tumors and metastases, with testicular tumors for comparison. All yolk sac tumors and both choriocarcinomas were GPC3-positive, whereas only a minority of immature and mature teratomas stained, and embryonal carcinomas and germinomas were negative. GPC3 expression is thus differential across sites, predominantly marking yolk sac tumors and choriocarcinoma, which may aid diagnosis of challenging germ cell tumors.

pmid-18628097.summary_ja: 男性の後腹膜に生じた気管支原性嚢胞22例と、転移性奇形腫34例を比較した。嚢胞は気管支様構造と呼吸上皮を示し、未熟成分や異型、壊死を欠いた。奇形腫は腸型と呼吸上皮型が混在し、CDX-2とTTF-1の共発現が認められたが嚢胞では認めなかった。肉眼・組織・免疫組織化学的所見により両者は確実に鑑別できると結論づけた。
pmid-18628097.summary_en: The authors compared 22 bronchogenic cysts with 34 teratomas metastatic to the retroperitoneum in men to determine distinguishing features. Most cysts showed tracheobronchial architecture and respiratory-type epithelium, lacking immature elements, atypia, and necrosis. Teratomas showed mixed enteric and respiratory epithelium, often coexpressing CDX-2 and TTF-1, which was absent in cysts. All cysts were CK7-positive and CDX-2-negative. The study concludes that bronchogenic cysts can be reliably distinguished from metastatic teratomas using gross, histologic, and immunohistochemical features.

pmid-18630521.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍70例(難治20例、化学感受性50例)を対象に、p53・p21発現とアポトーシス指数を組織型別に解析した。難治群はp53発現が低くp21・アポトーシス指数が高値であった。分化度に依存したアポトーシス制御が化学感受性に関与する可能性が示された。
pmid-18630521.summary_en: This study compared p53 and p21 expression and the spontaneous apoptotic index in 20 chemorefractory and 50 chemosensitive testicular germ cell tumors. Embryonal carcinoma showed high p53 and apoptosis, whereas seminoma lacked p21, and choriocarcinoma and mature teratoma showed low apoptotic potential. Refractory tumors had lower p53, higher p21 and a higher apoptosis index. The authors conclude these markers may influence chemosensitivity, reflecting differentiation-dependent apoptotic regulation.

pmid-18631909.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のある小児および思春期の34名を対象としたレビューでは、68%が良性で、大半は奇形腫であった。32%は悪性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌であった。思春期前の男児では良性腫瘍が多かった。10名に精巣温存手術が行われ、不完全切除後に良性奇形腫の再発が2名に生じた。また、6年後に対側精巣に異時性奇形腫が1名で検出された。完全切除と長期フォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-18631909.summary_en: This review of 34 children and adolescents with testicular tumors found 68% benign, mostly teratoma, and 32% malignant, yolk sac tumor and embryonal carcinoma. Prepubertal boys had more benign tumors. Testis-preserving surgery was done in 10 patients; two benign teratoma recurrences followed incomplete resection, and one metachronous contralateral teratoma appeared six years later. Complete excision and long-term follow-up are recommended.

pmid-18632724.summary_ja: POLG遺伝子のCAGリピート多型と精巣胚細胞腫瘍の関連を、患者243例と対照869例で検討した。非定型CAGリピートのホモ接合体は患者で有意に多かった(4.9%対1.3%)。ホモ接合の患者の大部分はセミノーマであり、POLG多型が特にセミノーマの発症に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-18632724.summary_en: This study examined whether the CAG repeat polymorphism in the POLG gene is associated with testicular germ-cell tumours (TGCT). Genotyping of 243 patients and 869 controls showed that homozygosity for non-common CAG repeat alleles was more frequent in patients (4.9% vs 1.3%). Most homozygous patients had seminoma. The authors suggest the POLG polymorphism may contribute to TGCT pathogenesis, particularly seminoma, though the mechanisms remain unclear.

pmid-18635624.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の捻転、破裂、悪性転化、感染、自己免疫性溶血性貧血などの合併症と、その画像所見を解説した総説。未熟奇形腫や卵巣甲状腺腫、混合腫瘍・衝突腫瘍、脂肪成分に乏しい成熟嚢胞性奇形腫などの非典型的所見も取り上げ、誤診を防ぐための画像診断の重要性を強調している。
pmid-18635624.summary_en: This imaging review describes complications of ovarian teratomas, including torsion, rupture, malignant transformation, infection, and autoimmune hemolytic anemia, and explains how each requires different management. It highlights unusual presentations that can lead to misdiagnosis, such as immature teratomas, struma ovarii, combination and collision tumors, and mature cystic teratomas lacking demonstrable fat. Recognizing these imaging features is emphasized for accurate diagnosis and appropriate treatment planning.

pmid-18636616.summary_ja: 病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された31例の臨床像と超音波所見を解析した研究。純粋型と類皮嚢腫内の不純型を比較し、「甲状腺パール」と呼ばれる滑らかな円形充実性領域が純粋型で最も特異的な所見であった。診断の手がかりとなる可能性があるが、前向き研究による検証が必要とされている。
pmid-18636616.summary_en: This study describes the clinical and ultrasound features of 31 women with histologically confirmed struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma. Pure struma ovarii and impure forms within dermoid cysts were compared using IOTA terminology and pattern recognition. The struma pearl, a smooth roundish solid area, was the most specific sonographic feature of pure struma ovarii and may help suggest the diagnosis, though prospective confirmation is needed.

pmid-18639672.summary_ja: 食道重複症を伴う気管支肺前腸奇形と良性奇形腫を合併した新生児の症例報告。出生前のドプラ超音波検査所見と出生後の管理を提示し、適切な画像検査と外科的介入の必要性を論じている。この希少な合併の発生機序についての仮説も示されている。
pmid-18639672.summary_en: A case report describes a neonate with a bronchopulmonary foregut malformation with esophageal duplication and an associated benign teratoma. Antenatal Doppler ultrasound findings and postnatal management are presented, along with recommendations on appropriate radiologic investigation and the need for surgical intervention. The authors also propose a hypothesis for the embryogenesis of this rare combination.

pmid-18642941.summary_ja: 胎児性癌の組織像を示す精巣由来と性腺外由来の胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を、プロテオーム、RT-PCR、array-CGHで比較した研究。両株のタンパク質プロファイルは類似し、66のタンパク質に発現差が認められた。性腺外由来株ではシスプラチン耐性に関わる可能性のあるタンパク質が見つかり、耐性が多因子性であることが示唆された。
pmid-18642941.summary_en: This study compares a testicular and an extragonadal germ cell tumor cell line, both with embryonal carcinoma histology, using proteomics, RT-PCR, and array-CGH. The two lines had similar protein profiles, with 66 proteins differentially expressed, and mRNA changes often matched protein changes, while genomic copy number correlated poorly. Proteins potentially linked to cisplatin resistance were identified in the extragonadal line, suggesting multifactorial resistance.

pmid-18646677.summary_ja: 36歳未経妊女性の卵巣甲状腺腫に濾胞変異型乳頭癌の病巣を認めた症例報告である。腹腔鏡下嚢胞摘出後、病期分類のため開腹術と両側付属器摘出などを施行した。フォローアップでは腫瘍マーカー、甲状腺検査、全身スキャンが正常であった。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の治療と監視の指針は未確立である。
pmid-18646677.summary_en: A 36-year-old nulligravid woman was found to have struma ovarii with a focus of follicular variant papillary thyroid cancer after laparoscopic cystectomy. She then underwent staging laparotomy, hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and infracolic omentectomy. Tumor markers, thyroid studies, thyroid scan, and whole-body scans were normal during follow-up. The authors note that carcinomatous change in struma ovarii is extremely rare, and that no guidelines exist for staging and treatment of malignant struma ovarii; optimal surveillance remains undefined.

pmid-18648929.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマを治療し治癒した46,XY真性半陰陽の男性が、凍結精巣精子を用いたIVF-ICSIにより健康な児を得た症例報告である。セミノーマを有する同種の不妊症例での成功例として初の報告とされる。がん治療後の凍結精巣精子の生殖可能性を示す事例である。
pmid-18648929.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old man with 46,XY true hermaphroditism who was treated and cured of seminoma. He and his 35-year-old wife then underwent IVF with ICSI using frozen testicular sperm, and a healthy infant was delivered. The authors describe it as the first reported successful delivery of a healthy child fathered by an infertile 46,XY true hermaphrodite with seminoma. Laboratory, pathology, and ultrasound data were reported. The case highlights the reproductive potential of cryopreserved testicular sperm after cancer treatment.

pmid-18649364.summary_ja: Y染色体上の性腺芽腫座の候補遺伝子TSPYが、翻訳伸長因子eEF1Aと相互作用することを示した研究である。セミノーマ標本の腫瘍胚細胞で両者が共局在し高発現していた。TSPYはタンパク質合成と遺伝子転写を増強し、発癌機能を果たす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-18649364.summary_en: This study identifies translation elongation factor eEF1A as a binding partner of TSPY, the putative gonadoblastoma locus gene on the Y chromosome. TSPY and eEF1A co-localized and were highly expressed in tumor germ cells of seminoma specimens. In transfected COS7 cells, they co-immunoprecipitated and colocalized in the cytoplasm. TSPY enhanced protein synthesis of a reporter gene, an effect augmented by eEF1A, and promoted nuclear redistribution of eEF1A. The authors propose that TSPY may exert oncogenic function by interacting with eEF1A.

pmid-18653399.summary_ja: 台北榮民總醫院で25年間に治療された12歳未満の思春期前男児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例の後方視的研究である。卵黄嚢腫瘍が85.3%を占め、病期I卵黄嚢腫瘍の19.2%が転移へ進行し化学療法を要した。5年生存率は卵黄嚢腫瘍96.5%、奇形腫100%であった。
pmid-18653399.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 34 prepubertal boys under 12 years with primary testicular germ cell tumors treated at a single center over 25 years, with mean follow-up of 139 months. All presented with painless scrotal masses and underwent radical orchiectomy. Yolk sac tumors predominated (85.3%), while mature teratomas accounted for the rest. Among stage I yolk sac tumors, 19.2% progressed to metastasis and required chemotherapy. Five-year survival was 96.5% for yolk sac tumor and 100% for teratoma, supporting excellent long-term outcomes with appropriate treatment.

pmid-18656249.summary_ja: 1995年から2006年に単施設で治療された卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍20例を後方視的に検討した研究である。補助化学療法として高用量BEPを施行し、全生存率は90%、骨盤内再発は2例（10%）であった。妊孕性温存手術を受けた15例は月経が回復し、2例が生児を得た。卵巣機能を損なわず良好な生存が得られた。
pmid-18656249.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated 20 patients with ovarian endodermal sinus tumor treated with adjuvant cumulative high-dose BEP chemotherapy at a single institution between 1995 and 2006. The median age was 18 years, and median follow-up was 70 months. Overall survival was 90%, and two patients (10%) had pelvic recurrence. Fifteen patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery; all regained regular menstruation after chemotherapy, and two had live births without complications. The authors conclude that BEP achieves excellent survival without impairing ovarian function.

pmid-18657202.summary_ja: 612例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のうち3%にあたる17例が両側病変を有したことを、25年間の単施設で後方視的に解析した研究である。異時性が11例、同時性が6例で、両側腫瘍の74%がセミノーマであった。対側発生リスクは一般集団の26倍で、残存精巣の長期監視が推奨される。
pmid-18657202.summary_en: This 25-year single-center retrospective analysis reviewed 17 of 612 testicular germ cell tumor patients (3%) with bilateral disease. Eleven cases were metachronous and six synchronous. Synchronous cases presented at higher stages (stage I: 33% vs 82%). Most bilateral tumors were seminomas, and histology often matched on both sides. Contralateral risk was 26-fold higher than in the general population. With median follow-up of 95 to 121 months, all patients were alive without evidence of disease. Long-term monitoring of the remaining testicle is recommended.

pmid-18675620.summary_ja: 母体ミラー症候群のため妊娠27週で娩出された、高度水腫を伴う仙尾部奇形腫の胎児症例。出生後に切除術が施行され、児は生存した。妊娠26～30週で娩出された水腫性SCT児の転帰に関する報告は少なく、本症例は家族へのカウンセリングに有用とされる。
pmid-18675620.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with profound hydrops and a sacrococcygeal teratoma, delivered at 27 weeks because of maternal mirror syndrome. Postnatal surgical resection was performed, and the infant survived. Outcome data for hydropic SCT fetuses delivered between 26 and 30 weeks are sparse, and the authors argue that this case can inform counseling for similar families. The report adds to the limited literature on early delivery and postpartum resection.

pmid-18678124.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫由来の濾胞型乳頭癌を呈した症例報告。卵巣甲状腺腫は成熟卵巣奇形腫の特殊型で、悪性化は全卵巣奇形腫の0.1～0.3%と稀である。CA-125の上昇と偽Meigs症候群を伴った。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の非典型的な変異型を示す報告である。
pmid-18678124.summary_en: This case report describes a malignant tumor, a follicular variant of papillary carcinoma, arising from struma ovarii. Struma ovarii is a specialized form of mature ovarian teratoma in which thyroid tissue makes up at least half of the tumor. Malignant struma ovarii is rare, accounting for 0.1-0.3% of ovarian teratomas. The patient had elevated CA-125 and pseudo-Meigs syndrome. The report highlights an unusual malignant variant with thyroid-type carcinoma.

pmid-18682004.summary_ja: 本総説は、免疫不全マウスに移植した多能性幹細胞が形成する奇形腫を分析し、3胚葉すべての組織を含むことを述べる。奇形腫は多能性の機能的評価に加え、胚発生や組織構築、ヒト発生と毒性研究のモデルとして論じられる。腫瘍学への応用可能性にも触れている。
pmid-18682004.summary_en: This review analyzes teratoma formation by pluripotent stem cells transplanted into immunodeficient mice, which generates tissues from all three germ layers. Beyond serving as a functional assay of pluripotency, teratomas are discussed as a window into embryonic tissue organization and as a model for human development and toxicity. The authors note potential relevance to oncology and bioengineering. Teratoma formation from different stem cell sources is compared to refine how teratoma characterization is interpreted.

pmid-18689908.summary_ja: 閉経後51歳女性で、甲状腺組織を主体とする卵巣奇形腫に生じた乳頭癌の症例を報告する。当初は甲状腺機能亢進症として提示されたが血清検査で確認されず、後に閉経後性器出血と腹部腫瘤が認められた。病理学的検査で卵巣甲状腺腫の乳頭癌と診断された。
pmid-18689908.summary_en: The authors report a postmenopausal 51-year-old woman with papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii, a rare malignant transformation of an ovarian teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. She initially presented with hyperthyroidism, but serology did not confirm it. Later she had postmenopausal vaginal bleeding, and radiography revealed an abdominal mass. Pathology established the diagnosis. The case highlights an unusual presentation relevant to internists.

pmid-18691724.summary_ja: イヌの胃腫瘍について、ヒトでのみ報告されてきた原発性胃絨毛癌に一致する病理組織学的および免疫組織化学的特徴を記述した。腫瘍は幽門および前部十二指腸の粘膜下層と固有筋層に浸潤し、胃リンパ節に転移していた。β-カテニンおよびE-カドヘリンの異常発現とc-mycおよびRasの増加を認め、Wnt/β-カテニン経路とRas経路の同時活性化が示唆された。
pmid-18691724.summary_en: The authors describe a canine gastric tumour with histopathological and immunohistochemical features of primary gastric choriocarcinoma, a condition previously reported only in humans. The tumour infiltrated the pyloric and duodenal wall and metastasized to a gastric lymph node. Neoplastic cells showed aberrant beta-catenin and E-cadherin expression, with increased c-myc and Ras. The authors suggest synchronous activation of Wnt/beta-catenin and Ras signalling in carcinogenesis.

pmid-18697473.summary_ja: 38歳男性が左精巣腫瘍（セミノーマ疑い、腫瘍マーカー陰性、臨床病期I）に対し左精巣摘除術を受けた。1年後に後腹膜リンパ節が腫大し、BEP化学療法や救援化学療法（CPT-11、ネダプラチン）でも縮小せず、生検で胎児性癌と判明した。後腹膜リンパ節郭清により悪性セルトリ細胞腫瘍と診断され、精巣摘除術後27か月で肝転移により死亡した。
pmid-18697473.summary_en: A 38-year-old man underwent left orchiectomy for a testicular tumor initially diagnosed as seminoma, with negative LDH, hCG and AFP and clinical stage I disease. A retroperitoneal lymph node mass developed a year later, and three courses of BEP chemotherapy failed to shrink it. Biopsy showed viable embryonal carcinoma, and salvage chemotherapy with CPT-11 and nedaplatin also failed. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy revealed malignant Sertoli cell tumor. He died 27 months after orchiectomy with liver metastases.

pmid-18700569.summary_ja: 32歳女性が3か月続く前胸部痛で受診。前縦隔に30mmの腫瘤があり、CTで脂肪成分と石灰化を伴う嚢胞性病変を認めた。心膜・大血管浸潤のため開胸下に不完全切除。病理で腺癌成分を認め、縦隔奇形腫の悪性転化と診断された。
pmid-18700569.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman presented with three months of anterior chest pain. Chest radiography showed a 30-mm anterior mediastinal mass, and contrast CT revealed a cystic lesion with fat and calcifications invading the pericardium and great vessels. Thoracotomy found hair within the cyst and hard tissue; the mass was incompletely resected because of extensive vascular invasion. Pathology showed adenocarcinoma, leading to a diagnosis of mediastinal teratoma with malignant transformation.

pmid-18701008.summary_ja: 1017人を対象に、精巣・陰嚢疾患への一次対応ワンストップ外来を2年間前向きに評価した。大半は良性疾患であった。超音波で精巣腫瘍が疑われた11例が精巣摘除術を受け、予想外のセミノーマ1例が見つかった。陰嚢超音波検査の待機期間は22週間から2週間に短縮した。
pmid-18701008.summary_en: This prospective two-year study evaluated a one-stop joint sonographer and urology nurse clinic for men referred with testicular or scrotal conditions. Of 1017 patients, most had benign pathology. Eleven patients with suspected testicular tumour on ultrasound underwent orchidectomy, and one unsuspected seminoma was found. Waiting time for scrotal ultrasound fell from 22 to 2 weeks, and related imaging waits also decreased. The clinic enabled rapid assessment of suspected malignancy while reducing patient anxiety.

pmid-18704552.summary_ja: 生後10日の新生児が頻呼吸、雑音、心拡大で受診した。心エコーで心室中隔を侵し左室内へ突出する多嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、左室流出路閉塞は伴わなかった。切除標本の病理で心臓奇形腫と確定した。先天性大動脈狭窄を合併した、極めてまれな心筋内奇形腫である。
pmid-18704552.summary_en: A 10-day-old infant presented with tachypnea, harsh murmur, and cardiomegaly. Echocardiography showed a multicystic mass infiltrating the interventricular septum and protruding into the left ventricle without left ventricular outflow obstruction. The mass was surgically resected, and biopsy confirmed a cardiac teratoma. The authors describe this as an unusually rare intramyocardial teratoma coexisting with congenital aortic stenosis.

pmid-18707723.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の42例に対し、両側神経温存腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した成績を報告している。開腹移行例はなく、平均手術時間は323分、術中合併症は認めなかった。化学療法後病期IIBの19例中4例で奇形腫を認め、後腹膜再発は見られなかった。順行性射精は85.7%で温存された。
pmid-18707723.summary_en: The authors report the feasibility and early oncological outcomes of bilateral nerve-sparing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 42 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, including stage I and post-chemotherapy stage IIB disease. No conversions occurred, mean operative time was 323 minutes, and no intraoperative complications arose. Teratoma was found in 21% of post-chemotherapy specimens. No retroperitoneal recurrence was observed, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in 85.7%.

pmid-18708903.summary_ja: 7歳女児が下腹部の急性腹痛で救急受診し、卵巣未熟奇形腫(grade 1)の茎捻転と診断された。救急での超音波検査の後に施行した術前MRIの所見が、治療方針の決定に役立った。MRI所見と病理所見を対比し、まれな疾患の診断にMRIが有用であることを示している。
pmid-18708903.summary_en: A 7-year-old girl presented with acute low abdominal pain caused by torsion of an ovarian immature grade 1 teratoma. Ultrasound in the emergency department was followed by preoperative MRI, whose findings helped guide the curative approach. The authors review the MRI characteristics of this neoplasm and correlate them with histopathologic findings. They conclude that MRI can contribute to the diagnostic approach for this rare entity, even in young children in the emergency setting.

pmid-18711182.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた1990〜2004年の病期I精巣セミノーマ患者3,125例の解析である。補助放射線療法の推奨は年次が新しいほど減少し、教育水準の低い地域や最年少の患者で推奨が少なかった。治療決定における社会人口統計学的格差が示された。代替的な術後管理法が開発されている状況も踏まえ、その推奨の変化を評価した研究である。
pmid-18711182.summary_en: This SEER-based study of 3,125 men with stage I testicular seminoma diagnosed from 1990 to 2004 found that recommendations for adjuvant radiation therapy declined over time. Men diagnosed in later periods had lower odds of receiving it. Men in counties with lower education levels and the youngest men were also less likely to be recommended adjuvant radiation therapy. The findings highlight sociodemographic disparities in treatment decisions as alternative postorchiectomy strategies gained acceptance.

pmid-18712671.summary_ja: 正常な齧歯類およびヒト精巣、ならびにヒトセミノーマ組織におけるReg Iの発現を検討した。精細管内のセルトリ細胞と胚細胞にReg Iが認められ、セルトリ細胞株では細胞膜に局在した。ヒトセミノーマ組織およびヒト腫瘍胚細胞株で強発現しており、正常および腫瘍性の胚細胞増殖への関与が示唆された。
pmid-18712671.summary_en: This study examined Reg I protein expression in normal rodent and human testes and in human seminoma testis tissue. Western blot and immunofluorescence showed Reg I in Sertoli and germ cells within the seminiferous tubules. In a Sertoli cell line, Reg I localized to the plasma membrane. Reg I was strongly expressed in human seminoma tissue and in a human tumor germ cell line, suggesting a potential role in normal and neoplastic germ cell proliferation.

pmid-18713584.summary_ja: 出生時から存在する排液性の殿部腫瘤で37歳女性が受診し、先天性仙尾部奇形腫と判明した。外陰部皮膚生検では、奇形腫から生じた粘液性腺癌が確認され、皮膚転移と判断された。奇形腫が悪性転化することはまれであり、成人でこのような経過をたどる症例は珍しいと著者らは述べている。
pmid-18713584.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman presented with a draining gluteal mass present since birth, which was found to be a congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma. Vulvar skin biopsy revealed a mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from the teratoma, consistent with cutaneous metastasis. The authors note that teratomas rarely undergo malignant transformation, making this an unusual presentation in an adult patient.

pmid-18714585.summary_ja: 両側付属器腫瘤の精査目的で入院した患者に、術後の病理検査で両側卵巣甲状腺腫が判明した症例である。臨床的な悪性所見や転移は認められなかった。卵巣腫瘍との鑑別が難しい点や、両側発生のまれさについて文献をもとに考察している。診断・治療面の知見も整理されている。
pmid-18714585.summary_en: A case of bilateral struma ovarii, detected postoperatively after hospitalization for bilateral adnexal masses, was confirmed histopathologically. No clinical malignancy or metastasis was found. The authors reviewed the literature and discussed diagnostic, histopathologic, and therapeutic aspects of the disease. Because it can mimic an ovarian neoplasm, and bilateral involvement is especially rare, the authors stress awareness of this entity.

pmid-18715834.summary_ja: 非ジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例を後方視的に検討した。白金製剤を含む化学療法後の再発は31%であった。初回手術時の病期、残存腫瘍、化学療法開始までの期間が再発の予測因子となる可能性が示された。5年生存率は39%で、進行例では積極的な減量手術や二次治療の必要性が示唆されている。
pmid-18715834.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 21 patients with nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors who underwent surgical resection and adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Relapse occurred in 31 percent. Stage at initial surgery, residual disease, and time to chemotherapy were identified as possible prognostic factors. The 5-year survival rate was 39 percent. The authors suggest that aggressive cytoreductive surgery and second-line combination chemotherapy may be needed in advanced disease.

pmid-18716971.summary_ja: 2歳児が反復性眼窩蜂窩織炎で受診し、眼窩外円錐内の腫瘤が確認された。画像検査で骨欠損と蝶形骨の奇形がみられ、異所性歯牙も存在した。成熟眼窩奇形腫と診断された。眼窩感染症の小児では、眼窩内腫瘤の除外のため画像検査を行うことが重要と強調されている。
pmid-18716971.summary_en: A 2-year-old child presented with recurrent orbital cellulitis and was found to have an extraconal orbital mass. Imaging showed a bony defect and sphenoid malformation, and an ectopic tooth was present. The lesion was diagnosed as a mature orbital teratoma. The authors note that sphenoid malformation has not been previously reported with intraorbital teratoma, and they emphasize imaging children with orbital infections to exclude an intraorbital mass.

pmid-18718589.summary_ja: 経腹超音波検査とカラー拡張血流マッピングを用いた超音波パターン認識により、付属器腫瘤306例で卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を診断できるかを検討した（36例が成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）。病理結果を基準とした感度は94.4%、特異度は98.2%であり、術前の良性奇形腫の診断に有用であることが示された。
pmid-18718589.summary_en: This study evaluated transabdominal ultrasound with color extended-flow mapping, using sonographic pattern recognition, to diagnose ovarian mature cystic teratoma in 306 patients with adnexal masses undergoing elective surgery. Histopathology served as the reference standard. Thirty-six masses were confirmed as mature cystic teratomas. Pattern recognition achieved a sensitivity of 94.4% and a specificity of 98.2%, supporting its accuracy for preoperative diagnosis of benign teratoma.

pmid-18720919.summary_ja: 持続する低値のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を示す症例で、hCG全体に占める遊離βサブユニットの割合を測定し、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)と非トロホブラスト性腫瘍の診断に有用かを検討した。128例中18例で割合が30%を超え、うち13例がPSTT、5例が非トロホブラスト性腫瘍と確定した。30%超は有用な検査と結論された。
pmid-18720919.summary_en: This study assessed the proportion of free beta-subunit of hCG as a diagnostic marker for placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and nontrophoblastic neoplasms in patients with persistent low hCG. Among 128 tested cases, 18 had a free beta-subunit proportion above 30% of total hCG; 13 of these were histologically proven PSTT and 5 had nontrophoblastic neoplasm. The authors conclude that a proportion above 30% is a highly useful test for identifying these malignancies in women with persistent low hCG outside pregnancy.

pmid-18720923.summary_ja: 1962年から2006年に地域センターで治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍804例のうち、36例(4.5%)に腟転移を認めた。多くは前壁の単発病変で、絨毛癌型が多かった。36%が出血のため輸血を要し、81%が治癒した。腟転移自体が予後不良や多剤併用化学療法を必然的に必要とするわけではないと結論された。
pmid-18720923.summary_en: This retrospective review of 804 patients treated for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia at a regional center from 1962 to 2006 identified 36 (4.5%) with vaginal metastases. Most were single anterior lesions with choriocarcinoma histology, and 36% required transfusion for bleeding. Single-agent methotrexate or actinomycin-D was given to 64%, and 81% were cured. The authors conclude that vaginal metastasis does not inherently worsen prognosis or require multiagent chemotherapy, though bleeding control may be needed.

pmid-18720924.summary_ja: ニューイングランド絨毛性疾患センターで開胸術を受けた19例を後方視的に検討した。治療目的の11例中10例で寛解が得られ、1980年以降は診断目的から治療目的へと適応が変化した。生存者は病期が低く、単発病変で、術前ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が低い傾向にあった。最適な症例は、病期III期、術前hCG 1,500 mIU/mL未満、化学療法抵抗性の単発肺結節と考えられた。
pmid-18720924.summary_en: This review of 19 thoracotomy patients at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center examined changing indications for thoracotomy in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Thoracotomy was therapeutic in 11 patients, of whom 10 achieved remission, and diagnostic in 8. Indications shifted from diagnosis before 1980 to therapy after 1980. Survivors had lower stage disease, solitary lesions, and lower preoperative hCG. Optimal candidates had stage III disease, preoperative hCG below 1,500 mIU/mL, and a solitary chemotherapy-resistant nodule.

pmid-18720927.summary_ja: 1986年から2007年にシェフィールドで登録された8,860例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患のうち、62例が子宮摘出術を受けた。適応は化学療法抵抗性と大量出血が主であった。病理は絨毛癌が最も多く、侵入奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が続いた。子宮摘出術後に化学療法を要した31例の93.5%が寛解に至った。子宮摘出術は高リスク症例に対する一次治療・補助療法として有用と結論された。
pmid-18720927.summary_en: This Sheffield series reviewed 8,860 patients registered for gestational trophoblastic disease from 1986 to 2007, of whom 62 underwent hysterectomy, an incidence of about 1 in 140 among treated patients. Indications were chemotherapy resistance and major hemorrhage. Pathology included choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Of 31 patients needing chemotherapy after hysterectomy, 93.5% achieved remission. The authors conclude hysterectomy is valuable as both primary and adjuvant treatment for high-risk patients.

pmid-18720943.summary_ja: 27歳の女性で、CTで偶然発見された肝の複合性腫瘤を呈した症例である。画像では肉眼的脂肪、中心部の軟部組織成分、石灰化が認められた。手術により良性肝奇形腫と確定した。真の肝奇形腫は極めてまれで、放射線学文献では25例のみ報告されている。
pmid-18720943.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old woman with a liver complex mass found incidentally on CT. Imaging showed macroscopic fat, a central soft tissue component, and calcification, suggesting teratoma. Surgery confirmed a benign liver teratoma. The authors note that true liver teratomas are exceptional, with only 25 cases reported in the radiology literature, and that most prior cases were intraperitoneal or retroperitoneal teratomas invading the liver.

pmid-18722980.summary_ja: 慢性的な骨盤痛を訴えた15歳の女児で、CTにて径10×8.5×8cmの被包性の仙骨前部・直腸後方腫瘍が確認された。奇形腫と診断し、腹腔鏡下に完全切除された。術中合併症はなく、術後に膀胱・直腸の感覚・運動障害も認められなかった。腹腔鏡手術は仙骨前部奇形腫の切除法として有用と結論づけている。
pmid-18722980.summary_en: A 15-year-old girl with chronic progressive pelvic pain was found to have a 10 x 8.5 x 8 cm encapsulated presacral and retrorectal tumor on CT. The lesion was diagnosed as a retrorectal teratoma and completely removed by laparoscopy, with no intraoperative complications and no postoperative bladder or rectal sensory or motor dysfunction. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is a feasible approach for presacral teratomas, which were traditionally removed through open abdominal or sacral approaches.

pmid-18725922.summary_ja: 45歳男性が右精巣摘除術を受け、病期Iのセミノーマと診断された。予定されていた予防的放射線療法は実施されず、その後、後腹膜腫瘤を伴う病変に対してシスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる化学療法が行われ完全寛解に至った。3年後、精巣原発びまん性大細胞型B細胞リンパ腫の中枢神経系再発と診断された。正確な病理組織学的診断の重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-18725922.summary_en: A 45-year-old man underwent right orchiectomy for a testicular mass diagnosed as stage I seminoma. He did not receive the planned prophylactic radiotherapy, and after a bulky retroperitoneal mass appeared he was treated with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy and achieved complete remission. Three years later, during follow-up, he developed neurological deficits and was diagnosed with testicular diffuse large B-cell lymphoma relapsing in the central nervous system, treated with high-dose methotrexate with or without cytarabine. The case highlights the importance of accurate histopathologic diagnosis in testicular neoplasm management.

pmid-18751412.summary_ja: KIT過剰発現を伴う病期IVの化学療法抵抗性純粋セミノーマの若年男性に、イマチニブとパクリタキセル・オキサリプラチン・ゲムシタビンによる第3選択の化学療法を併用した。β-hCGが正常化した後、後腹膜と肝の残存病変を外科的切除したところ、壊死組織のみであった。化学療法終了から36か月後も無病生存を維持している。
pmid-18751412.summary_en: A young man with stage IV chemoresistant pure seminoma overexpressing KIT achieved complete remission after imatinib was added to third-line chemotherapy of paclitaxel, oxaliplatin and gemcitabine with G-CSF support. He had previously received ifosfamide, bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, and methotrexate, vinblastine, actinomycin D and cyclophosphamide with cisplatin, without normalization of beta-hCG. After beta-hCG normalized, residual retroperitoneal and hepatic disease, found to be necrotic, was surgically resected. The patient remained disease-free 36 months after chemotherapy completion.

pmid-18752497.summary_ja: 正常胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患を含む88検体で、リン酸化Stat3（Ser727）の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で核内発現が高く、自然退縮した奇胎では妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍へ進展した症例より高値であった。アポトーシス指数およびBcl-2と相関を示し、胞状奇胎における妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の予測マーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-18752497.summary_en: The authors examined phosphorylated Stat3 (Ser727) expression by immunohistochemistry in 88 trophoblastic tissues, including normal placentas and gestational trophoblastic disease. Nuclear p-Stat3 was higher in hydatidiform mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor than in normal placentas. Spontaneously regressed moles showed higher levels than those progressing to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, and expression correlated with apoptotic indices and Bcl-2. The authors suggest p-Stat3 regulates apoptosis and may predict gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in hydatidiform mole.

pmid-18753963.summary_ja: EPSと胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の生物学的関連を検討するため、EPS20例のDNAジェノタイピングを行った。全例で父由来のアレルが確認され、トロホブラスト由来と確認された。XY 55%、XX 45%で、男性・女性いずれの妊娠からも発生しうることから、EPSとPSTTの腫瘍学的関連は支持されないと結論づけられた。
pmid-18753963.summary_en: The study performed DNA genotyping on 20 exaggerated placental site (EPS) reaction cases to test whether they carry the sex chromosomal genetic profile required for placental site trophoblastic tumor. All cases showed paternal alleles confirming trophoblastic origin, with 55% XY and 45% XX genomes. Because EPS arises from both male and female gestations, the authors conclude there is no evidence of a neoplastic association between EPS and PSTT. The work addresses the biological relationship between two morphologically similar placental-site lesions.

pmid-18753971.summary_ja: 69歳女性のステージIVの卵巣カルチノサルコーマ症例。悪性ミュラー上皮・間葉成分に加え、神経外胚葉性、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛性の分化を伴う。三胚葉由来成分を含むため胚細胞由来奇形腫との鑑別が問題となったが、類内膜腺癌と共存しそこから生じた可能性が高いため奇形腫とは異なると結論づけられた。
pmid-18753971.summary_en: This report describes a 69-year-old woman with stage IV ovarian carcinosarcoma containing malignant Müllerian epithelial and mesenchymal components, along with neuroectodermal, yolk sac tumor, and trophoblastic differentiation. Because the tumor contained elements from all three germ layers, it had to be distinguished from a germ cell-derived teratoma.
