The case highlights the uncommon cardiac metastatic spread of testicular malignancy, which can present with acute hemodynamic compromise and neurological symptoms.

pmid-19348382.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の非典型的な発症形式を示した2症例の報告です。1例目は精巣腫瘍の消化管転移により、不顕性の消化管出血を来していました。2例目は血清抗Ma2抗体陽性の辺縁系脳炎で発症し、後に悪性胚細胞腫瘍と診断されました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍が消化管症状や傍腫瘍性神経症状で初発しうることを示しています。
pmid-19348382.summary_en: This report describes two patients with unusual presentations of germ cell tumor. The first had metastatic testicular germ cell tumor involving the gastrointestinal tract, causing occult gastrointestinal bleeding. The second had limbic encephalitis with serum anti-Ma2 antibodies, and was subsequently diagnosed with malignant germ cell tumor. The cases illustrate that testicular germ cell tumors may first present with gastrointestinal or paraneoplastic neurological symptoms.

pmid-19357734.summary_ja: 生後10日の男児に生じた成熟仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍内には発達した下肢、未発達な外性器、歯牙が含まれていました。尾骨切除を含む完全切除を行い、術後経過は良好でした。3年間のフォローアップで臨床・生化学・画像評価により再発はありませんでした。成熟型は新生児期には良性で、完全切除が治療の基本であると結論づけています。
pmid-19357734.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-day-old boy with a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma containing well-developed lower limb, rudimentary external genitalia and teeth. He underwent complete surgical excision including coccygectomy, with primary wound closure and an uneventful recovery. Follow-up at three years, including clinical, biochemical and radiological assessment, showed no recurrence. The authors conclude that mature sacrococcygeal teratomas appear benign in the neonatal period and that complete excision remains the mainstay of treatment.

pmid-19370954.summary_ja: 出生時に認められた性腺外奇形腫の3症例の報告です。発生部位は仙尾部、後腹膜、鼻咽腔の3か所で、仙尾部のものは巨大でした。病理組織学的に3例とも成熟型の良性奇形腫で、外科的切除のみで治療が完結しました。フォローアップ中に再発は認められませんでした。新生児期に後腹膜や鼻咽腔に生じる例はまれであることが強調されています。
pmid-19370954.summary_en: This report describes three neonates with extragonadal teratomas present at birth, arising from three separate sites: a large sacrococcygeal teratoma, a retroperitoneal teratoma and a nasopharyngeal teratoma. All tumors were mature and benign on histopathology. Surgical removal alone was sufficient treatment, and no recurrence was noted during follow-up. The rarity of the retroperitoneal and nasopharyngeal locations in the neonatal period is emphasized.

pmid-19468478.summary_ja: 20歳男性が露出性の陰嚢腫瘤で受診した症例報告です。精査で肺転移を伴う精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断されました。全身化学療法により、陰嚢の腫瘤と肺転移の両方が消失しました。露出性陰嚢腫瘤は精巣腫瘍の稀な初発症状であり、英語文献では本例が2例目であると述べられています。
pmid-19468478.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man presenting with a fungating scrotal mass. Investigations revealed a testicular yolk sac tumor with lung metastasis. Systemic chemotherapy led to complete disappearance of both the scrotal mass and the pulmonary metastatic disease. The authors note that a fungating scrotal mass is a rare presentation of testicular tumor and that this is only the second such case reported in the English literature.

pmid-19471568.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた濾胞型甲状腺乳頭癌の症例報告です。腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術の後、病期分類のための開腹手術を行いました。良性嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化はまれで、術前の画像や腫瘍マーカーでも鑑別が困難であると指摘しています。確定病理で悪性が判明した場合は速やかな再手術が必要になりうると述べ、文献もあわせて概説しています。
pmid-19471568.summary_en: This case report describes a woman in whom a follicular-variant papillary thyroid carcinoma arose within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The tumor was treated by laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy followed by staging laparotomy. The authors emphasize that malignant transformation of a benign cystic teratoma is rare and cannot be reliably distinguished from benign disease preoperatively, even with imaging or tumor markers, so a second staging operation may be needed when definitive pathology shows malignancy. Literature on this entity is briefly reviewed.

pmid-19471656.summary_ja: 41歳女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来する粘液性腺癌が傍大動脈リンパ節転移を伴って認められた症例です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、扁平上皮癌が約75%を占め、腺癌は約6.8%とされます。本例のような粘液性腺癌での傍大動脈リンパ節転移の報告は過去になく、予後は極めて不良であると述べられています。
pmid-19471656.summary_en: A 41-year-old woman had mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, with para-aortic lymph node metastasis. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is uncommon. Squamous cell carcinoma is the most frequent type, accounting for about 75% of cases, while adenocarcinoma occurs in only about 6.8%. The authors state that no previous report has described para-aortic lymph node metastasis from mucinous adenocarcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. They also emphasize the very poor prognosis of this complication.

pmid-19472738.summary_ja: 染色体46,XYで性腺異形成のある13歳の表現型女性例で、付属器捻転に対する手術中に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが確認されました。性腺異形成でY染色体を有する場合は悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高く、予防的な両側性腺摘出術とその後のホルモン補充療法が推奨されると結論づけています。
pmid-19472738.summary_en: A 13-year-old phenotypically female patient with a 46,XY karyotype and gonadal dysgenesis, consistent with Swyer syndrome, underwent surgery for adnexal torsion. Examination of the gonads revealed gonadoblastoma with associated dysgerminoma. The authors emphasize that a Y chromosome in gonadal dysgenesis carries a high risk of malignant germ cell tumor development. They recommend prophylactic bilateral gonadectomy followed by hormone replacement therapy, and they describe the treatment and follow-up.

pmid-19475894.summary_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫と嚢胞性成熟奇形腫、一部では類表皮嚢胞が併存した2症例の報告です。固形腫瘍に隣接する嚢胞性扁平上皮病変は、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内のカルチノイド腫瘍と誤認される可能性があります。両症例の所見を示し、鑑別診断上の問題点と文献的考察を行っています。
pmid-19475894.summary_en: Two cases are reported of an ovarian granulosa cell tumour occurring together with a cystic mature teratoma and, in one case, an epidermoid cyst. In one case the cystic squamous lesion was intimately connected with the solid tumour, and in the other it was contralateral to it. These combinations are very rare and can be misinterpreted on gross and microscopic examination, where a cystic squamous lesion near a trabecular or microfollicular solid tumour may suggest a carcinoid tumour arising in a mature cystic teratoma. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis and review the literature.

pmid-19561752.summary_ja: 5日間の間欠的な腹痛と嘔吐で救急受診した4歳女児の症例です。当初は腸重積が疑われましたが、手術で卵巣奇形腫による右付属器捻転と判明し、右卵管卵巣摘出術が行われました。小児では稀ですが、卵巣腫瘤を伴う腹痛では卵巣捻転を鑑別に入れ、早期診断で卵巣温存と合併症の低減を図るべきと強調されています。
pmid-19561752.summary_en: A 4-year-old girl presented to the emergency department with five days of intermittent abdominal pain and vomiting, initially suspected to be intussusception. Surgical exploration revealed right adnexal torsion caused by an ovarian teratoma, treated with right salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors stress that ovarian torsion, although rare in children, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of abdominal pain with an ovarian mass, because early diagnosis may improve ovarian salvage and reduce morbidity.

pmid-19561881.summary_ja: 息切れと前胸壁上部の腫脹を主訴とした若年男性の症例です。組織学的検査と免疫組織化学的解析で原発性縦隔セミノーマと診断され、腹部・骨盤・頭部のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、精巣の超音波検査、骨シンチグラフィでは他部位に病変はありませんでした。BEP化学療法を4コース施行し、治療8か月後の受診時には良好な状態でした。
pmid-19561881.summary_en: A young man presented with shortness of breath and a swelling over the upper anterior chest wall. Histology and immunohistochemical analysis confirmed a primary mediastinal seminoma, while abdominal, pelvic and cerebral CT, testicular ultrasound and bone scintigraphy showed no other sites of disease. He received four cycles of BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Eight months later he was well at clinic follow-up. The report illustrates an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting with respiratory symptoms.

pmid-19688122.summary_ja: 進行胃癌と初診された2例で、生検により原発性胃絨毛癌と診断されました。免疫染色でβ-hCG陽性、血清β-hCGの高値が確認され、性腺に原発巣はありませんでした。両例ともBEP、VIP、EMA/CO等の化学療法を受けましたが転移が進行し、初診から10か月および12か月で死亡しています。
pmid-19688122.summary_en: Two cases of primary gastric choriocarcinoma are reported, both initially diagnosed as advanced gastric adenocarcinoma. The diagnosis was confirmed by biopsy showing choriocarcinomatous components, beta-hCG positivity on immunohistochemistry and elevated serum beta-hCG, with no gonadal primary. Both patients received multiple palliative chemotherapy regimens, including BEP, VIP and EMA/CO, but liver and lung metastases progressed. They died 10 and 12 months after the initial diagnosis. The authors review the literature on this rare and aggressive entity.

pmid-19715611.summary_ja: 15〜40歳の男性で最も多い悪性疾患である精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の臨床的・遺伝学的側面を総説しています。シスプラチンを基盤とした多剤併用化学療法により生存率が大きく改善し、セミノーマに対する放射線療法や外科的治療も進歩しました。家族歴は強いリスク因子ですが、高リスクの生殖系列変異は同定されておらず、家族集積の遺伝的基盤は未解決です。
pmid-19715611.summary_en: This review covers the clinical and genetic aspects of testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs), the most common malignancy in men aged 15 to 40. Survival has improved substantially, mainly due to cisplatin-based polychemotherapy, with advances in surgery and in radiotherapy for seminoma. Family history is among the strongest risk factors, but no high-risk germline mutations have been identified, and a Y chromosome deletion (gr/gr) confers only a modest risk. The authors conclude that the genetic basis of familial clustering remains unresolved.

pmid-19847284.summary_ja: 本後方視的症例集積は、国立がん研究所で8年間に治療された胚細胞腫瘍の小児33例を検討し、外科的治療の役割を評価したものである。ほとんどの患者は腹部膨満で受診し、61.8%が性腺、38.2%が性腺外に腫瘍を有していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍と悪性奇形腫が最も多い組織型であり、27.2%が転移性疾患を有していた。完全切除は無病生存期間の延長と関連し、切除不能例の全生存期間は同等であった。手術と化学療法の併用は、進行例や転移例でも良好な反応をもたらした。
pmid-19847284.summary_en: This retrospective case series of 33 children with germ cell tumours treated over eight years at a national cancer institute evaluates the role of surgery. Most patients presented with abdominal swelling; 61.8% had gonadal and 38.2% extragonadal tumours. Yolk sac tumour and malignant teratoma were the most common histologies, and 27.2% had metastatic disease. Complete resection was associated with better disease-free survival, while patients with irresectable disease had comparable overall survival. Surgery combined with chemotherapy achieved good responses even in advanced and metastatic disease.

pmid-20011478.summary_ja: 生後5か月の男児に発生した膵頭部の未熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。文献上18例の報告に続く19例目とされています。術前診断は困難で、確定診断は術中に得られました。小児の膵嚢胞性腫瘍は稀であり、本症はさらに稀な性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であることが示されています。臨床像と術前診断の課題が検討されています。
pmid-20011478.summary_en: This report describes a 5-month-old boy with an immature cystic teratoma arising in the head of the pancreas, presented as the 19th documented case in the literature. Cystic pancreatic tumours are rare in children, and this lesion is rarer still. A review of the world literature identified 18 prior cases across all age groups. Preoperative evaluation was uninformative, and definitive diagnosis was made intraoperatively. The paper discusses the clinical presentation and preoperative diagnostic challenges of this extragonadal germ cell tumour in infancy.

pmid-20071824.summary_ja: 妊娠20週の初産婦において、大きな仙尾部奇形腫が出生前超音波検査で発見された症例報告です。腫瘤は不均一で嚢胞と石灰化を伴い血流増加を示し、胎児心拡大や胎児水腫も認められました。胎児水腫を伴う本症は母子ともに予後不良であるため、妊娠は中絶されました。出生前の超音波評価の重要性が指摘されています。
pmid-20071824.summary_en: This case report describes antenatal detection of a large sacrococcygeal teratoma at 20 weeks' gestation in a primigravida. Ultrasound showed a heterogeneous, cystic and calcified mass with increased vascularity, along with fetal cardiomegaly, hydrops, thickened placenta and polyhydramnios. Given the grave prognosis associated with hydrops, the pregnancy was terminated. The fetus was expelled with a ruptured, actively bleeding mass. The authors emphasise that sacrococcygeal teratoma with hydrops carries a poor outlook for both mother and child, underscoring the value of prenatal ultrasound assessment.

pmid-21614323.summary_ja: 出生前超音波で顔面腫瘤が発見された新生児のエピグナトゥス奇形腫の症例報告です。帝王切開後に全切除されましたが、病理学的には悪性所見がなかったものの、2週間後に急速に再発し頭蓋内浸潤と閉塞性水頭症をきたしました。手術不能となり、生後5週で死亡しました。画像所見と攻撃的な経過が示されています。
pmid-21614323.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a facial mass detected on antenatal ultrasound, later diagnosed as epignathus teratoma. After caesarean delivery and total excision, histology showed teratoma without malignant features, yet the tumour recurred rapidly within two weeks with intracranial involvement and obstructive hydrocephalus. It was inoperable at re-exploration, and the infant died at five weeks of age. The case illustrates the imaging features and aggressive course of a neonatal epignathus teratoma with malignant behaviour.

pmid-21892277.summary_ja: 分化型甲状腺癌に類似した、稀な卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の3症例の報告です。全例で卵巣病変の切除後、甲状腺全摘と131Iアブレーション療法が行われ、良好な反応が得られました。フォローアップの腫瘍マーカーとしてサイログロブリンが有用とされています。核医学画像検査で転移を描出できる点も示されています。
pmid-21892277.summary_en: This report presents three patients with malignant struma ovarii, a rare ovarian germ cell tumour resembling well-differentiated thyroid carcinoma. All received surgical removal of the ovarian lesion, followed by thyroidectomy and radioiodine (131I) ablation; two had this as first-line management and one after metastatic disease developed. Thyroglobulin is suggested as a follow-up tumour marker, and radioiodine imaging can detect metastases. The authors conclude that a multidisciplinary approach with this sequence offers good response.

pmid-21892301.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を有する30歳男性が後頭葉の脳転移を発症した症例報告です。切除、全脳放射線療法、化学療法により一時的な完全寛解が得られました。その後、軟髄膜再発をきたし、救援化学療法にもかかわらず原病により死亡しました。胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移の予後は不良であり、有効な標準治療の確立が必要とされています。
pmid-21892301.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with an extragonadal germ cell tumour who developed an occipital brain metastasis. After resection, whole brain radiotherapy and further chemotherapy produced temporary complete remission. Leptomeningeal recurrence later developed, and despite salvage chemotherapy, the patient died of disease. The authors note that prognosis for brain metastases of germ cell tumours remains unsatisfactory and call for an effective standard treatment.

pmid-23012179.summary_ja: 14歳と19歳の姉妹にそれぞれ卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が診断された症例を報告する。20歳未満の女性の悪性卵巣腫瘍の約3分の2を占め、すべて悪性とされるが、攻撃的に進行するのは3分の1とされる。胚細胞腫瘍の家族内発生の報告は少なく、関連する遺伝子異常の研究も行われている。両症例の画像所見を併せて示す。
pmid-23012179.summary_en: This report describes two sisters, aged 14 and 19, diagnosed with ovarian dysgerminoma. Dysgerminomas account for about two-thirds of malignant ovarian neoplasms in women under 20 and are considered malignant, although only a third behave aggressively. The authors note that familial occurrence of germ cell tumors is rarely reported, and that some reports implicate specific genetic abnormalities. The cases are presented together with their radiological findings.

pmid-23133073.summary_ja: 縦隔の巨大な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を報告する。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の約6割を占め、周囲臓器を圧迫することが多い。完全切除により根治が得られた。術後6か月の時点でも肺は胸腔に比べ小さいままであり、腫瘍による圧迫の影響が長く残ることが示された。
pmid-23133073.summary_en: This report describes a giant benign cystic teratoma of the mediastinum, which accounts for a large share of mediastinal germ cell tumors and often compresses surrounding structures. The patient underwent total surgical excision, which was curative. Despite removal, the lungs remained compressed and small relative to the thoracic cavity six months after surgery, illustrating the lasting effects of the mass on adjacent organs. The paper emphasizes that complete excision is curative and life-saving.

pmid-23396681.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが陰嚢痛を初発症状として発症した症例を報告する。若年成人男性に最も多い悪性精巣腫瘍である。超音波検査では境界明瞭な低エコーで均一な腫瘤を示し、カラードプラでは豊富な血流が確認された。これらの典型的所見が正しい診断に重要であったと結論づけている。
pmid-23396681.summary_en: This case report describes a patient whose first clinical sign of testicular seminoma was scrotal pain. Seminomas are the most common malignant testicular tumors in young adult men. Ultrasonography showed a hypoechoic, well-defined, homogeneous mass, and color Doppler revealed rich vascularity. The authors emphasize that these typical ultrasound and Doppler findings were fundamental for the correct diagnosis, supporting the role of imaging in evaluating painful scrotal masses.

pmid-23675070.summary_ja: 正期産の2週間後に転移性絨毛癌を発症した28歳女性の症例である。肺病変があり、化学療法前のhCG値は84,000 mIU/mlであった。FIGOリスクスコアは8点で高リスク群に分類された。EMA/CO療法を7コース施行し完全寛解を得た。産後出血の際には妊娠性絨毛性疾患を念頭におき、hCG測定が早期診断に有用であると述べている。
pmid-23675070.summary_en: This report describes a 28-year-old woman who developed metastatic choriocarcinoma two weeks after a term delivery, with lung lesions and a pretreatment hCG level of 84,000 mIU/ml. Classified as high risk by FIGO scoring, she received EMA/CO first-line chemotherapy and achieved complete remission after seven courses. The authors highlight that postpartum bleeding may mask gestational trophoblastic disease and that hCG measurement can aid early diagnosis.

pmid-24179358.summary_ja: 生後11か月と12か月の乳児2例の大型充実・嚢胞性後腹膜奇形腫について報告する。両例とも完全切除され、17か月を超えるフォローアップで良好であった。奇形腫は主に上腹部に存在し、膵臓を前方へ圧排していた。腫瘍による周囲臓器の圧排、血管の変形と延長、偽被膜による大血管の線維性取り込み、大動脈分枝の被包といった手術解剖学的特徴を報告している。
pmid-24179358.summary_en: This report describes two infants aged 11 and 12 months with large solid-cystic retroperitoneal teratomas, both completely resected and doing well at follow-up beyond 17 months. The paper focuses on the surgical anatomy of this rare tumor. Teratomas were mainly in the upper abdomen and displaced the pancreas anteriorly. Observed features included displacement of organs, elongation of retroperitoneal vessels, fibrous incorporation of large vessels by the pseudocapsule, and wrapping of aortic branches by tumor lobes.

pmid-25389834.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍が脈絡膜に転移した21歳男性の症例報告である。超音波検査で厚さ10.3 mmの高エコー性腫瘤を認めた。ビンブラスチン、メスナ、イホスファミド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を開始し、6週間後に脈絡膜病変は完全に消失した。8か月後も再発は認められなかった。全身化学療法への迅速な反応が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-25389834.summary_en: This observational case report describes a 21-year-old man with a 10-cm testicular mixed germ cell tumor that metastasized to the choroid of one eye. Ophthalmic examination and ultrasonography revealed a large dome-shaped lesion. Chemotherapy with vinblastine, mesna, ifosfamide, and cisplatin led to complete resolution of the choroidal lesion within six weeks. No recurrence was seen at eight months. The authors conclude that choroidal metastases from testicular germ cell tumors can respond promptly to systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-25610022.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性の症例を報告する。根治的精巣摘除術により良好に治療された。術後10か月の時点でのコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、再発や転移の所見はなかった。タイトルは成人型顆粒膜細胞腫を指すが、要旨は精巣胚細胞腫瘍を中心に記述している。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床・病理学的特徴、治療、予後を文献的に概説している。
pmid-25610022.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with a testicular germ cell tumor, treated successfully with radical orchiectomy. Follow-up computed tomography 10 months after surgery showed no evidence of recurrence or metastasis. Although the title refers to adult-type granulosa cell tumor of the testis, the abstract centers on testicular germ cell tumor. The authors review the clinical and histopathological features, treatment, and prognosis of testicular GCT.

pmid-16206190.summary_ja: 重篤な状態で発見された乳児の転移性原発性肝絨毛癌の症例報告である。初回生検は行わず、画像所見と腫瘍マーカーで診断された。術前化学療法の後に外科的切除を遅らせて行い、診断から24か月間寛解を維持している。小児の極めて稀な悪性腫瘍では早期診断と迅速な治療開始が重要である。
pmid-16206190.summary_en: A case report of a critically ill infant with metastatic primary hepatic choriocarcinoma, diagnosed from radiographic and tumor marker findings without an initial biopsy. Management with neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by delayed surgical resection led to a successful outcome. The patient has remained in continuous remission for 24 months from diagnosis. The report emphasizes prompt diagnosis and treatment initiation for this extremely rare childhood malignancy, which can mimic benign and malignant liver tumors.

pmid-16377040.summary_ja: 口から突出する巨大な先天性エピグナサス奇形腫と口蓋裂を合併した新生児女児の症例報告である。出生当日に口外部分の減量切除と口腔内からの摘出を行い、病理学的に確定した。6か月後に再発が認められた。奇形腫全体の2〜9%を占める稀な病態である。
pmid-16377040.summary_en: A case report of a newborn girl with a congenital epignathus teratoma, a large mass protruding from the mouth, associated with cleft palate. Debulking of the extraoral portion was performed on the day of birth, followed by intraoral exstirpation. Histology confirmed congenital epignathus. A recurrence was found six months later. Epignathus accounts for 2 to 9 percent of teratomas and may extend intracranially, making management difficult during and after birth.

pmid-16503348.summary_ja: 本研究はin vitroで亜鉛クエン酸化合物CIZARの効果を検討した。正常栄養膜細胞や腫瘍性栄養膜細胞株と比べ、絨毛癌細胞株BeWoの生存率を用量・時間依存的に選択的に低下させ、アポトーシスとテロメア短縮を誘導した。p21(WAF1)とBaxの上昇、Bcl-2の低下、caspase-3の活性化を伴い、悪性栄養膜細胞に対する治療的可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16503348.summary_en: This in vitro study tested the zinc-citrate compound CIZAR on normal trophoblast cells, a tumorigenic trophoblast line (HT), and the choriocarcinoma line BeWo. CIZAR selectively reduced viability of BeWo cells in a dose- and time-dependent fashion, inducing apoptosis with telomere shortening. Apoptosis involved upregulation of p21(WAF1) and Bax, downregulation of Bcl-2, and caspase-3 activation. The authors conclude CIZAR is an apoptotic inducer in malignant trophoblast cells, suggesting possible therapeutic potential against choriocarcinoma.

pmid-16574224.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍などの妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の組織と細胞株におけるCEAの発現を検討した。CEAは妊娠全期を通じて発現し、GTDの形質転換した栄養膜では正常胎盤に比べ有意に増加していた(p<0.05)。絨毛癌細胞株や培養細胞栄養膜細胞もCEAを発現しており、CEA(CD66e)が栄養膜の分化に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16574224.summary_en: This study examined carcinoembryonic antigen (CEA) and CEA-related molecules in normal placenta, gestational trophoblastic diseases (invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, a placental site trophoblastic tumor), primary cytotrophoblast, and JAr and JEG-3 cell lines. Immunostaining and Western blot showed CEA expressed throughout pregnancy, and significantly increased in transformed trophoblast of GTDs compared with normal placenta (p<0.05). Choriocarcinoma cell lines and cultured cytotrophoblast expressed CEA. The authors suggest CEA (CD66e) and related proteins may participate in trophoblast differentiation.

pmid-16697107.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍46例(セミノーマ26例、非セミノーマ20例)と正常精巣組織15例で、p53標的遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化をリアルタイムMSP法で解析した。APAF-1は全腫瘍と正常組織の60%でメチル化が見られ、DAPK-1はセミノーマで頻繁にメチル化され病期と相関した。臨床病期Iの再発リスク評価のマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16697107.summary_en: Promoter methylation of p53 target genes APAF-1, CASP-8, DAPK-1 and IGFBP-3 was analysed by real-time methylation-specific PCR in 46 primary testicular germ cell tumors (26 seminomas, 20 nonseminomas) and 15 normal testicular samples. APAF-1 was methylated in all tumors and in 60% of normal tissue. DAPK-1 methylation was frequent in seminomas and correlated with clinical stage, distinguishing seminomatous from nonseminomatous and malignant from normal tissue. The authors suggest methylation markers may help risk estimation in clinical stage I disease.

pmid-16733519.summary_ja: 腰筋内に発生した原発性性腺外巨大卵黄嚢腫瘍により急性の脊髄圧迫を来した31歳男性の症例報告である。当初はポット病が疑われたが、腫瘍は第3腰椎を破壊し硬膜嚢を圧迫していた。前後合併手術で神経症状は改善し、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を行ったが、5か月後に敗血症で死亡した。若年男性の急性対麻痺では、精巣腫瘍の既往がなくても卵黄嚢腫瘍を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-16733519.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with a primary extragonadal giant yolk sac tumor in the psoas muscle who presented with acute spinal cord compression, paraparesis and urinary incontinence, initially suspected as Pott's disease. Imaging showed a giant cystic mass compressing the dural sac with third lumbar vertebral destruction. Combined anterior and posterior surgery improved neurological deficits, and chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin was given, but the patient died of sepsis five months later. The authors advise considering yolk sac tumor in young men with acute paraparesis even without testicular tumor history.

pmid-16759797.summary_ja: 米国小児腫瘍学グループの162例を用い、小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍におけるLINE-1 p40タンパク質の発現を検討した。全例で発現が認められ、強発現は低分化、性腺外発生、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型と関連した。活性化したLINE-1が小児胚細胞腫瘍に共通し、悪性転化に関与する可能性が示唆された。p40は腫瘍の悪性度を反映するマーカーとして期待される。
pmid-16759797.summary_en: This Children's Oncology Group study examined LINE-1 p40 protein expression in 162 pediatric malignant germ cell tumors. All cases expressed p40 to varying degrees, and normal testicular tissue showed weaker expression than tumor cells. Strong p40 expression was independently associated with poor differentiation, extragonadal primary site, and yolk sac tumor histology. The authors propose that active LINE-1 retrotransposition is a common feature of pediatric germ cell tumors and may contribute to malignant transformation, suggesting p40 as a potential marker of aggressive disease.

pmid-16770588.summary_ja: 妊娠31週で診断された大きな胎児頸部奇形腫の症例報告である。二次元超音波検査とカラードプラに加え、三次元超音波検査の表面モードによる所見の有用性を強調している。頸部奇形腫は全奇形腫の約6%を占める良性腫瘍で、予後は病変の大きさや部位、気管圧迫の程度に左右される。出生前画像診断の重要性が示された。
pmid-16770588.summary_en: This case report describes a large fetal cervical teratoma diagnosed at 31 weeks of gestation using two-dimensional ultrasonography and color Doppler. The authors highlight three-dimensional surface-mode ultrasonography, which provided findings useful for indirect assessment of neonatal prognosis. Cervical teratomas are rare benign tumors representing about 6% of all teratomas, and prognosis depends on lesion size, location, growth rate, and degree of tracheal compression. The report emphasizes the role of advanced prenatal imaging in planning and counseling for fetal teratomas.

pmid-16807779.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性脳炎の19歳女性の症例報告である。難治性てんかん重積状態などを呈し、血清と脳脊髄液からEFA6Aと共局在する自己抗体が検出された。腫瘍摘出と化学療法により神経症状は著明に改善した。若年女性の亜急性脳炎では卵巣奇形腫の除外が重要であり、この抗体は早期診断マーカーとなりうると述べている。
pmid-16807779.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with paraneoplastic encephalitis associated with immature ovarian teratoma, presenting with psychiatric symptoms, prolonged consciousness disturbance, refractory status epilepticus, and abnormal movements. Serum and CSF analysis revealed an autoantibody colocalizing with EFA6A, a brain-specific protein involved in dendritic development. Neurological symptoms improved significantly after tumor removal and chemotherapy. The authors suggest that ovarian teratoma should be excluded in young women with subacute encephalitis, and that these antibodies may serve as an early diagnostic marker for this potentially reversible condition.

pmid-16911854.summary_ja: 本多施設研究は、進行非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞がんにおいて、化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節が良性組織か、残存する奇形腫および生存腫瘍かを予測するモデルを更新し、検証した。1,094例のデータと、AFP、hCG、LDH、組織型、CTによる残存腫瘤の変化を含む6つの予測因子を用いた。更新モデルは、大半の施設で良好な校正を示し、1施設を除きc統計量は0.80を超えた。本モデルは、特に残存腫瘤が小さく良性組織の予測確率が低い患者など、真に外科的切除を要する患者の選択に役立つ。
pmid-16911854.summary_en: This multicentre study updated and validated a model predicting whether postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph nodes contain benign tissue or residual teratoma and viable cancer in advanced nonseminomatous testicular germ cell cancer. Using data from 1,094 patients and six predictors including AFP, hCG, LDH, histology, and CT residual mass changes, the updated model showed good calibration and a c-statistic above 0.80 in most centres. The model helps identify patients who truly need surgical resection, particularly those with small residual masses and low predicted probability of benign histology.

pmid-16920726.summary_ja: 本研究は、剥離した射精液細胞中の胎児性胚細胞マーカーAP-2γおよびOCT-3/4を用いた免疫細胞学的精液分析により、上皮内癌および初期の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を検出できるかを評価した。不妊症の男性294例とTGCTまたはその他の疾患の患者209例を検討したところ、AP-2γ陽性細胞はCIS患者の50%、未治療のTGCT患者の33.9%で認められた。特異度は93.6%、PPVは83.3%、NPVは60.3%であった。陰性の結果でもTGCTは除外できないため、本法は補助的な診断価値にとどまり、感度の改善が必要である。
pmid-16920726.summary_en: This study evaluates immunocytological semen analysis for detecting carcinoma in situ and early testicular germ cell tumours. It uses fetal germ cell markers AP-2gamma and OCT-3/4 in exfoliated ejaculate cells. Testing 294 infertile men and 209 patients with TGCTs or other diseases, AP-2gamma-positive cells were found in 50% of CIS cases and 33.9% of untreated TGCT patients. Specificity was 93.6%, PPV 83.3%, and NPV 60.3%. A negative result does not exclude TGCT, so the assay has only auxiliary diagnostic value and needs better sensitivity.

pmid-16924513.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性転化を生じた11例を後方視的に検討した研究です。軟部組織成分の有無、CT・MRIでの増強効果や嚢胞壁との角度、年齢、CA-125やCA 19-9などの腫瘍マーカーを解析しました。画像所見と臨床・検査データを組み合わせることで、術前診断の精度が向上する可能性が示されています。
pmid-16924513.summary_en: This retrospective study of 11 patients with mature cystic teratoma of the ovary and malignant transformation analysed CT and MR features of soft tissue components, along with age and tumour markers. Most tumours (82%) had soft tissue components, and 89% of those showed an obtuse angle to the cyst wall with enhancement. Tumours larger than 9.9 cm and patients over 45 years were common. CA-125 and CA 19-9 were frequently elevated. The authors propose combining these imaging and laboratory features to improve preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-16957908.summary_ja: 1999年から2004年の6年間に、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で悪性転化を生じた5例を報告しています。悪性転化の頻度は2%未満とされ稀です。形態学的および臨床病理学的特徴を検討し、文献レビューも行っています。小規模な症例シリーズですが、診断上の特徴を考察した報告です。
pmid-16957908.summary_en: This series reports five patients who developed malignant transformation in ovarian mature cystic teratoma between 1999 and 2004. Malignant transformation is rare, occurring in under 2% of cases according to the literature. The authors describe the morphological and clinicopathological features of these tumours and review the relevant literature. The paper is a small case series with discussion of diagnostic features.

pmid-16960727.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常な精子形成、障害された精子形成、および精巣腫瘍におけるDNMT1とHDAC1の細胞特異的発現を検討した。HDAC1は胎児性癌、セミノーマ、奇形腫で検出された一方、DNMT1はセミノーマでは欠如し、胎児性癌では上昇していた。円形精子細胞の成熟停止を示す男性では、円形精子細胞からDNMT1が消失していた。著者らは、エピジェネティックな制御因子が障害された精子形成と精巣がんの双方に関与している可能性があると示唆している。
pmid-16960727.summary_en: This study examined the cell-specific expression of the DNA methyltransferase DNMT1 and histone deacetylase HDAC1 in normal human spermatogenesis, impaired spermatogenesis and testicular tumours. HDAC1 was detected in embryonal carcinoma, seminoma and teratoma, while DNMT1 was absent in seminoma but upregulated in embryonal carcinoma. In men with round spermatid maturation arrest, DNMT1 was lost from round spermatids. The findings suggest that epigenetic regulators may be involved in both impaired spermatogenesis and testicular cancer.

pmid-16960883.summary_ja: 2歳男児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告しています。超音波では均一で境界明瞭な等エコーの充実性腫瘤を示し、内部血流が増加していました。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は4,396 ng/mlと著明に上昇し、病理学的に病期Iと確定しました。超音波所見は非特異的ですが、AFP高値と高血流性の充実性精巣腫瘤の組み合わせが診断に有用であると結論づけています。
pmid-16960883.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a testicular yolk sac tumour, the most common testicular malignancy in childhood. Ultrasound showed an ovoid, homogeneous, well-circumscribed, isoechoic solid testicular mass with increased internal vascularity on colour Doppler. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 4,396 ng/ml. Pathology confirmed stage I disease. The authors conclude that a raised AFP combined with a solid hypervascular testicular mass supports diagnosis, although sonographic features alone are nonspecific.

pmid-16996677.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍(非セミノーマおよびセミノーマ)の診断と治療の最新動向をまとめたレビューです。単独精巣では臓器温存手術が普及しつつあります。リスクに応じた治療により、患者の約半数は厳重なサーベイランスを選択できます。高リスク患者には補助化学療法や放射線療法が用いられ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は例外的になっています。
pmid-16996677.summary_en: This review summarises recent changes in the diagnosis and treatment of clinical stage I non-seminomatous and seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis. Organ-sparing surgery is now accepted for solitary testes and, with adjuvant radiotherapy, matches orchidectomy. Risk-adapted management means about half of patients may choose close surveillance. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection has become rare, while adjuvant chemotherapy, reduced-dose radiotherapy or carboplatin is used for higher-risk patients.

pmid-17011616.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎が疑われた水腫性胎盤294例を対象とした後方視的研究で、病理組織学的分類と倍数性による遺伝学的分類を比較した。両分類は23%の絨毛で不一致だった。病理学的に部分奇胎とされた症例の5%で持続性絨毛性疾患が生じたが、その奇胎はすべて二倍体であった。三倍体の水腫性妊娠では発症例はなかった。倍数性を用いて持続性絨毛性疾患の高リスク患者を同定することが有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17011616.summary_en: This retrospective study of 294 hydropic placentas suspected of hydatidiform mole compared histopathologic classification with ploidy analysis. Histopathology and genetic classifications were discordant in 23% of conceptuses. Among patients with histologically partial moles, 5% developed persistent trophoblastic disease, but all such moles were diploid; none of 131 triploid hydropic gestations did. The authors conclude that histopathologic examination should be performed for suspected moles, and ploidy should be used to identify patients at high risk of persistent trophoblastic disease after morphologic findings of hydatidiform change and trophoblastic hyperplasia.

pmid-17081678.summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴う奇形腫（TMT）患者14例の治療成績を報告。多くは肉腫成分を持ち、10例がシスプラチン併用化学療法と残存腫瘤の外科的切除を受けた。9例が再発し、14例中4例が生存。非GCT成分を標的とした治療も検討され、適応を調整した化学療法と手術の併用が予後改善につながる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17081678.summary_en: This series reports 14 patients with teratoma with malignant transformation (TMT), a rare germ cell tumor harboring a non-germ cell malignant component, most often sarcoma. Ten patients received first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy with resection of residual masses, and most achieved complete or partial responses. Nine patients relapsed, and four of eight treated at relapse with non-GCT-directed chemotherapy achieved partial responses. Four of 14 patients remained alive. Adapted chemotherapy combined with surgery may improve outcomes.

pmid-17081681.summary_ja: 尿中ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の糖鎖パターンを比較するため、レクチンを用いた免疫測定法と表面プラズモン共鳴法を開発した。正常妊娠、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、男性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を対象とした。3種のレクチンが、妊娠由来hCGと悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍・男性胚細胞腫瘍由来hCGを識別できた。診断と経過観察の改善に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-17081681.summary_en: This study developed a lectin-based sandwich immunoassay combined with surface plasmon resonance to compare the glycosylation of urinary hCG. Samples came from normal pregnancies, invasive moles, choriocarcinomas, and male germ cell tumors. Three lectins distinguished pregnancy-derived hCG from hCG of malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and male germ cell tumors. The authors propose that such glycoform discrimination could improve diagnosis and monitoring and may be extended to other glycosylated tumor markers.

pmid-17096341.summary_ja: 精巣がん（胚細胞腫瘍）の生存者29,511例を対象に、13のがん登録データを統合して二次悪性腫瘍のリスクを解析。全体の標準化罹患比は1.65で、複数の固形がんと骨髄性白血病で増加した。非セミノーマでは白血病リスクが特に高く、治療の影響が大きいと結論された。
pmid-17096341.summary_en: This pooled analysis of 13 cancer registries evaluated second malignancies among 29,511 survivors of germ cell testicular cancer. Overall risk was increased (SIR 1.65), with significant excess for several solid cancers and myeloid leukemia. Leukemia risk was markedly higher after nonseminoma, especially for patients diagnosed since 1990. Solid cancer risk rose with follow-up duration. The authors conclude that treatment effects likely contribute substantially to the excess risk of second primaries.

pmid-17101236.summary_ja: 34歳女性の右卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が回腸に穿通し、有茎性の回腸腫瘍として出現した症例報告。27歳時に左卵巣の類皮嚢腫を切除した既往がある。回盲部切除と右卵巣嚢腫切除が行われた。回腸病変には皮膚、神経組織、軟骨、骨などの成熟組織が認められた。
pmid-17101236.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman whose right ovarian mature cystic teratoma penetrated and protruded into the ileum, presenting as a pedunculated ileal tumor. She had previously undergone left ovarian cystectomy for a dermoid cyst at age 27. Ileocecal resection and right ovarian cystectomy were performed. Histology of the ileal mass showed skin, neural, cartilage, bone, and bronchial elements, along with a necrotic nodule containing hair and ovarian tissue.

pmid-17117392.summary_ja: 本総説は、多能性転写因子OCT4(POU5F1)を胚細胞腫瘍の指標として検討したものである。OCT4免疫組織化学は、性腺内および性腺外のセミノーマ/ディスジャーミノーマ、胎児性癌に高い感度と特異度を示し、原発不明転移の由来判定にも有用である。さらに、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)や性腺芽腫の胚細胞成分でも発現し、高リスク患者のスクリーニングへの応用も期待されている。
pmid-17117392.summary_en: This review covers OCT4 (POU5F1), a pluripotency transcription factor, as a marker of germ cell neoplasia. OCT4 immunohistochemistry is sensitive and specific for seminoma/dysgerminoma and embryonal carcinoma, both gonadal and extragonadal, including metastases of unknown primary. It also marks intratubular germ cell neoplasia and the germ cell component of gonadoblastoma, and may help screen high-risk patients. The authors discuss the pathogenesis and differential diagnosis of germ cell tumors.

pmid-17124010.summary_ja: 本研究は、胚細胞腫瘍の一種である胎児性癌(EC)細胞で発現する膜タンパク質ポドカリキシンを解析したものである。精製したポドカリキシンはTRA-1-60およびTRA-1-81抗体と結合し、これらは未分化な多能性幹細胞のマーカーである。レチノイン酸による分化誘導でこの抗原は消失し、ポドカリキシンの分子量も200kDaから170kDaへ変化した。すなわち、大型のポドカリキシン型が幹細胞抗原の担体であると示された。
pmid-17124010.summary_en: This study examines podocalyxin, a heavily glycosylated membrane protein, in embryonal carcinoma (EC), a malignant germ cell and pluripotent stem cell model. Purified EC podocalyxin binds TRA-1-60 and TRA-1-81 antibodies, which mark undifferentiated human pluripotent cells. Retinoic acid induces differentiation, loss of these markers, and a shift in podocalyxin's apparent molecular mass from 200 to 170 kDa, and the modified form no longer reacts with the antibodies. The larger podocalyxin form therefore carries the stem cell antigens.

pmid-17137617.summary_ja: 本症例集積は、脳転移を伴う高リスク・ステージIVの妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(GTN)患者4例の治療経験を報告している。早期開頭術または定位放射線治療に、エトポシド・シスプラチンとメトトレキサートの併用化学療法を組み合わせ、全脳照射や髄腔内化学療法を回避した。全例が12〜24か月の長期寛解を得たが、けいれんや運動異常などの神経後遺症を残した症例もあった。
pmid-17137617.summary_en: This case series describes four women with high-risk stage IV gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and brain metastases, managed by a multidisciplinary team. Early craniotomy or stereotactic radiosurgery was combined with etoposide-cisplatin followed by moderate- or high-dose methotrexate, avoiding whole brain radiation and intrathecal chemotherapy. All patients achieved prolonged remission of 12 to 24 months, although some had neurologic sequelae including seizures and dyskinesia.

pmid-17138961.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌(EC)細胞株のNT2/D1と27X-1について、レチノイン酸またはBMP-2で誘導される分化時の遺伝子発現を比較したものである。NT2/D1は神経外胚葉関連の転写産物を、27X-1は中内胚葉関連の遺伝子を多く発現していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍のデータとの比較により内臓内胚葉のマーカーが同定された。胎児性癌細胞株は多能性の程度が異なり、初期の系譜決定を研究するモデルとして有用であることが示された。
pmid-17138961.summary_en: This study compares gene expression in two human embryonal carcinoma (EC) lines, NT2/D1 and 27X-1, during differentiation induced by retinoic acid or BMP-2. NT2/D1 cells express neurectodermal transcripts and differentiate into neural or epithelial lineages, whereas 27X-1 cells express mesendodermal genes and become extra-embryonic endoderm. Comparison with yolk sac tumor data identified visceral endoderm markers. The findings show that EC lines differ in pluripotency and serve as models for early lineage choice.

pmid-17163397.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるTGF-βシグナル関連分子の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。正常胎盤51例と、絨毛癌17例および胞状奇胎64例を含む81例を対象とした。奇胎では正常栄養膜に比べて多くの分子の発現が上昇し、絨毛癌では奇胎に比べて低下していた。TGF-βシグナル経路は病態に関与し、治療標的や診断バイオマーカーとなりうると結論された。
pmid-17163397.summary_en: This study examined expression of TGF-beta signaling molecules (TGF-beta1/2, TbetaRI, TbetaRII, Smad2/3, Smad4) by immunohistochemistry in 51 normal placentas and 81 gestational trophoblastic diseases. The disease cohort included 17 choriocarcinomas, 39 complete moles, 6 partial moles and 19 invasive moles. Most signaling proteins were higher in moles than in normal trophoblast. Choriocarcinoma showed downregulation relative to moles, with TbetaRI and Smad2/3 lower than in normal villous trophoblast. The authors conclude that TGF-beta signaling contributes to gestational trophoblastic disease pathogenesis and may serve as a therapeutic target and diagnostic biomarker.

pmid-17172283.summary_ja: 精巣がんが偶発的に見つかった無精子症の4例で、腫瘍側精巣に対して顕微鏡下精巣内精子採取術を行った後方視的研究である。病理はセミノーマ2例、ライディッヒ細胞腫2例であった。4例中3例で精子が得られ、1回の顕微授精では妊娠に至らなかった。腫瘍側での採取は腫瘍学的リスクなく実施可能と結論づけられた。
pmid-17172283.summary_en: This retrospective study reports four azoospermic men with incidental testicular cancer found during orchiectomy, who underwent micro-TESE in the cancerous testis. Pathology showed classic seminoma in two patients and Leydig cell tumour in two. Sperm were retrieved in three of four patients, and one ICSI cycle was performed without pregnancy. The authors conclude that TESE in a cancerous testis is feasible, may avoid further surgery, and carries no oncological risk. All patients strongly desired offspring.

pmid-17177200.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し複数の化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた71例を後方視的に解析した。病理所見は線維化51%、胚細胞腫瘍28%、奇形腫21%であった。タキサン系の救援化学療法では残存する胚細胞腫瘍が少なかった。5年・10年の疾患特異的生存率は74%・70%で、後腹膜腫瘤5cm以上と胚細胞腫瘍の残存は予後不良因子であった。
pmid-17177200.summary_en: This institutional study of 71 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after multiple chemotherapy regimens for metastatic testicular germ cell tumors examined pathology and survival. Findings were fibrosis in 51%, GCT in 28% and teratoma in 21%. Taxane-containing salvage regimens were associated with fewer residual GCT and more fibrosis. Five- and 10-year disease-specific survival were 74% and 70%. A retroperitoneal mass of 5 cm or more and residual GCT predicted worse survival. The authors support selective RPLND after salvage chemotherapy.

pmid-17189656.summary_ja: 早期精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術後に放射線療法のみを行った346例を対象に、神経学的有害事象の頻度を検討した。放射線療法に起因すると考えられる症状は11例(3.2%)にみられた。感覚症状は多くが一過性であり、運動障害は線量が高いほど有意に増加した。標準線量では運動障害は稀だが、感覚症状に留意すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-17189656.summary_en: This study of 346 men treated with radiotherapy alone after orchiectomy for early-stage testicular seminoma estimated the rate of neurological adverse effects. Eleven patients (3.2%) had symptoms attributed to radiotherapy. Sensory symptoms occurred at doses of 25.2-36 Gy and mostly resolved, while motor impairment lasting over a year occurred at 36-40 Gy. Motor symptoms increased significantly with higher dose. The authors conclude that standard seminoma doses rarely cause motor impairment, but sensory symptoms should be recognized.

pmid-17197893.summary_ja: 79歳女性の卵巣に生じた8cmの卵巣甲状腺腫を報告する。内部にサイレント型副腎皮質刺激ホルモン産生性の下垂体腺腫が認められた。下垂体細胞はACTHおよびシナプトフィジンに陽性であった。甲状腺組織はサイログロブリン陽性の濾胞からなる。奇形腫内にみられる稀な体細胞型成分の症例であり、無症状の付属器腫瘤として発見された。
pmid-17197893.summary_en: The authors report an 8-cm struma ovarii containing a silent corticotroph cell pituitary adenoma, the first such report. The 79-year-old woman had an asymptomatic adnexal mass. Histology showed a focus of basophilic adenohypophyseal cells adjacent to mature neural tissue, while thyroglobulin-positive follicles formed the thyroid component. Pituitary cells were ACTH-positive and synaptophysin-positive. The case illustrates an unusual somatic-type component within an ovarian teratoma.

pmid-17199861.summary_ja: 日本の多施設共同研究で、進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する初回大量化学療法の成績を解析した。BEP療法3コース後に腫瘍マーカーが高値であった例に、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行した。中央値54か月の観察で生存は63%、無病生存は58%であった。治療関連死は4%である。予後不良例に対するランダム化試験の検討に値すると結論している。
pmid-17199861.summary_en: This multicenter study in Japan evaluated first-line high-dose carboplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide with peripheral blood stem cell support in advanced testicular germ cell tumor. Fifty-five patients received three cycles of BEP, and those with persistently elevated tumor markers went on to one cycle of high-dose chemotherapy. At median follow-up of 54 months, 63% were alive and 58% were disease-free. Treatment-related death occurred in 4%. The authors judged the regimen modestly active and well tolerated, and worth testing in randomized trials for poor-risk patients.

pmid-17199868.summary_ja: 転移性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(絨毛癌と胎児性癌の成分を含む)に対し8年前に化学療法を受け完全寛解した30歳男性が、左陰嚢の腫大を契機に精巣摘除術を受け、精巣セミノーマと診断された症例。治療前の精巣生検の是非には議論があり、異時性精巣腫瘍の可能性から長期フォローアップの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-17199868.summary_en: A 30-year-old man developed testicular seminoma eight years after chemotherapy for metastatic extragonadal germ cell tumor, which had choriocarcinoma and embryonal carcinoma components and reached complete remission. He was followed up without testicular biopsy. Left scrotal enlargement led to orchiectomy. The authors discuss the controversy over routine pretreatment testicular biopsy and stress the need for lifelong follow-up for metachronous testicular tumors.

pmid-17201931.summary_ja: 1989年に精巣奇形癌腫に対し精巣摘除術、全身化学療法、後腹膜残存腫瘤の切除を受けた20歳男性が、約17年間寛解を維持した。2005年に左鎖骨上の頸部腫瘤が前縦隔へ進展して見つかり切除され、成熟奇形腫と診断された。精巣非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍後の成熟奇形腫として報告例中最長級の間隔であり、生涯にわたるフォローアップの必要性が強調されている。
pmid-17201931.summary_en: A 20-year-old man treated in 1989 with orchiectomy, systemic chemotherapy and resection of a retroperitoneal residual mass for testicular teratocarcinoma remained in remission for about 17 years. In 2005 a large left supraclavicular neck mass extending into the anterior mediastinum was found and resected, and pathology showed mature teratoma. The authors note this is among the longest reported intervals and emphasize lifelong follow-up.

pmid-17203214.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の分子標的としてD型サイクリンを検討した研究。レチノイン酸による胎児性癌細胞株の分化でサイクリンD1が転写抑制と分解により減少し、臨床例の成熟過程でも同様の減少がみられた。サイクリンD1を標的としたsiRNAやエルロチニブは、シスプラチン感受性・耐性の両細胞の増殖を抑制し、治療標的としての可能性が示された。
pmid-17203214.summary_en: The study investigates D-type cyclins as targets in germ cell tumors. Retinoic acid differentiation of embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells and cisplatin-resistant derivatives reduced cyclin D1 through transcriptional repression and degradation, and reduced cyclin D1 was also seen in clinical tumors undergoing maturation. Knockdown of cyclin D1 inhibited growth, and erlotinib, which represses cyclin D1, suppressed proliferation of sensitive and resistant cells.

pmid-17208136.summary_ja: 英国北部地域の若年者悪性疾患登録に基づき、25歳未満の精巣がん253例を1968〜1999年について解析した研究。年齢調整罹患率は10万人あたり0.93から1.60へ上昇し、増加は15歳超の患者に限られた。5年生存率は46%から92%へ改善し、セミノーマは非セミノーマより良好であった。
pmid-17208136.summary_en: A registry study from the Northern Region of the United Kingdom identified 253 testicular cancer patients diagnosed before age 25 between 1968 and 1999. Age-standardized incidence rose from 0.93 to 1.60 per 100,000, confined to patients over 15 years. The 5-year survival improved from 46% to 92%, and was higher for seminoma than nonseminoma. The authors call for continued surveillance and research into etiology.

pmid-17208531.summary_ja: 羊水過多、胸水、腹水を伴う大きな前縦隔腫瘤を有する胎児例で、先天性心膜内奇形腫と診断された症例報告。出生前診断は困難であり、速やかに切除されない場合は致命的となりうる。周産期の外科的切除が唯一の救命療法であり、保存的治療は避けるべきであると結論づけられている。
pmid-17208531.summary_en: The authors describe a fetus with a large anterior mediastinal mass associated with polyhydramnios, pleural effusion and ascites, later diagnosed as congenital intrapericardial teratoma. Prenatal diagnosis is difficult, and the clinical course can be fatal if the tumor is not promptly excised. They conclude that perinatal surgical removal is the only lifesaving therapy and that conservative management should be avoided.

pmid-17209885.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ542例、非セミノーマ346例と対照870例を用いた症例対照研究で、携帯電話およびコードレス電話の使用を検討した。セミノーマでのオッズ比は1.1〜1.3、非セミノーマでは0.7〜1.0で、いずれも有意な関連は認められず、用量反応関係や潜伏期間による増加もみられなかった。停留精巣は両組織型と強く関連したが、電話使用との交互作用はなかった。
pmid-17209885.summary_en: This case-control study of 542 seminoma cases, 346 nonseminoma cases and 870 controls assessed use of cellular and cordless telephones. Odds ratios for seminoma were 1.1 to 1.3, and for nonseminoma 0.7 to 1.0, with confidence intervals including 1. No dose-response effect or latency trend was found. Cryptorchidism was strongly associated with both histologies but did not interact with phone use.

pmid-17217500.summary_ja: 15歳男児の病期Iセミノーマ症例の報告。精巣摘除術のみを行い補助療法は実施せず、術後8年間の臨床・画像・血清学的サーベイランスで再発はみられなかった。小児・思春期セミノーマにおける補助療法の必要性には不確実性があり、個別化した管理の検討が重要であると述べている。
pmid-17217500.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old boy with stage I seminoma treated with orchidectomy alone, without adjuvant therapy. Through clinical, radiological, and serological surveillance, he remained relapse-free for eight years after surgery. Seminomas are extremely rare in children and adolescents, and the authors emphasize the uncertainty regarding whether adjuvant treatment is needed for adolescent patients, particularly prepubescent children. The report highlights the need for individualized decision-making in managing pediatric and adolescent seminoma.

pmid-17220165.summary_ja: 無精子症男性145例を対象に、精巣結節と精巣がんの有病率を調べた研究。全体の結節有病率は7.5%、完全SCOS男性では結節26.3%、がん10.5%であった。がんには胎児性癌、セミノーマ、上皮内癌が含まれた。完全SCOSでは臨床評価、超音波検査、生検の重要性を強調している。
pmid-17220165.summary_en: This study assessed the prevalence of testicular nodules and cancer in 145 azoospermic men using clinical examination, testicular ultrasound, and biopsy. Overall nodule prevalence was 7.5%. Among men with complete Sertoli cell-only syndrome, nodules were found in 26.3% and cancer in 10.5%, including embryonal carcinoma, seminoma, and carcinoma in situ. The authors conclude that clinical evaluation, ultrasound, and biopsy should be emphasized in men with complete Sertoli cell-only syndrome to detect testicular neoplasia.

pmid-17220333.summary_ja: 米国兵士を対象とした症例対照研究（精巣胚細胞腫瘍508例、対照608例）で、免疫関連遺伝子の多型と発症リスクを検討した。TGFB1 Ex5-73C>Tが有意に関連し（オッズ比1.73）、LTA/TNFハプロタイプにも関連傾向が認められた。ただし多重検定補正後は有意性が消失した。TGFB1とLTA/TNFの多型が感受性に影響する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17220333.summary_en: A case-control study of 508 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 608 controls examined 32 SNPs in 16 immune function genes among US servicemen. TGFB1 Ex5-73C>T was associated with risk (odds ratio 1.73), and TGFB1 and LTA/TNF haplotypes showed suggestive associations, with some differences by histology. However, none of the associations remained significant after false discovery rate correction. The authors conclude that polymorphisms in TGFB1 and LTA/TNF may influence susceptibility to testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-17222545.summary_ja: 1987〜1992年に診断された精巣がん1,350例を対象とした欧州のEUROCARE研究。10年生存率はセミノーマで63〜94%、非セミノーマで47〜90%と国により差があった。西欧では診断時の病期が主な要因である一方、エストニアとポーランドでは治療の不十分さが示唆された。早期診断と治療へのアクセスの重要性を強調している。
pmid-17222545.summary_en: This EUROCARE high-resolution study reviewed records of 1,350 testicular cancer patients diagnosed in 1987 to 1992 across nine European countries to assess 10-year survival and relapse. Ten-year survival ranged from 63% to 94% for seminoma and from 47% to 90% for non-seminoma across registries. Differences in western registries were largely explained by stage at diagnosis, while Estonia and Poland had higher-than-expected hazard ratios, suggesting inadequate or unavailable treatment. The findings highlight the role of earlier diagnosis and treatment access in reducing inter-country survival disparities.

pmid-17223853.summary_ja: 妊娠20週で中絶された男性胎児の頸部先天性未熟奇形腫の剖検報告。腫瘍は93gで、三胚葉由来の組織を含み、未熟成分と成熟成分が認められた。左甲状腺葉が欠如していたことから、頸部軟部組織ではなく甲状腺左葉から発生したと結論づけられた。先天性頸部奇形腫の発生起源を判断する過程を示す症例である。
pmid-17223853.summary_en: This fetal autopsy report describes a congenital cervical immature teratoma in a male fetus aborted at 20 weeks 5 days of gestation. The 93 g tumor contained neoplastic cells from all three germ cell layers, with both immature and mature features, and small areas of thyroid tissue. Because the left thyroid lobe was absent while the right lobe was present, the authors concluded that the tumor arose from the left lobe of the thyroid gland rather than from neck soft tissue. The case illustrates the diagnostic reasoning needed to determine the origin of congenital cervical teratomas.

pmid-17228158.summary_ja: 3歳男児の後腹膜腫瘤で、画像上は後腹膜奇形腫と考えられた症例の報告。病理学的検査で、部分的に発達した脊柱を含む胎児内胎児（寄生性一卵性双胎）と診断された。胎児内胎児は生体内に見られるまれな病態で、小児において後腹膜腫瘤として発症しうることを示している。
pmid-17228158.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-year-old boy with a retroperitoneal mass that radiologically appeared to be a retroperitoneal teratoma. Pathological examination identified a fetus-in-fetu, a malformed parasitic monozygotic diamniotic twin containing a partially developed vertebral column. Fetus-in-fetu is a rare entity found within a living child or adult, and this report illustrates how it can present as a retroperitoneal mass in childhood.

pmid-17230577.summary_ja: 生後6日の女児に生じた大型の先天性未熟奇形腫の細胞診報告。腹部膨隆で受診し、超音波検査とCTで骨盤内の嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診では原始神経外胚葉腫瘍が疑われる小型円形青色細胞が見られた。切除標本では未熟な神経上皮とグリア成分を含む嚢胞性奇形腫で、細胞診所見と一致した。奇形腫の多様性による診断の難しさを強調している。
pmid-17230577.summary_en: A cytopathology report of a large congenital immature cystic teratoma in a 6-day-old girl who presented with abdominal distension. Ultrasound and CT showed a cystic pelvic mass, and ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration revealed small round blue cells suspicious for a primitive neuroectodermal tumor. Resection showed a cystic teratoma with immature neuroepithelial and glial components that matched the cytologic finding. The authors emphasize the diagnostic difficulty caused by the diversity of teratomas.

pmid-17234481.summary_ja: 27歳男性で、右肩甲骨部の疼痛から発見された骨溶解性病変の症例。切除生検で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍由来の転移と判明し、精巣と腹部に原発は認めなかった。前縦隔腫瘤をCTとMRIで確認した。シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる化学療法6コースで腫瘤は著明に縮小した。その後の外科的切除を経て、1年のフォローアップで良好であった。
pmid-17234481.summary_en: A case report of a 27-year-old man whose initial symptom was persistent right scapular pain, found to be an expansile osteolytic lesion. Excisional biopsy showed metastatic carcinoma of nonseminomatous germ cell tumor origin, while the testes and abdomen were negative. CT and MRI identified the primary anterior mediastinal mass. Six courses of cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide chemotherapy markedly reduced the mass, and the patient was well at one-year follow-up after surgical resection.

pmid-17235042.summary_ja: 予後不良な転移性胚細胞腫瘍の初回治療で、BEP療法に大量化学療法を追加する第III相無作為化試験。1年時点の持続的完全奏効率に有意差はなかった(52%対48%)。化学療法初期の腫瘍マーカー低下が遅いと、無増悪生存期間と全生存期間が短いことが示された。
pmid-17235042.summary_en: This phase III randomized trial enrolled 219 patients with intermediate- or poor-risk metastatic germ cell tumors to standard BEP alone or BEP followed by high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin and stem-cell rescue. The 1-year durable complete response rate did not differ significantly (52% vs 48%). In patients with unsatisfactory marker decline, high-dose chemotherapy appeared to improve response (61% vs 34%), but routine use did not improve outcome overall. Slow alpha-fetoprotein or hCG decline during the first two cycles predicted shorter progression-free and overall survival, supporting frequent serum marker monitoring.

pmid-17240432.summary_ja: 本後方視的症例集積および文献的考察は、22年間に治療された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌17例を検討した。患者の多くは閉経周辺期で、腫瘍は大きく偶発的に発見されることが多かった。予後は手術病期に強く影響され、補助療法後の再発は多かった。原病で死亡した4例で、1年全生存率は60%であった。早期病期では白金製剤化学療法と骨盤放射線療法が妥当な可能性があるが、補助療法に関する見解は一致していない。
pmid-17240432.summary_en: This retrospective case series and literature review examines squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratomas of the ovary in 17 women treated over 22 years. Most patients were perimenopausal, and tumors were often large and incidental findings. Surgical stage strongly influenced prognosis, and recurrence was common after adjuvant treatment. Four patients died of disease, and the overall 1-year survival rate was 60%. Platinum-based chemotherapy with pelvic radiation may be reasonable for early-stage disease, although consensus on adjuvant therapy is lacking.

pmid-17261854.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で初回の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、後腹膜に奇形腫のみを認めた210例の長期転帰を検討した。成熟奇形腫が85%を占め、悪性転化は8%であった。10年無再発率は80%で、残存腫瘤の大きさとIGCCCG分類が再発の予測因子であった。
pmid-17261854.summary_en: This retrospective cohort of 210 men with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors found only teratoma at initial postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND). Most patients received induction chemotherapy alone. Pathology showed mature teratoma in 85%, immature teratoma in 7%, and teratoma with malignant transformation in 8%. Ten-year freedom from recurrence was 80%. Residual mass size and IGCCCG risk class predicted recurrence, supporting the continued role of PC-RPLND in management.

pmid-17262080.summary_ja: 1960年から2004年に英国南東部で診断されたセミノーマ患者5555例と非セミノーマ患者3733例を対象に、生存率と二次がんのリスクを検討した。10年相対生存率は大きく改善した。結腸、軟部組織、膀胱、膵臓のがんや白血病の増加に加え、対側精巣を含む精巣がんの二次発生が認められた。治療の進歩と毒性低減が将来のリスク低下に寄与すると考察している。
pmid-17262080.summary_en: This registry-based cohort study from Southeast England followed 5555 seminoma and 3733 nonseminoma testicular cancer patients diagnosed from 1960 to 2004. Relative survival improved markedly over time, and late mortality decreased. Excess second cancers were identified, including colon, soft tissue, bladder, pancreatic, and leukaemia cancers, as well as second testis cancers. The authors attribute the improved outcomes to better treatment, and expect that reduced therapy toxicity will lower future health risks in survivors.

pmid-17262855.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う傍腫瘍性抗NMDA受容体脳炎の女性12例を報告した。患者抗体はNR2BおよびNR2Aを含むNMDAR複合体を認識し、腫瘍内の神経組織にもこれらのサブユニットが発現していた。腫瘍切除と免疫療法により、多くの治療例で改善がみられ、抗体価も並行して低下した。治療反応性のある自己免疫性脳炎として、診断用の抗体検査も提案されている。
pmid-17262855.summary_en: This study describes twelve women with paraneoplastic anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, eleven of whom had ovarian teratoma and one a mediastinal mature teratoma. Patient antibodies recognized NR2B- and NR2A-containing NMDAR heteromers, and tumor nervous tissue expressed these subunits. Tumor resection and immunotherapy led to improvement or recovery in most treated patients, with antibody titers falling in parallel. The authors propose this as a treatment-responsive autoimmune encephalitis with a diagnostic antibody test.

pmid-17268712.summary_ja: 22歳女性の完全型Currarino三徴候例。仙骨骨欠損、肛門狭窄、直腸膣瘻に加え、仙骨前部腫瘤として髄膜瘤と奇形腫の合併が認められ、大腸回転異常も伴っていた。この組み合わせは既報がないと報告され、外科的管理と文献的考察が示されている。
pmid-17268712.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman with complete Currarino triad presented with a sacral bony defect, anal stenosis, rectovaginal fistula, and a presacral mass. The mass combined a meningocele and a teratoma, and the colon showed malrotation, a combination not previously reported. The authors describe the clinical presentation and surgical management and review the literature. The case highlights teratoma as an extragonadal presacral lesion within a rare congenital syndrome.

pmid-17270653.summary_ja: 成人の後腹膜原発奇形腫はまれで、多くは精巣や卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍に続発する。本例は副腎骨髄脂肪腫様の所見を呈した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、腹腔鏡手術から開腹副腎摘除へ移行して完全切除された。悪性化のリスクから画像フォローアップが行われ、18か月以上再発は認められていない。
pmid-17270653.summary_en: Primary retroperitoneal teratomas are rare in adults and usually arise secondary to testicular or ovarian germ cell tumors. The authors report a mature cystic teratoma that mimicked an adrenal myelolipoma on clinical evaluation. Laparoscopic resection was converted to open adrenalectomy to achieve complete removal. Because of malignancy risk, follow-up imaging was performed, and the patient has remained free of recurrence for over 18 months. The report underscores teratoma in the differential diagnosis of adrenal-region masses.

pmid-17273781.summary_ja: ヒトのセミノーマおよび非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍組織ではREIC/Dkk-3の発現が低下していた。アデノウイルスによるREIC/Dkk-3過剰発現は、JNK活性化を介して精巣胚細胞がん細胞株NCCITにアポトーシスを誘導したが、正常線維芽細胞では誘導しなかった。単回腫瘍内注射はヌードマウスでNCCIT腫瘍の増殖を著明に抑制した。著者らは、Ad-RECを精巣がんに対する毒性の少ない非遺伝毒性治療法として提案している。
pmid-17273781.summary_en: REIC/Dkk-3 expression is reduced in human seminoma and non-seminomatous germ cell tumor tissues. Adenovirus-mediated overexpression of REIC/Dkk-3 induced apoptosis in the NCCIT testicular germ cell cancer line through JNK activation, but not in normal fibroblasts. A single intratumoral injection markedly suppressed NCCIT tumor growth in nude mice. The authors propose Ad-REIC as a potentially less toxic, non-genotoxic therapeutic approach for testicular cancer, which is curable but whose treatment can impair testicular function.

pmid-17274038.summary_ja: 妊娠21週に口から突出する混合エコー像の腫瘤として咽頭奇形腫を出生前診断した。3週間で腫瘤は増大し重度羊水過多を来たし、27週で子宮内胎児死亡が確認された。ミソプロストールで分娩誘発し、1,015gの死産女児を娩出。剖検で咽頭奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-17274038.summary_en: A fetal pharyngeal teratoma was diagnosed prenatally at 21 weeks' gestation as a mixed-echogenicity mass protruding from the mouth. Over three weeks the tumor enlarged and severe polyhydramnios developed, and intrauterine fetal death occurred at 27 weeks. Labor was induced with misoprostol, and a stillborn female neonate weighing 1,015 g was delivered. Postmortem examination confirmed pharyngeal teratoma. The report illustrates the progressive course of a fetal teratoma and the challenges of prenatal diagnosis and management, with a literature review.

pmid-17274819.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍60例と卵巣小細胞癌8例で多能性関連因子と胚細胞マーカーを解析した。NANOGやOCT-3/4は胚細胞腫瘍で高発現し、小細胞癌では発現しなかった。片側ディスジャーミノーマの13例中5例にKIT変異を認めた一方、両側例では変異はなく、性染色体Y由来物質を含む症例も示された。
pmid-17274819.summary_en: This study examined 60 ovarian germ cell tumor samples and eight ovarian small cell carcinomas for stem cell and germ cell markers. Pluripotency transcription factors such as NANOG and OCT-3/4 were highly expressed in germ cell tumors but not in small cell carcinomas. KIT mutations occurred in 5 of 13 unilateral dysgerminomas, whereas bilateral dysgerminomas and other histologies were wild type. Combined dysgerminoma/gonadoblastoma in phenotypic females contained Y-chromosome material. The authors propose two distinct pathways in ovarian germ cell tumor development.

pmid-17276434.summary_ja: 既往に卵巣甲状腺腫のある女性が新たに甲状腺機能亢進症を来たし、2個目の卵巣甲状腺腫と橋本甲状腺炎の合併が判明した。腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術で腫瘍を摘除した後、甲状腺機能亢進症は消失した。甲状腺機能異常の原因が二つ存在する場合には包括的な臨床評価が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17276434.summary_en: A woman with a previous struma ovarii developed new hyperthyroidism and was found to have a second struma ovarii coincident with Hashimoto's thyroiditis. Laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy removed the tumor, after which thyroid hormone levels normalized and hyperthyroidism resolved. The authors emphasize that when a patient has two distinct causes of abnormal thyroid function, a comprehensive clinical evaluation is needed. The report describes ovarian struma in a patient with autoimmune thyroid disease.

pmid-17277761.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例で、セミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別におけるD2-40免疫組織化学をKIT、CD30と比較した。D2-40は純粋なセミノーマすべてに陽性だが、胎児性癌の29%にも陽性であった。KITはセミノーマの92%で陽性（胎児性癌では陰性）、CD30は胎児性癌の93%で陽性（セミノーマでは陰性）であった。D2-40は特異性に欠けるため、KITおよびCD30の方が鑑別に有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17277761.summary_en: The authors assessed D2-40 immunohistochemistry for distinguishing seminoma from embryonal carcinoma in 40 testicular germ cell neoplasms, comparing it with KIT and CD30. D2-40 stained all pure seminomas with diffuse membranous staining, but was also focally positive in 29% of embryonal carcinomas. KIT was expressed in 92% of seminomas and no embryonal carcinomas, while CD30 was expressed in 93% of embryonal carcinomas and no seminomas. KIT and CD30 are more discriminating, since D2-40 lacks specificity.

pmid-17285132.summary_ja: 中期染色体比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍34例を解析した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は胚腫性腫瘍に比べ1p、4q、6qの欠失と3pの増加が多かった。成人例で通常みられる12p増加は5〜16歳の53%に認められた。12p増加のない腫瘍では16p欠失が多く、別の発生機構の関与が示唆された。
pmid-17285132.summary_en: Metaphase comparative genomic hybridisation was used to analyze 34 pediatric malignant germ cell tumors, including 22 yolk sac tumors, 11 germinomatous tumors, and one metastatic embryonal carcinoma, 17 of them ovarian. Yolk sac tumors showed more frequent losses at 1p, 4q, and 6q and gains at 3p than germinomatous tumors. Gain of 12p, typical of adult MGCTs, occurred in 53% of children aged 5 to 16. Gain of 12p was associated with gain of 12q. Tumors lacking 12p gain showed more frequent 16p loss, suggesting a distinct contribution to tumor development.

pmid-17288852.summary_ja: パキスタンの三次医療施設での記述的症例集積で、産科入院1030例中23例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を解析した。出生45例に1例の頻度で、19例が胞状奇胎、4例が悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患であった。8例が化学療法を受け、多くは吸引掻爬とフォローアップで管理された。21例が完全回復し、2例は脳転移を伴う進展で死亡した。早期診断の重要性が強調された。
pmid-17288852.summary_en: This descriptive case series from a Pakistani tertiary hospital reviewed 23 gestational trophoblastic disease cases among 1030 obstetric admissions, a frequency of about 1 per 45 live births. Nineteen were hydatidiform moles and four were malignant trophoblastic disease. Eight patients received chemotherapy, and most others underwent suction evacuation and follow-up. Twenty-one recovered fully, while two died of extensive disease with brain metastasis. The authors emphasize early diagnosis as key to better outcomes.

pmid-17291262.summary_ja: 19歳女性の左卵巣に生じた非妊娠性の純粋な絨毛癌の症例報告である。病理学的に他の胚細胞腫瘍成分を含まない純粋な絨毛癌であった。15座のショートタンデムリピート解析により非妊娠性起源を確認した。メトトレキサート、エトポシド、アクチノマイシンDによる複数コースの化学療法が有効であった。卵巣純粋絨毛癌の遺伝学的起源決定にはDNA多型解析が有用である。
pmid-17291262.summary_en: The authors report a 19-year-old woman with a pure nongestational choriocarcinoma of the left ovary. Pathology showed pure choriocarcinoma without other germ cell tumor components. DNA polymorphism analysis at 15 short tandem repeat loci confirmed a nongestational origin. Multiple courses of chemotherapy with methotrexate, etoposide, and actinomycin D were effective. The paper highlights STR analysis as a useful tool for determining the genetic origin of pure ovarian choriocarcinoma, which is otherwise difficult to establish.

pmid-17291263.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)4例の報告と文献レビューである。子宮に限局した3例は治療後無病生存したが、子宮外に進展した1例は積極的化学療法にもかかわらず死亡した。予後不良因子としては子宮外進展が最も重要とされた。化学療法への感受性が低いため子宮全摘術が治療の基本で、転移・再発例にはEP/EMAが最も有効な一次治療と考えられた。
pmid-17291263.summary_en: This report describes four patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), a rare variant of gestational trophoblastic disease, and reviews the literature. Three tumors were confined to the uterus and remained disease-free after treatment, while one with extrauterine extension died despite aggressive chemotherapy. Extension beyond the uterus was the most important adverse prognostic factor. Because PSTT is relatively insensitive to chemotherapy, hysterectomy is the mainstay of treatment, and EP/EMA appears the most effective first-line regimen for metastatic or relapsing disease.

pmid-17295347.summary_ja: 部分的10q トリソミーおよび部分的17p モノソミーを伴う胎児の出生前診断仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。妊娠24週の超音波で大きな仙骨部腫瘤、心奇形、腎盂拡張、発育不全が認められた。妊娠28週で早産し、児は死亡した。出生後の検査で所見が確認され、10q遠位トリソミーに特徴的な顔貌も認められた。染色体異常と仙尾部奇形腫との関連が示唆された。
pmid-17295347.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with a prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) in the setting of partial trisomy 10q and partial monosomy 17p. Ultrasound at 24 weeks revealed a large sacral mass with cardiac and renal anomalies and growth restriction. The fetus died after preterm delivery at 28 weeks, and postnatal examination confirmed the findings and identified facial features typical of distal 10q trisomy. The authors suggest a possible association between chromosomal aberrations and sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-17296380.summary_ja: 臨床病期I～IIAの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者500例を対象に、修正後腹膜リンパ節郭清テンプレート外の病変の頻度を検討した。テンプレートにより3～23%の患者に外側病変が認められた。右側・左側テンプレートに追加領域を含めると頻度はそれぞれ2%・3%に低下した。化学抵抗性の奇形成分が約20～30%に認められ、神経温存型の拡大テンプレートが支持された。
pmid-17296380.summary_en: This study of 500 patients with clinical stage I to IIA nonseminomatous germ cell tumors evaluated disease outside five modified retroperitoneal lymph node dissection templates. Extra-template disease occurred in 3% to 23% of patients depending on the template used, and about 20% to 30% of cases contained chemoresistant teratomatous elements. Extending the right-sided and left-sided templates to additional nodal regions reduced the incidence to 2% and 3%, respectively, supporting more extensive nerve-sparing templates.

pmid-17296383.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、補助化学療法を受けなかった80例を後方視的に検討した。節外浸潤を有する患者は23例であった。5年無病生存率は節外浸潤ありで74%、なしで75%と有意差はなかった。節外浸潤の予後的意義は認められず、それ単独で補助化学療法を行うべきかに疑問が呈された。
pmid-17296383.summary_en: This retrospective review of 80 patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and received no adjuvant chemotherapy examined extranodal extension. Extranodal extension was present in 23 patients and absent in 57. The five-year disease-free survival was 74% with extranodal extension and 75% without (p=0.67). The authors found no prognostic significance of extranodal extension, questioning whether it alone should prompt adjuvant chemotherapy in patients with low-volume retroperitoneal metastasis.

pmid-17298543.summary_ja: 精巣正常組織、上皮内癌、セミノーマ、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍におけるXIAPとSmac/DIABLOのmRNA発現を定量した。XIAPは組織型間で差がなかったが、Smac/DIABLOは正常組織から非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍へ段階的に低下した。XIAP対Smac/DIABLO比は臨床病期IIIで高値であった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の進展に伴い、抗アポトーシス作用のXIAPに有利な方向へ変化すると結論づけられた。
pmid-17298543.summary_en: This study quantified XIAP and Smac/DIABLO mRNA expression by real-time RT-PCR in normal testicular tissue, testicular carcinoma in situ, seminomas, and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. XIAP levels did not differ among histologic groups, whereas Smac/DIABLO decreased progressively from normal tissue to carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. The XIAP-to-Smac/DIABLO ratio rose correspondingly and was higher in clinical stage III. The authors conclude that the balance shifts toward antiapoptotic XIAP during testicular germ cell tumor progression.

pmid-17301082.summary_ja: 精巣がんの男性16例を対象に、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシン療法中および治療前後の臨床・神経生理学的変化を前向きに検討した。シスプラチン累積投与量が300mg/m²を超えると腱反射の消失と振動覚の低下が生じた。感覚神経活動電位の振幅は50～60%低下した。運動神経と自律神経は変化せず、遠位軸索変性ではなく大径感覚ニューロンの変性が示唆された。
pmid-17301082.summary_en: This prospective study serially assessed clinical and neurophysiological function in 16 men with testicular cancer receiving cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin at varying cisplatin doses. Above cumulative cisplatin doses of about 300 mg/m2, patients lost tendon reflexes and showed reduced vibration sense, with sensory nerve action potential amplitudes reduced by 50 to 60%. Motor conduction and autonomic function remained unchanged, suggesting degeneration of large sensory neurons rather than distal axonal degeneration.

pmid-17302291.summary_ja: 21例の胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象に、遊離β-hCG、インタクトhCG、総hCG(thCG)の3種のアッセイを治療中に比較した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では3者の相関が良好で、thCGは診断感度が高かった。thCGとihCGはfbetahCGより陰性化までに約4週間遅れた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理には、thCGが標準アッセイとして適切と結論づけている。
pmid-17302291.summary_en: This study compared three hCG assays, free beta-hCG (fbetahCG, the Japanese standard), intact hCG, and total hCG (thCG), in 21 patients with germ cell tumors during treatment. In seminomatous tumors, fbetahCG correlated poorly with the other assays, while in non-seminomatous tumors all three correlated well. thCG showed higher diagnostic sensitivity. In patients with positive hCG at diagnosis, fbetahCG normalized first, whereas thCG and ihCG normalized about four weeks later. The authors conclude that thCG is appropriate as a standard assay for non-seminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-17302578.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に持続的無精子症を呈した2例に対し、精巣内精子採取術(TESE)を施行した。1例は非セミノーマで、大量化学療法を含む治療後に局所的な精子形成がみられたが、ICSIでは妊娠に至らなかった。もう1例はセミノーマ後にセルトリ細胞のみ症候群を示し、1回のICSIで妊娠が継続した。凍結精子が利用できない場合はTESEを考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-17302578.summary_en: This report describes two men with persistent azoospermia after chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumor who underwent testicular sperm extraction (TESE). One had stage III non-seminoma treated with BEP plus high-dose chemotherapy and showed germinal aplasia with focal full spermatogenesis, but two ICSI cycles did not achieve pregnancy. The other had stage II seminoma treated with BEP, showed Sertoli-cell-only syndrome, and achieved an ongoing pregnancy after one ICSI cycle. The authors recommend considering TESE when frozen sperm samples are unavailable.

pmid-17307495.summary_ja: 縦隔に好発する奇形腫が肺内に発生した稀な2症例を報告した。臨床像、画像所見、病理組織学的所見を示し、他部位の奇形腫と類似する組織像であることを述べている。関連文献も検討している。肺実質内に発生する奇形腫はまれであり、その認識を広める症例報告である。
pmid-17307495.summary_en: This report describes two patients with intrapulmonary teratoma, an exceptionally rare site for these tumors, which are almost always found in the mediastinum. The authors present the clinical features, radiologic findings, and histopathologic findings of both cases. The histology resembles teratomas arising at other sites. The paper also discusses relevant literature on this rare presentation. It is a clinical case series that broadens recognition of teratoma arising within the lung parenchyma.

pmid-17307866.summary_ja: 陰嚢内腫瘤の多くは胚細胞腫瘍であり、通常のHE染色標本で認識できることを述べる。患者の年齢や既往、精巣と精巣傍の部位、肉眼所見から鑑別診断を絞り込む方法を解説する。淡明細胞型や腺管型、微小嚢胞型などの形態パターンごとの鑑別を示した。診断が難しい症例では免疫組織化学染色が有用である。
pmid-17307866.summary_en: This review describes a morphological approach to neoplastic scrotal masses, most of which prove to be germ cell tumors recognizable on routine hematoxylin and eosin sections. It explains how patient age, history, tumor site (testicular versus paratesticular), and gross findings focus the differential diagnosis. Recurring patterns, including diffuse clear-cell, glandular/tubular, microcystic, and oncocytic architecture, generate defined differential sets. Immunohistochemistry helps resolve difficult cases, including metastatic tumors, rare tumors, and intratubular proliferations.

pmid-17308380.summary_ja: 悪性転化した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の腺癌(病期IV)の70歳女性の症例を報告した。コラーゲンゲル液滴包埋薬剤感受性試験により、補助化学療法としてパクリタキセル/カルボプラチンを選択した。6コース後、腹水の増悪はなく胸壁腫瘍は消失した。原発巣の組織型が不明な場合の化学療法薬選択に有用である可能性を述べている。
pmid-17308380.summary_en: This case report describes a 70-year-old woman with stage IV adenocarcinoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma that had undergone malignant transformation, with pleural effusion, ascites, and a chest wall tumor. The collagen gel droplet embedded drug sensitivity test (CD-DST) was used to select paclitaxel/carboplatin as adjuvant chemotherapy. After six courses, ascites did not progress and the chest wall tumor disappeared completely. The authors suggest CD-DST may help select preoperative chemotherapy when the primary histologic type is unknown.

pmid-17309671.summary_ja: 当初子宮外妊娠と誤診された43歳女性の、子宮頸部原発妊娠性絨毛癌の症例を報告した。β-hCGの上昇が持続したため腹腔鏡と掻爬を行い、免疫組織化学で絨毛癌と診断した。子宮全摘後にメトトレキサートによる単剤化学療法を施行した。絨毛癌は化学感受性が高く、進行例でも予後は良好と述べている。
pmid-17309671.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old woman with primary gestational choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix, initially misdiagnosed as an ectopic pregnancy. Persistently rising beta-hCG led to laparoscopy and dilatation and curettage, and immunohistochemistry confirmed choriocarcinoma. She underwent hysterectomy followed by single-agent methotrexate. The authors discuss the difficulties of differential diagnosis and emphasize immunohistochemistry as the mainstay of diagnosis. Choriocarcinoma remains highly chemosensitive, with a good prognosis even in advanced stages.

pmid-17316775.summary_ja: 41歳女性の混合型卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。類内膜癌や未分化癌を合併し、膣壁にのみ転移を認めた。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法で一時完全奏効を得たが再発し、原病で死亡した。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の膣転移として初の報告としている。
pmid-17316775.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with a mixed ovarian yolk sac tumor associated with endometrioid and undifferentiated carcinoma, presenting with a pelvic mass and vaginal wall tumor. The disease metastasized only to the vagina. She received bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, followed by three additional cycles of etoposide and cisplatin. She initially achieved complete response, but the tumor recurred and she died of disease. The authors report this as the first case of a mixed ovarian germ cell tumor with vaginal metastasis.

pmid-17324327.summary_ja: 29歳男性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。単発の椎体転移により脊髄圧迫を呈した。左精巣摘除術と、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる4サイクルの化学療法を受け、完全寛解に至った。胚細胞腫瘍では骨転移は予後不良な晩期病変とされる。
pmid-17324327.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man with a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who presented with a solitary vertebral metastasis causing spinal compression. Bone metastasis is generally a late and poor-prognosis manifestation in germ cell tumors. He underwent left orchiectomy and four cycles of chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, and achieved complete remission. The report highlights an isolated bony metastasis treated with curative intent.

pmid-17333214.summary_ja: 1991年から2001年に登録された小児の成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫183例を対象とした、イタリアの前向き多施設共同研究。ほとんどの症例で完全切除が行われ、再発率は成熟奇形腫で約5%、未熟奇形腫で約14%だった。女性、不完全切除、組織学的グレードが再発・死亡リスクに関連し、10年全生存期間は98%であった。化学療法を受けた症例数は少なく、その有効性は評価できなかった。
pmid-17333214.summary_en: A prospective multicentre Italian study of 183 children with mature or immature teratomas treated from 1991 to 2001. Most tumours were resected completely, and relapse occurred in about 5% of mature and 14% of immature teratomas. Female sex, incomplete resection, and tumour grade were associated with a higher risk of relapse or death. Ten-year overall survival was 98%. Few patients received chemotherapy, so its efficacy could not be assessed.

pmid-17333512.summary_ja: 組織学的に確認された古典型セミノーマの32歳男性の症例報告。超音波検査を1年の間隔をあけて2回実施したところ、腫瘍径は変化しなかった。セミノーマの自然経過が多様であることを論じ、増殖パターンの二分化の可能性を指摘している。生物学的に侵襲性の低い腫瘍を見分けるための分子マーカーの必要性も述べている。
pmid-17333512.summary_en: A case report of a 32-year-old man with histologically confirmed classic seminoma of the testis, whose tumour size remained unchanged over one year on two ultrasound examinations. The authors discuss the heterogeneous natural history of seminoma and suggest a possible dichotomy in growth behaviour. They call for molecular markers to identify tumours with less aggressive biology, which could help avoid overtreatment in such patients.

pmid-17334483.summary_ja: 陰茎と下腹壁に浸潤した巨大精巣腫瘍を呈した36歳男性の症例報告。組織学的に成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫が認められた。超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引生検で単発の肺結節が転移と確認された。陰茎体部を含む根治的切除、両側鼠径リンパ節郭清、下腹壁切除を行い、その後化学療法と放射線療法を受け、肺転移巣も切除された。
pmid-17334483.summary_en: A case report of a 36-year-old man with a giant testicular tumour invading the penis and abdominal wall, showing mature and immature teratoma on histology. A solitary lung nodule was confirmed as metastasis by ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration. Treatment consisted of radical resection including the penile shaft, bilateral inguinal lymph node dissection, and abdominal wall resection, followed by chemotherapy and radiotherapy and later resection of the lung metastasis.

pmid-17336850.summary_ja: 肺および脳転移を伴う妊娠性絨毛癌の治療中であった33歳女性が、右小指に丘疹性病変を生じた症例報告。病理組織学により絨毛癌の皮膚転移と確認された。手や皮膚への転移は稀で、手への浸潤の報告は文献上1例のみであると述べられている。侵襲性の高い栄養膜性悪性腫瘍における非典型的な転移部位を示した報告である。
pmid-17336850.summary_en: A case report of a 33-year-old woman being treated for gestational choriocarcinoma with lung and brain metastases, who developed a papular lesion on the small finger. Histopathology confirmed it as a cutaneous metastasis of choriocarcinoma. The authors note that hand and cutaneous metastases are rare, with only one previous report of hand involvement in the literature. The paper highlights an unusual metastatic site for this aggressive trophoblastic malignancy.

pmid-17337380.summary_ja: 表現型男性で46XX真性半陰陽、両側停留精巣を有する35歳男性の症例報告。片側は卵精巣、反対側の停留精巣に純粋型セミノーマが発生していた。腫瘍は切除と併用化学療法で治療された。染色体検査では46XX核型で、Y染色体の性決定領域(SRY)は陰性であった。真性半陰陽における性腺腫瘍は極めて稀であると述べている。
pmid-17337380.summary_en: A case report of a 35-year-old phenotypic male with 46XX true hermaphroditism, bilateral undescended testes, an ovotestis on one side, and pure seminoma in the undescended testis on the other. The seminoma was treated with excision and combination chemotherapy. Cytogenetic analysis revealed a 46XX karyotype, with SRY-specific primers negative. The authors review the karyotypic abnormality and note that gonadal tumours in true hermaphrodites are very rare.

pmid-17339149.summary_ja: 34歳男性が前縦隔腫瘤で受診した。胸腔鏡下生検でジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）が認められ、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGの上昇から混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。術前化学療法後に残存腫瘍を完全切除した。病理学的には悪性神経節神経腫が主体で、奇形腫の小病巣を伴っていた。
pmid-17339149.summary_en: A 34-year-old man presented with an anterior mediastinal mass. Initial thoracoscopic biopsy showed germinoma, and elevated serum AFP and beta-hCG supported a diagnosis of mixed germ cell tumor. After preoperative chemotherapy, the residual tumor was completely resected. Pathology showed predominantly malignant ganglioneuroma with small residual teratoma foci. The authors report this as the first case of malignant ganglioneuroma arising from a mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor.

pmid-17341430.summary_ja: 34歳女性の卵巣腫瘍で、類内膜腺癌、明細胞癌、扁平上皮癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫が混在していた。神経外胚葉および横紋筋肉腫様の分化が顕著であった。全身化学療法後も再発を繰り返し、化学療法感受性の高い純粋な胚細胞腫瘍とは対照的であった。同一組成の既報例はなく、正確な診断の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-17341430.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman had an ovarian tumor composed of endometrioid adenocarcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and immature teratoma with prominent neuroectodermal and rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation. The tumor recurred repeatedly despite systemic chemotherapy, in contrast to pure germ cell tumors, which are typically chemosensitive. The authors found no previous cases with this identical composition and emphasize accurate diagnosis of this complex, aggressive tumor.

pmid-17342276.summary_ja: 22歳男性が歯肉と皮膚の結節、左精巣腫大で受診した。皮膚・歯肉病変の穿刺吸引細胞診で転移が疑われた。左高位精巣摘除術の病理組織学的検査で純粋型絨毛癌と診断された。皮膚転移の報告はあるが、歯肉転移は英文文献できわめてまれであり、貴重な症例である。
pmid-17342276.summary_en: A 22-year-old man presented with gingival and skin nodules and a left testicular swelling. Fine-needle aspiration of skin and gingival lesions suggested metastases. Left high orchidectomy showed pure choriocarcinoma. The authors note that testicular choriocarcinoma with skin metastases has been reported, but gingival metastasis is exceptional in the English literature, making this case unusual.

pmid-17342499.summary_ja: 妊娠24週で卵巣未分化胚細胞腫（FIGO III期）と診断された33歳女性である。パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンによる化学療法を施行し、妊娠36週で帝王切開と根治手術を行った。術後に補助療法を追加した。良好な治療効果が得られ、胎児への有害事象はなかった。
pmid-17342499.summary_en: A 33-year-old pregnant woman was diagnosed at 24 weeks' gestation with stage III ovarian dysgerminoma. She received three cycles of paclitaxel and carboplatin before cesarean section and radical surgery at 36 weeks, followed by three adjuvant cycles. The treatment produced an excellent response with no adverse effects on the fetus. The authors note this combination is not first-line therapy for dysgerminoma. The infant developed normally at 20 months.
