pmid-17343608.summary_ja: 35歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）で、術前画像に異常はなかったが卵巣転移を認めた。根治的子宮全摘術、両側卵巣摘出術、骨盤リンパ節郭清および術後化学療法で治療された。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の中でもまれなPSTTでは外科治療の役割が大きい。多職種による管理の重要性が示された症例である。
pmid-17343608.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman presented with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) and an ovarian metastasis despite normal preoperative imaging. She was treated with radical hysterectomy, bilateral oophorectomy, pelvic lymph node dissection, and postoperative chemotherapy. PSTT is the rarest form of gestational trophoblastic disease, and surgery plays a larger role in its management than in other forms. Adnexal spread is unusual, and the case underscores the value of multidisciplinary management.

pmid-17349529.summary_ja: 性腺芽腫4例を免疫染色で解析し、Y染色体上の性腺芽腫座の候補遺伝子TSPYの発現を検討した研究です。TSPYは性腺芽腫の発生初期から各進展段階で発現し、胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である精巣上皮内癌とも一致して認められました。TSPYは性腺芽腫の原因遺伝子候補であり、胚細胞腫瘍の重要なマーカーになりうると結論づけています。
pmid-17349529.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of four gonadoblastoma cases examined TSPY, a Y-chromosome tandem repeat gene in the gonadoblastoma locus. TSPY expression correlated with initiation and various stages of gonadoblastoma. It colocalized with placental alkaline phosphatase, c-KIT, and OCT3/4 in gonadoblastoma and adjacent carcinoma in situ, the precursor of germ cell tumors. The authors propose TSPY as a candidate gonadoblastoma gene and a significant marker for these germ cell tumors.

pmid-17351252.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を対象に、ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンを3コース投与する3BE500Pと、E500Pを4コース投与する方法を比較した無作為化試験です。奏効率は両群で同等で、4年無イベント生存率と全生存期間にも有意差はありませんでした。著者らは3BE500Pを標準治療として推奨していますが、生存解析には検出力が不足していると指摘しています。
pmid-17351252.summary_en: This randomized trial by the French GETUG group compared three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (3BE500P) with four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin (E500P) in good-risk metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Among 257 assessable patients, favorable response rates were similar. Four-year event-free survival (91% vs 86%) and overall survival did not differ significantly. The authors recommend 3BE500P as the treatment of choice, while noting the trial was underpowered for survival analysis.

pmid-17352176.summary_ja: 咳嗽と体重減少で受診した61歳男性の原発性縦隔絨毛癌の症例報告です。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法4コース後に手術が行われました。化学療法後のCTで認めた残存腫瘍のFDG-PET集積は部位により差があり、集積の低い部分は壊死、集積の保たれた部分は生存細胞が多いことが組織学的に確認されました。性腺外縦隔絨毛癌の化学療法後の腫瘍生存性評価にFDG-PETが有用と述べています。
pmid-17352176.summary_en: This case report describes a 61-year-old man with primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma, presenting with cough, weight loss, and enlarged mediastinal and right supraclavicular lymph nodes. After four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin chemotherapy, he underwent surgery. Residual tumor on CT showed variable FDG-PET uptake: low uptake corresponded to necrosis and higher uptake to viable cells. The authors suggest FDG-PET can assess tumor viability after chemotherapy in extragonadal mediastinal choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17355110.summary_ja: 1982年から2005年にRoyal Marsden病院で治療された、ダウン症候群と組織学的に確認された精巣がんの患者9例を検討しました。大半はセミノーマで、病期に応じてカルボプラチンや放射線療法が行われました。9例中5例が30か月以内に再発し、そのうち4例は放射線療法または併用化学療法で救済されました。併存疾患のため再発例の治療は困難であり、初回治療の充実と心理社会的ケアの重要性が強調されています。
pmid-17355110.summary_en: This retrospective review from the Royal Marsden Hospital identified nine patients with Down's syndrome and histologically confirmed testicular cancer treated between 1982 and 2005. Most tumours were seminomas, and treatment was stage-directed, including carboplatin and radiotherapy. Five of nine patients relapsed within 30 months; four of these were salvaged with radiotherapy or combination chemotherapy. The authors conclude that the relapse rate was high, that adequate initial treatment is important because relapsed disease is harder to manage given comorbidities, and that psychosocial care is essential.

pmid-17362311.summary_ja: 1992年から2005年の間に当院で行われた8,330件の帝王切開で偶発的に見つかった、直径5cm超の付属器腫瘤68例を検討した後方視的研究です。全例が帝王切開時に摘出されました。最多の組織型は良性嚢胞性奇形腫（29.4%）で、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が1例認められました。帝王切開時の嚢胞摘出は手術の罹患率を高めませんでした。将来の手術を避けるため切除を推奨しています。
pmid-17362311.summary_en: This retrospective study from a single centre reviewed 68 incidental adnexal masses larger than 5 cm found during 8,330 cesarean sections performed between 1992 and 2005. All masses were removed at surgery. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common histology at 29.4%, and one malignant struma ovarii was identified. Cystectomy during cesarean did not increase operative morbidity. The authors recommend resecting such masses at cesarean to avoid future surgery, while noting that the literature remains controversial.

pmid-17365825.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病理学における最近の進歩を概説したレビューです。早期の全胞状奇胎を部分胞状奇胎と誤分類することや、子宮外妊娠での胞状奇胎の過剰診断など、診断上の落とし穴を取り上げています。倍数性解析とp57kip2の免疫組織化学が、全胞状奇胎と三倍体部分胞状奇胎の区別に有用とされます。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌は持続性トロホブラスト病に含まれます。
pmid-17365825.summary_en: This review summarises recent advances in the pathology of gestational trophoblastic disease. It highlights common diagnostic pitfalls, including misclassifying early complete mole as partial mole, over-diagnosing mole in tubal pregnancy, and confusing placental site non-villous trophoblast with placental site trophoblastic tumour or choriocarcinoma. Ploidy analysis and p57kip2 immunohistochemistry help distinguish complete mole from triploid partial mole. Persistent trophoblastic disease is a clinical diagnosis that includes invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. The epithelioid trophoblastic tumour is also discussed.

pmid-17365830.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織を主体とする奇形腫である。甲状腺機能亢進症、腹水、Meigs症候群などの非典型的な臨床像や、嚢胞性・増殖性病変の診断困難性を概説する。「悪性卵巣甲状腺腫」という用語は複数の異なる病態を含むため避けるべきとし、甲状腺型癌の多くは卵巣外へ広がらないと述べる。
pmid-17365830.summary_en: This review summarizes the current knowledge of struma ovarii, a teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue. It covers unusual clinical presentations such as hyperthyroidism, ascites, and Meigs' syndrome, along with diagnostic difficulties in cystic and proliferative variants. The authors argue that the term 'malignant struma ovarii' should be avoided, as it has covered several distinct entities, and they note that thyroid-type carcinomas rarely spread beyond the ovary. Strumal carcinoid and differential diagnoses, including extra-ovarian spread, are also discussed.

pmid-17374303.summary_ja: 2002年から2004年にカラチの小児外科施設で治療された思春期前の女児18例の卵巣病変を症例集積として解析した。腹部腫瘤と疼痛が主な症状であった。悪性病変9例には悪性奇形腫4例、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）4例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例が含まれ、全例が病期IAであった。
pmid-17374303.summary_en: This case series reviewed 18 pre-menarche girls treated for ovarian lesions at a Karachi pediatric surgical unit between 2002 and 2004. Abdominal mass and pain were the most common presentations. Nine patients had malignant lesions, including four malignant teratomas, four dysgerminomas, and one yolk sac tumor, all staged as IA under the Paediatric Oncology Group system. The authors conclude that ovarian tumors are rare in this age group, and that benign and malignant lesions occurred with equal frequency.

pmid-17375035.summary_ja: 病期Iが大半を占める精巣セミノーマ182例を後方視的に検討し、初期病期分類における胸部CTの有用性を評価した。腹部CTが正常であった患者の13例で胸部CTに異常所見がみられたが、フォローアップでいずれも診断上無関係であった。胸部CTの偽陽性率は10%で、18例に追加検査が必要であった。
pmid-17375035.summary_en: This retrospective review of 182 patients with testicular seminoma, mostly stage I, evaluated whether chest CT adds value to initial staging. Chest CT showed abnormalities in 13 patients with normal abdominal CT, but follow-up confirmed these were incidental and benign. Only one patient had truly metastatic disease, which was also visible on chest X-ray. The false-positive rate for chest CT was 10%, requiring additional investigations in 18 patients. The authors conclude that chest CT can hinder management by detecting clinically irrelevant lesions.

pmid-17375712.summary_ja: 80歳女性で、巨大な隔壁を有する卵巣類皮嚢腫から発生した扁平上皮癌の症例報告。両側性の類皮嚢腫（最大30cm）が超音波検査とCTで確認された。腫瘍は病変卵巣に限局しFIGO病期IAに分類された。1年間のフォローアップで再発は認められなかった。
pmid-17375712.summary_en: This case report describes an 80-year-old woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising in a huge septated dermoid cyst of the ovary. Bilateral dermoids were present, measuring up to 30 cm, and were confirmed by ultrasound and CT. The tumor was confined to the affected ovary and classified as FIGO stage IA. After hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, and appendectomy, the patient had no recurrence during one year of follow-up. The authors review the clinical, pathological, treatment, and prognostic features of this rare malignant transformation.

pmid-17382165.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍779例を対象とした後方視的研究。原発巣の大きさと術前腫瘍マーカーが後腹膜転移を予測するかを検討した。後腹膜転移は26.6%に認められた。原発巣の大きさと術前β-hCGは予測因子とならず、術前αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が低値ほど後腹膜転移が多かった。
pmid-17382165.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 779 patients with clinical stage A nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection examined whether primary tumor size and preorchiectomy tumor markers predict retroperitoneal metastasis. Retroperitoneal metastasis was found in 26.6%. Neither tumor size nor preorchiectomy beta-hCG predicted metastasis. Preorchiectomy AFP did predict it, as lower AFP levels correlated with more retroperitoneal metastases. A normal preorchiectomy AFP was therefore associated with occult retroperitoneal disease.

pmid-17382725.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法中に腫瘍が増大した growing teratoma syndrome の9例を後方視的に検討した。増大速度は中央値で1か月あたり直径0.7cm、体積12.9ccだった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清の標本は全例で生存腫瘍を含まない成熟奇形腫であった。中央値2年の追跡で大半が無病生存し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は良好な局所制御が得られた。
pmid-17382725.summary_en: Nine patients with growing teratoma syndrome during chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors were reviewed at MD Anderson from 1980 to 2003. Growth was defined by enlarging metastatic mature teratoma with decreasing or normalized tumor markers. Median growth rates were 0.7 cm and 12.9 cc per month. All retroperitoneal lymph node dissection specimens showed mature teratoma without viable tumor. Complications occurred in several patients, but most remained disease-free at median 2-year follow-up. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection provided good local control.

pmid-17384869.summary_ja: 2歳男児が腹部腫瘤で受診し、きわめてまれな胃奇形腫と診断された症例報告。消化管出血や閉塞症状を呈した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で脂肪、石灰化、充実性と嚢胞性の領域が認められ、奇形腫に特徴的な所見として診断に役立った。小児の腹部腫瘤では胃奇形腫を念頭に置く必要がある。
pmid-17384869.summary_en: A two-year-old boy presented with an abdominal mass and was diagnosed with gastric teratoma, a very rare extragonadal tumor. Presentation included gastrointestinal bleeding and obstructive features. Computed tomography showed the characteristic teratoma features of fat, calcification, and mixed solid and cystic areas, which aided diagnosis. The report highlights that gastric teratoma should be considered in pediatric abdominal masses with these imaging findings.

pmid-17390059.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍54例を後方視的に解析し、BAXとp53の発現および遺伝子変異を検討した。BAX変異は全生存期間の短縮と関連し、BAX免疫染色強度の高さは未熟奇形腫と混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍で良好な予後と相関した。仙尾部原発との関連も示された。BAXの状態は小児胚細胞腫瘍の予後判定に有用な分子マーカーとなりうる。
pmid-17390059.summary_en: This retrospective study of 54 childhood germ cell tumors examined BAX and p53 protein expression by immunohistochemistry and their mutations by SSCP-PCR and sequencing. BAX protein was absent in 26% of tumors, and BAX mutations were found in six patients. BAX mutations inversely correlated with overall survival, while higher BAX immunostaining correlated with better survival, particularly in immature teratoma and mixed malignant GCT. BAX status may serve as a prognostic marker for pediatric GCT.

pmid-17396169.summary_ja: 精巣が化学療法の届きにくい聖域となるかを検討した総説。血液精巣関門が精巣内残存腫瘍の説明や遅延精巣摘除術の根拠としてしばしば挙げられる。一方、原発巣で腫瘍が完全に消失することも多く、聖域説に否定的な根拠がある。原発巣と転移巣の病理学的反応の違いは腫瘍の不均一性で説明しうるとし、初回化学療法後の根治的精巣摘除術の意義を強調している。
pmid-17396169.summary_en: This review examines whether the testis is a chemo-privileged sanctuary site for germ cell tumors. The blood-testis barrier is often cited to explain residual tumor in the gonad after chemotherapy and to justify delayed orchiectomy. However, complete eradication of viable tumor at the primary site is common, arguing against a sanctuary effect. Discordant histopathologic responses between primary and metastatic sites are attributed to tumor heterogeneity. Delayed radical orchiectomy remains important after primary chemotherapy.

pmid-17401218.summary_ja: 1993〜2002年に治療された病期IIおよびIIIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍58例を後方視的に解析した。国際胚細胞腫瘍コンセンサス分類のリスク群別に検討した。5年全生存期間は病期IIで85%、病期IIIで44%であった。多変量解析では原発部位と再発部位が独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-17401218.summary_en: A single-center retrospective study of 58 patients with stage II and III nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated between 1993 and 2002, stratified by International Germ Cell Cancer Consensus risk groups. Five-year overall survival was 85% in stage II and 44% in stage III. Overall survival was 97%, 75%, and 7% in good, intermediate, and poor risk groups. Primary site and relapse site remained significant in multivariate analysis.

pmid-17411461.summary_ja: 28歳で左精巣セミノーマと診断され、精巣摘除術と術後放射線療法を受けた男性の症例報告。家族に精巣腫瘍や膀胱がん、脂肪腫症がみられた。全身評価では大腸ポリープ、腎がん、成長ホルモン産生下垂体腺腫が見つかった。PTEN、PRKAR1A、MEN1の遺伝子検査は陰性で、新規の腫瘍易罹患症候群の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17411461.summary_en: A case report of a 28-year-old man with left testicular seminoma treated by orchiectomy and adjuvant radiation. His family history included testicular seminoma in his son, bladder cancer in his sister, and lipomatosis in his father. Evaluation revealed colon polyps, multiple lipomas, skin lesions, renal carcinoma, and a growth hormone-secreting pituitary adenoma. Genetic testing for PTEN, PRKAR1A, and MEN1 was negative, raising the possibility of a novel neoplasm susceptibility syndrome that a single case cannot establish.

pmid-17413983.summary_ja: BRCA2 6174delT変異を保有する33歳女性が、胎児性癌、絨毛癌、未分化胚細胞腫、未熟奇形腫を含む卵巣混合性胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。父親も同じ変異を有し、乳がんと前立腺がんを発症していた。BRCA2保有者でのGCT報告は初めてである。腫瘍では野生型アレルのヘテロ接合性の消失が認められず、典型的なBRCA関連上皮性卵巣腫瘍とは異なっていた。著者らは、GCTの発生にBRCA2の両アレルの不活性化は必要ないか、関連は偶発的である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17413983.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old Ashkenazi Jewish woman, a BRCA2 6174delT carrier, who developed a mixed ovarian germ cell tumor containing embryonal carcinoma, choriocarcinoma, dysgerminoma, and immature teratoma. Her father had breast and prostate cancer with the same mutation. This is the first germ cell tumor reported in a BRCA2 carrier. Molecular analysis showed no loss of heterozygosity of the wild-type allele in the tumor, unlike typical BRCA-related epithelial ovarian tumors. The authors suggest biallelic BRCA2 inactivation may not be required for germ cell tumor development, or that the association may be coincidental.

pmid-17414472.summary_ja: 1974年から2002年に治療された臨床病期Iセミノーマ75例を対象とした後方視的研究で、精巣摘除後の経過観察と補助放射線療法を比較した。追跡期間中央値7.7年で、経過観察群の80%が再発し、放射線療法群は3%であったが、全生存期間に有意差はなかった。再発はすべて36歳未満の患者で生じた。9%が第2の原発性腫瘍を発症し、多くは照射を受けた患者であった。著者らは、経過観察は密接なフォローアップができる場合にのみ安全であり、補助放射線療法を支持すると結論づけている。
pmid-17414472.summary_en: This retrospective study of 75 patients treated for stage I seminoma between 1974 and 2002 compared surveillance after orchiectomy with orchiectomy plus adjuvant radiation therapy. With median follow-up of 7.7 years, 80% of the surveillance group relapsed, versus 3% of the radiation group, although overall survival did not differ significantly. All relapses occurred in patients younger than 36 years. Nine percent developed second primary tumors, most of them in irradiated patients. The authors conclude surveillance is safe only with close follow-up, and they favor adjuvant radiation despite the small risk of secondary malignancy.

pmid-17414640.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の最近の進歩をまとめた総説。欧州の一部集団では発症率の上昇が鈍化しつつあり、人種、エストロゲン曝露、停留精巣、不妊などの危険因子に関する知見が蓄積されている。進行例の治療戦略が検討される一方、長期生存者では治療に伴う心血管・代謝系の合併症や晩期再発が注目されている。中等度・予後不良・再発例に対する有効な治療法の開発と長期毒性の軽減が課題とされる。
pmid-17414640.summary_en: This review summarizes recent preclinical and clinical developments in testicular germ cell tumors. Attenuation in the rising incidence has begun to appear in some European populations, and new data address risk factors including race, estrogen exposure, cryptorchidism, and infertility. Genetic and molecular studies of tissue and cell culture models continue. New strategies for advanced disease are being evaluated, and cardiovascular and metabolic consequences in long-term survivors are being clarified. Late relapses are increasingly recognized. The authors emphasize the need for more effective treatment of intermediate-risk, poor-risk, and recurrent tumors while reducing long-term toxicity.

pmid-17414772.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う腹膜神経膠腫症の稀な症例報告。腹膜神経膠腫症は成熟グリア組織の腹膜内増殖で、一般に良性とされる。CT所見は悪性腫瘍の腹膜播種に酷似し、卵巣腫瘍の病期を過大評価するおそれがある。放射線科医が奇形腫に関連するこの病態を認識する必要性が強調されている。
pmid-17414772.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of gliomatosis peritonei associated with an immature ovarian teratoma. Gliomatosis peritonei is a peritoneal proliferation of mature glial tissue, typically considered benign, that can mimic malignant peritoneal spread on imaging. CT findings closely resembled peritoneal dissemination of malignant tumors, creating a risk of overestimating the clinical stage of ovarian tumors. The authors advise radiologists to recognize this rare teratoma-related entity to avoid misdiagnosis during staging.

pmid-17418959.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に脊索腫が発生した初めての症例報告。免疫組織化学と間期FISH法により脊索腫への分化が裏付けられた。奇形腫細胞の19%でX染色体のポリソミー、脊索腫細胞の28%で7番染色体のモザイクが認められ、既報の染色体異常と一致した。良性の卵巣奇形腫内に生じた稀な悪性腫瘍の例である。
pmid-17418959.summary_en: This case report describes a chordoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, the first such reported case. Immunohistochemistry and interphase FISH supported chordoma differentiation. Polysomy of chromosome X was found in 19% of teratoma nuclei, and chromosome 7 mosaicism in 28% of chordoma nuclei, consistent with prior reports of chromosomal changes in each tumor type. The authors describe this as a rare malignancy arising within an otherwise benign ovarian teratoma, which is a form of malignant transformation.

pmid-17419363.summary_ja: 片側精巣腫瘍41例を後方視的に検討し、対側の腫瘍のない精巣について超音波検査で精巣微小石灰化を評価した。精巣微小石灰化は26.8%に認められ、上皮内癌は石灰化を有する11例中2例、有さない30例では0例だった。精巣微小石灰化は対側上皮内癌のリスク上昇を示唆する可能性がある。
pmid-17419363.summary_en: This retrospective study of 41 patients with unilateral testicular tumor used ultrasonography to assess testicular microlithiasis in the contralateral tumor-free testis, and PLAP immunostaining of archived biopsies to detect carcinoma in situ. Microlithiasis was found in 26.8% of patients, with microliths confirmed histologically in only two. Carcinoma in situ was found in 2 of 11 patients with microlithiasis versus none of 30 without (p=0.017). The authors conclude that microlithiasis may indicate an increased risk of contralateral carcinoma in situ.

pmid-17425677.summary_ja: 初発症状が脳内出血だった妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。緊急手術で脳転移と診断され、EMACO療法後、β-hCGの上昇と肺病変の出現により救援化学療法(EMAEP)を施行した。PET検査で潜在的な肺病変が検出され、胸腔鏡下切除後12か月間無病生存している。脳卒中様症状を呈する妊娠可能年齢の女性では、転移性絨毛癌を鑑別に含めるべきとされる。
pmid-17425677.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman presented with sudden headache from intracerebral hemorrhage, suspected to result from a ruptured pseudoaneurysm. Emergency surgery revealed metastatic choriocarcinoma, confirmed by immunostaining for cytokeratin and beta-hCG, and brain metastases were diagnosed. She received EMACO chemotherapy, then salvage EMAEP after pulmonary lesions appeared with rising beta-hCG. PET detected new lung lesions, which were resected by thoracoscopic surgery. She remained disease-free for 12 months. The authors highlight metastatic choriocarcinoma in the differential diagnosis of stroke-like symptoms in women of childbearing age.

pmid-17430271.summary_ja: 上部消化管出血で発症し、胃に生じた稀な性腺外セミノーマの症例報告である。精巣には腫瘍細胞が残らない「焼失」所見がみられた。両側精巣摘除術とエトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる4サイクルの化学療法で完全奏効が得られた。胃の性腺外セミノーマは過去に2例のみの報告があり、原因不明の消化管出血では胚細胞腫瘍も鑑別に挙げる必要がある。
pmid-17430271.summary_en: This case report describes a burned-out testicular seminoma presenting as upper gastrointestinal haemorrhage with a gastric seminoma, a rare extragonadal presentation. Endoscopic biopsy suggested seminoma, and testicular ultrasound showed a focal lesion with microcalcification. Treatment comprised bilateral orchidectomy followed by four cycles of etoposide and bleomycin, achieving complete response. Testicular histology showed burned-out changes with no residual tumour. The authors note only two previously reported cases of extragonadal gastric seminoma, highlighting the need to consider germ cell tumours in unexplained gastrointestinal bleeding.

pmid-17431543.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連する脳炎の4症例を報告し、既報17例と比較した臨床解析である。精神症状、痙攣、中枢性低換気が主な特徴で、心伝導障害と流涎過多も認められた。脳脊髄液の白血球増多や頭部MRIの側頭葉・脳幹の異常もみられた。腫瘍切除と免疫療法により21例中18例で神経症状が改善し、11例は完全回復した。
pmid-17431543.summary_en: This clinical analysis describes four patients with ovarian teratoma-associated encephalitis and compares them with 17 previously reported cases. Acute psychiatric symptoms, seizures, and central hypoventilation were the most common features, with cardiac conduction problems and hypersalivation in the new cases. Cerebrospinal fluid pleocytosis and cranial MRI abnormalities in the temporal lobes or brainstem were recorded. Most patients received tumour resection plus immunotherapy, and 18 of 21 showed neurological improvement, 11 fully recovering. The authors conclude that cardiac conduction problems and hypersalivation are characteristic additional features.

pmid-17437287.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の病期分類I期セミノーマのフォローアップについて、17件の前向き研究(5561例)をシステマティックレビューし、再発ハザードに基づくガイドラインを作成した。再発リスクに応じた受診頻度と、治療戦略ごとの画像検査項目を提案している。サーベイランスや補助カルボプラチン療法では腹部・骨盤のCTを推奨する。
pmid-17437287.summary_en: This evidence-based study developed guidelines for follow-up after orchiectomy for stage 1 seminoma. It was a systematic review of 17 prospective studies including 5561 patients, with five strategies: surveillance, extended-field radiotherapy, para-aortic radiotherapy, and one or two cycles of carboplatin. Weighted relapse hazards were calculated from Kaplan-Meier estimates. The authors recommend three visits a year when relapse risk exceeds 5%, twice a year at 1% to 5%, and annually until risk falls below 0.3%. Abdominal and pelvic CT is advised for surveillance and adjuvant carboplatin, while pelvic CT alone suffices after para-aortic radiotherapy.

pmid-17437431.summary_ja: 1998年から2005年の間に精巣・精巣傍腫瘍で治療を受けた小児11例を後方視的に検討した単施設報告である。病理では奇形腫が最も多く、大半は良性病変であった。全例で根治的精巣摘除術が行われ、腫瘍マーカーの上昇は手術後に正常化した。著者らは、凍結切片で良性と確認された場合には精巣温存も考慮すべきと提案している。
pmid-17437431.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review describes 11 children treated for testicular and paratesticular tumours between 1998 and 2005. Pathology showed teratoma in four, yolk sac tumour in two, epidermoid cysts in two, extrarenal nephroblastomatosis in one, and paratesticular rhabdomyosarcoma in two. All underwent radical orchidectomy. Three had elevated tumour markers that normalised after surgery. Chemotherapy was given for the two rhabdomyosarcoma cases. Most lesions were benign, and teratoma was the most common subtype. The authors advocate an initial radical inguinal approach, with testis-sparing surgery considered when frozen-section analysis confirms benign disease.

pmid-17437432.summary_ja: IGCCCG中間・高リスクの転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍157例を対象とした単施設研究。化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清で、残存病変は線維化47%、奇形腫40%、生存胚細胞腫瘍13%。5年の疾患特異的生存率は81%、無増悪確率は70%。残存腫瘤の大きさ、不完全切除、奇形腫、生存胚細胞腫瘍が再発の予測因子だった。
pmid-17437432.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study of 157 men with IGCCCG intermediate- or poor-risk metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumour evaluated outcomes after chemotherapy followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Residual retroperitoneal histology showed fibrosis in 47%, teratoma in 40%, and viable germ cell tumour in 13%. Five-year disease-specific survival was 81% and progression-free probability 70%. Residual mass size, incomplete resection, teratoma, and viable germ cell tumour predicted progression. Poor-risk patients did not have a higher progression risk than intermediate-risk patients. Complete resection of residual masses after chemotherapy supports long-term disease control.

pmid-17437848.summary_ja: 胎児精巣、セミノーマ33例、Leydig細胞腫瘍11例でp44とPRMT5の発現を免疫組織化学で解析。腫瘍細胞では核内発現が減少し細胞質発現が増加していた。p44ヘテロ接合体マウスでは精巣サイズが29%増大した。核内と細胞質の複合体に異なる機能がある可能性が示唆されたが、機能的な裏付けは今後の課題とされている。
pmid-17437848.summary_en: This study examined p44 (Mep50) and protein arginine methyltransferase 5 (PRMT5) expression in developing human fetal testes, 33 seminomas, and 11 Leydig cell tumors using immunohistochemistry. In fetal and adult nonneoplastic testis, both proteins were predominantly nuclear, whereas seminoma and Leydig tumor cells showed reduced nuclear and increased cytoplasmic expression. Fetal germ cells showed cytoplasmic staining. In p44 heterozygous mice, testicular size increased by 29%. The authors suggest that nuclear and cytoplasmic p44/PRMT5 complexes have distinct roles in fetal testis development and testicular tumor oncogenesis, while noting that functional confirmation is needed.

pmid-17442106.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1を血管筋形成培地で培養し、形態と心筋・内皮関連遺伝子の発現を検討した。アクチン構造は維持され、16遺伝子中ベータミオシン重鎖遺伝子以外の15遺伝子で発現が持続した。神経外胚葉への分化傾向がある一方、中胚葉系遺伝子も活性化できるため、中胚葉由来組織の発生研究モデルとしての有用性が示唆された。
pmid-17442106.summary_en: This negative-results report examines whether the human embryonal carcinoma line NTERA2 cl.D1 (NT2/D1) keeps its typical morphology when cultured in an angiomyogenic medium with or without BMP2. Actin organization was preserved, and 15 of 16 analyzed genes, including cardiac, endothelial, neuronal, and teratocarcinoma markers, maintained expression over time. The beta myosin heavy chain gene was not detected. Although NT2/D1 cells tend toward neuroectodermal differentiation, the authors conclude they can activate mesodermal genes and may serve as a model for mesodermal development under suitable culture conditions.

pmid-17447857.summary_ja: 予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍患者24例に対し、初回治療としてT-BEP（パクリタキセル後にBEP）を評価した第II相試験。完全または部分奏効かつ腫瘍マーカー陰性は54.2%。好中球減少が高頻度で、敗血症による治療関連死が2例あった。奏効率や無増悪期間は改善せず、G-CSFなしでの使用は推奨されていない。
pmid-17447857.summary_en: This phase II study evaluated first-line T-BEP (paclitaxel followed by BEP) in 24 patients with poor-prognosis germ cell tumors, three of whom had primary mediastinal tumors. Complete or partial response with negative tumor markers occurred in 54.2%. Median time to progression was 9.5 months, and median follow-up was 35.6 months. Grade 3-4 granulocytopenia occurred in 52.1% of courses, with two treatment-related sepsis deaths. Response and progression did not exceed those of standard BEP, but overall survival was surprisingly long. The authors advise against using this regimen without G-CSF support.

pmid-17459461.summary_ja: 復旦大学腫瘍病院で1992〜2005年に救済手術を受けた化学療法抵抗性卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍34例を後方視的に解析した。全体の5年生存率は約33%。単変量解析では最適な減量手術、組織型、BEP/PVBレジメンによる救援化学療法が予後良好因子であり、最適な減量手術は有益と結論づけた。
pmid-17459461.summary_en: This retrospective study of 34 Chinese patients with chemorefractory ovarian germ cell malignancies who underwent salvage surgery at Fudan University Cancer Hospital (1992 to 2005) examined prognostic factors. Overall 5-year survival was 33%. Optimal cytoreduction, histology (dysgerminoma or immature teratoma), and salvage chemotherapy with the BEP/PVB regimen were associated with better survival in univariate analysis, while disease site was not independent on multivariate analysis. The authors conclude that optimal cytoreduction during salvage surgery benefits chemorefractory patients.

pmid-17462976.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的特徴、予後、治療法をまとめた総説。卵巣悪性腫瘍の2〜5%を占め、若年女性に多い。術後の補助化学療法により予後が改善し、BEPレジメンが標準とされる。手術は最大限の減量が原則で、子宮摘出や両側付属器切除を省略できる例もある。希少腫瘍のため協力グループでの研究が必要とされる。
pmid-17462976.summary_en: This review summarizes the clinical characteristics, prognosis, and management of ovarian germ cell tumours, which account for 2 to 5% of ovarian cancers and often occur in adolescents and young women. It highlights the benefit of adjuvant chemotherapy after surgery, with the BEP regimen now standard owing to comparable efficacy and lower toxicity than PVB. Surgery should aim for maximal cytoreduction, and hysterectomy and bilateral adnexectomy may be avoided in many cases. The authors advocate cooperative group studies to clarify prognostic factors for these rare tumours.

pmid-17464447.summary_ja: 129系マウスに自然発生する先天性精巣胚細胞腫瘍と、Dnd1を不活化するTer変異について概説した展望論文。Ter/Ter雄では腫瘍発生率が94%に達する。Ter変異は原始胚細胞の喪失を引き起こし、不妊と腫瘍感受性を修飾する。ヒト乳児の精巣奇形腫との類似性から、Dnd1不活化による腫瘍発生機構の解明が課題とされる。
pmid-17464447.summary_en: This perspective discusses the 129 mouse strain, which develops congenital testicular germ cell tumors at low frequency, and the Ter mutation, which inactivates Dead-end1 (Dnd1) and raises tumor incidence to 94% in 129 Ter/Ter males. Ter causes progressive loss of primordial germ cells, leading to sterility, and acts as a modifier of 129-derived susceptibility genes. The author outlines future studies to clarify how Dnd1 inactivation drives testicular tumor development, relevant to human infant teratomas.

pmid-17465292.summary_ja: 妊娠30週の胎児に急速に増大する仙尾部奇形腫が見つかり、胎児水腫が明らかになる前に母体で高血圧や蛋白尿、血小板減少を伴うミラー症候群を発症した症例の報告です。分娩後に母体の所見は改善し、出生後の手術も成功しました。胎児の早期徴候の把握が早期介入につながる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-17465292.summary_en: A case report of mirror syndrome associated with a rapidly growing sacrococcygeal teratoma in a fetus at 30 weeks' gestation. Maternal hypertension, epigastric pain, proteinuria and thrombocytopenia developed before overt fetal hydrops, and all findings resolved after delivery. Postnatal surgery on the infant was successful. The authors suggest that early signs of fetal compromise may help predict mirror syndrome and allow earlier intervention.

pmid-17465293.summary_ja: 妊娠23週の経産婦が進行性の呼吸困難と頻脈で受診し、当初はパニック障害として評価されていました。呼吸不全の進行後にようやく肺転移を伴う絨毛癌が鑑別に挙がり、非生存児の娩出後に死亡しました。血清β-hCGの高値を伴う妊婦では、呼吸不全の鑑別診断に絨毛癌を含める必要性が強調されています。
pmid-17465293.summary_en: A 36-year-old multipara at 23 weeks' gestation presented with progressive dyspnea and tachycardia and was initially evaluated for panic disorder. Metastatic pulmonary choriocarcinoma was considered only after respiratory failure developed. She delivered a nonviable infant and died of complications. Serum beta-hCG was elevated. The authors emphasize that choriocarcinoma should be included in the differential diagnosis of pregnant women with elevated beta-hCG and respiratory failure.

pmid-17465299.summary_ja: 24歳の未経妊女性が腹部膨満と間欠的な腹痛で受診し、腹部の触知可能な腫瘤が確認されました。CTで低吸収域を認め、CA-125とCA-19.9は上昇していましたがβ-hCGは正常でした。開腹手術で左卵管采部に発生した31cmの成熟充実性奇形腫が見つかり、左卵管摘出術が行われました。石灰化を伴う骨盤内・腹部腫瘤では卵管奇形腫も考慮すべきです。
pmid-17465299.summary_en: A 24-year-old nulliparous woman presented with abdominal distention, intermittent pain and a palpable mass. CT showed an abdominal hypodense lesion. CA-125 and CA-19.9 were elevated, while carcinoembryonic antigen and beta-hCG were normal. Laparotomy revealed a 31 cm mature solid teratoma arising from the fimbrial portion of the left fallopian tube, treated by left salpingectomy. The tumor contained bone, hair, and sebaceous and sweat glands. The authors suggest considering fallopian tube teratoma in calcified pelvic or abdominal masses.

pmid-17465366.summary_ja: 新生児の頭頂部正中に発生した大きな皮下腫瘤が、頭頂間部脳瘤を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された症例の報告です。奇形腫と脳瘤はいずれも正中付近に生じる先天奇形であり、共通の発生起源が示唆されています。本論文では、その発生学的意義を考察し、関連文献をレビューしています。
pmid-17465366.summary_en: The authors report a newborn with a large midline subcutaneous mass in the interparietal region, diagnosed as a mature teratoma associated with an interparietal encephalocele. Because both lesions are congenital malformations arising near the midline, the findings suggest a common embryologic origin. The paper discusses the developmental significance of this association and reviews the relevant literature.

pmid-17466158.summary_ja: 腹腔内停留精巣を有する64歳男性が、対側の下降精巣に対するセミノーマの根治的治療から40年後に、停留精巣にセミノーマを発症した。腫瘍により腸閉塞を来した。著者らは、これを腹腔内停留精巣の悪性転化として極めてまれな症例と位置づけ、停留精巣や精巣胚細胞腫瘍の既往を有する患者には長期フォローアップが必要であると示唆している。
pmid-17466158.summary_en: A 64-year-old man with abdominal cryptorchidism developed a seminoma in the undescended testis 40 years after curative treatment for seminoma in the contralateral descended testis. The tumor led to intestinal obstruction. The authors describe this as an exceptionally rare case of malignant transformation of an abdominal cryptorchid testis, suggesting that long-term follow-up is warranted in patients with cryptorchidism and a prior testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-17467818.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の有糸分裂チェックポイント機能をMAD2発現との関連から検討した研究です。8株中6株で微小管阻害後に分裂停止が起こらず、MAD2蛋白の低下と相関していました。セミノーマ23例では核内MAD2が正常精巣より低下していました。MAD2の発現異常が染色体不安定性に寄与すると考えられています。
pmid-17467818.summary_en: The authors investigated mitotic checkpoint function in testicular germ cell tumour using eight TGCT cell lines and 23 tumor samples. Six of eight cell lines failed to arrest in mitosis after microtubule disruption, correlating with reduced MAD2 protein. In 23 seminomas, nuclear MAD2 was markedly lower than in normal testis, while cytoplasmic MAD2 was higher. Aberrant MAD2 expression may contribute to chromosomal instability in TGCT.

pmid-17470166.summary_ja: 進行性非セミノーマ性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の男性6例に対し、初回大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を施行した。全例で腫瘍マーカーが正常化し、5例が部分寛解を得た。残存腫瘍の切除では壊死、成熟奇形腫、生存癌の所見がみられた。中央値36か月の追跡で5例が無病生存した。全例にグレード3の血液毒性がみられたが、治療関連死はなかった。
pmid-17470166.summary_en: This study of six male patients with advanced non-seminomatous extragonadal germ cell tumors evaluated first-line high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation after conventional induction. Tumor markers normalized in all patients, and five achieved partial remission. Residual-tumor resection showed necrosis in two, mature teratoma in two, and viable cancer in one. With median follow-up of 36 months, five patients were alive and disease-free. Grade 3 hematologic toxicity occurred in all patients, without treatment-related deaths, suggesting this is an attractive option.

pmid-17471115.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は全胚細胞腫瘍の1～5%を占める。成熟・未熟奇形腫、セミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌、絨毛癌など多彩な形態を取り上げ、縦隔と仙骨尾骨部が好発部位であることを述べる。新生児、小児、成人の年齢群ごとに、部位・組織型・病期による予後を論じる。二次性悪性腫瘍や部位別の鑑別診断も総括している。
pmid-17471115.summary_en: This review examines extragonadal germ cell tumors, which account for 1% to 5% of all germ cell tumors. It covers their diverse morphologies, including mature and immature teratoma, seminoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma, along with their most common sites, the mediastinum and sacrococcygeal region. Prognosis is discussed across neonatal, pediatric, and adult age groups, considering anatomic site, histology, and stage. The authors also address secondary malignancies and provide a site-based survey of differential diagnoses.

pmid-17471572.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者5,663例を含む13の疫学研究を統合したメタ解析である。出生体重2,500g未満と4,000gを超える場合の両方でリスクが上昇し、U字型の関連が認められた。組織型別では低出生体重はセミノーマに特異的な関連を示した。生物学的機序は今後の解明が必要とされている。
pmid-17471572.summary_en: This meta-analysis of thirteen epidemiologic studies, including 5,663 testicular cancer patients, examined the association between birth weight and later testicular cancer risk. Both low birth weight below 2,500 g and high birth weight above 4,000 g were associated with increased risk, producing a U-shaped relationship. When analyzed separately, low birth weight was specifically associated with seminoma rather than nonseminoma. The authors conclude that the biological mechanisms underlying this association remain to be elucidated.

pmid-17474261.summary_ja: 下腹部腫瘤を呈した9歳女児の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。超音波ガイド下穿刺吸引細胞診で、密な細胞集塊、乳頭状の細胞索、均質な無細胞性好酸性小体が確認された。卵黄嚢腫瘍は卵巣で2番目に多い胚細胞腫瘍であり、術前の細胞診による診断は、その後の検査や治療の計画に有用であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-17474261.summary_en: This case report describes a 9-year-old girl with a lower abdominal mass whose ovarian yolk sac tumor was diagnosed preoperatively by ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration cytology. Aspirates showed tight cell clusters, papillary fronds, and homogeneous acellular eosinophilic bodies. The authors emphasize that preoperative cytologic recognition of yolk sac tumor, the second most common ovarian germ cell tumor, is useful for planning further diagnostic and therapeutic steps.

pmid-17478764.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に生じた古典型の乳頭状甲状腺癌の22歳女性の症例報告である。腫瘍はBRAF T1799A変異についてヘテロ接合性で、ret/PTC-1およびret/PTC-3の再構成は認められなかった。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は原発性の乳頭状甲状腺癌と組織学的にも遺伝学的にも類似すると結論づけている。卵巣甲状腺腫は奇形腫の稀な亜型であり、その悪性転化が本報告の主題である。
pmid-17478764.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with a classical variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in a struma ovarii. Molecular analysis showed the tumor was heterozygous for the BRAF T1799A mutation, with no ret/PTC-1 or ret/PTC-3 rearrangements. The authors conclude that malignant struma ovarii is histologically and genetically similar to primary papillary thyroid carcinoma. Struma ovarii is a rare teratoma subtype, and its malignant transformation is the central subject of this report.

pmid-17478784.summary_ja: 巨大な腹部腫瘤を呈し、Wilms腫瘍の疑いで手術を受けた1歳男児の純粋な腎内卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告である。組織学的および免疫組織化学的所見は性腺由来の卵黄嚢腫瘍と一致した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は稀であり、症例報告として記載されることが多い。著者らは本腫瘍を小児腎腫瘍の鑑別診断に加えるべきだと提案している。
pmid-17478784.summary_en: This report describes a pure intrarenal yolk sac tumor in a one-year-old boy who presented with a large abdominal mass and was operated on for suspected Wilms tumor. Histologic and immunohistochemical features matched those of gonadal yolk sac tumor. The authors note that extragonadal germ cell tumors are rare and typically described in case reports. They propose adding this entity to the differential diagnosis of pediatric renal neoplasms.

pmid-17479076.summary_ja: 34歳女性が抗NMDA受容体抗体陽性の脳炎を発症し、卵巣未熟奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性のものと診断された。興奮、けいれん、自律神経不安定などで集中治療を要した。左側卵管卵巣摘出術に加え、ステロイド、血漿交換、免疫グロブリン静注、シクロホスファミド、化学療法で治療された。胚細胞腫瘍が神経症状で初発しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-17479076.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman developed severe encephalitis with NMDA receptor antibodies, later found to be paraneoplastic and associated with an immature ovarian teratoma. Her presentation included agitation, seizures, autonomic instability, and dystonic movements requiring intensive care. Treatment combined surgical removal of the left ovary with the tumor, corticosteroids, plasma exchange, intravenous immunoglobulin, cyclophosphamide, and chemotherapy. The case shows how a germ cell tumor can first present as a neurological disease.

pmid-17479161.summary_ja: 8歳女児の成熟卵巣奇形腫から得られた粘液と組織のムチンを精製し解析した。ゲル濾過、SDS-PAGE、ウエスタンブロッティング、免疫組織化学を用いた。腫瘍の大腸型と気道型の成分では、MUC2、MUC5AC、MUC5B、MUC1、MUC6などの発現パターンが異なっていた。分泌されたムチンは主に高分子型で、粘性が高かった。小児の成熟奇形腫における粘液成分の分子的特徴を示した。
pmid-17479161.summary_en: This study characterized mucins in crude mucus and tissue from a mature ovarian teratoma in an 8-year-old girl. Mucins were purified and analyzed by gel filtration, SDS-PAGE, western blotting and immunohistochemistry. The tumor was lined by colonic and respiratory mucosa, and each component expressed distinct mucin types, including MUC2, MUC5AC, MUC5B, MUC1 and MUC6. The secreted mucin was largely polymeric and highly viscous. The findings clarify the molecular composition of mucinous secretion in a pediatric mature teratoma.

pmid-17479685.summary_ja: 妊娠34週の22歳女性に、腸閉塞を伴う巨大な卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍が見つかり、AFPが高値を示した。帝王切開、妊孕性温存手術、併用化学療法4コースを行い、19か月間再発はなかった。その後の妊娠では週1回のAFP測定と月1回の超音波検査で監視し、健康な児を出産した。妊娠中のこの腫瘍の管理について考察している。
pmid-17479685.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman at 34 weeks' gestation had a huge ovarian yolk sac tumor causing bowel obstruction, with markedly elevated AFP. She underwent cesarean section, fertility-sparing surgery and four cycles of combination chemotherapy, with no recurrence at 19 months. A later pregnancy reached term with a healthy infant, monitored by weekly AFP measurement and monthly ultrasound. The authors discuss how such tumors should be managed during pregnancy.

pmid-17480159.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫は出生前にまれに発生し、気道閉塞により致死的となりうる。全切除により治癒した2例と、出生直後に死亡した1例を報告した。出生前超音波検査での診断は、気道確保と手術の準備に有用である。死亡例については病理解剖の所見も検討された。
pmid-17480159.summary_en: Cervical teratomas are rare prenatal tumors that can cause fatal airway obstruction. The authors report two infants treated successfully by total excision and a third case that died soon after birth, which underscores the value of antenatal ultrasound diagnosis. Early identification allows a multidisciplinary team to prepare airway support and surgery. The study also includes a postmortem pathological examination.

pmid-17482245.summary_ja: 非妊娠女性で血清β-hCGが持続的に高値となった14例を解析した。全例で偽陽性は否定され、3例は妊娠性絨毛癌を発症した。11例は原因不明で、手術や化学療法の効果は乏しかった。診断と管理の流れ図を提示し、腫瘍が数か月から数年後に現れることから長期フォローアップの重要性を強調した。
pmid-17482245.summary_en: The study reviewed women referred with persistently raised beta-hCG who were not pregnant. False-positive results were excluded in all 14 patients, and three later developed gestational choriocarcinoma. In 11 women, no cause was found, and most had no benefit from surgery or chemotherapy. The authors propose a clinical algorithm and emphasize long-term follow-up because tumours may appear months or years later.

pmid-17482942.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣109例と転移巣11例で、TopoIIα（トポイソメラーゼIIα）の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、セミノーマ、絨毛癌の多くでは発現が高く、成熟奇形腫では発現が認められなかった。この差は化学療法への感受性の違いを説明しうる。
pmid-17482942.summary_en: This study examined topoisomerase II alpha (TopoIIalpha) expression in primary and metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, using immunohistochemistry on 109 primary specimens and 11 metastases. Most embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, seminoma and choriocarcinoma components were immunoreactive, whereas mature teratoma showed no expression. The authors suggest that TopoIIalpha expression may explain the sensitivity of certain components to topoisomerase II inhibitors and the chemoresistance of teratomas, offering a molecular basis for variable chemoresponse in testicular tumors.

pmid-17483435.summary_ja: Li-Fraumeni症候群の患者で、難治性・進行性の胎児性癌に対しp53遺伝子治療（Advexin）を行った。注射された病変はFDG-PETで完全かつ持続的な寛解を示し、症状も改善した。腫瘍はp53異常とコクサッキーアデノウイルス受容体の発現を示し、治療で細胞周期停止とアポトーシスが誘導された。反復投与でアデノウイルス抗体価は上昇したが、p53活性は保たれた。
pmid-17483435.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with Li-Fraumeni syndrome and a refractory, progressive embryonal carcinoma treated with intralesional p53 gene therapy (Advexin). The injected lesion showed complete and durable remission on FDG-PET, with improvement of tumor-related symptoms. The tumor had abnormal p53 and expressed the coxsackie adenovirus receptor, and treatment induced cell cycle arrest and apoptosis. Repeated dosing raised adenoviral antibody titers without impairing p53 activity or causing adverse sequelae.

pmid-17483941.summary_ja: 横隔膜に発生した嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。術前の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では、境界明瞭で均一な脂肪様の腫瘤を呈し、軟部組織の脂肪腫と診断されていました。脂肪抑制像では皮下脂肪と同程度まで信号が低下していました。辺縁切除で摘出され、腫瘍内には多数の毛髪と油性液体が認められ、横隔膜と連続していました。性腺外の奇形腫が画像上、良性の脂肪性病変と類似しうることを示しています。
pmid-17483941.summary_en: This report describes a cystic teratoma arising from the diaphragm, a rare extragonadal site. Preoperative MRI showed a well-demarcated, homogeneous fat-like mass that was initially read as a soft-tissue lipoma. Fat-suppression imaging confirmed that the signal was suppressed to the level of subcutaneous fat. The lesion was removed by marginal excision; it contained numerous hairs and oily fluid and was attached to the diaphragm. The case highlights that extragonadal teratomas can mimic benign lipomatous lesions on imaging.

pmid-17484510.summary_ja: 6歳の女児が思春期早発症を呈した卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の症例報告です。血清のβ-hCG、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、エストラジオールがいずれも高値でした。合胞体栄養膜巨細胞の存在や悪性転化が、内分泌活性の原因と考えられています。腫瘍切除後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、思春期早発症も消失しました。小児の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では、ホルモン異常が重要な手がかりになることを示しています。
pmid-17484510.summary_en: This report describes a 6-year-old girl with ovarian dysgerminoma presenting with precocious puberty. Serum beta-hCG, alpha-fetoprotein, and estradiol were all elevated, which may reflect syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells or malignant transformation of the tumor. After resection, tumor markers normalized and precocious puberty resolved. The authors note that dysgerminoma is usually hormonally inert but can cause endocrine effects. A brief literature review is included. The case shows that hormonal abnormalities can serve as clinical clues to an ovarian germ cell tumor in children.

pmid-17484918.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期病期（病期Iおよび後腹膜浸潤が軽度の病期IIa）の管理を扱った総説です。病期Iでは、監視と補助療法（放射線療法またはカルボプラチンを用いた化学療法）のどちらを選ぶかが主要な論点です。心血管疾患、消化器疾患、二次がんなどの晩期毒性への懸念から、再発時の治療と強化した監視が提唱されています。病期IIaでは放射線療法が中心的な治療とされています。
pmid-17484918.summary_en: This review addresses the management of early-stage testicular seminoma, covering stage I and minimal retroperitoneal spread (IIa). For stage I, the debate centers on surveillance versus adjuvant treatment, including adjuvant radiotherapy or carboplatin-based chemotherapy. Concern about long-term toxicities such as cardiovascular disease, gastrointestinal disease, and secondary cancers has encouraged intensified surveillance, with treatment at relapse. Radiation therapy remains the mainstay for stage IIa disease. The article integrates surgical, radiation, and medical oncology perspectives across diagnosis, treatment, and follow-up.

pmid-17484919.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療選択肢を検討した総説です。監視、後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによるシスプラチン併用化学療法2コースは、いずれも97%以上の長期制御率が得られています。リンパ管・血管浸潤や原発巣の胎児性癌優位は潜在性転移のリスク因子です。これらがない患者は再発リスクが低く、積極的監視で管理できます。監視に適さない高リスク患者には、初回化学療法より後腹膜リンパ節郭清が勧められています。
pmid-17484919.summary_en: This review examines management options for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer. Surveillance, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND), and two cycles of bleomycin-etoposide-cisplatin chemotherapy all achieve long-term cancer control of 97% or more. Lymphovascular invasion and embryonal carcinoma predominance in the primary tumor identify patients at higher risk of occult metastasis. Patients without these features have a low relapse risk and can be managed by active surveillance. For high-risk patients unsuitable for surveillance, the authors favor RPLND over primary chemotherapy.

pmid-17484922.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法の現状と論点をまとめた総説です。シスプラチン併用化学療法により、約90%の患者が治癒すると報告されています。標準的な初回治療はブレオマイシン/エトポシド/シスプラチン3コースで、代替としてエトポシド/シスプラチン4コースがあります。ランダム化臨床試験の結果を踏まえた開発の経緯と、今後の検討課題が示されています。
pmid-17484922.summary_en: This review outlines first-line chemotherapy for good-risk metastatic germ cell tumors, where about 90% of patients are cured with cisplatin-based regimens. The current standard is three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin, with four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin as an alternative. The article traces how randomized trials shaped this treatment and discusses remaining questions for further investigation. It summarizes both the progress made and the controversies that persist in managing advanced testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-17484926.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが高値であった患者を対象に、後腹膜のみの残存腫瘤を切除する手術の役割を検討しています。これらの患者の50%で残存胚細胞腫瘍が認められ、3分の1が5年時点で生存していました。5年生存率は残存奇形腫で77.5%、壊死で85.7%でした。術前のβ-hCG上昇、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値、再手術、活動性腫瘍が死亡の予測因子でした。適切に選択された患者は手術で治癒が期待できます。
pmid-17484926.summary_en: This study evaluated surgery to resect retroperitoneal-only residual masses in patients with elevated tumor markers after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Residual germ cell cancer was found in 50% of these patients, and one third were alive at five years. Five-year survival was 77.5% with residual teratoma and 85.7% with necrosis. Declining markers at surgery, beta-hCG below 100, and first-line chemotherapy predicted retroperitoneal teratoma or fibrosis. Rising beta-hCG, elevated AFP, redo surgery, and active germ cell cancer predicted death. Carefully selected patients can be cured with surgery.

pmid-17484928.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に、後腹膜以外に残存した腫瘤の管理を扱った総説です。部位によって組織像が異なることが多いため、血清腫瘍マーカーが正常化している場合は後腹膜以外の残存病変をすべて切除することが推奨されています。生存腫瘍を切除した後、導入化学療法のみを受けた中間リスク患者は、さらなる全身療法の恩恵が期待されています。
pmid-17484928.summary_en: This article addresses management of residual masses outside the retroperitoneum after chemotherapy for advanced testicular germ cell tumors. Histology often differs between sites, so the authors recommend resecting all residual disease outside the retroperitoneum once serum tumor markers have normalized. After excision of viable tumor, intermediate-risk patients who received only induction chemotherapy appear to benefit from further systemic treatment. The review emphasizes that histologic discordance among sites makes complete resection important for accurate risk assessment and treatment decisions.

pmid-17484929.summary_ja: 成人および小児の精巣奇形腫を扱った総説です。思春期前の男児における純粋な精巣奇形腫では転移の報告がない一方、成人では60%に臨床的転移が認められます。奇形腫は局所増殖、遠隔転移、体細胞型の悪性腫瘍への悪性転化を起こしえます。化学療法抵抗性のため、完全な外科的切除が治療の第一選択であり、残存腫瘤の大きさにかかわらず後腹膜の完全な制御が推奨されています。
pmid-17484929.summary_en: This review covers testicular teratoma in adults and children. Pure teratoma in prepubertal boys has not been reported to metastasize, whereas adult testicular teratoma is associated with clinical metastases in 60% of cases. Teratoma can grow locally, metastasize, and transform into somatic malignant tissue. It is often found with other nonseminomatous histologies and in 40% of post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal dissections. Because it resists chemotherapy, complete surgical resection is the treatment of choice, and complete retroperitoneal control is advised regardless of residual mass size.

pmid-17487419.summary_ja: 腫瘍におけるHedgehog経路の異常の機序として、Patched遺伝子プロモーターのメチル化状態を調べた研究です。卵巣の皮様嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)や線維腫を含む卵巣腫瘍では、正常組織と比べて有意な過剰メチル化が認められました。一方、皮膚の基底細胞癌では差がみられませんでした。卵巣腫瘍ではエピジェネティックな発現抑制が関与する一方、皮膚腫瘍では別の機序が考えられています。
pmid-17487419.summary_en: This study examined methylation of the Patched promoter as a mechanism of Hedgehog pathway deregulation in tumors. Bisulfite sequencing showed significant hypermethylation in ovarian tumors, including dermoids and fibromas, compared with healthy tissue, particularly near Gli1-binding sites. In contrast, basocellular carcinomas of the skin showed no methylation difference. The authors conclude that epigenetic silencing contributes to ovarian tumor development, whereas skin basal cell carcinomas likely arise through different mechanisms. The ovarian dermoids studied are mature teratomas.

pmid-17488340.summary_ja: ヒト胚性幹細胞の培養適応が、胚細胞腫瘍の悪性進展と並行していることを検討した論文である。胚性癌細胞と同様に、ES細胞は多能性と自己複製能を持つ。長期の体外培養により、染色体12の過剰などの遺伝的変化が生じ、これは胚細胞腫瘍で見られる変化によく似ている。これらの異常細胞は増殖が速く、播種効率も高い。著者らは、培養適応を調べることが胚細胞腫瘍の発生と進展の機序の解明につながる可能性を提案している。
pmid-17488340.summary_en: This article examines how culture adaptation of human embryonic stem cells parallels malignant evolution in germ cell tumors. Like embryonal carcinoma cells, ES cells are pluripotent and self-renewing. Prolonged in vitro culture produces genetic changes, such as gain of chromosome 12, that closely resemble those seen in germ cell tumors. These abnormal cells also show faster growth and higher plating efficiency. The authors propose that studying culture adaptation may reveal mechanisms underlying the development and progression of GCT.

pmid-17491309.summary_ja: 31歳男性が腹痛で受診し、多発性の高血管性肝腫瘤が見つかった。血清β-hCGは2,300 ng/mlと著明に上昇し、肝生検で絨毛癌と確認された。縦隔の混合性胚細胞腫瘍と肝転移と診断され、BEP療法8コースによりβ-hCGは正常化した。びまん性の高血管性肝病変が、性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状となりうることを示す症例報告である。
pmid-17491309.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and was found to have multiple, hypervascular liver masses. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated at 2,300 ng/ml, and liver biopsy confirmed choriocarcinoma. Chest imaging revealed an anterior mediastinal mass, leading to a diagnosis of a combined germ cell tumor with hepatic metastases. He received eight cycles of BEP chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin), after which beta-hCG normalized. The authors highlight that diffuse hypervascular liver lesions can be the initial manifestation of an occult extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-17493670.summary_ja: 高リスク絨毛癌（妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍）の再発患者が、複数の化学療法およびPET誘導下のサルベージ手術に反応しなかった。治療毒性のためカペシタビンに変更したところ完全寛解が得られ、開始後15か月で寛解が持続している。EP/EMA療法後に再発する高リスク患者に対し、カペシタビンと多職種による管理を検討すべきと結論している。
pmid-17493670.summary_en: A woman with relapsed high-risk choriocarcinoma did not respond to multiple chemotherapy regimens or PET-guided salvage surgery. Because of treatment toxicity, capecitabine was started, which achieved complete remission that persisted for 15 months after initiation. The authors conclude that capecitabine and multidisciplinary management merit consideration for high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients who relapse after EP/EMA, given its efficacy and low toxicity. The report describes a single case of salvage therapy.

pmid-17495498.summary_ja: 若年男性の両側精巣腫瘍に対し、左は精巣温存手術、右は精巣摘除術を行った。病理組織学的検査で、左は単純な類表皮嚢胞、右は成熟奇形腫と診断された。著者らはこれを初の同時性類表皮嚢胞と成熟奇形腫の合併例とし、転移はなく、術後3年で無病、血中テストステロン値も正常と報告している。臓器温存治療後の慎重なフォローアップの重要性を示唆している。
pmid-17495498.summary_en: A young man presented with bilateral testicular tumors and underwent testis-sparing surgery on the left and radical orchiectomy on the right. Histopathology showed a simple epidermoid cyst on the left and a mature teratoma on the right, following Price's criteria. The authors report this as the first described synchronous epidermoid cyst and mature teratoma of the testis. No metastasis was found, and at three years the patient remains disease-free with normal postoperative testosterone levels, supporting careful follow-up after organ-sparing management.

pmid-17499134.summary_ja: 新生児の鼻咽頭に生じた巨大な先天性未熟奇形腫の症例で、腫瘍切除を行った。腫瘍は口腔をほぼ満たし口外に突出していた。出生前評価、慎重な気道評価、熟練者による挿管が不可欠であり、周術期の出血や気道閉塞に注意が必要と強調している。性腺外に生じた奇形腫の症例報告である。
pmid-17499134.summary_en: A newborn with a huge congenital immature teratoma of the nasopharynx underwent surgical resection. The tumor nearly filled the oral cavity, protruded through the mouth, and was comparable in size to the head, although the infant could breathe when the head was turned. The authors emphasize that prenatal evaluation, careful airway assessment, thorough preparation, and intubation by an expert are essential. Perioperative bleeding and airway obstruction by the tumor or residual tissue can complicate such cases. This is a case report of an extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-17499277.summary_ja: オーストラリアのがん登録（1982～2002年）を用いた人口ベースの研究で、まれな精巣胚細胞腫瘍である精母細胞性セミノーマの発生率と年齢分布を推定した。原発性精巣悪性腫瘍9,658例のうち58例（セミノーマの1.1%）で、年齢調整発生率は100万人あたり0.4であった。55歳未満も同程度に発生するため、若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論している。
pmid-17499277.summary_en: This population-based study from Australian cancer registries (1982-2002) estimated the incidence, temporal trend, and age distribution of spermatocytic seminoma, a rare testicular germ cell tumor. Of 9,658 primary testicular malignancies, 58 (1.1% of seminomas) were spermatocytic, with an age-standardized incidence of 0.4 per million. Incidence rose over time but not significantly. Patients ranged from 19 to 92 years, and about half were under 55. The authors argue that this tumor should be considered in the differential diagnosis of testicular germ cell tumors in young adults.

pmid-17499297.summary_ja: トルコの2施設で治療された両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍30例を後方視的に解析した研究。セミノーマ患者では対側腫瘍のリスクが約2倍で、同時性腫瘍は進行病期で発見されることが多かった。異時性腫瘍の多くは病期1であった。適切な治療で予後は良好であり、初診時の対側精巣生検は必須ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-17499297.summary_en: This retrospective study of 30 patients from two Turkish centers with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors (3.0% of 987 patients) found sequential tumors in 24 and synchronous tumors in 6. Seminoma patients had roughly twice the risk of a contralateral tumor. Synchronous tumors presented at more advanced stages, while most metachronous tumors were stage 1. Outcomes were excellent with appropriate treatment, and routine contralateral testis biopsy at diagnosis was judged unnecessary.

pmid-17500001.summary_ja: 上行大動脈から発生した心膜内腫瘍の成人女性2例を報告。いずれも縦隔腫瘤として受診し、正中胸骨切開で完全切除された。組織学的に奇形腫と異所性甲状腺が認められた。大動脈由来の腫瘍はまれだが、縦隔腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきであると結論づけている。
pmid-17500001.summary_en: Two adult women aged 50 and 64 presented with intrapericardial tumors arising from the ascending aorta, both appearing as mediastinal masses. Both underwent complete excision via median sternotomy. Histology revealed teratoma and ectopic thyroid tissue. The authors conclude that such aortic-origin tumors are rare but should be included in the differential diagnosis of mediastinal masses.

pmid-17504385.summary_ja: 原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌の4例を報告し、既報の約82例とあわせて文献的に検討した。臨床像、鑑別診断および適切な治療を記載している。4例とも2005年1月時点で生存していた。極めてまれな疾患であり、治療に関する知見を補う報告である。
pmid-17504385.summary_en: Four cases of primary cervical choriocarcinoma are reported alongside a literature review of roughly 82 previously published cases. The authors describe clinical features, differential diagnosis and appropriate management. All four patients were alive as of January 2005. Primary cervical choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, and this report adds to the limited evidence base for its management.

pmid-17506876.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来の胚性癌細胞株NCCITを用い、OCT4、SOX2、NANOGをサイレンシングして遺伝子発現への影響を検討した基礎研究。OCT4とSOX2のノックダウンは中胚葉様の分化を誘導し、自己複製の喪失にはFGFシグナルの低下が伴った。胚性癌細胞と胚性幹細胞で自己複製の制御が類似することを示している。
pmid-17506876.summary_en: Using the NCCIT embryonal carcinoma cell line, the authors silenced OCT4, SOX2 and NANOG and analysed the effects by microarray. OCT4 and SOX2 knockdown induced mesodermal differentiation, and loss of self-renewal was accompanied by reduced FGF signalling. FGF receptor inhibition showed that autocrine FGF activates ERK/MAPK to maintain the undifferentiated state. Self-renewal control appears similar in embryonal carcinoma and embryonic stem cells.

pmid-17508953.summary_ja: 25歳女性の腎臓に生じた良性の成熟囊胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。同側の水腎症、尿路感染症、自然流産を伴い、病理組織学的に確定診断されました。腎奇形腫は稀で、多くは後腹膜奇形腫の腎臓への進展と考えられてきました。若年女性の囊胞性腎腫瘤の鑑別において、原発性腎奇形腫を考慮すべきことを示しています。
pmid-17508953.summary_en: This case report describes a benign mature cystic teratoma arising in the kidney of a 25-year-old woman. She presented with ipsilateral hydronephrosis, urinary tract infection, and spontaneous abortion, and histological examination confirmed the diagnosis. The authors note that renal teratomas are rare and have often been regarded as retroperitoneal teratomas secondarily invading the kidney. They report that this is the first such case in their region. The case suggests that a primary renal teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of cystic renal masses in young women.

pmid-17509135.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫内に発生する腎原発カルチノイド腫瘍について、文献例6例と自施設の1例を合わせた7例を解析しています。腹痛で発症することが多く、手術により全例が治癒し、再発や転移は認められませんでした。画像では境界明瞭で部分的に石灰化した病変、病理では小型円形細胞が索状・充実性に配列する像が特徴とされています。
pmid-17509135.summary_en: This review and case series analyzes primary carcinoid tumors arising within mature teratomas of the kidney, combining six previously reported cases with one unreported institutional case. Patients were mostly middle-aged and typically presented with abdominal pain without carcinoid syndrome. Imaging showed well-circumscribed, partly calcified lesions. Histologically, the tumors showed anastomosing cords and solid nests of small round cells. Surgery was curative in all seven cases, and no local recurrences or metastases occurred. The authors conclude that this rare entity is surgically curable and has an excellent prognosis.

pmid-17509283.summary_ja: 1975年から2001年までの米国における精巣がんの発生率、治療動向、医療資源の利用、経済的負担を解析した研究です。発生率は46%上昇し、セミノーマの比率が増加、病期II・III症例は減少しました。生存率は95.9%に達し、積極的監視が一次治療として増えています。年間医療費は2000年に約2,180万ドルと推計されています。
pmid-17509283.summary_en: This population-based analysis quantifies the clinical and economic burden of testicular cancer in the United States from 1975 to 2001. Incidence rose by 46 percent over this period, with a relative increase in seminoma compared with nonseminoma and fewer patients presenting with stage II and III disease. Five-year survival reached about 95.9 percent. Active surveillance became more common as a primary treatment, while hospitalization rates declined and care shifted toward outpatient settings. The estimated annual treatment cost was about 21.8 million dollars in 2000, and many patients missed work during therapy.

pmid-17511735.summary_ja: 初回2サイクルのBEPまたはVIP/VB化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーの低下が不良であった進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の3例を報告しています。その後TIP療法(パクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチン)を4サイクル実施し、全例で完全寛解が得られました。生命を脅かす毒性はなく、34か月の観察期間中、全例が無増悪で生存しています。
pmid-17511735.summary_en: This report describes three patients with advanced non-seminomatous germ cell tumors who showed unfavorable tumor marker decline after two cycles of standard BEP or VIP/VB chemotherapy. They were switched to four cycles of TIP (paclitaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin). All three achieved complete remission without life-threatening toxicity and remained alive without progression over a 34-month follow-up. The findings suggest that TIP may be a feasible option for intermediate or poor risk patients with inadequate early marker response, although the series is very small.

pmid-17511736.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍、後腹膜および肺転移、左腎静脈から下大静脈に及ぶ腫瘍栓を有する33歳男性の症例報告です。精巣摘除術後の病理で胎児性癌と診断され、8サイクルの化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、肺転移は消失しました。残存した後腹膜リンパ節と腫瘍栓に対し、静脈-静脈バイパス下で郭清と血栓摘除を行い、成熟奇形腫が確認されました。術後は無病の状態が続いています。
pmid-17511736.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with a left testicular tumor, retroperitoneal and lung metastases, and tumor thrombus extending from the left renal vein into the inferior vena cava. Pathology after orchidectomy showed embryonal carcinoma, classified as poor risk. After eight cycles of chemotherapy, tumor markers normalized and lung metastases disappeared, but retroperitoneal nodes and the thrombus persisted. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and thrombectomy were performed under veno-venous bypass, and the thrombus pathology showed mature teratoma. The patient has remained disease-free since surgery.

pmid-17511805.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後に持続性の妊娠性栄養膜疾患を経た患者が、満期産で死産に至った胎盤内絨毛癌の症例報告です。当初は大量の胎児母体間出血が死因と考えられましたが、血清hCGの高値が持続したため、胎盤の病理再検討で絨毛癌と診断されました。大量の胎児母体間出血を認めた際には、胎盤由来の絨毛癌も考慮すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-17511805.summary_en: This case report describes intraplacental choriocarcinoma that caused fetal death at term. The patient had earlier developed a hydatidiform mole with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease and then delivered a stillborn infant at term. Massive fetomaternal hemorrhage was initially considered the unexpected cause of death. Choriocarcinoma was diagnosed only after pathologic review of the placenta, prompted by persistently high serum hCG levels. The authors emphasize that massive fetomaternal hemorrhage should alert obstetricians and pathologists to the possibility of placenta-derived choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17521702.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍171例を対象に、性染色体Y上の遺伝子TSPYの発現を免疫組織化学などで解析した研究である。TSPYはセミノーマや上皮内癌で強く発現し、非セミノーマではほとんど発現しなかった。TSPYは他の胚細胞腫瘍マーカーと共発現し、異所性発現により12p13の増殖関連遺伝子を活性化した。他のマーカーと組み合わせた診断・分類への有用性と発症への関与が示唆される。
pmid-17521702.summary_en: This study examined TSPY, the putative gonadoblastoma-locus Y-chromosome gene, in 171 testicular germ cell tumor cases and normal testis controls using immunohistochemistry, Western blotting and RT-PCR. TSPY was abundantly expressed in carcinoma in situ and seminoma but minimally in nonseminomas, co-expressing with established germ cell and proliferation markers. Ectopic TSPY expression upregulated progrowth genes at chromosome 12p13. The authors suggest TSPY, combined with other markers, may aid diagnosis and subclassification of testicular germ cell tumors and supports its role in pathogenesis.

pmid-17525001.summary_ja: 13歳時に進行した卵巣未熟奇形腫（グレード3）と診断された29歳の女性の症例である。片側卵管卵巣摘出術、対側楔状切除、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受け完全寛解に至った。初回治療から16年後に健康な児を出産した。進行例であっても、妊孕性温存を目的とした手術と化学療法が生殖機能の維持に有効となり得ることが示された。
pmid-17525001.summary_en: This report describes a 29-year-old woman treated at age 13 for advanced grade 3 ovarian immature teratoma with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, contralateral wedge resection, and two cisplatin-based chemotherapy regimens, achieving complete remission. She delivered a healthy baby 16 years after initial treatment. The authors conclude that intensive fertility-preserving surgery followed by chemotherapy may preserve reproductive function even in advanced-stage malignant immature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-17525010.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、原発性精巣奇形腫内の大腸型腺管に由来する分化型腺癌を記述している。精巣奇形腫の悪性転化の報告はまれであり、小児期の奇形腫は通常良性だが、治療されずに成人に至ると悪性変化を来すことがあると著者らは指摘する。本報告は、精巣奇形腫に対する適切な外科的管理と長期フォローアップの重要性を強調している。
pmid-17525010.summary_en: This case report describes differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from colonic-type glands within a primary testicular teratoma. The authors note that malignant transformation of testicular teratomas is rarely reported, and that childhood teratomas, though generally benign, may undergo malignant change if left untreated into adulthood. The report highlights the importance of appropriate surgical management and long-term follow-up for testicular teratomas.

authors: Díaz Muñoz de la Espada VM
pmid-17525045.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌で化学療法後に完全奏効を得た女性が、フォローアップ中にβ-hCGの偽陽性値を持続的に示した症例である。病変の遺残がないにもかかわらず生じた原因を検討し、測定上の偽陽性の要因を総説している。妊娠性絨毛性疾患では上昇したhCGは再発を示すことが多いため、真の再発と判断する前に測定誤差を除外する必要性が示された。
pmid-17525045.summary_en: This report describes a woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma who achieved complete response after chemotherapy but later showed persistently false-positive beta-hCG values during follow-up, despite no evidence of persistent disease. The authors review the causes of false-positive beta-hCG determinations. The case underscores that in gestational trophoblastic disease a rising hCG usually indicates persistent disease, so clinicians must exclude assay artifacts before attributing elevated values to relapse.

pmid-17525561.summary_ja: 正期産の新生児が経腟分娩中に頸椎脱臼と脊髄離断を負い、腹部の腫大を触知して緊急帝王切開に移行した法医病理の症例報告である。児は生後3日で死亡し、剖検で未診断の腹腔内未熟奇形腫が判明した。奇形腫の病理と分娩外傷の文献をレビューし、出生前診断の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-17525561.summary_en: This forensic case report describes a term neonate who sustained cervical spine dislocation with subtotal spinal cord transection during a difficult vaginal delivery. An enlarged abdomen was palpated and delivery was converted to emergency cesarean section. The infant died on day 3, and autopsy revealed an undiagnosed intra-abdominal immature teratoma. The authors review teratoma pathology and the literature on birth trauma, emphasizing risk factors and the importance of prenatal diagnosis of congenital anomalies.

pmid-17525908.summary_ja: 1980〜2004年にライプツィヒで治療された小児の精巣および精巣傍腫瘍24例の単施設経験である。胚細胞腫瘍が多く、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫、胎児性癌が含まれた。精巣温存手術は3例で行われ局所再発はなかった。文献のメタ解析から、条件を満たす思春期前の男児では精巣温存手術が可能とされたが、悪性腫瘍の頻度が高いため高位鼠径精巣摘除術が標準治療であると結論づけている。
pmid-17525908.summary_en: This single-center experience reviewed 24 boys treated over 25 years for testicular and paratesticular tumors, most of them germ cell tumors (yolk sac tumors, teratomas and one embryonal carcinoma). Serum AFP was elevated in most yolk sac tumors, while hCG was normal in all tested cases. Testis-sparing surgery in three boys with primary testicular tumors showed no local relapse. A literature meta-analysis supports testis-sparing surgery in prepubertal boys meeting defined criteria, but the authors consider high inguinal orchidectomy the standard because of the frequent malignancy rate.

pmid-17526968.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍の小児患者が、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンを含む化学療法の初回投与後に、びまん性で線状の局所性色素沈着を生じた症例報告である。主にブレオマイシンによる皮膚毒性が原因と考えられている。通常は美容上の問題とされる化学療法関連の色素沈着も、臨床的に配慮すべき課題であることを示している。
pmid-17526968.summary_en: A child with yolk sac tumor developed localized, diffuse, flagellate-like hyperpigmentation after the first course of chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin. The authors attribute the pigmentation mainly to bleomycin-related skin toxicity. The report highlights that chemotherapy-induced hyperpigmentation, usually considered cosmetic, can be a relevant clinical issue in pediatric germ cell tumor patients receiving bleomycin-containing regimens.

pmid-17527070.summary_ja: 精巣原発41例と後腹膜転移43例の胚細胞腫瘍について、ES細胞転写因子NANOG、OCT3/4、SOX2の免疫組織化学染色を評価した研究である。NANOGとOCT3/4はセミノーマと胎児性癌の鋭敏なマーカーであり、NANOGは転移性腫瘍のマーカーにもなることが示された。SOX2は胎児性癌で発現し純粋なセミノーマでは陰性であったため、セミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に有用である。
pmid-17527070.summary_en: This study evaluated the embryonic stem cell transcription factors NANOG, OCT3/4, and SOX2 by immunohistochemistry in 41 primary testicular and 43 metastatic retroperitoneal germ cell tumors. NANOG and OCT3/4 marked seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, and NANOG was a marker of metastatic tumors. SOX2 was expressed in embryonal carcinoma but not pure seminoma, making it useful for distinguishing seminomatous from nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-17527072.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う卵巣粘液性腫瘍44例を、CK7、CK20、CDX2、ビリンの免疫組織化学染色で検討した。多くは消化管型の分化を示し、卵巣偽粘液腫はCK7陰性/CK20陽性、CDX2陽性、ビリン陽性と有意に関連していた。著者らは、下部消化管型の特徴を持つ一群は奇形腫起源の可能性があり、続発性の転移性粘液性腫瘍との鑑別を複雑にすると述べている。
pmid-17527072.summary_en: This study examined 44 ovarian mucinous tumors associated with mature cystic teratomas using CK7, CK20, CDX2, and villin immunostaining. Most tumors showed gastrointestinal-type differentiation, and pseudomyxoma ovarii was strongly associated with a CK7-negative, CK20-positive profile and CDX2 and villin positivity. The authors suggest a subset may be of teratomatous origin with lower gastrointestinal features, which complicates distinction from secondary metastatic mucinous tumors.

pmid-17527127.summary_ja: 新生児の心タンポナーデを呈した心膜内奇形腫の症例である。大量の心嚢液貯留による心臓圧迫があり、多列検出器螺旋CTで診断された。本論文では、まれな疾患である心膜内奇形腫の画像所見、臨床像、鑑別診断を述べ、評価におけるCTの役割を強調している。
pmid-17527127.summary_en: A neonate presented with cardiac tamponade due to a large pericardial effusion, and an intrapericardial teratoma was diagnosed using multidetector spiral computed tomography. The report describes the imaging features, clinical presentation, and differential diagnosis of this rare entity, which usually presents in infancy and can be life-threatening through cardiac compression. The authors emphasize the role of CT in its evaluation.

pmid-17530119.summary_ja: 生後7か月の男児に発生した胃の未熟奇形腫の症例報告である。胃奇形腫は小児の奇形腫の1%未満とされる極めてまれな疾患で、未熟型の報告は十数例程度にすぎない。乳児期にみられるこのまれな未熟奇形腫の症例として、限られた文献に知見を加えるものである。
pmid-17530119.summary_en: The authors describe a 7-month-old boy with an immature teratoma arising in the stomach. Gastric teratomas are very rare, accounting for less than 1% of pediatric teratomas, and only about a dozen immature cases have been reported. The report adds to the limited literature on this uncommon presentation of an immature teratoma in infancy.

pmid-17533625.summary_ja: 妊娠中に卵巣絨毛癌を発症した症例について、ダウン症候群の母体血清スクリーニングの検査値を後方視的に検討した報告である。完全奇胎の転移性絨毛癌と原発性卵巣絨毛癌の鑑別の困難さに触れ、妊娠週数に応じた付属器切除術や化学療法の治療選択を論じている。母体血清スクリーニングで早期に卵巣絨毛癌を示唆できるかが検討課題である。
pmid-17533625.summary_en: The authors describe a pregnant woman with ovarian choriocarcinoma and retrospectively studied her maternal serum biochemistry to assess whether the tumor could have been detected at Down syndrome screening. The paper discusses the difficulty of distinguishing metastatic choriocarcinoma in a complete mole from primary ovarian choriocarcinoma and the treatment options during pregnancy, including adnexectomy and chemotherapy depending on gestational age.

pmid-17540035.summary_ja: 生後18か月の女児で、鼻中隔から発生した組織学的に確定した成熟奇形腫の症例を報告する。鼻声呼吸と反復性鼻漏で発症し、右鼻腔が閉塞していた。全切除術を行い、31か月のフォローアップ後も再発はない。著者らは、鼻中隔の良性奇形腫は全切除により予後が良好であると結論づけている。これまで鼻中隔の成熟奇形腫の報告は2例のみである。
pmid-17540035.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-month-old girl with a histologically confirmed mature teratoma arising from the nasal septum, presenting with noisy breathing and recurrent rhinorrhea. Only two prior cases of mature nasal septal teratoma had been reported. Total surgical excision was performed, and she remained free of recurrence at 31 months of follow-up. The authors conclude that complete excision gives a good prognosis for this benign head and neck teratoma.

pmid-17540823.summary_ja: 36歳女性の子宮頸部腫瘤の症例報告である。生検で当初ディスジャーミノーマと診断されたが、骨盤コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)でリンパ節腫大と4cmの複雑な卵巣腫瘤が確認された。最終的な病理所見により正しい診断が確立された。稀な腫瘍では広い鑑別診断と病理の慎重な再評価が重要であると述べている。
pmid-17540823.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with heavy vaginal bleeding and an exophytic cervical mass. Biopsy initially showed dysgerminoma, and pelvic CT revealed lymphadenopathy and a 4 cm complex ovarian mass. The final pathology established the true diagnosis. The authors emphasize that rare tumors require a broad differential diagnosis and careful review of pathology together with the clinical context.

pmid-17541518.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた付属器捻転の放射線学的症例報告である。連続した単純腹部X線写真で、腫瘤の進行性の拡大と壁肥厚が確認された。これは出血性梗塞の進行を反映すると考えられる。下腹部痛を呈する女性において、この重篤な病態の認識に有用な所見となりうると述べている。
pmid-17541518.summary_en: This radiology case report describes adnexal torsion of a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Successive plain abdominal radiographs showed progressive enlargement and wall thickening of the mass, reflecting evolving hemorrhagic infarction. The authors note that no previous report has described these serial changes on plain radiographs, suggesting such findings may help clinicians recognize this serious condition in women with lower abdominal pain.

pmid-17542994.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌の組織発生を、免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。21例中、CK10は33.3%、CK18は66.7%に陽性であった。この発現パターンは、円柱上皮から扁平上皮化生を経て生じる子宮頸部や肺の扁平上皮癌に類似していた。卵巣奇形腫内の扁平上皮癌は化生性扁平上皮に由来する可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-17542994.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined squamous cell carcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma of the ovary to clarify its histogenesis. Of 21 cases, CK10 was expressed in 33.3% and CK18 in 66.7%. This pattern resembled SCC of the uterine cervix and lung, which arise from columnar epithelium through squamous metaplasia. The authors conclude that SCC in mature cystic teratoma may derive from metaplastic squamous epithelium.

pmid-17544417.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術を受けた76例を対象に、対側の健常精巣の精子形成を後方視的コホート研究で検討した。Johnsonスコア中央値はセミノーマで8.9、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で8.6と同等であった。血管侵襲の有無による差も認められなかった。精巣がんでは精子形成が障害されるが、組織型や血管侵襲は有意な危険因子ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-17544417.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 76 patients undergoing orchiectomy for seminoma or nonseminomatous germ cell tumor examined spermatogenesis in the contralateral healthy testis by open biopsy. Johnsen scores were similar by histologic type, at 8.9 for seminoma and 8.6 for NSGCT. Vascular invasion did not reduce spermatogenesis. The authors conclude that testicular cancer impairs spermatogenesis, but tumor type and vascular invasion are not significant risk factors.

pmid-17544490.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍12例を対象に、子宮外進展や再発を予測する指標を免疫組織化学で検討した。血清hCGや腫瘍サイズなどは両群を区別できなかったが、p53陽性は進展・再発群の全例で認められ、限局群では1例のみであった。p53免疫染色が侵襲性の予測に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17544490.summary_en: This study of 12 placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) cases examined whether immunohistochemical markers could predict invasive or recurrent behavior beyond the uterine corpus. Serum hCG, tumor size, mitotic activity, and Ki-67 did not discriminate advanced or recurrent cases from confined ones. In contrast, p53 positivity was seen in all six advanced or recurrent cases but in only one of six confined cases (p=0.015). The authors conclude that p53 immunostaining may help predict aggressive PSTT behavior and highlights p53 function in PSTT biology.

pmid-17545618.summary_ja: Wntシグナルを阻害する可溶性受容体F8CRDhFcの抗腫瘍効果を、奇形癌細胞株を用いて検討した。in vitroでは4種の細胞株で自己分泌型Wntシグナルを抑制し、in vivoではPA-1とNTera-2の異種移植腫瘍の増殖を有意に抑えた。治療後にはWnt関連マーカーの発現変化が見られ、治療効果や適応患者の指標となる可能性が示された。
pmid-17545618.summary_en: This preclinical study tested a soluble Wnt receptor, Frizzled8 cysteine-rich domain fused to human Fc (F8CRDhFc), against teratocarcinoma. In vitro, it inhibited autocrine Wnt signaling in four teratoma cell lines, including PA-1 and NTera-2. Systemic administration significantly slowed growth of PA-1 and NTera-2 xenografts. Wnt pathway marker gene expression changed in treated tumors, suggesting these markers could indicate treatment response and help select patients who might benefit. The authors conclude that Wnt antagonists merit further development as cancer therapeutics.

pmid-17548695.summary_ja: 1980〜2003年にAIDSを発症した約27万人の男性を対象に、HIV/AIDSと胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した。セミノーマのリスクは上昇し（SIR 1.9）、播種性疾患やAIDS発症直後で特に高かった。非セミノーマのリスクは有意な上昇を示さなかった。HAART時代にはセミノーマの過剰リスクは消失した。
pmid-17548695.summary_en: This population-based study linked cancer and HIV/AIDS registries covering 268,950 men who developed AIDS between 1980 and 2003. Seminoma risk was significantly increased (SIR 1.9), with the highest risk in disseminated disease and within nine months of AIDS onset. Nonseminoma risk was not significantly elevated, while extratesticular GCT risk was also increased. The seminoma excess declined over time and was no longer elevated in the highly active antiretroviral therapy era. The authors suggest impaired tumor immunosurveillance or AIDS-related testicular atrophy as possible mechanisms.

pmid-17548962.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍組織と非腫瘍性精巣を比較し、DNMT1、DNMT3A、DNMT3Bの発現とDNAメチル化を検討した研究である。腫瘍ではDNMT3Aのみが顕著に上昇していた。プロモーター領域は両群とも非メチル化であったが、イントロン25は腫瘍でほぼ脱メチル化しており、サザンブロットでも確認された。著者らは、イントロン25の脱メチル化が胚細胞腫瘍発生過程でのDNMT3A発現上昇と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-17548962.summary_en: This study examined expression and DNA methylation of DNA methyltransferase genes DNMT1, DNMT3A, and DNMT3B in human testicular germ cell tumor tissues compared with non-tumor testis. Only DNMT3A was markedly upregulated in tumors. Its promoter regions were unmethylated in both groups, but intron 25 was largely demethylated in tumors, a change confirmed by Southern blot. The authors conclude that demethylation of intron 25 is associated with increased DNMT3A expression during germ cell tumorigenesis. Intron 25 may be a differentially methylated region modulated during germ cell development and tumorigenesis.

pmid-17549357.summary_ja: 精巣の正常組織と原発性精巣腫瘍でOCT3/4上流領域のメチル化状態をバイサルファイトシーケンスで解析した。セミノーマと胎児性癌は低メチル化を示し、他の腫瘍や正常精巣は高メチル化を示した。OCT3/4の発現はメチル化変化と関連するが、胚細胞腫瘍の発がんを駆動する因子とは考えにくいとされた。
pmid-17549357.summary_en: This study used bisulfite genomic sequencing to map methylation of the OCT3/4 upstream region in normal testis and primary testicular tumors, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and teratoma. Normal testis, several tumor types, and the seminoma-derived cell line JKT-1 were consistently hypermethylated. In contrast, seminoma and embryonal carcinoma were hypomethylated, confirmed after microdissection. Testicular lymphomas showed heterogeneous patterns. The authors conclude that OCT3/4 expression is linked to specific methylation changes and that OCT3/4 is unlikely to be a driving oncogenic factor in germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-17551256.summary_ja: 再発セミノーマの後腹膜再発に対し、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を受けた患者で、3コース後に早期の肺障害が疑われた。FDG-PETで右肺にびまん性のFDG集積が認められ、HRCTで肺障害と確認された。ブレオマイシン中止とステロイド投与で所見は改善し、FDG集積も消失した。
pmid-17551256.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with seminoma and a retroperitoneal relapse treated with cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin. After three cycles, the patient developed early bleomycin-induced pneumonitis, and FDG-PET showed diffuse increased pulmonary FDG uptake in the right lung. High-resolution CT confirmed findings consistent with BIP. After bleomycin was stopped and steroids were given, both clinical findings and pulmonary FDG uptake normalized. The authors conclude that FDG-PET can assess residual disease in advanced seminoma, and that unexplained pulmonary FDG uptake during bleomycin therapy warrants evaluation for early BIP.

pmid-17551405.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療から8か月後に、3歳女児が侵襲性全身性肥満細胞症を発症した症例である。インターフェロンαとステロイドで治療したが、2か月後に多臓器不全で死亡した。骨髄・末梢血に加え、以前の胚細胞腫瘍組織からもC-KIT点変異が検出された。
pmid-17551405.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-year-old girl who developed aggressive systemic mastocytosis eight months after treatment for an ovarian germ cell tumor. She was treated with interferon-alpha and steroids and tolerated the infusions, but died of multiple organ failure after two months. C-KIT point mutations were found in the bone marrow, peripheral blood, and the previously diagnosed germ cell tumor tissue. The report indicates the same C-KIT mutation was present in both disease states, which is relevant to understanding secondary hematologic disorders after germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-17552950.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップ中の患者499例を後方視的に検討し、再発検出におけるLDHの有用性を評価した。感度は40%、特異度は90.5%と限定的で、偽陽性も多かった。LDHの上昇は一部の再発の早期発見に寄与したため、繰り返し測定と画像検査との併用が必要とされた。
pmid-17552950.summary_en: This retrospective study of 499 testicular germ cell tumor patients in follow-up evaluated serum LDH for detecting relapse. Elevated LDH was linked to disease in only 1.4% of visits, while 7.7% had high LDH from unrelated causes. LDH detected six of 15 relapses, with sensitivity of 40%, specificity of 90.5%, and positive predictive value of 12.8%. Among 116 relapsed patients, LDH increases helped detect relapse in 2% of nonseminomatous and 11% of seminomatous GCTs. The authors conclude LDH has limited value alone and should be interpreted cautiously with repeat measurement and imaging.

pmid-17556377.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3を用い、IGF-IIが浸潤能を高める機序を検討した研究である。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌組織ではIGF-IIが高発現していた。IGF-IIはインスリン受容体を介して細胞接着と走化性を促進し、阻害剤によりその効果は抑制された。絨毛癌の転移制御における治療標的となりうることを示唆している。
pmid-17556377.summary_en: This study examines how IGF-I and IGF-II regulate invasion of JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Tissue analysis showed higher IGF-II levels in hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma than in first-trimester placenta.
