IGF-II promotes cell adhesion and chemotaxis toward collagen IV through the insulin receptor, whereas IGF-I acts through the IGF-I receptor. Pharmacological blockade of the insulin receptor abolished IGF-II effects, suggesting that this receptor could be a therapeutic target for metastatic choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17556829.summary_ja: 超音波検査で出生前に診断された胎児内胎児の2症例を報告している。症例1は後腹膜の嚢胞性腫瘍で、切除により2つの胎児様構造が確認された。症例2は水頭症を伴う頭蓋内腫瘍で、中絶後の剖検により未熟奇形腫を含む6個の胎児様構造が見つかった。寄生性の一卵性双胎か、高分化型奇形腫かを考察している。
pmid-17556829.summary_en: This report describes two cases of fetus-in-fetu diagnosed prenatally by ultrasonography. Case 1 was a fetal retroperitoneal cystic tumor with two fetiform masses, resected after birth. Case 2 was an intracranial tumor with hydrocephalus, found at 19 weeks and terminated; postmortem examination revealed six fetiform masses and immature teratoma. The authors discuss whether these lesions represent parasitic monozygotic diamniotic twins or highly differentiated teratomas.

pmid-17560233.summary_ja: 1980〜2003年にオランダで仙尾部奇形腫を切除された3歳超の患者を対象とした全国調査である。約半数に排便障害や尿失禁があり、40%で瘢痕が美容的に許容されなかった。腫瘍体積500cm3超は瘢痕不良の危険因子で、長期後遺症は生活の質の低下と関連した。
pmid-17560233.summary_en: This Dutch national study surveyed 79 of 99 patients who had resection of sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1980 and 2003 and were older than three years. Nearly half reported impaired bowel function or urinary incontinence, and 40 percent had a cosmetically unacceptable scar. Tumor volume above 500 cm3 was a significant risk factor for poor scar appearance. Long-term sequelae were associated with reduced quality of life, but clinical variables could not clearly identify high-risk patients.

pmid-17561131.summary_ja: 2005年5月に終わる18か月間に原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた73例の後方視的検討である。平均手術時間は132分、平均出血量は207ccで、平均在院日数は2.8日であった。短期罹患率は従来の対照群より改善しており、腹腔鏡手術を従来の成績と比較することには注意が必要とされた。
pmid-17561131.summary_en: This retrospective chart review analyzed 73 consecutive patients who underwent primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection during the 18 months ending May 2005. Most had unilateral dissection, and 82 percent had a nerve-sparing procedure. Mean operative time was 132 minutes, mean blood loss 207 cc, and mean hospital stay 2.8 days. The authors conclude that short-term morbidity has improved compared with historical controls, and that comparison with historical open data is inappropriate for laparoscopic series.

pmid-17561476.summary_ja: 新生児男児の仙尾部に生じた大型の胎児型奇形腫の症例。X線、超音波検査、MRIで術前診断され、骨盤底再建を伴う完全切除が行われた。術後11か月で再発し、悪性転化を認めたため再手術と化学療法を実施。治療後18か月にわたり良好な経過をたどっている。完全切除後も長期のフォローアップが必要であることを示す。
pmid-17561476.summary_en: This report describes a male newborn with a large sacrococcygeal fetiform teratoma, diagnosed by radiography, ultrasonography and MRI and completely excised with pelvic floor reconstruction. Eleven months later the tumor recurred as a malignancy, which was treated with a second operation and chemotherapy. The patient has remained well for 18 months. The case illustrates malignant transformation of a well-organized sacrococcygeal teratoma in infancy and the need for long-term surveillance even after complete resection.

pmid-17563738.summary_ja: 精巣の純粋絨毛癌または絨毛癌症候群の男性13例を対象とした後方視的解析。シスプラチン併用療法後に増悪した症例に、救援大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を行った。生存期間中央値は19か月で、6例(46%)が無病生存を維持。予後不良な疾患でも長期の無病生存が得られる可能性を示した。
pmid-17563738.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviews 13 males with pure testicular choriocarcinoma or choriocarcinoma syndrome treated with salvage high-dose carboplatin and etoposide plus autologous stem cell transplantation after progression on cisplatin-based therapy. Median survival was 19 months, and six patients (46%) remained continuously disease free at median follow-up of 37 months. One additional patient survived after relapse and further surgery. The authors conclude that high-dose chemotherapy can offer long-term disease-free survival in this rare, poor-prognosis disease.

pmid-17563846.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化を超音波で指摘された14例を検討し、13例が精巣がんの手術を受けた。超音波検査で微小石灰化を認めたのは53.8%、組織学的に確認されたのは69.2%で、超音波の検出精度には限界があった。組織型は主にセミノーマで、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍も認められた。微小石灰化と精子機能低下は精巣がんの危険因子と考えられる。
pmid-17563846.summary_en: This study examined 14 patients referred for ultrasound after testicular microlithiasis was found, 13 of whom underwent surgery for testicular cancer. Microlithiasis was detected by ultrasonography in 53.8% of cancers but confirmed histologically in 69.2%, indicating limited ultrasound sensitivity. Histology showed mainly seminomas, along with mixed germ cell tumors, an embryonal carcinoma, and a yolk sac tumor. The authors conclude that microlithiasis and poor sperm function are risk factors for testicular cancer.

pmid-17564107.summary_ja: 右精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍)に脳転移と肺転移を伴った20歳男性の症例報告である。精巣摘除術、開頭術、シスプラチン併用化学療法、肺切除を施行した。9年後、化学療法に反応するHCG単独の再発を繰り返した後、CTの骨条件撮影でL4椎体の潜在性転移が検出された。放射線療法の後に全脊椎切除術を行い、腫瘍は根治した。18か月のフォローアップでHCGは正常化し、再発はみられていない。
pmid-17564107.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with right testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor) and brain and lung metastases, treated with orchiectomy, craniotomy, cisplatin-based chemotherapy and lung resection. Nine years later, after repeated hCG-only relapses responsive to chemotherapy, an occult L4 vertebral metastasis was detected on CT bone-window imaging. Radiation therapy followed by total spondylectomy eradicated the tumor, and hCG normalized with 18 months of follow-up without recurrence.

pmid-17566404.summary_ja: テヘランで脊髄髄膜瘤の手術を受けた330例を対象とした後方視的研究で、15例(4.5%)に髄膜瘤内奇形腫が病理学的に確認された。多くは背側正中の嚢胞性または充実性腫瘤として現れ、指状の突出物や皮膚洞を伴うことがあった。奇形腫は良性で、標準的手術後に再発は認められていない。
pmid-17566404.summary_en: A retrospective review of 330 children operated for myelomeningocele in Tehran identified 15 (4.5%) with a teratoma inside the MMC on histology. Most presented as midline dorsal cystic or solid masses with abnormal skin, and some had a protruding fingerlike appendage or dermal sinus. Hydrocephalus was present in six children. The authors suggest these features as warning signs of concurrent teratoma, and note that teratomas within an MMC are benign and did not recur after standard surgery.

pmid-17568878.summary_ja: 27歳の患者が胸痛と呼吸困難を訴えた。胸部X線で右半胸郭のほぼ全体が不透明化し、CTでは胸水様の不均一な液体貯留が認められた。良性の縦隔奇形腫が疑われ開胸術で完全切除された。非典型的な経過と腫瘍の大きさのため術前診断は困難だったが、術後経過は良好だった。
pmid-17568878.summary_en: A 27-year-old patient presented with chest pain and dyspnea, and chest radiography showed near-total opacification of the right hemithorax. CT revealed a heterogeneous fluid-like collection mimicking pleural effusion. Based on this, a benign mediastinal teratoma was suspected, and exploratory thoracotomy confirmed and completely excised a large teratoma. The postoperative course was favorable. The atypical presentation and large size hindered preoperative diagnosis, illustrating that mediastinal teratomas may mimic pleural disease.

pmid-17569957.summary_ja: 本症例は、胎児超音波検査で嚢胞性の仙尾部奇形腫と終末脊髄瘤の鑑別が困難だった例である。両疾患の胎児超音波所見と周産期リスクを比較した。超音波所見が判然としない場合は、正確な診断のため胎児MRI検査を行うべきだと強調している。出生前の鑑別の難しさを示す症例報告である。
pmid-17569957.summary_en: This report describes a fetus in which cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma and terminal myelocystocele were difficult to distinguish on prenatal sonography. The authors compare the fetal ultrasound presentation and perinatal risks of the two conditions. They emphasize that fetal MRI should be obtained to establish an accurate diagnosis when sonographic findings are equivocal. The case illustrates the diagnostic challenge of differentiating a cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma from a terminal myelocystocele before birth.

pmid-17571487.summary_ja: 子宮摘出標本で偶然発見された卵巣の類表皮嚢胞の症例報告である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫との鑑別が必要で、一部では単一胚葉性奇形腫とみなされている。組織発生は不明であり分類には議論がある。稀な病変で多くは偶発所見として見つかり、より頻度の高い卵巣奇形腫との慎重な病理学的鑑別が必要であると述べている。
pmid-17571487.summary_en: This report describes an incidental epidermoid cyst of the ovary found in a hysterectomy specimen. The authors note that such lesions must be distinguished from mature cystic teratomas, and that some investigators consider epidermoid cysts to be monodermal teratomas. Because the histogenesis remains uncertain, the classification is debated. The paper highlights that these rare lesions are typically discovered incidentally and require careful pathological differentiation from the more common ovarian teratoma.

pmid-17572845.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患および関連疾患を対象に、p57Kip2の免疫組織化学染色と超微細構造を検討した。完全胞状奇胎の栄養膜ではp57Kip2染色が消失し、非胞状絨毛と間葉性異形成では陽性であった。電子顕微鏡では胞状奇胎、間葉性異形成、侵入奇胎、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍の特徴を区別できた。p57Kip2の欠失が異常増殖に関与すると示唆された。
pmid-17572845.summary_en: This study examined p57Kip2 immunohistochemistry and ultrastructure in gestational trophoblastic disease and related disorders. P57Kip2 staining was absent in trophoblast of complete hydatidiform moles but present in nonmolar villi and mesenchymal dysplasia. Electron microscopy distinguished molar cystic villi, mesenchymal dysplasia, invasive mole and a lung epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Findings suggest that loss of p57Kip2 contributes to abnormal trophoblastic proliferation and differentiation, supporting its diagnostic utility in distinguishing molar pregnancy from its mimics.

pmid-17572987.summary_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の超音波デジタル画像とドプラ血流計測に非線形解析を適用した研究である。絨毛癌患者の子宮画像は、胞状奇胎や健常者より歪度が高かった。子宮動脈血流の非線形性は絨毛癌で低下していた。絨毛細胞画像でも空間的カオスが増加し、腫瘍抑制遺伝子p16の解析と一致した。トロホブラスト疾患では決定論的カオスが宿主の階層的な特徴であると提唱している。
pmid-17572987.summary_en: This study applied nonlinear dynamics, including skewness, spread, fractal dimension and autocorrelation, to digital ultrasound images and Doppler blood-flow measurements in trophoblastic tumor. Uterine images from choriocarcinoma patients showed higher skew values than those from hydatidiform mole or healthy controls. Uterine artery flow dynamics appeared less chaotic in choriocarcinoma. Chorionic villous cell images also showed increased spatial chaos with p16 analysis. The authors propose that deterministic chaos is a hierarchical feature of host responses in trophoblastic disease.

pmid-17573843.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマは従来のセミノーマとは異なる発症機序を持つ独立した胚細胞腫瘍であり、セミノーマの亜型ではないと結論づけている。ヒト胚細胞腫瘍の自然発生およびその誘導動物モデルの有用性を検討した。イヌのセミノーマがヒト精母細胞性セミノーマの最も有益なモデルとされる。分類と病態モデルの両面で重要な示唆を与える。
pmid-17573843.summary_en: This review and analysis presents evidence that spermatocytic seminomas are germ cell tumors with a pathogenesis distinct from classical seminoma, and should not be regarded as a seminoma variant. The authors discuss spontaneous and induced animal models for human germ cell tumors and their value for studying disease. Canine seminomas are considered the most informative model for human spermatocytic seminoma. The work supports reclassifying spermatocytic seminoma as a separate germ cell tumor entity with important implications for classification and modeling.

pmid-17573850.summary_ja: アレイCGHで精巣胚細胞腫瘍のコピー数異常領域を同定し、従来の報告を精緻化した。12p由来遺伝子と4q12増幅領域の発現から、KRASとKITの関与が示唆された。セミノーマ細胞株TCam-2ではKITの発現抑制により細胞生存率が低下した。KRAS変異とKRAS過剰発現は相互排他的で、KIT・KRAS・GRB7の発現は相関した。KITとRASシグナルの活性化が治療標的になり得ると提唱している。
pmid-17573850.summary_en: This study used array comparative genomic hybridization to define regions of copy-number imbalance in testicular germ cell tumours, refining previous reports. Expression of genes at 12p and amplicons at 4q12 implicated KRAS and KIT in tumour development. KIT knockdown in the seminoma cell line TCam-2 reduced viability. KRAS activating mutations and KRAS overexpression were mutually exclusive, and KIT, KRAS and GRB7 expression correlated. The authors propose that KIT and RAS signalling activation contributes to germ cell tumour development and may be therapeutic targets.

pmid-17573854.summary_ja: マイクロRNA(miRNA)の正常発生と悪性化における役割を、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍を中心にレビューしている。miRNAは翻訳を微調整し、幹細胞形成に重要である。セミノーマと非セミノーマを含むII型精巣腫瘍では、miR-371-373クラスターが癌遺伝子誘導性の細胞老化を抑制し、野生型p53の保持を説明しうると述べている。胚細胞腫瘍内の分化系統ごとに特徴的なmiRNAプロファイルが存在し、胚発生を模倣する。
pmid-17573854.summary_en: This review discusses the role of microRNAs in normal development and malignancy, with a focus on human germ cell tumours. The authors describe how miRNAs fine-tune translation and are important in stem cell formation. In type II testicular tumours, including seminomas and non-seminomas, the miR-371-373 cluster inhibits oncogene-induced senescence, which may explain the wild-type p53 status characteristic of these tumours. Distinct miRNA profiles characterise the differentiation lineages within GCTs, mirroring embryonic development.

pmid-17578369.summary_ja: 24歳女性の左側腹痛と慢性骨盤痛の症例で、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により5cmの卵巣腫瘤が認められた。腹腔鏡下に子宮直腸窩で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む腫瘤が確認され、左卵巣は正常位置に存在しなかった。病理組織学的に生存卵巣組織の存在が確認された。炎症や捻転による卵巣の自己切断が、異所性卵巣の成因として示唆された。
pmid-17578369.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with five years of chronic pelvic pain and left abdominal pain. MRI revealed a 5 cm left ovarian mass, which later resolved spontaneously. Laparoscopy found the mass in the cul-de-sac, partly enveloped by omentum and disconnected from pelvic organs, with no left ovary in its normal position. Histopathology showed a mature cystic teratoma containing viable ovarian tissue. The authors propose that inflammation or torsion caused autoamputation of the ovary, an uncommon mechanism for ectopic ovary formation.

pmid-17578376.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の既往がある38歳女性に生じた肺の類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)の症例報告である。hCG 高値と肺病変から転移性絨毛癌が疑われ、部分切除により確定診断された。組織学的には出血性壊死と単核および巨細胞の所見が認められた。免疫組織化学的に hCG などの栄養膜マーカーが陽性であり、絨毛癌との鑑別の重要性が示された。
pmid-17578376.summary_en: This case report describes epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), a rare gestational trophoblastic disease, arising in the lung of a 38-year-old Japanese woman with a prior hydatidiform mole. Elevated hCG and pulmonary lesions raised suspicion of metastatic choriocarcinoma, and partial lung resection was performed for diagnosis. Histology showed hemorrhagic necrosis with mononuclear and giant trophoblast-like cells. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated hCG and other trophoblast markers, and electron microscopy supported the diagnosis. The authors emphasize that ETT must be distinguished from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17581760.summary_ja: 子宮角妊娠の疑いでメトトレキサート治療を受けた35歳女性の症例報告である。β-hCG 値が上昇を続けたため、腹腔鏡下に左子宮角の腫瘤を楔状切除し、妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。保存的治療後の β-hCG の適切なモニタリングの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-17581760.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman whose suspected cornual ectopic pregnancy did not respond to methotrexate. Beta-hCG levels plateaued and then rose after treatment. Dilation and curettage showed no trophoblastic tissue, but laparoscopy revealed a left cornual mass, which was resected by wedge resection and diagnosed as gestational choriocarcinoma. The authors stress that careful beta-hCG monitoring after conservative management of ectopic pregnancy is essential to detect persistent ectopic gestation and to rule out malignant trophoblastic disease.

pmid-17583253.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎の後に肺転移を伴う絨毛癌を発症した43歳女性の症例報告である。治療前後で連続的に陽電子放射断層撮影(FDG-PET)を施行し、腫瘍活動を評価した。化学療法抵抗性のため子宮摘出術を行い、その後統合療法を実施して治療に成功した。FDG-PET は血清 β-hCG より転移病変の局在把握に優れることが示された。
pmid-17583253.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old woman with pulmonary metastatic choriocarcinoma (FIGO stage 3C) following a partial molar pregnancy. Serial FDG-PET was performed before, during, and after treatment. Rising beta-hCG after eight cycles of EMA-CO led to laparoscopically assisted vaginal hysterectomy, followed by three cycles of EMA-CE consolidation therapy. The authors conclude that FDG-PET is more accurate than serial serum beta-hCG for locating metastatic or persistent lesions and helps guide treatment decisions, particularly in multiagent chemotherapy-resistant disease.

pmid-17587461.summary_ja: 表現型が女性で核型46,XYの純粋性性腺異形成(Swyer症候群)の3例にディスジャーミノーマが発生した症例報告である。全例が腹骨盤内腫瘤で発症し、開腹術と性腺摘出術が施行された。Swyer症候群では本腫瘍のリスクが高く、性腺摘出術が推奨される。無月経を伴う思春期患者では核型検査が重要であると結論づけられている。
pmid-17587461.summary_en: This report describes three phenotypically female patients with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis who developed dysgerminoma. All presented with abdominopelvic masses and underwent laparotomy. Karyotyping confirmed 46,XY. Gonadectomy revealed streak ovaries without malignancy on histopathology, and two patients received adjuvant therapy. The authors conclude that the risk of dysgerminoma is high in Swyer syndrome, that gonadectomy is recommended, and that karyotyping should be performed in adolescents with dysgerminoma and amenorrhea.

pmid-17591609.summary_ja: 呼吸困難で受診した41歳男性で、両心房内と精巣に腫瘤を認めた症例報告である。心内腫瘤による血流閉塞に対し放射線療法を行い、その後根治的精巣摘除術を実施した。精巣セミノーマと診断され、化学療法4サイクルで良好な経過が得られた。心房への転移により血流閉塞を来した、まれな転移性精巣セミノーマの提示である。
pmid-17591609.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old man who presented with respiratory distress and was found to have masses in both atria of the heart and in one testicle. Palliative radiotherapy relieved obstruction of blood flow caused by the intracardiac masses, followed by radical orchiectomy. The diagnosis was testicular seminoma, successfully treated with four cycles of systemic chemotherapy. The authors describe this as a rare presentation of metastatic testicular seminoma with symptomatic obstruction of blood flow due to atrial involvement.

pmid-17592049.summary_ja: 10年間に3254件の精巣超音波検査を後方視的に検討した研究。精巣微小石灰化は4.6%に認められ、古典的な精巣微小石灰化では精巣がんの頻度が有意に高かった（5.8%対0.73%）。著者らは、古典的な精巣微小石灰化の患者には精巣の自己検査を勧め、超音波検査によるフォローアップは高リスク群に限定することを提案している。
pmid-17592049.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 3,254 testicular sonograms over ten years and found testicular microlithiasis in 4.6% of patients. Testicular cancer was significantly more frequent in patients with classic TM (5.8% versus 0.73% in controls, P = .04), and all nine neoplasms occurred in the classic TM group. Patients with TM and no malignancy showed no tumor development during a mean 19-month follow-up. The authors suggest testicular self-examination for classic TM patients, with follow-up ultrasonography limited to high-risk subgroups.

pmid-17592271.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍42例に隣接する精細管を調べ、精細管内の胚細胞腫瘍性病変を評価した。精細管内セミノーマは19%、精細管内胎児性癌は7%に認められた。精細管内セミノーマは非セミノーマ性腫瘍の1例にも存在し、真の前浸潤性病変と考えられた。精細管内胎児性癌は非セミノーマ性腫瘍のみに認められた。
pmid-17592271.summary_en: This study examined the seminiferous tubules adjacent to 42 testicular germ cell tumors for intratubular germ cell neoplasia. Unclassified IGCNU was found in 88% of cases, intratubular seminoma in 19%, and intratubular embryonal carcinoma in 7%. Intratubular seminoma was linked mainly to seminomas and mixed tumors but also occurred in one nonseminomatous tumor, supporting it as a true preinvasive lesion. Intratubular embryonal carcinoma occurred only with nonseminomatous tumors. The findings suggest that most nonseminomatous tumors arise initially as seminomas.

pmid-17593098.summary_ja: シスプラチンなどを含む治療に抵抗性の進行性胚細胞腫瘍8例に対し、パクリタキセル・イホスファミド・ネダプラチン（TIN）療法を救援化学療法として実施した。7例が無病状態となり、残存腫瘍の外科的切除を受けた。中央値27か月の観察で6例が無病を維持した。1例で縦隔にgrowing teratoma syndromeが生じた。全例でグレード4の白血球減少症が認められたが、G-CSFにより管理可能であった。
pmid-17593098.summary_en: This study treated eight patients with advanced germ cell tumors, refractory to bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin or to irinotecan with nedaplatin, using a paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and nedaplatin (TIN) salvage regimen. Seven achieved disease-free status and underwent surgical resection of residual tumor. Six remained disease-free at a median follow-up of 27 months. One patient developed growing teratoma syndrome in the mediastinum. Grade 4 leukocytopenia occurred in all patients but was manageable with G-CSF.

pmid-17593625.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞株と悪性奇形癌腫細胞株の遺伝子発現を比較し、癌幹細胞性に関わる転写産物プロファイルを解析した。1170遺伝子に発現差が認められ、酸化ストレスや血管新生の経路が関与していた。細胞外基質タンパク質であるデコリンが、将来の治療戦略の候補として挙げられている。
pmid-17593625.summary_en: This study compared the global mRNA expression profiles of murine embryonic stem cell lines with those of malignant murine teratocarcinoma cell lines to investigate cancer stemness. Of the genes analyzed, 1,170 were differentially expressed. Pathways involved in cancer stemness included oxidative stress and angiogenesis, with prominent transcription factors and extracellular matrix molecules. Decorin, an extracellular matrix protein, was highlighted as a potential target for future therapeutic strategies.

pmid-17594744.summary_ja: 1998〜2000年にカナダ・マニトバ州で診断された精巣がん80例の管理を集団ベースで検討した。腫瘍マーカーが欠如していた例は52%、病理報告の詳細が十分だった例は27%にすぎなかった。5年全生存期間(全生存率)はセミノーマで97%、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で84%であった。管理の不備が指摘され、ガイドラインと教育の改善が必要とされている。
pmid-17594744.summary_en: This population-based cohort study reviewed 78 men with 80 testicular cancers diagnosed in Manitoba, Canada, between 1998 and 2000. Seminomas accounted for 59% of cases and non-seminomatous germ cell tumors for 41%. Tumor markers were missing in 52% of cases, and pathology reports gave adequate detail in only 27%. Staging was completed at least three weeks after surgery in 23%. Five-year overall survival was 97% for seminoma and 84% for NSGCT. The authors call for clearer management guidelines and education.

pmid-17595797.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍173例の保存病理標本でKIT発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。純粋セミノーマの77.5%がKIT陽性であったが、非セミノーマ性腫瘍ではまれであった。KITは病期や治療反応とは相関せず、KIT過剰発現の化学療法抵抗性例にはチロシンキナーゼ阻害薬が有用となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17595797.summary_en: This study examined KIT (CD117) immunohistochemistry in 173 archival male germ cell tumors. KIT was positive in 77.5% of pure seminomas but in only 18.2% of anaplastic seminomas, and rarely in nonseminomatous tumors, with positivity in 48.6% of combined malignant teratomas. KIT did not correlate with stage or treatment response. The authors suggest tyrosine kinase inhibitors may benefit chemoresistant patients who overexpress KIT.

pmid-17596674.summary_ja: 31歳女性が巨大な頸部腫瘤を呈し、甲状腺原発の悪性奇形腫(原始神経上皮組織と未熟な間葉を含む)と診断された症例報告である。CTとPETでは転移は認められなかった。甲状腺全摘術と両側の準根治的頸部郭清術を施行し、その後化学療法と放射線療法を受けた。22か月の時点で甲状腺機能は正常で再発はみられていない。著者らは、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍成分が顕著な甲状腺悪性奇形腫として、韓国で初めての報告であると述べている。
pmid-17596674.summary_en: A 31-year-old woman presented with a huge neck mass that proved to be a primary malignant teratoma of the thyroid, containing primitive neuroepithelial tissue and immature mesenchyme. CT and PET found no metastatic disease. She underwent total thyroidectomy with bilateral modified radical neck dissection, followed by chemotherapy and radiotherapy. At 22 months she remained euthyroid without recurrence. The authors describe this as the first reported malignant thyroid teratoma with a prominent PNET component in Korea.

pmid-17598338.summary_ja: 20歳男性が上大静脈症候群と肺腫瘤で受診した。肺病変は非小細胞肺癌と診断されたが、精巣腫瘤から未熟奇形腫を伴う絨毛癌（非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）が確認された。化学療法で肺病変と上大静脈症候群は改善したが、右上肺野の病変は進行し脳転移が出現して、4サイクル目の化学療法後に死亡した。同時性重複悪性腫瘍の稀な症例である。
pmid-17598338.summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with superior vena cava syndrome and lung masses. Lung biopsy suggested non-small cell lung carcinoma, but testicular biopsy revealed immature teratoma with choriocarcinoma, a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Chemotherapy resolved the pulmonary lesions and SVC syndrome and lowered tumor markers. However, the right upper zone lesion progressed, brain metastases developed, and he died after the fourth chemotherapy cycle. The case is reported as an example of synchronous double primary malignancies.

pmid-17599859.summary_ja: Graves病で甲状腺近亜全摘術を受けた42歳女性が、術後も甲状腺機能亢進症が持続した症例。131I全身シンチグラフィーで骨盤内に集積を認め、超音波検査で右卵巣の11cm腫瘤が見つかった。手術で卵巣甲状腺腫と確定し、術後に甲状腺ホルモン値は低下域となった。難治性の甲状腺機能亢進症では、機能性卵巣腫瘤の評価に放射性ヨウ素検査を行うべきと提言している。
pmid-17599859.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of persistent hyperthyroidism after near-total thyroidectomy for Graves' disease, caused by a functioning struma ovarii (ovarian thyroid tissue teratoma). A 131I scan showed pelvic uptake, and pelvic ultrasonography revealed an 11 cm mixed solid-cystic right ovarian mass. Surgical resection confirmed struma ovarii, and thyroid hormone levels fell into the hypothyroid range postoperatively. The authors recommend radioiodine scanning in refractory hyperthyroidism after thyroid surgery to identify functioning ovarian masses.

pmid-17602084.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者132名と、年齢などをマッチさせた対照137名を比較した研究。生存者の53.8%が妊孕性温存手術を受け、その多くで治療後も月経が続いていた。生存者は生殖に関する懸念や性的快感の低下を訴えた一方、パートナーとの関係は良好であった。妊孕性温存手術を受けた場合、化学療法後も月経機能と妊孕性が保たれやすいと結論している。
pmid-17602084.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group study compared 132 long-term survivors of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, treated with surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy, with 137 matched controls. Of survivors, 54% had fertility-sparing surgery, and most of those still menstruated; 24 survivors reported 37 offspring. Survivors reported greater reproductive concerns and less sexual pleasure, but better dyadic consensus, satisfaction, and cohesion. Fertility-sparing surgery appeared to preserve menstrual function and fertility after chemotherapy.

pmid-17602088.summary_ja: 小児期の固形がん生存者4,581名のコホート内で行われた症例対照研究。治療内容で調整した上で、初発がんの種類が二次悪性腫瘍（SMN）のリスクを独立して高めるかを検討した。胚細胞腫瘍は、ホジキンリンパ腫、網膜芽細胞腫、骨腫瘍、軟部肉腫などと同様にSMNリスク上昇と関連した。胚細胞腫瘍の生存者は綿密なサーベイランスを受けるべきと結論している。
pmid-17602088.summary_en: A nested case-control study within a European cohort of 4,581 childhood solid cancer survivors examined whether the first malignancy independently predicts second malignant neoplasms (SMN). After matching for treatment, 146 SMN cases were compared with 417 controls. Germ cell tumor as a first cancer, along with Hodgkin lymphoma, retinoblastoma, bone tumors, and soft tissue sarcoma, was associated with increased SMN risk. Germ cell tumor survivors should therefore receive close surveillance.

pmid-17602447.summary_ja: 妊娠29週で非免疫性胎児水腫を伴い子宮内死亡に至った心膜内奇形腫の症例。超音波所見から疑われ、胎児病理で確定した。大量の心膜液貯留による心タンポナーデが水腫と死亡の原因と考察している。出生前診断が早期に行われれば、子宮内での減圧介入と計画的な出産・新生児管理が可能になると述べている。
pmid-17602447.summary_en: This case report describes intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed in utero at 29 weeks of gestation, presenting with nonimmune hydrops and fetal death. Ultrasound suggested the diagnosis, which was confirmed by fetopathology. The authors explain that massive pericardial effusion causing tamponade drives hydrops and death. Earlier prenatal diagnosis could allow in utero decompression, with planned delivery and rapid neonatal management.

pmid-17603244.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎の35歳女性の症例。当初は非ヘルペス性脳炎として抗ウイルス薬とステロイドパルス療法で治療され、症状は改善した。その後卵巣腫瘍が発見され、脳脊髄液からグルタミン酸受容体（GluR）自己抗体が検出された。卵巣奇形腫とGluR自己免疫の関連が傍腫瘍性の機序として示唆されている。
pmid-17603244.summary_en: This case describes paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis in a 35-year-old woman with consciousness disturbance, initially treated as non-herpetic encephalitis with acyclovir and steroid pulse therapy. After symptoms improved, an ovarian tumor was discovered. Cerebrospinal fluid testing revealed autoantibodies to glutamate receptor (GluR). The authors suggest an association between the ovarian teratoma and GluR autoimmunity as a paraneoplastic mechanism.

pmid-17603707.summary_ja: 上皮性卵巣癌53例と卵巣胚細胞腫瘍25例を比較した免疫組織化学的研究。p53変異は上皮性癌（56.6%）で胚細胞腫瘍（28%）より有意に多かった。Bcl-2とトポイソメラーゼIIαには差がなかった。両者の化学感受性の違いにp53が関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17603707.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study compared p53 mutation, Bcl-2, and topoisomerase II alpha expression in 53 malignant epithelial ovarian cancers and 25 ovarian germ cell tumors. p53 mutation was significantly more frequent in epithelial cancers (56.6%) than in germ cell tumors (28%). Bcl-2 and Topo II alpha did not differ between groups. Age, stage, and chemotherapy response differed. The authors propose that p53 status contributes to the difference in chemosensitivity between these two ovarian tumor types.

pmid-17603725.summary_ja: 生後8か月女児の膣に発生した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例。膣出血と膣からの腫瘤突出で受診した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で膀胱後方に腫瘤が認められ、生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は上昇し、膣子宮摘出術後に腫瘍内科へ紹介された。小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍として膣は極めて稀な発生部位である。
pmid-17603725.summary_en: This case report describes a rare vaginal yolk sac tumor in an 8-month-old girl presenting with vaginal bleeding and a protruding mass. CT showed a mass posterior to the bladder, and biopsy confirmed endodermal sinus tumor. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. She underwent vaginohysterectomy and was referred to an oncologist for further management. The authors highlight the vagina as an extremely rare site for malignant germ cell tumors in childhood.

pmid-17613426.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍(絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍など)の総説である。多くは化学療法と切除で治癒するが、転移性疾患や化学療法抵抗性・再発例では新たな治療が必要である。著者らは分子病因の最新知見を概説し、治療標的となりうる分子を挙げている。
pmid-17613426.summary_en: A review of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, comprising choriocarcinoma, placental-site trophoblastic tumour, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumour, many of which derive from hydatidiform moles. Most patients are cured by chemotherapy and tumour resection, but some with metastatic, chemoresistant, or recurrent disease need new treatments. The authors summarize recent advances in molecular etiology and highlight molecules that could serve as therapeutic targets. Because the underlying biology remains poorly understood, treatment development remains largely empirical.

pmid-17618044.summary_ja: フランス南西部の542例の胚細胞腫瘍患者（1983〜2002年）を対象とした集団ベース研究。症状出現から診断までの遅延は、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では病期および5年生存率と有意に関連したが、セミノーマでは関連がみられなかった。遅延の全体的傾向は20年間で変化せず、直近10年でわずかに短縮した。著者らは、精巣がんの認知向上により早期診断を促すべきと結論づけた。
pmid-17618044.summary_en: This large population-based French study of 542 germ cell tumour patients (1983–2002) examined diagnostic delay, defined as the time from symptom onset to diagnosis, in testicular cancer. Mean delay was longer for seminoma than for non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. In NSGCT, delay correlated with stage and significantly reduced 5-year survival, whereas no such association was seen for seminoma. Overall delay trends did not change over 20 years, although a slight decrease occurred in the last decade. The authors conclude that urologists should promote awareness programmes to speed diagnosis.

pmid-17630116.summary_ja: 38歳女性の子宮頸部未熟奇形腫の症例。外胚葉・内胚葉・中胚葉・神経上皮への分化を示し、神経上皮成分から低悪性度の乏突起膠腫が発生して悪性と判定された。子宮頸部奇形腫は極めて稀で、神経上皮分化を伴う例や神経系腫瘍の合併例の報告はこれまでなく、病理組織学的所見と文献を検討している。
pmid-17630116.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman had an immature teratoma of the uterine cervix containing ectodermal, endodermal, mesodermal and neuroepithelial components. A low-grade oligodendroglioma developed within the neuroepithelial component, making the tumour malignant. Teratomas of the cervix are very rare, and a cervical teratoma with neuroepithelial divergence and a glial-type neoplasm has not previously been reported. The authors describe the histopathology and review the literature.

pmid-17634488.summary_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、18FDG PETにより潜在性転移のない患者を同定し、安全に経過観察できるかを検討したMRC TE22試験の予備報告である。PETを受けた111例のうち88例がPET陰性となり経過観察に入った。87例中33例が再発し、1年無再発率は63%であった。PET陰性患者の再発率が高かったため試験は中止され、著者らはこの目的にはPETの感度が不十分であると結論づけた。
pmid-17634488.summary_en: This MRC TE22 trial preliminary report evaluated whether 18FDG PET could identify high-risk clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumour patients without occult metastasis who could safely undergo surveillance. Of 111 scanned patients, 88 were PET-negative and entered surveillance. Relapse occurred in 33 of 87 patients, with a 1-year relapse-free rate of 63%. Because the relapse rate in PET-negative patients was high, the trial was stopped, and the authors concluded PET is insufficiently sensitive for this purpose.

pmid-17634885.summary_ja: 22歳男性が微熱と咳で受診。胸部CTで縦隔リンパ節腫脹と軽度の女性化乳房を認め、超音波検査で左精巣腫瘤、腹部CTで後腹膜リンパ節腫脹が判明した。左精巣摘除術で精巣セミノーマと診断された。縦隔病変や女性化乳房が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状となりうることを示す症例である。
pmid-17634885.summary_en: A 22-year-old man presented with long-term low-grade fever and cough. Chest CT showed mediastinal lymphadenopathy and mild gynecomastia. Ultrasonography then revealed a left testicular mass, and abdominal CT showed retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. Left orchiectomy confirmed testicular seminoma. The case illustrates that mediastinal nodal disease and gynecomastia may be the initial presentation of a testicular germ cell tumour, prompting evaluation of the testes.

pmid-17635618.summary_ja: 34歳女性が妊娠22週に卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍(病期IC)と診断された。妊娠中にシスプラチン単剤を4サイクル投与し、その後シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドの併用化学療法を3サイクル行った。治療後28か月で完全寛解を維持し、妊娠35週に帝王切開で健常児が出産された。妊娠中のシスプラチン単剤療法は有効かつ安全と考察されている。
pmid-17635618.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman was diagnosed with a pure endodermal sinus tumour of the ovary, stage IC, at 22 weeks of gestation. She received four cycles of cisplatin monotherapy during pregnancy, followed by three cycles of cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. She remained in complete remission 28 months after treatment, and a healthy infant was delivered by caesarean section at 35 weeks. The authors conclude that cisplatin monotherapy appears effective and safe during pregnancy and that prognosis is very good with adjuvant therapy.

pmid-17638164.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の家族性症例を報告し、散発例との違いを検討している。家族性と散発性では特徴が異なると示唆される。単独の奇形として生じる場合と、直腸肛門奇形や仙骨異常を伴うCurrarino三徴の一部として生じる場合がある。胎生発生、診断、スクリーニング、治療について既報を基に考察している。
pmid-17638164.summary_en: This paper reports a familial case of sacrococcygeal teratoma and compares it with sporadic cases. Familial and sporadic sacrococcygeal teratomas appear to differ in characteristics. The condition may occur as an isolated anomaly or as part of Currarino triad, with anorectal malformations and sacral anomalies. The authors discuss embryogenesis, diagnosis, screening and management, drawing conclusions from previously published reports.

pmid-17638834.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に低悪性度の腹膜神経膠腫症を合併した症例を報告。腹膜播種は神経膠組織から成り、稀に悪性転化しうる。繰り返しのCTは被曝量の問題があるため、フォローアップにおけるMRIの役割を検討している。明確な指針はない。
pmid-17638834.summary_en: This paper describes a case of immature ovarian teratoma complicated by low-grade gliomatosis peritonei, in which peritoneal implants consisted of glial tissue. Gliomatosis peritonei may rarely undergo malignant change. Because repeated CT scanning carries radiation dose implications, the authors present MRI findings and discuss its potential role in surveillance of these patients, for whom no clear follow-up guidance exists.

pmid-17639422.summary_ja: 三次小児医療施設で17年間に得られた小児の精巣・精巣傍組織標本551例を病理組織学的に検討した。触知不能精巣が最多で、精巣腫瘤では白血病の精巣浸潤が最も多かったが、乳児期では卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫が主であった。腫瘍は病理標本の20%超を占めた。
pmid-17639422.summary_en: This review of 551 paediatric testicular and paratesticular specimens from a tertiary centre over 17 years found that impalpable testes were the most frequent group. Among testicular masses, leukaemic infiltration was the commonest tumour overall, but yolk sac tumours and teratomas predominated in infancy. Neoplasms accounted for over 20% of pathology. Most specimens came from children under 4 years, reflecting cryptorchidism, vanished testis, neonatal torsion and testicular tumours.

pmid-17641723.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）を有する患者が、拡張掻爬術（D&C）後に卵管卵巣膿瘍を呈した症例を報告する。これらの嚢腫では捻転、破裂、悪性転化が一般的な合併症であり、感染はまれである。婦人科的処置後に骨盤内感染を来した場合は、類皮嚢腫の重複感染も鑑別に考慮する必要があることを示唆している。
pmid-17641723.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with an ovarian dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma) who developed a tubo-ovarian abscess after dilation and curettage. Infection is a rare complication of these cysts, which are more commonly associated with torsion, rupture, or malignant change. The report suggests that clinicians consider superinfection of a dermoid cyst when pelvic infection follows gynecologic instrumentation.

pmid-17642278.summary_ja: 血清AFPが531.1 ng/mlと著明に上昇した、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う肺の二相性芽腫の症例を報告する。右上葉切除と縦隔リンパ節郭清に続き、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる補助化学療法が行われ、AFPは正常化した。術後27か月で局所再発し放射線療法が施行され、術後70か月時点で生存している。
pmid-17642278.summary_en: This case report describes a pulmonary biphasic blastoma containing a yolk sac tumor component in a patient with a 10-cm right upper lobe mass and markedly elevated serum AFP (531.1 ng/ml). After right upper lobectomy and mediastinal lymph node dissection, adjuvant cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy was given and AFP normalized. Local recurrence at 27 months was treated with radiation therapy, and the patient was alive at 70 months after surgery.

pmid-17643097.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ17例（うち肉腫2例）と通常型セミノーマ18例で、アポトーシスとその制御因子を比較した。精母細胞性セミノーマではアポトーシスが有意に多く、p53は低下、FADDは増加していた。転移しにくい本腫瘍の予後良好性の一因として、アポトーシス亢進が関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17643097.summary_en: This study compares apoptosis and apoptotic regulators in 17 spermatocytic seminomas (two with sarcoma) and 18 usual seminomas using light microscopy and immunostaining. Spermatocytic seminoma showed significantly more apoptotic and activated caspase-3-positive cells, lower p53 expression, and increased FADD. Sarcomatous components showed reduced apoptosis. The authors propose that increased apoptosis may partly explain the indolent behavior of spermatocytic seminoma.

pmid-17644135.summary_ja: ヒト精巣の各種病変（精巣腫瘍、正常精巣、不妊患者の検体）と胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1におけるビタミンD受容体（VDR）の発現を検討した。胎児性癌で最も強く染色され、in vitroではビタミンDがVDR発現を誘導した。テストステロンは発現を低下させ、カルシウムは補助因子として作用する可能性が示された。
pmid-17644135.summary_en: The authors examined vitamin D receptor (VDR) expression across human testicular pathologies, including testicular tumors, normal testis, and infertile specimens, and in the embryonal carcinoma cell line NT2/D1. VDR was expressed in germ and tumor cells, with strongest staining in embryonal carcinoma. In vitro, vitamin D induced VDR expression, while testosterone reduced it and calcium modulated it. Testosterone may down-regulate VDR, and calcium may be a cofactor.

pmid-17644403.summary_ja: 1966年から2005年までの文献から選択した138編をレビューし、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のサーベイランス成績を評価した。サーベイランス中の再発は非セミノーマ性で約28%、セミノーマで約17%であり、原病特異的生存率は約98～100%だった。臨床病期Iに対して積極的監視は適切な第一選択と考えられた。
pmid-17644403.summary_en: This systematic review of 138 selected articles, drawn from MEDLINE and CINAHL through 2005, evaluates surveillance outcomes for testicular germ cell tumors. Relapse occurred in about 28% of NSGCT and 17% of seminoma patients on surveillance, with cause-specific survival near 98% and 100%. Compliance varied, and evidence on costs, quality of life and psychosocial outcomes was inconsistent. Active surveillance appears to be an appropriate, possibly optimal, first-line approach for clinical stage I disease.

pmid-17646728.summary_ja: 37歳女性の慢性骨盤痛と右卵巣嚢胞（7cm）に対し、腹腔鏡下右卵巣摘出術を施行した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例である。その後、甲状腺全摘術と放射性ヨウ素（131I）アブレーションを行った。文献検索で48例を集計し、治療方針は未確立であるとして、甲状腺癌に準じた管理を提案している。
pmid-17646728.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman with chronic pelvic pain and a 7 cm right ovarian cyst was diagnosed with malignant struma ovarii. She underwent laparoscopic right ovariectomy, followed by total thyroidectomy and radioiodine (131I) ablation. The authors reviewed 48 previously reported cases from Medline and noted that management remains controversial. They suggest managing malignant struma ovarii like thyroid carcinoma, including thyroidectomy and 131I therapy after ovarian surgery.

pmid-17651911.summary_ja: 56歳男性の左精巣の10cm大の腫瘍で、精母細胞性セミノーマの未分化型変異と診断された。典型的な領域に加え、大型核と明瞭な核小体を持つ未分化領域を認めた。白膜・血管浸潤と精巣上体への進展もみられた。免疫染色ではCD117が弱陽性のみで、他のマーカーは陰性であった。攻撃的な組織像を示す稀な症例の報告である。
pmid-17651911.summary_en: A 56-year-old man presented with a large left testicular tumor (10 cm) diagnosed as spermatocytic seminoma. The tumor contained typical areas as well as anaplastic regions with large nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Tunical and vascular invasion and epididymal extension were present. Immunohistochemistry showed only weak CD117 positivity, with other markers negative. The report documents a rare anaplastic variant of spermatocytic seminoma with aggressive histologic features.

pmid-17652534.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫30例を免疫組織化学で検討し、ランゲルハンス細胞を表皮の基底上層に認めた。ランゲルハンス細胞はメラノサイトと同じ部位に存在し、CD3陽性T細胞とともに基底膜を越える像もみられた。表皮のみからなる奇形腫では認めなかった。神経堤由来の起源やT細胞系免疫系との関連を示唆している。
pmid-17652534.summary_en: This study examined 30 mature ovarian teratomas by immunohistochemistry for Langerhans cells (CD1, S100), melanocytes (melan-A, HMB45), and lymphocytes and monocytes. Langerhans cells were found in the suprabasal epidermis, co-localized with melanocytes in the basal layer, and sometimes penetrated the basement membrane alongside CD3-positive T cells. They were absent in teratomas composed only of epidermis. The authors propose a neural crest origin, possibly related to Schwann cells, and a role in a T-cell-associated immune system.

pmid-17652549.summary_ja: 77歳女性の左卵巣腫瘍に対し子宮全摘術と両側付属器切除術が行われた。充実成分は卵巣甲状腺腫で、嚢胞壁には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の低分化型腺癌を認めた。免疫染色ではCK7陽性、CK20およびTTF-1陰性であった。卵巣甲状腺腫と腺癌の併存例であり、起源の解明には症例の蓄積が必要とされる。
pmid-17652549.summary_en: A 77-year-old woman underwent total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for a left ovarian tumor. The solid component was struma ovarii, while the cyst wall contained a poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma. Immunohistochemistry showed CK7 positivity and CK20 and TTF-1 negativity. The authors concluded that struma ovarii and other components coexisted with the adenocarcinoma, and that more cases are needed to clarify the origin of adenocarcinomas arising in mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-17652649.summary_ja: シスプラチン含有併用化学療法後に進行した転移性精巣腫瘍184例の後方視的解析である。カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞救援を行い、116例が再発なく完全寛解を維持した。セミノーマでは35例中26例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では149例中90例が無病生存した。治療関連死3例と急性白血病3例がみられた。
pmid-17652649.summary_en: This retrospective review of 184 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors that progressed after cisplatin-containing chemotherapy examined high-dose carboplatin and etoposide followed by autologous stem-cell rescue. Overall, 116 patients achieved durable complete remission. Among second-line patients, 94 of 135 were disease-free. Platinum-sensitive disease responded well, with 26 of 35 seminoma and 90 of 149 nonseminomatous patients disease-free. Treatment-related deaths occurred in three patients, and acute leukemia developed in three others.

pmid-17656239.summary_ja: 18歳男性が右精巣痛と萎縮精巣の増大で受診した。超音波検査で不均一な腫瘤を認め、胸部画像と腫瘍マーカーは正常であった。根治的精巣摘除術の病理で、ネフロブラストーマ成分を伴う奇形腫、限局性の胎児性癌、微小な卵黄嚢腫瘍を認めた。精巣にウィルムス腫瘍が生じるのは稀で、胚発生期のWT1遺伝子の活性化が関与すると考察している。
pmid-17656239.summary_en: An 18-year-old man presented with right testicular pain and enlargement of an atrophic testis. Ultrasonography showed a heterogeneous mass, while chest imaging and tumor marker levels were normal. Radical orchiectomy revealed teratoma with a nephroblastoma (Wilms-type) component, focal embryonal carcinoma, and minute yolk sac tumor. The authors note this is a rare occurrence of a Wilms-like tumor in the testis and attribute it to activation of the WT1 gene during embryogenesis.

pmid-17657368.summary_ja: 男性新生児が巨大な舌奇形腫と口蓋裂を呈した。腫瘤は直ちに気道閉塞を起こさず、羊水過多がなかったため出生前超音波検査で見逃された。全身麻酔下で切除され、病理組織学的には3胚葉すべての成分を含み、主に神経膠組織からなっていた。術後に舌下神経麻痺が生じたが、経過観察4年の時点で再発はみられていない。
pmid-17657368.summary_en: A male newborn presented with a massive lingual teratoma and cleft palate. The mass did not cause immediate airway obstruction and was missed on antenatal ultrasonography because there was no polyhydramnios. Surgical excision was performed under general anaesthesia. Histopathology showed all three embryonic germ layers, predominantly glial tissue. The infant developed postoperative hypoglossal nerve palsy, but no recurrence was detected at four years of follow-up.

pmid-17665498.summary_ja: 本研究は、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化した転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者100例に対し、残存腫瘍に行った修正型後腹膜リンパ節郭清を後方視的に評価した。病理では奇形腫62%、壊死36%、癌2%であった。2年および5年無病生存率は95%で、再発4例はすべて両側完全郭清の範囲外に生じた。選択された患者では修正郭清が有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17665498.summary_en: This retrospective review of a testicular cancer database evaluated modified postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (PC-RPLND) in 100 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who had normal tumor markers after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Residual disease was confined to the primary landing zone. Pathology showed teratoma in 62 percent, necrosis in 36 percent, and cancer in 2 percent. Two- and five-year disease-free survival was 95 percent. All four recurrences occurred outside the boundaries of a full bilateral dissection, supporting modified templates in selected patients.

pmid-17666639.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、長期の性器出血、腹痛、貧血を呈した未経産の思春期女性を扱う。当初は妊娠物の残留が疑われたが、腟内に腫瘤が認められ、Haultain法により子宮反転を整復した。反転の原因は子宮未熟奇形腫であった。非産褥性子宮反転は悪性腫瘍の可能性が高いが、最終病理結果が出るまでは若年女性では子宮温存手術を試みるべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-17666639.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent nullipara with prolonged vaginal bleeding, abdominal pain, and symptomatic anemia, initially suspected to have retained products of conception. Examination revealed a large vaginal mass, and uterine inversion was diagnosed and corrected using the Haultain procedure. The inversion was caused by an immature teratoma of the uterus. The authors note that nonpuerperal uterine inversion in reproductive-age women is likely malignant, but uterus-sparing surgery should be attempted in young women until final pathology is known.

pmid-17667449.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、β-hCGが9000 IU/Lを超えて上昇したが原発巣が特定できなかった31歳女性を扱う。メトトレキサートにより一時的に低下したが、再上昇した。F-18 FDG PETでCTでは捉えられなかった縦隔病変が検出され、切除により胸腺近傍の原発性縦隔絨毛癌と診断された。術後β-hCGは105 IU/Lに低下した。
pmid-17667449.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with markedly elevated beta-hCG above 9000 IU/L and no source identified on conventional work-up. Methotrexate reduced the marker, but levels rose again after seven cycles. F-18 FDG PET detected a mediastinal focus that CT had not shown, and resection of the mass and thymus revealed primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma. Postoperative beta-hCG fell to 105 IU/L. The case illustrates the value of PET in detecting occult extragonadal germ cell tumors when tumor markers rise without an identified primary.

pmid-17671812.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率が非常に高い染色体置換マウス系統129.MOLF-Chr19を用い、第19染色体上の感受性候補遺伝子を探索した。遺伝学的・ゲノム学的手法により、精巣腫瘍感受性として未報告の遺伝子3個とマイクロRNA(miRNA)1個を同定した。性腺組織における複数の第19染色体遺伝子の発現変化が高頻度発生に寄与すると考えられ、胚細胞の形質転換と腫瘍発生の研究に有用なモデルとされる。
pmid-17671812.summary_en: This study uses the consomic 129.MOLF-Chr19 mouse strain, in which males develop testicular germ cell tumors at a very high rate, to identify candidate susceptibility genes on chromosome 19. Combining genetic and genomic approaches, the authors identified three protein-coding genes and one microRNA not previously implicated in testicular tumor susceptibility. Altered expression of multiple chromosome 19 genes in gonadal tissue likely contributes to the high incidence. The strain is proposed as a useful model for germ cell transformation and tumor development.

pmid-17675800.summary_ja: 犬の卵巣腫瘍9組織型を対象に、免疫組織化学染色の特徴を検討した獣医病理学の研究です。胚細胞腫瘍のうち敷石型はビメンチンとAFPのみ陽性でした。組織型ごとの免疫表現型を整理し、犬の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断に役立つ基礎データを提供しています。
pmid-17675800.summary_en: This veterinary study immunohistochemically characterized canine ovarian tumors across nine histological types, including epithelial, sex-cord stromal, and germ cell tumors. Markers included PLAP, CK7, desmin, S100, AE1/AE3, inhibin alpha, vimentin, and alpha-fetoprotein. The cobblestone-type germ cell tumors were positive only for vimentin and AFP. The study refines the immunophenotypic features that distinguish histological subtypes, providing reference data for diagnosing canine ovarian germ cell tumors and related lesions.

pmid-17682003.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症にY染色体のAZF欠失やハプログループが関与するかを検討した症例対照研究です。散発例118例と地域をマッチさせた対照93例を解析しました。欠失やハプログループの分布に差はなく、セミノーマと非セミノーマの間でも差はみられませんでした。Y染色体の変異は感受性に寄与しないと結論づけています。
pmid-17682003.summary_en: This case-control study examined whether Y chromosome AZF deletions and haplogroups influence susceptibility to testicular germ cell cancer. It analyzed 118 sporadic cases and 93 microgeographically matched controls. No AZF or partial AZFc microdeletions were found, and haplogroup distribution did not differ between cases and controls. Results were also similar for seminoma versus non-seminoma and for normozoospermic versus azoo-oligozoospermic patients. The authors conclude that Y chromosome variation does not contribute meaningfully to susceptibility.

pmid-17682839.summary_ja: 41例の精巣腫瘍組織を用い、セミノーマにおけるOCT-4転写因子の発現と局在を検討した研究である。免疫組織化学とウェスタンブロッティングにより、セミノーマ細胞の細胞質と核にOCT-4が局在することが示された。NCCITおよびNT2細胞株でも確認された。RT-PCRでは、ヒト胚性幹細胞に比べてOct-4 mRNAが高発現していた。著者らは、この所見が始原生殖細胞様細胞から精巣胚細胞腫瘍への形質転換を示す可能性があると述べている。
pmid-17682839.summary_en: This study investigated aberrant expression and distribution of the OCT-4 transcription factor in seminomas. Immunohistochemistry and Western blotting of 41 testicular tumor tissues showed OCT-4 localized in both cytoplasm and nucleus of seminoma cells. Findings were confirmed in NCCIT and NT2 cell lines derived from embryonal carcinoma. RT-PCR showed higher Oct-4 mRNA in NCCIT, NT2, and seminoma tissues than in human embryonic stem cells. The findings suggest OCT-4 may reflect transformation of primordial germ cell-like cells into testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-17683189.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の各亜型について、病理組織学、臨床像、新しい免疫組織化学マーカーを総合的にまとめた総説です。混合型では胎児性癌成分や脈管侵襲が、臨床病期Iの潜在性転移の予測因子となります。小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍や成人の奇形腫の特徴も整理されています。
pmid-17683189.summary_en: This review summarizes testicular germ cell tumors, covering subtype histopathology, clinical behavior, and newer immunohistochemical markers. It describes unclassified intratubular germ cell neoplasia as the precursor lesion, adult seminoma, and spermatocytic seminoma in elderly men. In mixed tumors, embryonal carcinoma component and vascular invasion predict occult metastasis in clinical stage I disease. Prepubertal yolk sac tumor is the most common pediatric GCT, and adult teratomas behave malignantly. The paper provides a practical framework for distinguishing subtypes.

pmid-17683548.summary_ja: 64歳男性の膵尾部に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告。画像検査では診断が確定せず、術中診断の後に左膵切除術が施行された。まれな良性の胚細胞腫瘍で、術前診断の難しさと外科的切除の重要性が論じられている。内視鏡的超音波検査と穿刺吸引細胞診が有用と考察されている。
pmid-17683548.summary_en: This case report describes a 64-year-old man with a dermoid cyst of the pancreatic tail, an extremely rare benign germ cell neoplasm. Preoperative ultrasonography, CT and MRI were inconclusive, so the diagnosis was made intraoperatively. Left pancreatectomy was performed, and histology confirmed a dermoid cyst measuring 8.5 x 3.0 cm. The authors emphasize that preoperative diagnosis is difficult, that endoscopic ultrasound with fine-needle aspiration may help, and that surgical resection should be considered standard to exclude malignancy.

pmid-17688374.summary_ja: 単一施設において、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療戦略を比較した研究である。監視療法のみを受けた145例の再発率は35.9%であった。血管侵襲と組織型に基づくリスク適応群では、補助BEP、初回のRPLND、または監視療法が行われた。血管侵襲のない患者を監視した群では再発率が19.4%に低下し、全生存率は98%を超えた。著者らは、監視療法は血管侵襲のない患者に限定すべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-17688374.summary_en: This study compared therapeutic strategies for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors in patients treated at a single center. In a surveillance-only group of 145 patients, the relapse rate was 35.9 percent. Risk-adapted groups based on vascular invasion and histology received adjuvant BEP, primary RPLND, or surveillance. Relapse fell to 19.4 percent in patients without vascular invasion managed by surveillance, and overall survival exceeded 98 percent. The authors conclude that surveillance should be restricted to patients without vascular invasion.

pmid-17688924.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3とJARを用い、ヘパラナーゼ(Hpa)の転移能への関与を検討した基礎研究。浸潤能の高いJEG-3ではHpaの発現が高く、正常絨毛と比較しても発現上昇が認められた。アンチセンス法で発現を抑制すると浸潤能が低下した。Hpaは絨毛癌の転移能に関与し、治療標的となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-17688924.summary_en: This study examined heparanase (Hpa) in human choriocarcinoma cell lines JEG-3 and JAR. The more invasive JEG-3 line expressed higher levels of Hpa mRNA and protein than JAR and normal chorion. Antisense oligodeoxynucleotide knockdown of Hpa in JEG-3 cells reduced its expression four- to five-fold and decreased invasion in Matrigel assays. The authors conclude that Hpa contributes to the metastatic capability of choriocarcinoma and may be a therapeutic target.

pmid-17694322.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍における単純型ムチン型O-グリカンとポリペプチドGalNAc転移酵素を免疫組織化学で解析した。正常精巣では段階特異的な糖鎖パターンが認められ、セミノーマと上皮内癌では胎児型のシアル酸化糖鎖が発現していた。胎児性癌ではこれらの糖鎖が欠如していた一方、奇形腫では秩序を欠いた様式で発現していた。著者らは、糖鎖の変化が胚細胞の成熟と腫瘍分化を反映し、診断ツールとなりうるとともに、精巣がんの発生モデルを支持すると結論づけている。
pmid-17694322.summary_en: This study analyzed simple mucin-type O-glycans and polypeptide GalNAc-transferases in normal human testis and testicular germ cell tumors by immunohistochemistry. Normal testis showed stage-specific glycan patterns, and seminoma and carcinoma in situ expressed fetal-type sialylated glycans. Embryonal carcinoma lacked these glycans, whereas teratomas expressed them in a disorganized manner. The authors conclude that glycosylation changes reflect germ cell maturation and tumor differentiation, offering diagnostic tools and supporting a developmental model of testicular cancer.

pmid-17701689.summary_ja: 14か月の女児に発生した上縦隔の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内であった。切除標本には全層を有し神経節を伴う腸管様構造が認められた。縦隔奇形腫内にこのような完全な腸管組織が見られた報告はなく、二次性腫瘍発生の可能性にも言及している。
pmid-17701689.summary_en: A 14-month-old girl presented with cough and wheeze, and imaging showed a large superior mediastinal mass. Tumor markers were normal. Resection revealed a mature cystic teratoma containing well-formed bowel-like structures with all wall layers and a ganglionated myenteric plexus. The authors note that complete bowel sections within a mediastinal teratoma have not been previously published. They also raise the possibility of secondary neoplasia arising in these components.

pmid-17705807.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と奇形腫の起源と正中線上の分布に関する仮説をレビューした論文である。GCTの新たな分類(I型とII型)、ゲノムインプリンティングのデータ、胚性幹細胞から胚細胞が生じ得るという知見を統合している。著者らは、正中線上の分布は始原生殖細胞の移動によると提案している。また、II型腫瘍はSCF発現フィーダー細胞やTSPY含有領域など、より厳しいニッチ条件を必要とすると述べている。
pmid-17705807.summary_en: This review examines hypotheses on the origin and midline distribution of extragonadal germ cell tumors and teratomas. It integrates recent classification of GCTs into Type I (infantile teratomas/yolk sac tumors) and Type II (seminomatous tumors and non-seminomas), genomic imprinting data supporting a germ cell origin, and the finding that germ cells can be derived from embryonic stem cells. The authors propose that midline distribution reflects primordial germ cell migration during development, and that Type II tumors require stricter niche conditions, such as SCF-expressing feeder cells and TSPY-containing regions.

pmid-17705808.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのモデルとして広く使われてきたJKT-1細胞株が、実際にセミノーマ由来かを検証した研究。核型解析、マーカー染色、マイクロRNA解析などを行った結果、胚細胞的特徴はあるものの、12番染色体短腕の増加などセミノーマに特徴的な染色体異常やOCT3/4、NANOGの発現が欠如していた。元の原発腫瘍由来ではないと結論づけ、セミノーマの代表モデルとはいえないと述べている。
pmid-17705808.summary_en: This study tested whether the JKT-1 cell line, widely used as a model of human testicular seminoma, truly derives from seminoma. Using karyotyping, array CGH, marker immunostaining, microRNA profiling and imprinting analysis, the authors found germ cell features but absence of the characteristic seminoma chromosomal changes, such as 12p gain, and lack of OCT3/4 and NANOG expression. Molecular comparison showed the supposed primary tumor was not the cell line's origin. The authors conclude that JKT-1 is not representative of human seminoma, though a non-germ cell origin cannot be excluded.

pmid-17706482.summary_ja: 腹痛と腹囲増大を呈した16歳女児の大型嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤の症例。腹腔鏡下に摘出され、病理学的に卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。卵巣甲状腺腫は甲状腺組織が50%以上を占める稀な腫瘍で、通常は良性である。思春期女児の大きな嚢胞性卵巣腫瘤では本疾患を考慮すべきで、腹腔鏡手術が治療の選択であると結論している。
pmid-17706482.summary_en: This report describes a 16-year-old girl with abdominal pain and increasing girth who had a large cystic ovarian mass. Laparoscopic removal was performed, and histology confirmed struma ovarii, a rare tumor composed of at least 50% thyroid tissue. Although usually benign and most common in women aged 40 to 60, the authors emphasize that struma ovarii should be considered in adolescent girls with large cystic ovarian masses. They conclude that laparoscopy is the treatment of choice in this setting.

pmid-17707012.summary_ja: 小児の精巣腫瘤に対し、超音波検査で精巣温存手術の適応を判断できるか検討した後方視的研究。7例に核出術を行い、嚢胞性奇形腫4例、類上皮腫2例、単純性嚢胞1例であった。術後の精巣は左右対称で再発はなかった。一方、超音波検査は正常実質を過小評価しており、精巣温存の判断に術前の正常実質量を用いるべきではないと結論している。
pmid-17707012.summary_en: In children with testicular masses, the authors examined whether ultrasonography can guide testis-sparing surgery. Seven patients underwent enucleation, with final diagnoses of cystic teratoma (4), epidermoid tumor (2), and simple cyst (1). Postoperative examinations showed symmetrical testes and no recurrence. However, ultrasonography underestimated the normal residual parenchyma, which was compressed into a thin rim around the mass. The authors conclude that the amount of normal tissue seen on preoperative ultrasound should not determine eligibility for testis-sparing surgery.

pmid-17707269.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんは化学療法への感受性が高いが、血液脳関門が脳再発の障壁となり得るかを検討した研究。化学療法で無病となった後に脳のみに再発した5例を報告している。そのうち1例は初診時に予後良好群であった。完全寛解後でも中枢神経系に再発しうるため、精巣がんでも血液脳関門は重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17707269.summary_en: This paper asks whether the blood-brain barrier is relevant in metastatic germ cell tumors despite their high chemosensitivity. The authors describe five patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with chemotherapy who achieved disease-free status but later relapsed in the brain alone. One of these had initially good-risk disease by IGCCG criteria. The authors conclude that the blood-brain barrier is relevant in testicular cancer, so CNS relapse can occur even after complete remission.

pmid-17708751.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、米国の人種・民族別に精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率と診断時病期の推移を比較した研究。黒人やAPI/AIAN男性は白人より発生率が低かった。白人とAPI/AIANでは1989〜1993年頃までに増加が主で、黒人では後に増加した。ヒスパニック系白人は非ヒスパニック系白人より低く、セミノーマと非セミノーマの両方が増加した。一部の集団では流行がピークに達した可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17708751.summary_en: Using SEER registry data from 1973 to 2003, this study compared testicular germ cell tumor incidence and stage at diagnosis across racial and ethnic groups in the United States. Rates were lower among black and Asian/Pacific Islander/American Indian men than white men. Rates rose in white and API/AIAN men mainly before 1989 to 1993, while black men saw later increases. Among Hispanic white men, incidence was lower than non-Hispanic white men, though seminoma and nonseminoma rates both rose. The authors conclude the epidemic may have peaked in some groups.

pmid-17710660.summary_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症を有する小児に生じたディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の症例報告。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、CA125、β-hCGが高値であった。本疾患は小脳失調、免疫不全、放射線感受性を特徴とし、悪性腫瘍の発生率が高いことが背景にある。抄録では腫瘍の発生部位は明記されていない。
pmid-17710660.summary_en: This case report describes a child with ataxia-telangiectasia who developed a dysgerminoma. The patient had elevated alpha-fetoprotein, CA125, and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin levels and had been followed for ataxia-telangiectasia for two years. The report highlights the increased cancer risk associated with ataxia-telangiectasia, a recessive disorder with cerebellar ataxia, immunodeficiency and radiation sensitivity. The abstract does not specify the tumor's anatomical site.

pmid-17711512.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し化学療法後に再度行った後腹膜リンパ節郭清（再RPLND）54例の検討。再発部位は大血管後方・傍大動脈領域が多く、病理では分化型奇形腫が35%、悪性奇形腫（未分化型）が17%を占めた。再手術後の生存率は初回のみの症例と差がなかった。再発と再手術を避けるため、初回の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を慎重かつ完全に行うことが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-17711512.summary_en: This study reviews 54 repeat post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND) among 359 patients with metastatic testicular GCT. Recurrence sites were mainly para-aortic and retrocrural nodes, and pathology showed differentiated teratoma in 35% and undifferentiated malignant teratoma in 17%. Survival after repeat surgery was similar to that after a single primary RPLND. The authors conclude that a careful, complete initial RPLND is crucial to avoid recurrence and reoperation.

pmid-17718136.summary_ja: 38歳男性の胸骨腫瘤で、縦隔の肝様卵黄嚢腫瘍が胸骨および多発肺転移を伴っていた症例報告。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は60,000 IU/mLと著明に上昇し、他の原発巣は認められなかった。胸骨転移の穿刺吸引細胞診では肝様細胞の充実性増殖が認められ、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に肝様分化が確認された。細胞診と臨床像、腫瘍マーカーの組み合わせが初期診断に重要であると述べている。
pmid-17718136.summary_en: A 38-year-old man presented with a sternal mass and was found to have a mediastinal hepatoid yolk sac tumor with sternal and multiple lung metastases. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 60,000 IU/mL, and no other primary site was identified. Fine needle aspiration cytology of the sternal metastasis showed monotonous large polygonal hepatoid cells in solid sheets and trabeculae with endothelial entrapment, resembling hepatocellular carcinoma. Histology and immunohistochemistry confirmed hepatoid differentiation. The authors believe this sternal metastasis has not been reported before and emphasize that cytology combined with clinical features and tumor markers is crucial for initial diagnosis.

pmid-17721188.summary_ja: PTC様の組織像を示す悪性卵巣甲状腺腫6例と良性卵巣甲状腺腫9例を対象に、BRAF、RAS、RETの異常を解析した研究。悪性例6例中4例にBRAF変異（V600Eを含む）が認められ、良性例には認められなかった。RAS、RETの異常は両群ともになかった。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫は部位によらず乳頭状甲状腺癌と共通の発生機序を持つと考えられ、予後との関連は今後の検討課題とされている。
pmid-17721188.summary_en: Study of BRAF, RAS and RET alterations in six malignant struma ovarii with papillary thyroid carcinoma features and nine benign struma ovarii. BRAF mutations, including V600E, were found in four of six malignant cases and none of the benign ones. No RAS or RET alterations were detected in either group. The authors conclude that malignant struma ovarii shares BRAF-driven pathogenesis with thyroid PTC regardless of location, while the RET/RAS/RAF pathway is not involved in benign struma ovarii. Prognostic significance remains undetermined.

pmid-17721191.summary_ja: 縦隔、後腹膜、性腺に発生した肉腫成分を伴う胚細胞腫瘍46例（転移巣を含む）の臨床病理学的・免疫組織化学的検討。肉腫成分は胎児性横紋筋肉腫が最多であった。40例の追跡で32例が死亡または進行し、肉腫成分のない対照群より有意に予後不良であった。肉腫成分は性腺および性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍における予後不良の指標と結論づけられている。
pmid-17721191.summary_en: Clinicopathologic and immunohistochemical study of 46 germ cell tumors containing sarcomatous components, arising in mediastinum, retroperitoneum, or gonads, including metastases. Most sarcomatous elements were embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. Patients were treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and surgery. Among 40 with follow-up, 32 died or had progressive disease, and survival was significantly worse than in age- and stage-matched GCT controls without sarcomatous components. The authors conclude sarcomatous components are a poor prognostic sign.

pmid-17729204.summary_ja: 左上顎に発生した口腔咽頭奇形腫の死産児の症例報告です。妊娠40週5日の超音波検査で出生前に診断されました。新生児にとって高リスクであり、出生前診断は産科的管理と治療の最適化に重要であると述べられています。
pmid-17729204.summary_en: This case report describes a stillborn infant with an oropharyngeal teratoma of the left maxilla, diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound at 40 weeks and 5 days of gestation in a 33-year-old primigravida. Such teratomas arise from all three germ layers and carry high risk for the neonate, though recurrence is not typical. The authors describe the clinical course and histopathology. They stress that prenatal diagnosis is important for obstetric management and for optimal treatment of the affected newborn.

pmid-17760764.summary_ja: 両側同時性セミノーマを有する3例に対し、精巣を温存する治療を実施した結果を報告しています。大きい方の腫瘍に対する片側精巣摘除術の後、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法を3コース実施しました。全例で24~82か月の経過観察中に再発はなく、テストステロン値と性機能も保たれました。
pmid-17760764.summary_en: This report describes three patients with synchronous bilateral seminoma treated with a testis-preserving protocol. Unilateral orchiectomy of the larger tumor was followed by three courses of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy. All patients remained free of recurrence at 24 to 82 months. Serum testosterone stayed near the lower normal limit without androgen replacement, and sexual function was preserved. Sperm counts were maintained in the patient with oligospermia, while the two patients with azoospermia remained azoospermic. Quality of life was good in all patients.

pmid-17762576.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の管理に関する最新の知見をまとめた総説です。低リスク例の大半は単剤化学療法で治癒し、高リスク例では多剤併用療法が用いられます。薬剤耐性例ではパクリタキセル含有レジメンの忍容性が良好とされ、高リスク例の生存率は86%と報告されています。
pmid-17762576.summary_en: This review updates management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, the malignant end of the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum. Advances include genetic insights into its origin and a better understanding of hCG monitoring and the forms of hCG produced in cancer. Most low-risk patients are cured with single-agent chemotherapy, while high-risk disease is treated with combination regimens. For drug-resistant disease, paclitaxel-containing regimens appear better tolerated. Survival is now 86% in high-risk patients, though resistance remains a key challenge.

pmid-17768701.summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるc-KIT遺伝子変異と発現を解析した研究です。両側例では第17エクソンの変異が63.6%に認められ、片側例の6.4%より有意に高率でした。また、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍からセミノーマへの進展過程でc-KITの発現は低下しており、発症素因と進展の両方に関与することが示唆されています。
pmid-17768701.summary_en: This study examines c-KIT mutations in bilateral testicular germ cell tumours. Exon 17 mutations were found in 63.6% of bilateral cases compared with 6.4% of unilateral cases, suggesting that these mutations raise the risk of bilateral disease and may arise early in embryonic development. c-KIT expression was also significantly lower in seminomas than in adjacent intratubular neoplastic germ cells, indicating downregulation during progression. The findings link c-KIT alterations to both susceptibility and progression of testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-17785371.summary_ja: 本研究では、pT1からpT3までのセミノーマ、成人精巣、胎児精巣について、マイクロアレイ、RT-PCR、免疫組織化学のデータを比較し、精巣セミノーマの新規胚細胞マーカーを同定した。既知マーカーであるKIT、OCT4、NANOGはセミノーマで発現が上昇し、BOB1およびPROM1(CD133)も同様であった。セルトリ細胞関連因子のSCGFおよびMCFD2も腫瘍細胞で発現していた。マーカーの発現は腫瘍段階間で変化しなかった。著者らは、セミノーマが初期の前精原細胞、または発生期の胚細胞マーカーを再発現する精原細胞に由来する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-17785371.summary_en: This study identified novel germ cell markers in testicular seminoma by comparing microarray, RT-PCR and immunohistochemistry data across seminoma stages pT1 to pT3, adult testis, and fetal testis. Known markers KIT, OCT4 and NANOG were upregulated in seminoma, along with BOB1 and PROM1 (CD133). Sertoli-associated factors SCGF and MCFD2 were also expressed in tumor cells. Marker expression did not change between tumor stages. The authors suggest seminoma may originate from early gonocytes or from spermatogonia re-expressing developmental germ cell markers.

pmid-17827842.summary_ja: 慢性腎臓病の患者でセミノーマの脳転移に伴うたこつぼ型心筋症を発症した症例報告である。急性うっ血性心不全、ST上昇、左室壁運動低下を認めたが心筋酵素の上昇はなかった。適切な治療により心機能および心電図異常は改善した。胚細胞腫瘍の転移に関連する稀な心合併症として示された。
pmid-17827842.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with chronic kidney disease who developed tako-tsubo cardiomyopathy associated with brain metastasis of seminoma. The patient presented with acute congestive heart failure, ST-segment elevation and left ventricular dysfunction despite normal cardiac enzymes. Echocardiography showed severe hypokinesis to akinesis of anterior and apical walls with basal hyperkinesis. With proper treatment, the wall motion and electrocardiographic abnormalities greatly improved. The case highlights an uncommon cardiac complication of metastatic germ cell tumor.

pmid-17844700.summary_ja: 65歳の閉経後女性が左側の腹痛で受診し、下行結腸に癒着する腹腔内腫瘤が認められた。開腹術で大網への播種を伴う腫瘍が確認された。病理組織学的に、毛髪や皮脂を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、高分化から低分化に至る扁平上皮癌、大網への転移が認められた。後腹膜原発成熟奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が発生した症例である。
pmid-17844700.summary_en: A 65-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with left-sided abdominal pain and a large intra-abdominal mass adherent to the descending colon. Laparotomy revealed a mesenteric tumor with omental deposits. Histopathology showed mature cystic teratoma containing hair and sebaceous material, with a spectrum of well- to poorly differentiated squamous cell carcinoma and omental metastasis. The case illustrates squamous cell carcinoma arising from a primary retroperitoneal mature teratoma.

pmid-17844714.summary_ja: 72歳男性が難治性の心窩部痛を訴え、数か月間慢性膵炎として治療されていた。胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で縦隔腫瘤が発見され、原発性縦隔胎児性癌と診断された。通常は20～50歳代に好発する本疾患が高齢者にも生じうることを示した。慢性の心窩部痛の鑑別診断に縦隔腫瘍を含める必要性が強調されている。
pmid-17844714.summary_en: A 72-year-old man presented with prolonged, intractable epigastric pain and was treated for chronic pancreatitis for several months. A chest CT scan eventually revealed a mediastinal mass, which was diagnosed as primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma. The authors note that this aggressive tumor, typically seen in patients aged 20 to 50 years with pulmonary or pressure-related symptoms, can present in older adults. They emphasize including mediastinal tumors in the differential diagnosis of chronic epigastric pain.

pmid-17847753.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を示唆する所見のない後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍の2例を報告する。絨毛癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の患者で、精巣超音波検査では右精巣に異常を認めた。右精巣摘除術により、成熟奇形腫と精細管内悪性胚細胞が確認された。後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍が原発か、精巣がんからの転移かを考察している。
pmid-17847753.summary_en: This report describes two patients with primary retroperitoneal germ cell tumors: a 21-year-old with choriocarcinoma and an 18-year-old with yolk sac tumor. Neither had clinical evidence of a testicular tumor. Testicular ultrasound showed right testicular abnormalities, and orchiectomy revealed mature teratoma with intratubular malignant germ cells. The authors discuss whether retroperitoneal germ cell tumors are primary or metastases from a viable or burned-out testicular cancer.

pmid-17848256.summary_ja: 空腸から発生した先天性未熟奇形腫の1例を報告する。著者らによれば、小腸奇形腫は英文文献でこれまで報告がない。本論文では、この希少な腸管病変の病態生理学的特徴と臨床経過を考察している。発生部位の希少性から、症例報告として位置づけられている。
pmid-17848256.summary_en: The authors report a congenital immature teratoma arising from the jejunum. They note that small bowel teratoma has not previously been described in the English literature. The paper discusses the pathophysiologic features of this rare intestinal lesion and its clinical course, presenting the case as a first description of this site of origin.

pmid-17848741.summary_ja: 米国の長期精巣がん生存者143例（平均フォローアップ8.4年）を対象に、白金製剤化学療法後の心血管合併症を検討した。白金製剤群では高血圧が増加したが、未診断の高血圧で補正すると消失した。高脂血症は両群で全国推定値より高かった。未診断の高血圧と高脂血症が重要な交絡因子であると結論づけている。
pmid-17848741.summary_en: This study of 143 long-term American testicular cancer survivors (mean follow-up 8.4 years) examines cardiovascular and other complications associated with platinum-based chemotherapy. Hypertension rose from baseline in the platinum-treated group, but this increase disappeared after adjustment for undiagnosed hypertension. Hyperlipidemia rates exceeded national estimates in both groups, and coronary artery disease was more frequent with platinum plus radiation, though not significantly. The authors conclude that undiagnosed hypertension and hyperlipidemia are important confounders.

pmid-17851279.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍データベースから抽出した40歳以上の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者93例を対象に、年齢による予後への影響を評価した。50歳以上の群は限局性疾患が少なく、初回化学療法の完全奏効率が低く、治療中の病勢進行率が高かった。多変量解析では、進行期が生存に関する唯一の独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-17851279.summary_en: This study examines how age affects prognosis in 93 patients aged 40 and over with testicular germ cell tumor, drawn from a germ cell tumor database. Patients were grouped as 40 to 44, 45 to 49, and 50 and over. Patients aged 50 and over were less often localized, had lower complete response rates to initial chemotherapy, and had higher progression rates during treatment. Advanced stage was the only independent prognostic factor for survival in multivariate analysis.

pmid-17868483.summary_ja: 非妊娠女性で血清β-hCGが上昇する原因を総説し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患、卵巣や末梢の胚細胞腫瘍、婦人科以外のがんを挙げる。病態によってhCGの型は異なり、治療効果の指標にもなり得る。肩の紡錘細胞型骨肉腫の症例では、化学療法後にβ-hCGが検出されなくなったことを示す。
pmid-17868483.summary_en: This review examines elevated serum beta-hCG in nonpregnant women, which can reflect gestational trophoblastic disease, ovarian or peripheral germ cell tumors, or nongynecologic cancers. The hCG type may differ across conditions, and levels can serve as a marker of treatment success. A 26-year-old woman with spindle cell osteosarcoma illustrates this, with beta-hCG becoming undetectable after chemotherapy.

pmid-17873381.summary_ja: 本総説は、幹細胞生物学の観点から精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子病態を検討している。胎児の胚細胞はNANOG、SOX2、OCT4などの多能性因子を発現しており、著者らは生殖系列特異的な阻害因子の喪失により胚細胞が癌幹細胞へ変換される可能性を提案している。ヒト胚性幹細胞研究と動物モデルの知見をもとに、胚細胞腫瘍の発生と幹細胞生物学の関連を論じている。
pmid-17873381.summary_en: This review examines the molecular pathogenesis of testicular germ cell tumors through the lens of stem cell biology. Fetal germ cells express the pluripotency factors NANOG, SOX2, and OCT4, and the authors propose that loss of germ line-specific inhibitors may convert germ cells into cancer stem cells. Drawing on human embryonic stem cell research and animal models, the paper links germ cell tumorigenesis with stem cell biology.

pmid-17874544.summary_ja: 1年以上精液を凍結保存した163例を後方視的に検討し、うち72例は胚細胞腫瘍患者だった。保存精子を実際に使用したのは少数で、多くは造精機能の回復後に廃棄された。治療後に精液検査を受けた例では、精巣がん患者の20.9%で造精機能が回復していなかった。化学療法前の凍結保存を推奨し、長期保存体制の整備を求める。
pmid-17874544.summary_en: The authors retrospectively reviewed 163 patients who cryopreserved semen for at least one year, including 72 with germ cell tumors. Few patients used their stored sperm, and most specimens were discarded after spermatogenesis recovered. Among patients tested after treatment, 20.9% with testicular cancer and 57.9% with hematologic cancer had not recovered spermatogenesis. The authors recommend pre-treatment cryopreservation and call for long-term storage systems.

pmid-17874549.summary_ja: セミノーマで後腹膜リンパ節転移を生じ、放射線療法とシスプラチン化学療法を受けた44歳男性の症例である。両側尿管狭窄に対して留置ステントが行われた。15年後、ステント交換時に左尿管と腹部大動脈の瘻孔が生じ、大量出血が疑われた。瘻孔閉鎖、尿管結紮、腎瘻造設で救命した。長期経過後の重大な合併症として注意を喚起する。
pmid-17874549.summary_en: A 44-year-old man treated for seminoma with retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis by radiation therapy and cisplatin chemotherapy developed bilateral ureteral stenosis requiring indwelling stents. Fifteen years later, a left ureter-abdominal aortic fistula formed during stent exchange, causing hematuria and a risk of massive bleeding. Surgical closure, ureteral ligation, and nephrostomy were performed. The authors highlight uretero-arterial fistula as a serious late complication.

pmid-17875493.summary_ja: 性分化疾患(DSD)における胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを総説した論文。Y染色体GBY領域とTSPY遺伝子が悪性転化に関与し、前駆病変は上皮内癌(CIS)や性腺芽腫とされる。OCT3/4とTSPYの二重免疫組織化学と形態・臨床情報を組み合わせ、過剰診断や不必要な性腺摘出を避ける個別化管理の必要性を提案する。
pmid-17875493.summary_en: This review examines tumor risk in disorders of sex development (DSD), focusing on germ cell tumor development in patients with hypovirilization or gonadal dysgenesis. The GBY region of the Y chromosome is a prerequisite for malignant transformation, with TSPY a likely candidate gene. Precursor lesions include carcinoma in situ and gonadoblastoma, with undifferentiated gonadal tissue proposed as a gonadoblastoma precursor. OCT3/4 markers may cause overdiagnosis because of delayed germ cell maturation in DSD gonads, risking unnecessary gonadectomy. The authors propose combining histology, OCT3/4 and TSPY double immunohistochemistry, and clinical parameters to guide individualized management.

pmid-17877681.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫由来の扁平上皮癌14例の症例集積。悪性転化は類皮嚢腫の1〜2%と稀で、成熟奇形腫より高齢で発症し、術前診断が困難であった。化学療法・放射線療法の役割は不明確であり、再発時の反復外科的切除が選択例で長期的な奏効をもたらす可能性が示唆された。
pmid-17877681.summary_en: This descriptive case series reviews 14 women with squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian dermoid cysts diagnosed between 1989 and 2006. Malignant transformation occurs in only 1 to 2 percent of cases. Patients presented at an older age than those with mature teratoma, and preoperative diagnosis was difficult. No reliable diagnostic or prognostic indicators were identified, and the role of chemotherapy and radiotherapy remained unclear. The authors describe their experience with surgery and suggest that repeated surgical resection at relapse may give durable responses in selected women.

pmid-17880687.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞モデルである胎児性癌細胞において、核内受容体コリプレッサーRIP140がレチノイン酸(RA)標的遺伝子を選択的に制御することを検討した。RIP140はRA依存性遺伝子の約半数にのみ作用し、主にRAシグナルと分化を抑制していた。RIP140をサイレンシングすると低用量RAへの感受性が高まり、分化療法の増強標的となる可能性が示された。
pmid-17880687.summary_en: This study examines the corepressor RIP140 in retinoic acid (RA)-induced differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma cells, a stem cell model of testicular germ cell tumors. Microarray analysis showed that RIP140 regulated only about half of RA-dependent genes, mainly limiting RA signaling and tumor cell differentiation. Silencing RIP140 sensitized embryonal carcinoma cells to low-dose RA. The authors conclude that RIP140 shapes RA-mediated gene expression in this cancer stem cell model and may be a target for enhancing retinoid-based differentiation therapy.

pmid-17883088.summary_ja: 喀血と上大静脈症候群で発症した18歳男性の症例報告。精巣腫瘤は当初血瘤腫と診断されていた。組織学的に絨毛癌様病変を伴う未熟奇形腫と判明し、局所でβhCGが部分的に陽性であった。肺穿刺で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の転移が確認され、遠隔転移で発症した精巣腫瘤の診断の落とし穴を示す。
pmid-17883088.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old man who presented with hemoptysis and superior vena cava syndrome. A testicular mass had previously been diagnosed as hematocele. Histology showed an immature teratoma with a choriocarcinoma-like lesion, a rare association in testicular tumours, with focal beta-hCG positivity. Lung aspiration revealed metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumour. The case highlights the diagnostic pitfalls of testicular masses that first present with distant metastases.

pmid-17883093.summary_ja: 生後3か月の乳児の後腹膜に発生し、結腸ループを含む成熟奇形腫の症例報告。腸管の臓器様分化を伴う奇形腫は稀で、卵巣や仙尾部での報告が多いとされる。臨床・画像・病理所見を記載し、後腹膜という稀な部位と結腸様の臓器分化を強調している。
pmid-17883093.summary_en: This case report describes the clinical, radiological and pathological findings in a three-month-old child with a retroperitoneal teratoma containing colonic loops. Teratomas showing organoid intestinal development are rare, and such cases are mostly described in the ovary and sacrococcygeal region. The authors highlight the unusual retroperitoneal location and the colonic organoid differentiation of this mature teratoma.

pmid-17883144.summary_ja: 稀な妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の症例報告。絨毛性腫瘍全体の2%未満を占める。自然流産後に発生した症例で、腫瘍内に絨毛が存在していた点が特徴的である。非絨毛性トロホブラスト由来の腫瘍であることから、中間型トロホブラストの過剰な活性が重要な診断所見であると強調している。
pmid-17883144.summary_en: This case report describes placental site trophoblastic tumour (PSTT), a rare gestational trophoblastic neoplasm accounting for under 2% of cases. The tumour can arise after normal pregnancy, molar pregnancy, or spontaneous abortion, sometimes many years later. The authors emphasise that excessive intermediate trophoblastic activity is the key diagnostic feature, even when chorionic villi are present within the lesion. The case is notable because it followed a spontaneous abortion, an uncommon antecedent, and showed villi despite the tumour's non-villous origin.

pmid-17884151.summary_ja: 薬剤耐性絨毛癌細胞に対し、アデノウイルスによるPUMA発現(Ad-PUMA)が化学療法薬への感受性を回復させるかを検討した。in vitroおよびin vivoで、Ad-PUMAはアポトーシスを介して腫瘍増殖を抑制した。耐性細胞ではAd-PUMAとVP16の併用で阻害効果が顕著に増強され、PUMAは薬剤耐性絨毛癌の感受性増強因子として有用と結論づけている。
pmid-17884151.summary_en: This study examined whether adenoviral PUMA expression (Ad-PUMA) can restore chemosensitivity in drug-resistant choriocarcinoma cells (JEG-3/VP16) and their parental line. Ad-PUMA suppressed growth through apoptosis both in vitro and in xenografts. Combining Ad-PUMA with 5-FU, VP16, or methotrexate markedly lowered IC50 values in resistant cells, far more than in parental cells. In vivo, VP16 plus Ad-PUMA raised tumour inhibition in the resistant model from 14.57% to 78.93%. The authors conclude that PUMA may serve as a chemosensitizer for drug-resistant choriocarcinoma.

pmid-17893849.summary_ja: 本研究では、II型およびIII型の胚細胞腫瘍(69検体、重複測定)および細胞株を対象に、156種のマイクロRNAについて定量的PCRによるハイスループットスクリーニングを実施した。以前報告されたmiR-371-373クラスターの知見が確認された。生体内検体は染色体異常ではなく成熟度によってクラスター化し、正常な胚発生に類似していた。正常精巣はセミノーマおよび精母細胞性セミノーマより高いレベルで識別的miRNAを発現しており、分化した非セミノーマでは過剰発現していた。これらの知見は、miRNAが腫瘍内に保持された幹細胞の分化を調節していることを示唆している。
pmid-17893849.summary_en: This study performed high-throughput quantitative PCR screening of 156 microRNAs across type II and III germ cell tumours (69 samples, in duplicate) and cell lines. The previously reported miR-371-373 cluster was confirmed. In vivo samples clustered by maturation status, paralleling normal embryogenesis, rather than by chromosomal anomalies. Normal testis expressed discriminating miRNAs at higher levels than seminomas and spermatocytic seminomas, and differentiated non-seminomas overexpressed them. The findings suggest miRNAs regulate stem cell differentiation retained in these tumours.

pmid-17905939.summary_ja: 本総説は、自然発生的にヒト乳児の奇形腫に類似したI型精巣胚細胞腫瘍を生じる129/Ter系マウスを用いた胚細胞腫瘍発生を概説する。この系統は、原始生殖細胞の生存と遊走に必須のdead-end(Dnd1)遺伝子に不活化変異を有する。著者らは、Dnd1の機能を解明し胚細胞および腫瘍の発生における役割を明らかにするための進行中の研究を紹介している。また、この系統で腫瘍発生率が高い遺伝学的背景の概要も示している。
pmid-17905939.summary_en: This review summarises germ-cell tumour development using the 129/Ter mouse strain, which spontaneously develops type I testicular germ-cell tumours resembling human infant teratomas. The strain carries an inactivating mutation in the dead-end (Dnd1) gene, which is essential for primordial germ cell survival and migration. The authors outline ongoing studies on Dnd1 function to clarify its role in germ-cell and tumour development. It provides an overview of the genetic basis for the high tumour incidence in this strain.

pmid-17906201.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた532例を解析しました。生存腫瘍または奇形腫を認めた269例のうち、テンプレート範囲外の後腹膜病変は7%から32%でみられました。残存腫瘤径が大きいほど範囲外転移の頻度は高くなり、著者らは両側郭清が妥当であると結論しています。
pmid-17906201.summary_en: This single-institution series of 532 men who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for metastatic NSGCT assessed disease outside modified template boundaries. Of 269 patients with viable GCT or teratoma, 7% to 32% had extratemplate retroperitoneal disease, depending on template definition.
