Extratemplate metastasis rose with residual mass size, reaching 25% to 29% for masses over 2 cm. The authors conclude that bilateral RPLND is a prudent approach.

pmid-17911198.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの若年男性患者が、化学療法の第2コース中に急性前壁心筋梗塞を発症した症例を報告しています。冠動脈疾患の明らかな危険因子はなく、化学療法レジメンが原因と考えられました。胚細胞腫瘍の標準治療に伴う心血管毒性への注意と、化学療法中の心機能評価の重要性を示しています。
pmid-17911198.summary_en: The authors report a 27-year-old man with testicular seminoma who developed an acute anterior myocardial infarction during the second course of combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin. He had no significant coronary risk factors, so the infarction was likely attributed to the chemotherapy regimen. The case highlights cardiovascular toxicity as a potential complication of standard germ cell tumour treatment in young men. It underscores the need for cardiac monitoring during chemotherapy.

pmid-17911410.summary_ja: 本総説は、成人精巣で最も多いII型のヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍について検討する。上皮内癌とセミノーマ細胞はOCT3/4およびNANOGを発現し、胎児性癌はSOX2も発現しており、いずれも多能性関連因子である。奇形腫を除く大部分の組織学的成分はシスプラチン併用化学療法に感受性があることが論じられている。また、野生型p53の保持におけるmiR-371-373クラスターの役割も検討している。著者らは、これらの腫瘍は悪性化した原始生殖細胞に由来する胚性癌であると提唱している。
pmid-17911410.summary_en: This review examines human testicular germ-cell tumours, focusing on type II tumours, which are the most common in adult testes. It describes how carcinoma in situ and seminoma cells express OCT3/4 and NANOG, while embryonal carcinoma also expresses SOX2, all pluripotency-related factors. The authors discuss the sensitivity of most histological elements to cisplatin-based chemotherapy and the role of the miR-371-373 cluster in preserving wild-type p53. They propose that these tumours are embryonic cancers arising from malignant primordial germ cells.

pmid-17912088.summary_ja: 口唇口蓋裂と鼻柱洞の異常を伴う、鼻咽頭部の高分化型奇形腫を有する女児新生児の症例を報告しています。8×5×7cmの軟らかい腫瘤が気道を閉塞し、経口哺乳を妨げていました。奇形腫は小児で最も多い性腺外胚細胞腫瘍であり、頭頸部は乳児期の好発部位の第2位です。術後の合併症はありませんでした。
pmid-17912088.summary_en: The authors describe a female neonate with a well-differentiated teratoma of the nasopharyngeal area, accompanied by bilateral cleft lip and palate and a columellar sinus. The 8 x 5 x 7 cm soft mass blocked the airway and prevented oral feeding. Histology showed a teratoma, which is the most common extragonadal germ cell tumour of childhood. The authors note that head and neck teratomas are the second most common site in early infancy. The patient recovered without postoperative complications.

pmid-17913046.summary_ja: MDアンダーソンがんセンターにおける病院ベースの症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例144例と対照86例を比較しました。妊娠初期の重度の悪心はリスク上昇と関連し（OR 2.0）、交絡因子の調整後も同程度でした。著者らは、子宮内エストロゲン曝露仮説を支持する結果と解釈しています。
pmid-17913046.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study at MD Anderson Cancer Center examined maternal and perinatal factors as risk factors for testicular germ cell cancer in 144 cases and 86 matched controls. Severe first-trimester nausea was associated with elevated risk (OR 2.0; 95% CI 1.0-3.9), which remained similar after adjustment. Preterm delivery and abnormal birth weights showed nonsignificant increases. The authors interpret these findings as supporting the in utero estrogen exposure hypothesis.

pmid-17916870.summary_ja: 北欧男性で増加している精巣がんの総説です。生存率は過去一世代で大きく改善しました。病理組織型(セミノーマ/非セミノーマ)と病期に応じて、化学療法、放射線療法、手術、監視療法を組み合わせて治療します。長期生存者の治療毒性低減と、治療抵抗性例の課題が強調されています。
pmid-17916870.summary_en: This review summarizes testis cancer, which is rising in northern European men but with markedly improved survival over the past generation. It discusses possible environmental and estrogen-related etiologies, the seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes, and standard management: radical inguinal orchidectomy followed by histology- and stage-directed chemotherapy, radiotherapy, surgery, or surveillance. The authors highlight reducing treatment toxicity in long-term survivors and the ongoing challenge of treatment-refractory disease.

pmid-17918286.summary_ja: 大量化学療法と自家造血幹細胞移植を受けた胚細胞腫瘍44例を解析し、17例で治療失敗が確認されました。再発後の中央生存期間は、さらなる治療を受けた14例で約6か月でした。単一部位に限局した再発で全身療法と手術または放射線療法を併用した例で予後が比較的良好で、持続する完全奏効例もありました。
pmid-17918286.summary_en: This analysis of 44 germ cell tumor patients who underwent high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell transplantation identified 17 treatment failures. Fourteen received further treatment, with median survival of 6 months after relapse. Patients with relapse confined to a single site who received combined systemic therapy plus surgery or radiotherapy had the best prospects, and several achieved durable complete response. The authors conclude that such patients may benefit from further treatment.

pmid-17918296.summary_ja: 27歳男性に生じた同時性両側セミノーマの症例報告です。両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の頻度は約0.5〜7%と稀で、大半は異時性とされます。組織病理学的診断が治療と予後判断に重要であることを論じ、関連文献を簡潔にレビューしています。両側例では組織型の正確な把握が治療計画に欠かせないことも示しています。
pmid-17918296.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with synchronous bilateral seminoma, a rare presentation since bilateral testicular germ cell tumors occur in only about 0.5 to 7 percent of cases, and most are metachronous. The authors discuss how histopathological diagnosis informs therapy and prognosis and briefly review the related literature. The case highlights the importance of accurate histology in planning treatment for bilateral disease.

pmid-17918540.summary_ja: 新生児の頭蓋底・硬口蓋から発生し口腔内へ突出した巨大エピグナトス奇形腫の症例報告です。経口蓋的内視鏡下経鼻アプローチにより外切開なしで完全切除されました。病理学的には卵黄嚢成分を伴う未熟奇形腫で、1年後も再発と神経学的異常はみられていません。
pmid-17918540.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a giant epignathus teratoma arising from the skull base and hard palate and protruding into the oral cavity. The tumor was completely resected through a transpalatal endoscopic endonasal approach without external incisions. Pathology showed an immature teratoma with well-differentiated yolk sac elements. At one-year follow-up there was no recurrence, and the child remained neurologically intact, supporting this approach in a preterm infant.

pmid-17921970.summary_ja: 本総説は、現在95%を超える治癒率を有する精巣胚細胞腫瘍の保存的治療に焦点を当てる。ブレオマイシンの除外やカルボプラチンへの置換といった治療強度を下げた試験の失敗から得られた教訓と、救済療法改善の必要性を論じている。また、良好リスク転移例の治療を3サイクルに短縮すること、病期I期セミノーマに1日間のカルボプラチンを放射線療法の代わりに用いること、対側の二次胚細胞がんが72%減少したことも取り上げている。さらに、臓器温存を目指した試験の目的についても述べている。
pmid-17921970.summary_en: This review focuses on conservative management of testicular germ cell tumors, which now have cure rates above 95 percent. It discusses lessons from failed trials of less intensive regimens that omitted bleomycin or substituted carboplatin, highlighting the need for better salvage therapy. It also covers shortening good-risk metastatic treatment to three cycles and using one-day carboplatin instead of radiotherapy for stage I seminoma, a 72 percent reduction in contralateral second germ cell cancers, and the aim of organ-preserving trials.

pmid-17923185.summary_ja: 9か月の女児が腹部腫瘤で受診した。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で奇形腫が疑われ、手術では胆嚢由来の未熟奇形腫と腹膜神経膠腫症が見つかったが、両側卵巣は正常であった。胆嚢に発生した奇形腫は極めて稀であり、本症例はその症例報告である。
pmid-17923185.summary_en: A 9-month-old girl presented with an abdominal mass. Preoperative CT suggested a teratoma. At surgery, an immature teratoma arising from the gallbladder was found together with gliomatosis peritonei, while both ovaries were intact. This is described as a rare case of teratoma originating in the gallbladder, a site not typically associated with germ cell tumors, and associated with gliomatosis peritonei.

pmid-17923202.summary_ja: Swyer症候群の女性8例を対象に、超音波検査、ホルモン・遺伝学的検査、両側性腺摘除後の組織学的解析を行った。6例に性腺腫瘍(性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、またはその合併)が見つかった。46,XY性腺異形成では腫瘍化リスクが高いため、両側性腺摘除が推奨される。
pmid-17923202.summary_en: Eight females with Swyer syndrome (46,XY gonadal dysgenesis), aged 13 to 18 years, were studied. Ultrasound, hormonal and genetic testing, and histology after bilateral gonadectomy were performed. Gonadal tumors were found in six patients, including gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma, and combined forms. Some gonadoblastomas were hormonally active, and one masked dysgenesis. The authors recommend bilateral gonadectomy in 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis because of high neoplastic risk.

pmid-17939602.summary_ja: インドネシアの1施設で組織学的に確定した侵入奇胎27例を横断的に検討した。約7割が完全奇胎に先行し、3分の2で穿孔がみられ、3例が死亡した。96%で外科的治療が行われ、大半は子宮摘出術であった。経産婦で奇胎歴があり転化期間が短い場合は侵入奇胎を疑うべきとしている。
pmid-17939602.summary_en: A cross-sectional study of 27 histologically confirmed invasive mole cases at Hasan Sadikin Hospital, Indonesia. Most were preceded by complete mole. Perforation occurred in two-thirds of patients, with three deaths. Ultrasound was diagnostically useful but needs further study. Surgery was performed in 96%, mostly hysterectomy. Two patients developed metastases and both survived. The authors suggest suspecting invasive mole in multiparous patients with prior mole and a short transformation period.

pmid-17941495.summary_ja: 生後4日の女児の成熟型仙尾部奇形腫が、22か月後に卵黄嚢腫瘍として再発し、硬膜外脊髄転移を生じた。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は68,000 ng/mlに達した。椎弓切除術、化学療法、自家造血幹細胞救助を伴う大量化学療法を行い、AFPは1.3 ng/mlまで低下し筋力も改善した。仙尾部奇形腫の卵黄嚢腫瘍への再発と脊柱管圧迫は初の報告である。
pmid-17941495.summary_en: A 4-day-old girl with a mature sacrococcygeal teratoma recurred 22 months later as an endodermal sinus tumor with epidural spinal metastases, causing abdominal pain, urinary retention and gait difficulty. Her AFP reached 68,000 ng/ml. Treatment included laminectomy, subtotal resection, four cycles of chemotherapy, and then two tandem courses of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell rescue. AFP fell to 1.3 ng/ml and strength improved. The authors report the first such recurrence with spinal canal compromise.

pmid-17942145.summary_ja: 転移性hCG産生腫瘍の女性42例を対象に、マイクロサテライト遺伝子型解析で妊娠由来か非妊娠由来かを判定した。24例は妊娠由来、14例は非妊娠由来、4例は結論不能であった。遺伝学的結果が治療方針を変えた5症例を提示し、非典型例での遺伝学的検査の有用性を示した。本研究は1994～2005年の専門施設の症例に基づく。
pmid-17942145.summary_en: This study assessed whether molecular genetic analysis can distinguish gestational from non-gestational origin in women with metastatic hCG-producing tumours. Fluorescent microsatellite genotyping was applied to 42 atypical cases treated at a major gestational trophoblastic tumour centre between 1994 and 2005. Twenty-four were gestational, 14 non-gestational, and four inconclusive. Five illustrative cases showed how genetic results altered management decisions, supporting genetic testing for atypical hCG-producing malignancies.

pmid-17947845.summary_ja: Y染色体由来物質を有するターナー症候群の12歳女児の症例報告である。一側に多嚢胞性卵巣、対側の索状性腺に性腺芽細胞腫を認めた。思春期前に腹腔鏡下性腺摘出術を行い、良好な経過を得た。Y染色体物質を有する例では性腺摘出の時期の検討が重要である。
pmid-17947845.summary_en: A 12-year-old girl with Turner syndrome and Y-chromosome material, treated with growth hormone, developed a polycystic ovary and, in the contralateral streak gonad, a gonadoblastoma. Laparoscopic gonadectomy was performed at prepubertal age with a good prognosis. The authors highlight the rarity of precocious polycystic ovary in Turner syndrome and the value of timely gonadectomy when Y-chromosome material is present, since such patients carry a risk of dysgerminoma.

pmid-17948094.summary_ja: 失神を呈した若年女性が、乳び心膜液による心タンポナーデを発症していた。原因は成熟型で良性の前縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫であった。奇形腫が乳び心膜を生じ心タンポナーデに至った初例と報告されている。乳び心膜液の鑑別として奇形腫を考慮すべきことを示している。
pmid-17948094.summary_en: A young woman presented with syncope and cardiac tamponade caused by chylous pericardial effusion. The cause was a mature, benign anterior mediastinal cystic teratoma. Although pericardial effusions from anterior mediastinal cystic teratomas have been reported previously, this is described as the first case of a teratoma causing chylopericardium that presented as tamponade. The report emphasises that teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of chylous pericardial effusion with tamponade.

pmid-17948916.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者236例のうち41例（17%）が化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清で生存腫瘍を認めた。これらの患者の44%が再発し、29%が原病死した。術前αフェトプロテイン(AFP)5.3ng/mL超や中間・不良リスク分類が不良転帰の予測因子であった。再発リスクの高い患者を同定する指標を提示している。
pmid-17948916.summary_en: In 236 patients undergoing postchemotherapy RPLND for testicular cancer, 41 (17%) had viable tumour. Over a median follow-up of 3.9 years, 44% recurred and 29% died of disease. Recurrence was associated with larger retroperitoneal masses and less frequent adjuvant chemotherapy. Intermediate or poor IGCCC risk, preoperative AFP above 5.3 ng/mL, and postoperative recurrence predicted poorer outcomes, helping identify patients at risk of progression when viable tumour is found at surgery.

pmid-17949524.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍302例を後方視的に検討し、PEB療法のエトポシド用量（500と360mg/m2）を比較した。高用量群は再発率が低く（3%対29%）、全生存率も良好であった。再発例ではパクリタキセル含有救援化学療法で死亡が少なかった。IGCCCのリスク分布は概ね一致した。
pmid-17949524.summary_en: This retrospective review of 302 patients with metastatic germ cell tumours treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy compared etoposide doses of 500 and 360 mg/m2 in PEB regimens. The higher-dose group had markedly lower relapse (3% versus 29%) and better overall survival. Among relapsed patients, paclitaxel-containing salvage regimens were associated with substantially fewer deaths. Risk distribution at this tertiary centre was largely comparable to the IGCCC, though intermediate-risk non-seminoma patients differed.

pmid-17949969.summary_ja: 1970年以降のオランダ南部における精巣がん死亡率の推移を、治療と生存率の変化と照らし合わせて解析した。死亡率は1979～1986年に低下後横ばいとなった。10年相対生存率はセミノーマで81%から95%、非セミノーマで54%から92%へ改善した。死亡率低下は生存率向上で十分説明されると結論づけた。
pmid-17949969.summary_en: Mortality from testicular cancer in the southern Netherlands was analysed alongside treatment patterns and relative survival since 1970. Mortality fell in 1979 to 1986 and then plateaued. Treatment remained guideline-concordant over time. Ten-year relative survival for seminoma rose from 81% to 95%, and for non-seminoma from 54% to 92%. The authors conclude that the decline in mortality is well explained by improved survival driven by treatment advances.

pmid-17951198.summary_ja: モノクローナル抗体D2-40を用い、122例の腫瘍でポドプラニン発現を検討した。セミノーマの全病巣は強いびまん性膜染色を示したが、他の胚細胞腫瘍成分は限局的な染色にとどまった。非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性例はまれであった。びまん性膜染色はセミノーマに対して高感度かつ特異的であり、鑑別診断に有用である。
pmid-17951198.summary_en: Using monoclonal antibody D2-40, the study examined podoplanin expression in 122 tumours: primary and metastatic germ cell tumours, metastatic melanomas, carcinomas, and lymphomas. All seminoma foci showed strong diffuse membranous staining, whereas other germ cell components stained only focally. Among non-germ cell tumours, staining was rare. Diffuse membranous D2-40 reactivity is therefore highly sensitive and specific for seminoma and can support its diagnosis in the differential diagnosis of poorly differentiated epithelioid malignancies.

pmid-17964956.summary_ja: ステージ1の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するサーベイランス戦略を扱った総説。治療後の長期的な副作用への認識から人気が高まっている。画像検査、特にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)が中心的な役割を果たす。非セミノーマ性GCTの試験を受け、画像検査頻度の低減が示唆されている。
pmid-17964956.summary_en: This review addresses surveillance as a management strategy for stage 1 testicular germ cell tumour, which is gaining popularity because of recognized long-term treatment side effects. Imaging, particularly computed tomography, is central to surveillance protocols. Recent trials in non-seminomatous GCT support less frequent imaging, but the authors state that further studies are needed for seminoma and to evaluate MRI as an alternative to abdominal CT.

pmid-17970049.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍、IGCNU、正常精巣を対象に遺伝子発現を網羅的に解析し、126例の組織マイクロアレイで免疫組織化学を行った研究。CD9、PODXL、CENPAがIGCNU、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で同定された。SOX2とNodal経路は胎児性癌のみで上昇しており、進展経路の違いが示唆された。
pmid-17970049.summary_en: This study used global gene expression profiling of invasive testicular germ cell tumors, intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified (IGCNU) and normal testes, followed by immunohistochemistry on a tissue microarray of 126 tumors. RAS-related genes and embryonic stem cell markers were overexpressed in IGCNU. CD9, PODXL and CENPA were identified as markers in IGCNU, seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. SOX2 and Nodal pathway targets were upregulated only in embryonal carcinoma, suggesting distinct routes of progression from IGCNU.

pmid-17977177.summary_ja: 自然破裂した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を2週間以上放置した結果、1年間持続する化学性腹膜炎を生じた症例報告です。ステロイドと免疫抑制性代謝拮抗薬による治療を要しました。破裂が疑われる場合は速やかな手術と、流出した嚢腫液の除去が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-17977177.summary_en: This case report describes a spontaneously ruptured ovarian mature cystic teratoma that was left untreated for more than two weeks, leading to chemical peritonitis lasting one year. The peritonitis required corticosteroid and immunosuppressive antimetabolite therapy. The authors conclude that suspected spontaneous rupture of an ovarian cyst requires immediate surgery and prompt removal of spilled cyst fluid to prevent prolonged peritonitis.

pmid-17986128.summary_ja: 無症状の45歳女性で、健診のCTにより前縦隔腫瘍と周囲のすりガラス影が見つかった症例報告です。胸腔鏡手術で破裂した類皮嚢腫が確認され、内容物は右肺実質へ浸潤していました。術後合併症はなく、10か月後も再発はみられていません。嚢胞性奇形腫は通常良性ですが、肺へ破裂した場合は緊急手術が必要と強調しています。
pmid-17986128.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old asymptomatic woman in whom routine assessment revealed an anterior mediastinal tumor with peripheral ground-glass opacity on CT. Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery showed a ruptured dermoid cyst whose contents had infiltrated the right lung parenchyma. No complications occurred, and there was no recurrence at 10 months. The authors emphasize that ruptured cystic teratomas, though usually benign, require emergency surgery when they penetrate lung tissue.

pmid-17991085.summary_ja: 嚢胞内に浮遊する球状構造物を認めた卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の超音波検査およびCT所見を報告しています。著者らはこの「ミートボール」所見を成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に特異的なものとしています。脂肪成分と石灰化成分の確認に加え、画像診断上の重要な手がかりとなります。
pmid-17991085.summary_en: This short report presents an ovarian mature cystic teratoma with unusual ultrasound and CT findings: multiple floating, ball-like bodies within the cyst. The authors describe these 'meat balls' as pathognomonic of mature cystic teratoma. Mature cystic ovarian teratomas are among the commonest germ cell tumors, and fatty and calcific components usually suggest the diagnosis. The report highlights the floating-ball appearance as a distinctive imaging clue.

pmid-17991554.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ86例の後方視的研究で、原発腫瘍の病理学的因子と診断時の臨床転移の関連を検討しました。多変量解析では腫瘍径6cm超と精巣網浸潤が独立した予測因子でした。β-hCG 800 mUI/mL超の症例は除外されています。
pmid-17991554.summary_en: This retrospective study of 86 patients with pure testicular seminoma examined whether primary tumor pathologic features predict clinical metastasis at diagnosis. Tumor size over 4 cm, rete testis invasion, and several other features were univariately associated with metastasis. Multivariate analysis identified tumor size over 6 cm and rete testis invasion as independent predictors. Patients with beta-hCG above 800 mUI/mL were excluded.

pmid-17991576.summary_ja: 精巣摘除と後腹膜放射線療法を受けた病期IIのセミノーマから34年後、71歳男性が唯一機能する腎の腎盂に扁平上皮癌を発症した。腫瘍は照射野内に生じた。放射線療法による二次悪性腫瘍は稀だが重篤な晩期合併症であり、長期寛解の患者でも注意が必要と報告している。
pmid-17991576.summary_en: A 71-year-old man developed squamous cell carcinoma of the renal pelvis in a solitary functioning kidney, 34 years after orchidectomy and adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy for stage II seminoma. The tumor arose within the radiation field. The authors emphasize that radiotherapy-induced second malignancies are an uncommon but serious late effect, even in patients in long-term remission. They state this is the first report of renal pelvic squamous cell carcinoma occurring after radiation treatment.

pmid-17991577.summary_ja: 35歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、精巣奇形腫内に原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(PNET)が生じ、後腹膜に転移していた。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の白金系化学療法後に奇形腫の悪性転化が3〜6%で生じると述べている。精巣奇形腫に伴うPNETは報告が少なく、文献を含めて検討した。
pmid-17991577.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with a malignant mixed germ cell tumor showed primitive neuroectodermal tumor (PNET) arising within a testicular teratoma, with retroperitoneal metastasis. The authors note that teratomas with malignant transformation occur in roughly 3 to 6% of patients with metastatic germ cell tumors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy, most often as carcinoma or sarcoma. PNET is rarely reported in this setting, with only seven prior case reports, and the paper reviews the literature.

pmid-17992334.summary_ja: 29歳男性が胸部鈍的外傷後に心陰影の拡大を示した。開胸術で大きな縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的に成熟型縦隔奇形腫と診断された。縦隔腫瘍は無症状で偶然発見されることが多いことを背景に、外傷手術中に発見された巨大奇形腫の症例を報告している。
pmid-17992334.summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with an enlarged cardiac silhouette after blunt thoracic trauma. Thoracotomy revealed a large mediastinal mass, which histopathology identified as a mature mediastinal teratoma. The authors note that most mediastinal tumors are found incidentally because they are asymptomatic. This case describes a giant teratoma discovered during surgery performed for trauma.

pmid-17993720.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍12例と正常精巣3例を対象に、cDNAマイクロアレイで遺伝子発現を網羅的に解析した。セミノーマではPRAMEやMAGEA4などの精子形成関連遺伝子が、胎児性癌ではDNMT3BやSOX2などが高発現していた。大規模コホートで免疫組織化学とRT-PCRにより検証し、組織型特異的な遺伝子シグネチャーを同定した。
pmid-17993720.summary_en: This study used whole-genome cDNA microarrays on 12 testicular germ cell tumors and 3 normal testes to define transcriptional programs in the progression from intratubular germ cell neoplasia to tumors. Seminomas expressed spermatogenesis-associated genes such as PRAME and MAGEA4, while embryonal carcinomas expressed DNMT3B, SOX2, and the keratins KRT8 and KRT18. Selected markers were validated by immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR in a larger cohort, identifying histology-specific gene signatures.

pmid-18004247.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍77例で、原発腫瘍のMDR1(P-gp)発現が化学療法後の後腹膜残存病変を予測するかを検討した。単変量解析では生存腫瘍・奇形腫残存と関連したが、多変量解析では独立した予後因子とならなかった。ルーチンの染色は現時点では推奨されないが、転移性非セミノーマでの傾向から、さらなる検討が必要である。
pmid-18004247.summary_en: This study tested whether MDR1 (P-glycoprotein) expression in primary testicular tumors predicts residual viable tumor or teratoma after chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in advanced testicular germ cell cancer. Among 77 patients, MDR1 was assessed by immunohistochemistry in 47 primary tumors and 73 RPLND sections. Mature teratoma and viable tumor were mainly seen in non-seminomas. MDR1 predicted residual disease only on univariate analysis, not multivariate analysis, so routine staining is not recommended, though a trend in metastatic non-seminomas merits larger studies.

pmid-18005875.summary_ja: 慢性副睾丸炎の症状で受診した21歳男性を報告する。精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍とともに、男性生殖器に限局した結節性多発動脈炎(PAN)を認めた。両者の併存は初めての報告である。手術から2年後、腫瘍およびPANの再発は認められていない。
pmid-18005875.summary_en: The authors describe a 21-year-old man with chronic epididymitis who had isolated polyarteritis nodosa of the male reproductive system together with a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. PAN is usually a systemic disease with poor prognosis, while isolated forms usually have a favorable outcome, and both forms have been linked to malignancy. Two years after surgery there was no evidence of recurrence of either the tumor or the vasculitis. This is the first report of this combination of conditions.

pmid-18019775.summary_ja: 43歳女性の左卵巣に生じた10cm大の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に、扁平上皮癌が発生していた稀な症例である。超音波検査と血清腫瘍マーカーによる評価を検討している。標準治療は外科的切除と白金製剤による補助化学療法であり、この稀な悪性転化の多くは予後不良である。
pmid-18019775.summary_en: A 43-year-old woman had a 10 cm left ovarian mature cystic teratoma with an unusual finding of squamous cell carcinoma arising within it. The authors discuss clinical evaluation, including ultrasound and serologic markers. Standard treatment is surgical resection with platinum-based adjuvant chemotherapy, and prognosis is generally very poor in most cases of this rare malignant transformation.

pmid-18020925.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法の時代においても稀な、精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍からの脳転移を扱う総説である。脳転移は同時性・異時性のいずれもあり、長期生存例も存在する。報告例の大多数は非セミノーマ型であり、その診断と治療に関する文献を概観している。
pmid-18020925.summary_en: This review examines brain metastasis from testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, which is rare in the cisplatin era. Brain metastases may be synchronous or metachronous, with or without systemic disease, and some patients achieve long-term survival. Most reported cases involve nonseminomatous histology, which is the focus here. The authors survey the literature on diagnosis and management, providing a clinical overview for clinicians treating testicular cancer patients with cerebral involvement.

pmid-18022422.summary_ja: 小児期に腹腔内膿瘍による急性腹症で受診し、ドレナージと抗菌薬で治療された患者の症例である。15年後に症状が再発し、膿瘍は感染した後腹膜奇形腫と判明した。小児で奇形腫が膿瘍として発現した初めての報告で、原因不明の膿瘍では奇形腫を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-18022422.summary_en: A child presented with an acute abdomen from an abdominal abscess, treated with drainage and antibiotics. Fifteen years later symptoms recurred, and the abscess was recognized as an infected retroperitoneal teratoma. The authors note that retroperitoneal teratomas are rare and usually present as asymptomatic masses. They recommend considering teratoma for unexplained abscesses in the sacrococcygeal area, gonads, mediastinum, or retroperitoneum in children, as this presentation had not been described before in children.

pmid-18026662.summary_ja: 6か月の胸痛と血痰を主訴とした49歳男性の症例報告である。胸部X線とCTで左上葉に陰影を認め、開胸術後の病理検査で肺内奇形腫と診断された。術後は良好な経過をたどり、外来でフォローアップ中である。奇形腫の稀な原発部位を示す症例である。
pmid-18026662.summary_en: A 49-year-old man presented with six months of chest pain and bloody sputum. Chest X-ray and CT showed an opacity in the left upper lobe, and bronchoscopy revealed bronchial hemorrhage in the lingular segment. Because of diagnostic and therapeutic needs, he underwent left thoracotomy, and pathology of the resected specimen revealed an intrapulmonary teratoma. He recovered well and remains under outpatient follow-up. This case documents teratoma arising in an unusual primary site.

pmid-18028743.summary_ja: 不妊外来を受診した男性749人に精巣超音波検査と精液検査を実施した研究です。9人で腫瘍が疑われ、7人が精巣摘除術を受け、5人にセミノーマが確認されました(発生率0.7%)。精液所見にかかわらず精巣腫瘍が不妊外来で見つかりうるため、不妊男性への超音波検査の活用が提案されています。
pmid-18028743.summary_en: This study screened 749 men attending an infertility clinic with testicular ultrasound and semen analysis. Nine men showed suspected testicular tumors; seven underwent orchiectomy, and five were confirmed as seminoma, an incidence of 0.7%. Testicular tumors can present in infertility clinics regardless of semen quality, supporting wider use of diagnostic ultrasound in infertile men.

pmid-18029845.summary_ja: 組織学的に確定した精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者21例に、造影剤投与前後で1.5T MRIを施行しました。2名の放射線科医が後方視的に評価し、21例中19例(91%)でセミノーマか非セミノーマかを正しく判定できました。T2強調像で低信号が主体で隔壁が造影される病変はセミノーマが示唆され、著明に不均一な病変は非セミノーマが示唆されました。
pmid-18029845.summary_en: Twenty-one patients with histologically proven testicular germ cell tumors underwent 1.5-T MRI before and after gadolinium contrast. Two radiologists retrospectively reviewed the images, and MRI correctly characterized 19 of 21 tumors (91%) as seminomatous or nonseminomatous. Predominantly low T2 signal with enhancing septa suggested seminoma, while marked heterogeneity suggested nonseminoma, with excellent interobserver agreement.

pmid-18030121.summary_ja: 1歳男児に発生した単独の眼窩卵黄嚢腫瘍の後方視的症例報告です。血清学的検査と病理組織学により診断され、眼科と腫瘍科の連携のもと化学療法が行われました。卵黄嚢腫瘍は通常、性腺に発生する悪性胚細胞腫瘍であり、眼窩のような性腺外原発は稀であると述べ、治療選択肢を概説しています。
pmid-18030121.summary_en: This retrospective case report describes an isolated endodermal sinus tumor of the orbit in a 1-year-old boy. Diagnosis was established by serologic testing and histopathology, and the patient was treated with chemotherapy in collaboration with ophthalmology and oncology. The authors note that endodermal sinus tumor is a malignant germ cell tumor usually arising in gonads, with primary extragonadal orbital presentation being rare, and review treatment options.

pmid-18041366.summary_ja: 著者らは、XY核型を有し完全アンドロゲン不応症候群と診断された24歳女性における両側性精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の初症例を報告する。超音波検査で性腺腫瘤が認められた後、両側精巣摘除術が施行され、組織学的に両側性精細管内胚細胞腫瘍と確認された。補助療法は行われず、CTおよび腫瘍マーカーによるサーベイランスの結果、4年時点で再発は認められなかった。
pmid-18041366.summary_en: The authors describe the first case of bilateral intratubular germ cell tumor in a 24-year-old woman with XY karyotype and complete androgen insensitivity syndrome. Bilateral orchiectomy was performed after ultrasound showed gonadal masses. Histology confirmed bilateral intratubular germ cell tumor. No adjuvant therapy was given; surveillance with CT and tumor markers showed no relapse at four years.

pmid-18041444.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の卵巣腺癌(FIGO病期IC)の既往がある29歳女性が、性交後出血で受診した症例報告です。膣病変の生検で卵巣腫瘍と同一の組織像が確認され、パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンによる化学療法を受けましたが、胸水貯留と上大静脈症候群を来し3か月後に死亡しました。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の腺癌による膣への二次性浸潤の初の報告です。
pmid-18041444.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman with FIGO stage IC ovarian adenocarcinoma arising in mature cystic teratoma, who later presented with postcoital vaginal bleeding. Incisional biopsy showed a vaginal lesion histologically identical to the ovarian tumor, and paclitaxel-carboplatin chemotherapy was given. She developed pleural effusion with superior vena cava syndrome and died three months later. The authors report this as the first case of such secondary vaginal involvement.

pmid-18042148.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍（TGCT）のDNAメチル化異常をまとめたレビュー。セミノーマはメチル化が乏しく、非セミノーマは分化に伴いメチル化が増加する。MGMTやRASSF1Aなどの腫瘍抑制遺伝子の不活化、刷り込み異常、XISTの非メチル化などを解説し、非侵襲的診断や治療反応の予後マーカーとしての可能性を論じている。
pmid-18042148.summary_en: This review summarizes the epigenetic landscape of testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), the most common malignancy in young men. Seminomas are largely devoid of DNA methylation, whereas nonseminomas show methylation levels that increase with differentiation, from embryonal carcinoma to teratoma. The authors discuss frequently methylated tumor suppressor genes such as MGMT, RASSF1A, and HIC1, along with imprinting defects, hypomethylation of cancer-testis genes, and unmethylated XIST. They propose that aberrant methylation could enable noninvasive diagnostic testing and serve as a prognostic marker for treatment response.

pmid-18043048.summary_ja: 本報告は、卵巣のgrowing teratoma syndromeを有する女性において、成熟奇形腫の結節内に生じたカルチノイド腫瘍の初症例を記述する。19年前に未熟卵巣奇形腫および後腹膜リンパ節陽性で受診し、手術と化学療法を受けていた。その後、数十年にわたり成熟奇形腫が繰り返し再発した。著者らは公表された卵巣GTS症例もレビューし、結節は通常、原発腫瘍から2年以内に出現し、骨盤、腹部、後腹膜に限局していることを明らかにした。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者には長期フォローアップが重要であると強調している。
pmid-18043048.summary_en: This report describes the first case of a carcinoid tumor arising within a mature teratoma nodule in a woman with ovarian growing teratoma syndrome (GTS). Nineteen years earlier, the patient had presented with an immature ovarian teratoma and positive retroperitoneal lymph nodes, treated with surgery and chemotherapy. Mature teratomas then recurred repeatedly over the following decades. The authors also review published ovarian GTS cases, finding that nodules usually appear within two years of the primary tumor and remain confined to the pelvis, abdomen, and retroperitoneum. They emphasize the importance of long-term follow-up for patients with ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-18049836.summary_ja: 本マウス研究では、Dnd1変異を持ちながら精巣腫瘍を発生するかまたは無精子精巣となるTerマウスを用いた。染色体置換系統を用いて、XとYのどちらの染色体が腫瘍発生率に影響するかを検討した。B6由来の染色体Xを持つTer/Ter雄は腫瘍発生から不妊精巣表現型へと傾向がシフトした一方、Y染色体の置換には同様の効果はみられなかった。X連鎖の遺伝因子が、Dnd1不活化マウスにおける胚細胞腫瘍の発生率を調節することが示された。
pmid-18049836.summary_en: This mouse study uses Ter mice, which carry a Dnd1 mutation and either develop testicular germ cell tumors or have sterile testes. Using chromosome substitution strains, the authors tested whether the X or Y chromosome influences tumor incidence. Ter/Ter males carrying a C57BL/6J-derived X chromosome shifted from tumor development toward the sterile testis phenotype, whereas Y chromosome substitution had no such effect. The findings show that X-linked genetic factors modulate germ cell tumor incidence in Dnd1-deficient mice, relevant to testicular dysgenesis syndrome.

pmid-18050831.summary_ja: 21歳男性で上行結腸癌として切除不能と診断された症例。精査の結果、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。診断と治療方針には組織型の確認が重要であり、若年の悪性腫瘍患者では胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーの測定を行うべきであることが強調されている。患者はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法によく反応した。
pmid-18050831.summary_en: The authors describe a 21-year-old man diagnosed with an apparently inoperable cancer of the ascending colon. Subsequent studies revealed that the tumor was an extragonadal germ cell tumor. The case emphasizes that histology is key to diagnosis and management, and that germ cell tumor markers should be measured in all young patients with malignancy. The patient responded well to chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin.

pmid-18052842.summary_ja: 巨大な胎児頸部奇形腫を有する新生児2例を報告。予後は気道閉塞の程度で決まるため、胎盤循環下で気道を確保するEXIT（ex-utero intrapartum treatment）を施行した。1例では気管切開が可能となり、もう1例では気管偏位の修正と経鼻気管挿管が行われた。重度の気道障害を伴う胎児奇形腫に対して、EXITは有用な選択肢となりうる。
pmid-18052842.summary_en: This report describes two newborns with giant cervical teratomas whose prognosis depended on the severity of airway obstruction. Both were managed with the ex-utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure, which secures a patent airway while the infant remains on placental support. In the first case, EXIT enabled tracheotomy. In the second, it allowed correction of tracheal displacement and nasotracheal intubation. The authors suggest that EXIT can be an effective approach for fetal teratomas with severe airway compromise.

pmid-18058267.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫（単一胚葉性卵巣奇形腫）13例を検討し、濾胞変異型乳頭状甲状腺癌が発生しうるかを評価した。10例は非定型的組織像とCK19のびまん性陽性を示し、そのうち7例にRET/PTC再構成が認められた。BRAF V600E変異は認められなかった。卵巣甲状腺腫からの濾胞変異型乳頭状甲状腺癌の発生が示され、分子検査が診断の確認に有用とされている。
pmid-18058267.summary_en: The authors examined 13 cases of struma ovarii, a monodermal ovarian teratoma composed predominantly of thyroid tissue, to determine whether follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma can arise in it. Ten cases showed atypical histology and diffuse CK19 positivity, and seven of these carried RET/PTC rearrangements, though none had BRAF V600E mutations. The three benign-appearing cases lacked these features. The findings show that follicular variant PTC can arise in struma ovarii, and that molecular testing can help confirm the diagnosis.

pmid-18059230.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌36例を免疫組織化学で解析し、栄養膜細胞の亜集団を調べた研究です。MUC-4は全例で陽性、HLA-GとMel-CAMは正常胎盤に類似した中間栄養膜細胞のパターンを示しました。絨毛癌は主に合胞体栄養膜細胞と中間栄養膜細胞から成り、細胞性栄養膜細胞はごく一部であることが示唆されました。鑑別診断にも役立つ知見です。
pmid-18059230.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to characterize trophoblastic subpopulations in 36 gestational choriocarcinomas, alongside placenta, complete mole, placental site nodule, epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, and placental site trophoblastic tumor specimens. MUC-4 was diffusely positive in all cases, and HLA-G and Mel-CAM showed intermediate trophoblast patterns resembling normal placenta. Nuclear beta-catenin was seen in a small minority of cytotrophoblast-like cells. Choriocarcinoma appears to consist mainly of syncytiotrophoblast and intermediate trophoblast, and may arise from transformed cytotrophoblast cells acting as cancer stem cells. The findings aid differential diagnosis.

pmid-18059402.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ、非セミノーマ、細胞株について、染色体コピー数と遺伝子発現を比較した研究です。コピー数の変化は発現変化と正に相関し、両者は類似の発症機序を持つと考えられました。精母細胞性セミノーマは4q22などの発現増加で区別されました。コピー数と発現の両方に異常がみられる19領域が同定されました。
pmid-18059402.summary_en: This study compared genomic copy number and global expression changes in seven seminomas, one combined tumour, seven nonseminomas, and seven cell lines of testicular germ cell tumours. Copy number changes correlated positively with expression, supporting copy number as a main driver. Seminomas and nonseminomas could not be distinguished by these data, consistent with a similar pathogenesis. Spermatocytic seminoma showed distinct expression increases at 4q22, 5q23.2, and 9p21. Nineteen regions with both copy number and expression imbalances were identified, and their genes are candidates for involvement in tumour development.

pmid-18063508.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、14歳女児に発生した悪性卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍を記述する。超音波検査では低抵抗の細動脈を伴う大きな多房性充実性卵巣腫瘤が認められ、造影MRIでは周辺の充実成分に強い増強効果が認められた。血清αフェトプロテインは131,630 ng/mLと著明に上昇しており、手術による病期分類で大網浸潤、病期IIIcと判明した。著者らは、思春期の患者においてAFPの上昇、低い抵抗指数、高血管性を認めた場合には、術前に本腫瘍を疑うべきであると提言している。
pmid-18063508.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with a malignant ovarian endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor. Ultrasound showed a large multilocular solid ovarian mass with low-resistance arterioles, and contrast-enhanced MRI showed peripheral solid components with strong enhancement. Serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 131,630 ng/mL, and surgical staging revealed omental invasion, stage IIIc. The authors suggest that elevated AFP, low resistance index, and hypervascularity in an adolescent should prompt suspicion of this tumor preoperatively.

pmid-18065732.summary_ja: 1989〜2002年に病期IIA・IIBの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者252例を、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と化学療法で比較した研究です。予後不良因子を持つ患者を選択的に化学療法へ回すことで、郭清群の無再発生存率が改善しました。一次化学療法は無再発生存率が高かったものの、疾患特異的生存率に有意差はありませんでした。化学療法の使用割合は大きく増えませんでした。
pmid-18065732.summary_en: This study compared primary chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for clinical stage IIA and IIB nonseminomatous germ cell tumor in 252 patients treated from 1989 to 2002. Over time, patients with adverse features were increasingly selected for primary chemotherapy, improving relapse-free survival after RPLND from 78% to 100%. Primary chemotherapy gave better relapse-free survival than RPLND (98% vs 79%), but disease-specific survival did not differ significantly. Overall chemotherapy exposure did not increase substantially.

pmid-18068467.summary_ja: 病期I純粋セミノーマで、血清β-hCGが4497 IU/Lと著明に高値だった症例の報告です。精巣摘除術と化学療法後、術後13日目までにβ-hCGは検出限界以下になりました。30か月間再発はありません。純粋セミノーマでも著明なhCG上昇が起こり得ることを示しています。
pmid-18068467.summary_en: This case report describes a man with histologically pure stage I seminoma, copious syncytiotrophoblast cells, and a serum beta-hCG of 4497 IU/L. This is reportedly the third highest beta-hCG value in stage I pure seminoma. He underwent orchiectomy and chemotherapy, and beta-hCG became undetectable by postoperative day 13. He has remained disease free for 30 months. The report highlights that marked hCG elevation can occur in pure seminoma and does not necessarily indicate nonseminoma.

pmid-18068470.summary_ja: 86歳男性の古典的精巣セミノーマの症例を報告し、無作為に選んだ若年男性4例の腫瘍と比較した研究です。有糸分裂数、脈管侵襲、PCNA、Ki67、p53の発現を検討しました。高齢者の腫瘍は若年者と類似した表現型を示しました。高齢者でも治療方針は変えるべきでないと結論づけています。
pmid-18068470.summary_en: This study describes a rare classic seminoma in an 86-year-old man and compares its histologic features with four randomly selected tumors from younger men. Mitotic count, intravascular invasion, and PCNA, Ki67, and p53 expression were assessed as indicators of biologic activity. The octogenarian tumor showed a phenotype similar to those in younger men. The authors conclude that treatment paradigms for elderly patients with seminoma should remain unchanged.

pmid-18071867.summary_ja: 著者らは、病期II精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法とシスプラチン併用化学療法の17年前および24年前に生じた可能性のある左尿管がんの2症例を報告する。両患者は後腹膜鏡補助下左腎尿管全摘除術を受け、2年以上のフォローアップで良好な転帰が得られた。著者らは、精巣がんの生存者は治療後少なくとも35年間にわたり固形腫瘍のリスクが上昇するという知見を引用している。若年患者は、その後の人生において高いがんリスクを有する可能性があると述べている。
pmid-18071867.summary_en: The authors report two cases of left ureteral carcinoma that may have arisen after radiotherapy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy for stage II testicular seminoma, 17 and 24 years earlier. Both patients underwent retroperitoneoscopy-assisted left nephroureterectomy and had satisfactory outcomes after more than 2 years of follow-up. The authors cite evidence that testicular cancer survivors face an increased risk of solid tumors for at least 35 years after treatment. Young patients may therefore face a high cancer risk in later life.

pmid-18071871.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法抵抗性となった34歳男性の症例。全身化学療法と放射線療法後もAFPが高値で、2年間に計4回の救済手術（後腹膜リンパ節郭清などを含む）を施行した。その結果AFPは正常化し、最終手術後2年間再発なく経過した。反復救済手術が選択された患者に有益な可能性を示す。
pmid-18071871.summary_en: A 34-year-old man with chemotherapy-resistant metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis, with retroperitoneal nodal metastases and persistently elevated AFP, had received eight courses of systemic chemotherapy and radiotherapy before referral. After TEP failed to normalize AFP, he underwent four salvage operations over two years, including repeated RPLND, neck node dissection and thoracic duct excision. Viable tumor was found in all specimens except one neck node. AFP normalized and he remained relapse-free for two years after the final surgery, suggesting repeated salvage surgery may benefit selected patients.

pmid-18092963.summary_ja: ダウン症候群と停留精巣を合併した20歳日本人男性の症例。左鼠径部腫瘤に対し精巣摘除術が行われ、停留精巣内に胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む混合型胚細胞腫瘍が認められた。染色体は47,XY,+21であった。3疾患の関連性が示唆され、両合併例での混合型胚細胞腫瘍の初報告とされる。
pmid-18092963.summary_en: A 20-year-old Japanese man with Down syndrome and cryptorchidism presented with a left inguinal mass and underwent orchidectomy for suspected testicular tumor. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor with embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor containing syncytiotrophoblastic giant cells, arising in an undescended testis. Peripheral lymphocyte karyotype was 47,XY,+21. The authors propose that Down syndrome, cryptorchidism and testicular germ cell tumor may be closely associated, and report this as the first case of mixed germ cell tumor in a patient with both conditions.

pmid-18092964.summary_ja: 精巣原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍が膀胱・胃へ異時性転移した38歳男性の症例。組織学的には奇形腫と胎児性癌からなり、体細胞型の肉腫成分を伴っていた。転移巣は横紋筋肉腫と診断された。リンパ節転移細胞へのFISH法で精巣腫瘍に特徴的なi(12p)が検出され、免疫組織化学とともに診断を支持した。
pmid-18092964.summary_en: A 38-year-old man had a primary right testicular malignant tumor that metachronously metastasized to the urinary bladder and stomach. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor of teratoma and embryonal carcinoma with a somatic sarcoma component. The metastases showed rhabdomyoblastic differentiation identical to the testicular sarcoma component and were diagnosed as rhabdomyosarcoma. FISH on lymph node metastasis cells demonstrated isochromosome 12p, a chromosomal aberration typical of testicular neoplasms, supporting the diagnosis together with immunohistochemistry.

pmid-18158042.summary_ja: 腫瘍径4cm超または34歳未満の高リスク病期I精巣セミノーマ64例に対し、エトポシド/シスプラチン2コースの補助化学療法を行った。主な有害事象は好中球減少と嘔気・嘔吐。中央値60か月の追跡で再発はなく、異時性精巣がん1例が認められた。
pmid-18158042.summary_en: This prospective Hellenic Cooperative Oncology Group study treated 64 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma and one of two risk factors (tumor diameter over 4 cm or age under 34 years) with two cycles of etoposide and cisplatin as adjuvant therapy, with G-CSF support. Grade 3 or 4 toxicities were mainly neutropenia and nausea and vomiting. After a median follow-up of 60 months, no relapses occurred, although one metachronous testicular carcinoma was reported. The authors conclude that two cycles of EP are effective and safe for high-risk Stage I seminoma.

pmid-18158054.summary_ja: 35歳男性の精巣腫瘍症例。抗菌薬無効の陰嚢硬結で受診し、超音波検査とMRIで左精巣に被膜を有する腫瘍を認めた。転移病変はなく、根治的精巣摘除術の病理で、自然退縮が疑われる純粋セミノーマの小領域と線維化を認めた。術後1年間、再発はみられなかった。
pmid-18158054.summary_en: A 35-year-old man presented with persistent scrotal induration after several weeks of antibiotics. Ultrasonography and MRI showed an encapsulated tumor in the left atrophic testis, without visceral or nodal disease. Radical orchiectomy revealed a fibrotic tumor containing a small area of pure seminoma that appeared to be undergoing spontaneous regression, along with widespread intratubular germ cell neoplasia. The patient remained disease-free one year after surgery, suggesting that seminoma can rarely regress without metastasis.

pmid-18160807.summary_ja: Cowden病を合併した思春期患者に生じた精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の初めての症例報告。精細管周囲のPTEN発現や精巣がん細胞株のPTEN変異が、両者の関連を示唆する根拠として挙げられている。著者らは、乳腺・甲状腺などのサーベイランスに加え、精巣の追加スクリーニングを提言している。
pmid-18160807.summary_en: Reports the first case of testicular mixed germ cell tumor in an adolescent with Cowden disease, a hamartomatous syndrome with increased malignancy risk. The authors propose a link between Cowden disease and testicular malignancy, citing strong PTEN expression in seminiferous tubule basal cells and frequent PTEN mutations in testicular cancer cell lines. They recommend additional testicular screening for patients with Cowden disease, beyond standard surveillance of breast, thyroid, endometrial and renal cancers.

pmid-18179152.summary_ja: 19歳女性で腹部腫瘤と腫瘍マーカーの上昇を認めた。妊孕性温存手術で、同一卵巣に病期IAの卵黄嚢腫瘍と性腺芽腫を認めた。化学療法は拒否されたが、6か月のフォローアップ中に再発はなかった。腫瘍マーカーと免疫組織化学が診断に有用と考察している。
pmid-18179152.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman with an abdominal mass and elevated CA-125 and AFP underwent fertility-sparing surgery, which revealed a stage IA endodermal sinus tumor with gonadoblastoma in the same ovary. She declined chemotherapy and remained disease-free over six months of follow-up. The authors suggest that tumor markers and immunohistochemistry aid diagnosis of gonadoblastoma-associated ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-18182846.summary_ja: 精巣胎児性癌由来のNT2/D1細胞でSOX15を過剰発現させると増殖が抑制され、G1-G0期の細胞が増加した。マイクロアレイでは増殖や細胞周期に関連する遺伝子を含む26個の遺伝子の発現上昇を認めた。胚細胞腫瘍の増殖制御因子を探る細胞研究である。
pmid-18182846.summary_en: Shows that overexpressing SOX15 in NT2/D1 cells, a line derived from testicular embryonal carcinoma, slows proliferation and increases the G1-G0 fraction. Microarray analysis identified 26 upregulated genes and none downregulated, several linked to proliferation or the cell cycle, including IGFBP5 and PDCD4. The study uses this germ cell tumor model to explore regulators of tumor cell growth.

pmid-18184914.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞がんは、停止した胎児の胚細胞に由来するという仮説を検討した総説である。上皮内癌は原始生殖細胞やゴノサイトに類似しており、ほとんどの症例は精巣異形成が基盤にある。その病態は環境曝露と遺伝子多型によって形作られ、個体の感受性に影響する。胚細胞分化の停止が最初の重要な事象とされ、その後、思春期以降に悪性転化を経て顕在化した腫瘍に至ると提案されている。
pmid-18184914.summary_en: Reviews the hypothesis that testicular germ cell cancer arises from arrested fetal germ cells, as carcinoma in situ resembles primordial germ cells and gonocytes. Testicular dysgenesis underlies most cases, shaped by environmental exposures and genetic polymorphisms that influence individual susceptibility. Arrested germ cell differentiation is proposed as the key initial event, followed by malignant transformation and overt tumor after puberty.

pmid-18186691.summary_ja: 病期IIA〜IIIの非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対し、化学療法後に腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した16例（17件）の報告。手術関連の合併症はなく、1例でブレオマイシンによる間質性肺炎を認めた。平均26か月のフォローアップで2例に再発があった。残存腫瘍が少ない症例に限り実施可能と結論づけている。
pmid-18186691.summary_en: Reports 17 laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissections after chemotherapy in 16 patients with clinical stage IIA-III nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Procedures were completed in all patients without transfusion or procedure-related complications. One patient developed bleomycin-induced interstitial pneumonia. After a mean follow-up of 26 months, two recurrences were observed. The authors conclude that the approach is feasible and oncologically safe for carefully selected patients with low residual tumor volume.

pmid-18203521.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の日本人男性47例を対象とした単施設後方視的解析。一次BEP化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーは全例で正常化し、BEP単独で38.3%が完全奏効した。5年無再発生存率は79.2%で、セミノーマと非セミノーマの間に有意差はなかった。組織型にかかわらず良好な反応例は予後良好であることが示唆された。
pmid-18203521.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective study of 47 Japanese men with metastatic germ cell tumors (16 seminoma, 31 nonseminoma) treated with first-line BEP chemotherapy, who did not receive high-dose chemotherapy, found that tumor markers normalized in all patients after 2 to 4 cycles. Complete response after BEP alone was 38.3%, and 12 of 15 patients who underwent residual-tumor resection had pathological complete response. Five patients relapsed, and 5-year recurrence-free survival was 79.2%, with no significant difference between histologic subtypes.

pmid-18224246.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍23例の胚細胞腫瘍成分46個を免疫染色と共焦点顕微鏡で解析した研究。神経内分泌マーカー陽性細胞は奇形腫、胎児性癌、神経内分泌癌で認められた。胎児性癌から奇形腫への移行細胞でCGAとPLAPが共局在し、神経内分泌細胞は胎児性癌由来である可能性が示された。
pmid-18224246.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of 46 germ cell tumor components from 23 testicular tumors, examining neuroendocrine differentiation. Neuroendocrine marker-positive cells were found in teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and neuroendocrine carcinoma components. Confocal microscopy showed chromogranin A and PLAP co-localized in the same transitional cells, and neuroendocrine carcinoma expressed CD30. The authors propose that neuroendocrine cells may arise directly from embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-18260746.summary_ja: 47歳女性の原発性非妊娠性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告。扁平上皮からの化生転換を伴い、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に確認された。アクチノマイシンDによる化学療法5コース後に根治的子宮摘出術と骨盤リンパ節郭清を施行した。子宮頸部上皮の化生転換から発生しうると結論づけている。
pmid-18260746.summary_en: Case report of a 47-year-old woman with primary non-gestational cervical choriocarcinoma, diagnosed 17 years after tubal resection. Histologic and immunohistochemical examination confirmed choriocarcinoma with metaplastic transformation from squamous cells. She received five courses of actinomycin-D chemotherapy, followed by radical hysterectomy with bilateral pelvic lymphadenectomy. The authors conclude that such tumors may arise from metaplastic transformation of cervical epithelium.

pmid-18277735.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で発見された胎児の大きな口腔奇形腫の症例報告。出生時の気道確保困難が予想されEXIT手技を計画した。胎盤循環による支持下で腫瘍を同時切除し、気道確保と健康な乳児の娩出に成功した。稀な症例の管理上の課題を示す報告である。
pmid-18277735.summary_en: Case report of a large fetal oral teratoma detected on antenatal ultrasound. Because airway securing at birth was expected to be difficult, an ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure was planned. The tumor was excised while the fetus remained supported by placental circulation, allowing safe airway control and delivery of a healthy infant. The report highlights the management challenges of such rare cases.

pmid-18330332.summary_ja: 35歳のエチオピア人女性で完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の症例。腹部腫瘤と原発性無月経で受診し、開腹術で腹腔内腫瘤を摘出した。腫瘤の病理組織学的所見はセミノーマに一致した。鼠径管内の腫瘤は精巣組織であった。AISの診断・管理について文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-18330332.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old Ethiopian woman with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome who presented with an abdominal mass, primary amenorrhea, and infertility. Laparotomy removed a large intra-abdominal solid mass and an inguinal mass. Histopathology of the abdominal tumour showed seminoma features, and the inguinal mass was consistent with testis. No ovaries were found. The authors review the diagnosis, differential diagnosis, and management of AIS, and note that this is the first reported AIS case in an Ethiopian patient.

pmid-18340374.summary_ja: 若年女児の非典型的な骨盤内腫瘤の診断に関する報告。卵巣のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が問題となる。シスプラチンを含む化学療法により予後は改善し、病期I未熟奇形腫や病期IAディスジャーミノーマは術後補助化学療法なしでフォローアップされる。温存手術により多くの患者で卵巣機能と妊孕性を維持できる。
pmid-18340374.summary_en: This report describes a young girl presenting with an unusual pelvic mass that posed a diagnostic dilemma. The tumour was identified as ovarian dysgerminoma, the most common germ cell tumour. The authors note that prognosis has improved with cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and that stage I immature teratoma and stage IA dysgerminoma can be followed up after surgery without adjuvant chemotherapy. Conservative surgery preserves ovarian function and fertility in most patients.

pmid-18496978.summary_ja: 精巣がんとサルコイドーシスの合併64例の文献的レビュー。精巣腫瘍が先行する例が半数以上で、組織型ではセミノーマが62%と最多であった。サルコイド反応によるリンパ節腫大や肺結節が転移と誤認される診断上の落とし穴となる。サルコイドーシスの8割は自然寛解し、がんの管理や予後は変わらないとされる。
pmid-18496978.summary_en: This literature review analyses 64 reported cases of sarcoidosis concomitant with testicular cancer. Testicular cancer preceded sarcoidosis in over half of cases, and seminoma was the most frequent histology at 62%. Sarcoid-like reactions can produce nodes or pulmonary nodules that mimic metastatic disease, creating a diagnostic pitfall. Sarcoidosis regressed spontaneously in 80% of cases and did not alter cancer management or prognosis.

pmid-18515983.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマに対して単剤カルボプラチンによる術後補助化学療法を受けた患者が、48か月後に腹部リンパ節転移を伴って再発した症例を報告する。カルボプラチンは傍大動脈放射線療法と比べ3年無再発生存率が非劣性とされる。晩期再発が起こりうることや成熟したデータが不足していることから、著者らは2年を超えてもCTによる経過観察が必要と提案している。
pmid-18515983.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who received adjuvant single-agent carboplatin for stage I seminoma and relapsed with abdominal lymph node metastasis at 48 months. The authors note that adjuvant carboplatin offers non-inferior 3-year relapse-free survival compared with para-aortic radiotherapy. Because late relapse can occur and mature data are lacking, they suggest that CT surveillance beyond 2 years is required.

pmid-18542765.summary_ja: 純粋セミノーマの2症例で、転移性悪性脊髄圧迫を発症した。1例は病期Iで監視療法を選択し、フォローアップを中断した後22か月で脊髄圧迫として再発した。もう1例は脊髄圧迫の初発症状として精巣腫瘤が判明し、緊急放射線療法と精巣摘除術の後に化学療法を受けた。若年男性の脊髄圧迫では精巣セミノーマを鑑別に挙げるべきと強調している。
pmid-18542765.summary_en: This report describes two pure seminoma patients who developed metastatic malignant spinal cord compression. One presented at stage I, chose surveillance, was lost to follow-up, and relapsed as cord compression 22 months later. The other presented with cord compression and a testicular mass, and received emergency radiotherapy before orchidectomy. Both recovered neurological function after treatment. The authors stress considering seminoma in young men with malignant cord compression.

pmid-18542808.summary_ja: 小児期に停留精巣の既往がある28歳男性の症例。多精巣症を伴い、左精巣セミノーマに対して精巣摘除術を施行後、右側の腹腔内に2つ目の原発性セミノーマが認められた。腹腔内腫瘍の病理組織学的所見は古典的セミノーマであった。停留精巣の患者では多精巣症の評価を行うべきと提唱している。
pmid-18542808.summary_en: The authors report a 28-year-old man with childhood cryptorchidism who had polyorchidism and two primary seminomas: a left testicular seminoma treated by orchiectomy, and a right-sided abdominal seminoma. Pathology of the abdominal tumour showed classic seminoma bordered by non-tumour tissue and epididymal remnants. They suggest that patients who present with cryptorchidism be assessed for polyorchidism, as it may be a source of additional primary tumours.

pmid-18947799.summary_ja: 2施設における10年間の思春期前男児の精巣腫瘍15例の解析である。8例が胚細胞腫瘍で、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、セミノーマ、絨毛癌などを含む。術前に陰嚢疾患と誤診された例が多く、多くで根治的精巣摘除術が行われた。平均4年のフォローアップで再発はなかったが、ステージIVの絨毛癌の1例が死亡した。
pmid-18947799.summary_en: This two-institution, 10-year review of 15 prepubertal testicular tumors found that eight were germ cell tumors, including teratomas, yolk sac tumors, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Most boys were misdiagnosed preoperatively as scrotal disorders. Radical orchiectomy was performed in most cases, with testis-sparing surgery in a few benign lesions. No recurrences occurred at mean four-year follow-up, though one child with stage IV choriocarcinoma died. Benign teratoma and epidermoid cysts were the most common lesions.

pmid-19454048.summary_ja: BMJ Clinical Evidenceに掲載された、セミノーマ治療の有効性と安全性に関するシステマティックレビューである。病期Iおよび非病期Iの予後良好群・中間予後群のセミノーマについて、精巣摘除術後の補助放射線療法、化学療法、サーベイランスなどを評価している。27の研究を対象にGRADEでエビデンスの質を評価した。
pmid-19454048.summary_en: This BMJ Clinical Evidence systematic review summarizes effectiveness and safety of treatments for seminoma. It covers stage 1 seminoma after orchidectomy, good- and intermediate-prognosis non-stage 1 seminoma, and maintenance chemotherapy. Interventions include adjuvant radiotherapy, surveillance, carboplatin, bleomycin with vinblastine and cisplatin, and etoposide with cisplatin. The authors graded evidence quality using GRADE, identifying 27 eligible studies from searches up to April 2006.

pmid-19675770.summary_ja: 46XYの男性で子宮と卵管を有する持続性Müller管症候群の症例報告である。片側の鼠径ヘルニアと反対側の触知しない精巣を伴い、transverse testicular ectopiaと転移を伴う混合型胚細胞腫瘍がみられた。ヘルニア修復前の超音波検査によりMüller管構造と精巣悪性腫瘍を評価することを推奨している。
pmid-19675770.summary_en: This case report describes persistent Müllerian duct syndrome with a uterus in a 46XY male, presenting as a uterine inguinal hernia with transverse testicular ectopia. The testis harbored a mixed germ cell tumor with metastasis. The authors recommend suspecting transverse testicular ectopia when unilateral inguinal hernia coexists with a contralateral nonpalpable testis, and performing ultrasonography before hernia repair to evaluate Müllerian structures and testicular malignancy.

pmid-20084727.summary_ja: 31歳男性が背部痛、体重減少、急性腹症で受診した症例報告である。精巣に原発巣はなく、手術で後腹膜正中の腫瘤が腹腔内へ破裂し十二指腸に浸潤していた。病理学的に卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、大動脈周囲の性腺外原発と考えられた。後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別診断についても述べている。
pmid-20084727.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with back pain, weight loss and an acute abdomen. No testicular primary was found. Surgery revealed a retroperitoneal midline mass that had ruptured into the peritoneal cavity and invaded the duodenum. Pathology showed a yolk sac tumor, interpreted as a primary para-aortic extragonadal yolk sac tumor. The paper also discusses the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses.

pmid-23120419.summary_ja: 舌から発生した口腔内奇形腫の女性新生児の症例報告で、外科的切除により良好に治療された。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含む真の腫瘍で、成熟度は様々であることを解説している。新生児の口腔内奇形腫の報告は文献上22例のみとされる。
pmid-23120419.summary_en: This case report describes a female neonate with an oral teratoma arising from the tongue, successfully treated with surgical excision. The authors note that teratomas are true neoplasms containing tissues from all three germ layers, with variable maturity and unknown origin. They report that only 22 oral-cavity teratomas in newborns had been reported in the literature. The paper combines the clinical case with a brief review.

pmid-27303479.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、仙尾部奇形腫を出生前および出生後のMRIで同定・評価し、その後の外科的切除所見と対比したものである。画像所見と手術所見の相関を示し、周産期における画像診断の有用性を示唆している。症例報告であるため一般化には限界がある。
pmid-27303479.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma identified and characterized on both prenatal and postnatal MRI. The imaging findings were compared with the subsequent surgical resection, showing how MRI can depict the lesion's extent and features before and after birth. As a single case report, the findings illustrate imaging correlation rather than generalizable outcomes, but they highlight MRI's value in evaluating sacrococcygeal teratomas across the perinatal period.

pmid-27303485.summary_ja: 成人女性で、傍咽頭間隙に境界明瞭な不均一な腫瘤を認めた症例報告である。乳児期に頸部の腫瘤摘出歴があった。外科的切除と病理学的検討により良性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定された。頭頸部の奇形腫が成人まで残存しうることを示している。
pmid-27303485.summary_en: This case report describes an adult woman with a mildly symptomatic, heterogeneous, encapsulated mass in the parapharyngeal space. The mass had been removed from her neck as an infant. Imaging showed an encapsulated lesion, and surgical resection with pathology confirmed a benign, mature cystic teratoma. The case shows that head and neck teratomas can be benign and persist into adulthood, and that prior neck surgery history may be relevant.

pmid-15899536.summary_ja: 2006年の医療政策論文で、1996年に策定されたドイツの精巣胚細胞腫瘍のエビデンスに基づくガイドラインがほとんど効果を上げていない理由を検討している。受動的な周知と不十分な医療体制が過剰死亡や地域差の要因とされ、能動的な周知、体制変革、実施指標の設定、継続的な監視が必要と論じている。
pmid-15899536.summary_en: This 2006 Health Policy article examines why evidence-based German guidelines for testicular germ cell tumors, introduced in 1996, have had little effect. The authors attribute Germany's excess mortality and regional disparities in care largely to passive dissemination and inadequate care structures. They argue that active dissemination, structural change, implementation indicators, and continuous monitoring are needed to improve diagnosis, therapy, and follow-up. It is a policy analysis rather than a clinical study and calls for further research on implementation strategies.

pmid-15975650.summary_ja: 胎盤および絨毛癌細胞株におけるDLX4の役割を検討したin vitro研究である。JEG-3細胞でDLX4をRNA干渉によりノックダウンするとアポトーシスが増強し、カスパーゼ-3と-8が増加した。DLX4は絨毛癌細胞の生存に関与する可能性があるが、詳細な機序は未解明であると結論している。
pmid-15975650.summary_en: This study examined DLX4, a homeobox gene implicated in several cancers, in normal placenta and human choriocarcinoma cell lines. Knocking down DLX4 with RNA interference in JEG-3 cells reduced DLX4 protein and enhanced apoptosis, with increased caspase-3 and caspase-8 but no change in Bax. The authors conclude that DLX4 may support survival of choriocarcinoma cells by inhibiting apoptosis, though the mechanism remains unclear. The work is preliminary, based on cell lines, and does not involve patient outcomes.

pmid-15990092.summary_ja: 胃絨毛癌細胞株SCHにHNF-4αを導入し、機能変化を検討した基礎研究である。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)分泌は抑制され、CEACAM1の免疫反応性は増加し、メトトレキサートへの感受性は低下したが、増殖能は変化しなかった。胃組織に特異的な転写因子が胃絨毛癌の機能を調節すると結論している。
pmid-15990092.summary_en: This study tested whether hepatocyte nuclear factor-4alpha (HNF-4alpha), a transcription factor normally expressed in gastric rather than trophoblastic tissue, alters the behavior of a gastric choriocarcinoma cell line (SCH). Stable HNF-4alpha transfection suppressed hCG secretion, increased hPL and CEACAM1 immunoreactivity, and reduced sensitivity to methotrexate, while proliferation was unchanged. Ultrastructural paranuclear filament bundles increased. The authors conclude that tissue-specific transcription factors modulate gastric choriocarcinoma function. The study is in vitro and xenograft-based.

pmid-16007592.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に重篤な高カルシウム血症を合併した16歳女児の症例報告である。悪性腫瘍関連高カルシウム血症の原因と治療を概説し、固形卵巣腫瘤を有する小児では血清カルシウムの監視が必要と提言している。腫瘍切除まで改善しない場合があり、小児腫瘍医が見落としやすい合併症であると指摘している。
pmid-16007592.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with an ovarian dysgerminoma complicated by severe hypercalcemia, a rarely reported metabolic abnormality in this tumor. The authors review potential causes of malignancy-associated hypercalcemia and current treatment strategies. They recommend monitoring serum calcium in all children with solid ovarian masses, since hypercalcemia may not resolve until the tumor is removed. The report highlights that pediatric oncologists may overlook this complication.

pmid-16026831.summary_ja: 本研究では、水腫状流産、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の計39例のホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋標本を用い、p63の免疫組織化学的発現を検討した。絨毛癌では全例でp63陽性細胞が認められず、他の診断との鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。また、染色強度は部分胞状奇胎と完全胞状奇胎の間でのみ差がみられ、奇胎では水腫状流産より強い発現を示した。
pmid-16026831.summary_en: This study examined p63 immunohistochemical expression in hydropic abortion, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma, using formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded samples (39 cases in total). None of the choriocarcinomas showed p63-positive cells, whereas the other diagnoses did. Staining intensity differed only between partial and complete hydatidiform moles. Immunostaining was markedly stronger in moles than in hydropic abortion. The authors conclude that p63 may help distinguish choriocarcinoma from other gestational trophoblastic diseases and separate hydropic abortion from moles in difficult cases.

pmid-16122787.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用い、アンジオテンシンII（Ang II）の遊走・浸潤への影響をTranswell法で検討した。Ang IIは遊走・浸潤を促進し、FAKおよびAktのリン酸化を活性化した。その効果はAT1受容体拮抗薬およびPI3K阻害薬により消失した。Ang IIはAT1受容体を介するPI3K活性化により、絨毛癌細胞の悪性的な振る舞いを促進すると結論づけられている。
pmid-16122787.summary_en: Angiotensin II (Ang II) was tested for effects on migration and invasion of the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo using Transwell assays. Ang II at 10^-8 M promoted both migration and invasion and increased random cell mobility. It activated FAK and Akt phosphorylation. These effects were abolished by a selective AT1 receptor antagonist and by a PI3K inhibitor. The authors conclude that Ang II promotes malignant behavior of choriocarcinoma cells through PI3K activation following AT1 receptor binding.

pmid-16136360.summary_ja: 55歳女性の症例で、右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内にカルチノイド腫瘍を認め、子宮内膜腺癌を併存していた。Pseudo-Meig症候群を伴う多発性同時性の良性・悪性骨盤内腫瘍の初の報告であり、複合的な骨盤内腫瘍の診断の難しさを示している。
pmid-16136360.summary_en: This case report describes a 55-year-old woman with Pseudo-Meigs syndrome, presenting with asthma exacerbation, right ovarian mass, hydrothorax, and elevated CA-125. Histology showed a right ovarian carcinoid tumor embedded within a mature cystic teratoma, while the left ovary, fallopian tube, and uterus harbored a poorly differentiated endometrial adenocarcinoma. The authors state this is the first report of Pseudo-Meigs syndrome associated with an ovarian carcinoid tumor and multiple synchronous benign and malignant pelvic tumors. The case highlights the diagnostic complexity of combined pelvic neoplasms.

pmid-16168588.summary_ja: 三次施設で18か月間に治療した先天性頸部奇形腫の3例を後方視的に検討した。出生前診断はEXIT手技による計画的介入を可能にしたが、1例は死亡した。全例で術後の呼吸窮迫の慎重な観察が必要とされている。
pmid-16168588.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzes three neonates with congenital cervical teratomas managed at a tertiary centre over 18 months. One was diagnosed antenatally and underwent an EXIT procedure with tracheostomy but died shortly after delivery. The other two presented at birth without respiratory distress and underwent neonatal surgical excision. Both developed postoperative respiratory distress requiring intervention but recovered fully without recurrence. The authors conclude that antenatal diagnosis permits planned intervention, and that all patients need close postoperative observation for respiratory distress.

pmid-16175573.summary_ja: セミノーマと非セミノーマの計13例で518のタンパク質キナーゼ遺伝子を解析した。KIT以外に関与する変異キナーゼは見つからず、点突然変異は少ない一方、コピー数変化は頻繁であった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子機序を示す研究である。
pmid-16175573.summary_en: This study sequenced 518 protein kinase genes in seven seminomas and six nonseminomas to identify somatic mutations in testicular germ cell tumors. Only one point mutation, K277E in STK10, was found, and sequencing of STK10 in 40 additional tumors revealed no further mutations. SNP array analysis showed all 13 tumors were aneuploid, with consistent gains on 12p, 8q, 7, and X, and losses on 13q, 18q, 11q, and 4q. The authors conclude that KIT is the only protein kinase implicated in these tumors. Point mutation frequency is low, contrasting with frequent copy number changes.

pmid-16206211.summary_ja: 本研究は、小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床像、治療、転帰を、44年間に治療された女児66例について2施設から検討したものである。多くは病期Iで、成熟奇形腫が最も多かった。大多数は手術のみで治療され、再発率は4.5%、死亡率は3%と、予後は良好であった。
pmid-16206211.summary_en: This two-center review of 66 girls treated over 44 years for ovarian germ cell tumor found that most tumors were stage I and mature teratomas predominated. Most patients underwent surgery alone, with chemotherapy in 10 and radiotherapy plus chemotherapy in one. Recurrence occurred in three patients (4.5%) and mortality was 3%, confirming an excellent prognosis for girls with this disease. Tumor torsion required emergency surgery in 16 patients.

pmid-16220549.summary_ja: セントジュード小児研究病院の腫瘍カンファレンスで提示された、妊娠した思春期女性の妊娠性絨毛癌の症例について述べたものである。小児ではまれな疾患であり、診断、治療、治療終了後の管理に特有の課題が示されている。主要な症例所見と重要な管理上のポイントが論じられている。
pmid-16220549.summary_en: This St. Jude tumor board presentation describes an adolescent with gestational choriocarcinoma, a rare pediatric disease. The case highlights unique diagnostic considerations, treatment challenges, and off-therapy management issues specific to adolescents who become pregnant. The authors discuss the key findings of the case and the important management points for clinicians caring for this population. The presentation shows how multidisciplinary tumor board review can inform care decisions for such patients.

pmid-16226796.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫の既往があり化学療法を受けた19歳女性が、後腹膜腫瘤を呈した。切除で成熟奇形腫と判明したが、後腹膜郭清に伴う乳糜槽損傷と思われる乳糜腹水を合併した。穿刺排液、食事療法、静脈栄養による保存的治療で3か月後に自然消失し、保存的管理の有効性が示された。
pmid-16226796.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman with a prior immature teratoma treated with chemotherapy presented with a retroperitoneal mass. Resection revealed mature teratoma but was complicated by chylous ascites, likely from cisterna chyli injury during retroperitoneal dissection. Management with repeated paracenteses, a low-fat medium-chain triglyceride diet, and total parenteral nutrition led to spontaneous resolution at three months. The case suggests that conservative management can succeed in this setting.

pmid-16228852.summary_ja: 原因不明の反復性喀血を呈した22歳女性で、肺に進展した良性成熟縦隔奇形腫と診断された症例である。3回の塞栓術が無効であったため、胸部外科手術が行われた。本症例は、原因不明の喀血の鑑別に縦隔奇形腫を考慮すべきであることを示唆する。
pmid-16228852.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with recurrent hemoptysis of unknown cause, ultimately diagnosed with a benign mature mediastinal teratoma extending into the lung. Three embolization procedures were ineffective before thoracic surgery was performed. The report highlights that a mediastinal teratoma can present as hemoptysis and should be considered when pulmonary bleeding is unexplained, particularly in young women with no other clear source.

pmid-16229939.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者73例と対照72例で、BCL10遺伝子の4つの一塩基多型を比較した研究である。コドン5とコドン8の変異型アレルは、局在性疾患に比べ転移性疾患と有意に関連していた。これらの多型は進行期への進展に関与する可能性があるが、症例数が少ないため検証が必要である。
pmid-16229939.summary_en: This case-control study examined four BCL10 polymorphisms in 73 testicular germ cell tumor patients and 72 controls. Variant alleles at codons 5 and 8 were associated with metastatic disease, with adjusted odds ratios of 6.25 and 4.63 respectively, compared with localized disease. The authors suggest these BCL10 variants may contribute to progression to advanced-stage germ cell tumors, though the modest sample size warrants validation in larger cohorts.

pmid-16246400.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の一種である胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)55例と文献180例を解析し、予後因子を検討した。病期と明細胞質の存在が全生存期間の独立因子であり、病期と年齢が無病生存の独立因子であった。死亡率は15%で、高齢や長い妊娠間隔も予後不良と関連した。
pmid-16246400.summary_en: This study analyzed 55 placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) cases together with 180 cases from the literature to identify prognostic factors. Most patients were stage I, and 15% died of metastatic disease. Adverse survival was associated with age over 35, an interval over 2 years since the last pregnancy, stage III or IV, high mitotic rate, deep myometrial invasion, and clear cytoplasm. Stage and clear cytoplasm were independent predictors of overall survival, while stage and age predicted disease-free survival.

pmid-16254023.summary_ja: 未治療の病期IIA/B精巣セミノーマ108例に対し、単剤カルボプラチン(AUC7)を3〜4サイクル投与した第II相試験である。完全奏効は81%、失敗率は18%であった。再発14例はすべて完全奏効後に生じ、後腹膜に限局していた。4サイクルでは後腹膜転移を確実に根絶できないと結論された。
pmid-16254023.summary_en: This phase II trial from the German Testicular Cancer Study Group evaluated single-agent carboplatin (AUC 7) in 108 patients with previously untreated stage IIA/B testicular seminoma. Complete response was achieved in 81%, and the overall failure rate was 18%. Fourteen patients relapsed, all after complete response and all in the retroperitoneum. The authors conclude that four cycles of carboplatin do not reliably eradicate retroperitoneal metastases, and the overall and disease-specific survival rates were 99% and 100%.

pmid-16267684.summary_ja: 24歳男性が頸部腫瘤を初発症状として受診し、精巣絨毛癌と診断された症例報告です。絨毛癌は通常、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の成分として生じ、精巣の腫大は軽微なことがあります。頸部への転移は稀であり、若年男性の頸部腫瘤では精巣胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別診断に含める必要があると述べています。
pmid-16267684.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with a neck mass as the first sign of testicular choriocarcinoma, a highly malignant component usually found within mixed germ cell tumors. The testicular enlargement was subtle, and cervical metastasis is rarely reported. The authors stress that cervical masses in young males should include testicular germ cell tumor in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-16271752.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるマスピン発現を免疫組織化学とRT-PCRで検討した研究です。胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍では正常胎盤より発現が低下していました。その後妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を発症した奇胎で発現がより低く、予後予測因子となる可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-16271752.summary_en: This study examined maspin expression in gestational trophoblastic disease using immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR. Maspin was reduced in hydatidiform moles, choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumors compared with normal first-trimester placenta. Expression was lower in moles that later developed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, suggesting a possible prognostic role.

pmid-16273510.summary_ja: 本研究は、OCT3/4、VASA、TSPYの免疫組織化学マーカーを用いて、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が胚細胞を生じうるかを検討した。胚細胞は独立した3例の非セミノーマで認められ、そのうち2例は純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍、1例は卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫の混合腫瘍であった。これは、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍が従来認識されていなかった全能性を持つ可能性を示す。また、原始胚細胞を腫瘍細胞株から誘導できる可能性も示唆している。
pmid-16273510.summary_en: The authors investigated whether non-seminomatous germ cell tumors can generate germ cells using immunohistochemical markers OCT3/4, VASA and TSPY. Germ cell differentiation was identified in three non-seminomas, including two pure yolk sac tumors and one mixed tumor with immature teratoma. The findings suggest a previously unrecognized totipotent potential of human germ cell tumors and raise the possibility of deriving primordial germ cells from tumor cell lines.

pmid-16306787.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患29例（胞状奇胎21例、絨毛癌8例）でHMGI(Y)の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究です。胞状奇胎では絨毛細胞栄養膜細胞と増殖性トロホブラスト領域が陽性で、合胞体栄養膜細胞は陰性でした。絨毛癌は全例で強陽性を示しました。発症機序への関与や補助的な診断マーカーとしての有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-16306787.summary_en: HMGI(Y) expression was examined by immunohistochemistry in 29 gestational trophoblastic disease cases, including 21 hydatidiform moles and 8 choriocarcinomas. Moles showed positivity in villous cytotrophoblast and proliferative trophoblast areas, while syncytiotrophoblast was negative. All choriocarcinomas showed strong immunoreactivity. The authors suggest HMGI(Y) may contribute to GTD pathogenesis and serve as an additional diagnostic marker.

pmid-16306792.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫121例を対象に、術後再発10例と非再発111例を比較した研究です。再発群は若年で、三胚葉成分が多く、中枢神経系成分の発現率が高い傾向でした。シナプトフィジン/GFAP比が高いことは、神経系と神経膠系の両方への分化能を示唆しました。ネスチンは再発予測マーカーとしては有用ではありませんでした。
pmid-16306792.summary_en: This study analyzed 121 patients with mature ovarian cystic teratomas, comparing 10 with recurrence and 111 without. The recurrent group was younger, had more tridermal components and higher CNS component expression. Maturation reduced neurons and increased glia, and a high synaptophysin/GFAP ratio suggested recurrent teratomas can differentiate toward both neuronal and glial lineages. Nestin did not predict recurrence.

pmid-16310039.summary_ja: 胎盤組織における顆粒酵素B阻害因子PI-9の発現を免疫組織化学で検討した研究です。PI-9は絨毛外栄養膜細胞などで高発現し、部分胞状奇胎および全胞状奇胎では合胞体栄養膜細胞でPI-9が著明に増加していました。絨毛癌細胞株でも高発現が確認されました。PI-9の増加が妊娠性絨毛性疾患の免疫逃避に寄与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-16310039.summary_en: This study examined expression of the granzyme B inhibitor PI-9 in placental tissue across gestational ages by immunohistochemistry. PI-9 was highly expressed in extravillous and proliferative cytotrophoblasts and was markedly upregulated in syncytiotrophoblasts of partial and complete hydatidiform moles compared with first-trimester placentas. Choriocarcinoma cell lines also expressed very high PI-9 levels. The authors propose that PI-9 upregulation in gestational trophoblastic disease contributes to immune evasion and pathogenesis.

pmid-16314036.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマが転移した極めて稀な症例の報告です。これまで文献上1例しか報告がなく、本症例では腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の組織学的検索で転移が確認されました。精母細胞性セミノーマの転移は極めて稀であり、術後の病理診断の重要性を示しています。症例報告であり臨床情報は限られています。
pmid-16314036.summary_en: This report describes a patient with metastatic spermatocytic seminoma, a condition documented in the literature only once previously. The metastatic disease was confirmed histologically after laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-RPLND). The case highlights the extreme rarity of metastatic spermatocytic seminoma and the diagnostic role of histopathology after surgical staging. It is a brief case report with limited clinical detail.

pmid-16328533.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍による脳転移15例を後方視的に検討した研究です。全例が手術と全脳放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けました。診断時に脳転移があった例の方が予後良好で、多発転移や栄養膜成分は予後不良因子でした。著者らは積極的な集学的治療を推奨しています。
pmid-16328533.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 15 patients with brain metastases from non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis treated surgically between 1984 and 1998. All received surgery, whole-brain radiotherapy, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Mean survival was about 37.7 months, and eight patients survived beyond five years. Survival was better when brain metastasis was present at diagnosis, while multiple metastases and a trophoblastic component predicted poorer outcomes. The authors advocate aggressive multimodal treatment.

pmid-16338478.summary_ja: 完全ヒト型モノクローナル抗体8-1Aは、無傷のhCGと反応するよう作製されました。マウス由来抗体は免疫原性のため反復投与が困難でしたが、ヒト抗体はこの問題を回避しうると考えられます。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の再発や微小転移の診断、難治例の治療への応用が期待されています。前臨床の抗体開発研究です。
pmid-16338478.summary_en: This study describes the generation of 8-1A, a fully human monoclonal antibody against intact human chorionic gonadotropin, produced in KM mice. Because murine and chimeric antibodies cause immunogenicity that limits repeated use, a human antibody could be advantageous. The authors suggest it may support new diagnostic techniques for detecting recurrence or micrometastasis and new therapies for intractable gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and choriocarcinoma. The report is primarily a preclinical antibody development study.

pmid-16360415.summary_ja: 乳児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍10例でAPC遺伝子を検討した。変異は認められなかったが、7例でプロモーターのメチル化、9例中3例以上で5q21のヘテロ接合性の消失があった。8例はAPCタンパク質を発現していなかった。対立遺伝子欠失とメチル化による不活化が発生に関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-16360415.summary_en: This study examined whether APC gene inactivation contributes to infantile testicular yolk sac tumours. Ten pure infantile YSTs were analysed for mutations, loss of heterozygosity at 5q21, promoter methylation, and protein expression. No mutations were found, but loss of heterozygosity occurred in at least three of nine evaluable tumours, and promoter methylation in seven of ten. Eight tumours lacked APC protein expression, whereas normal infant testicular germ cells expressed it. The authors conclude that allelic loss and promoter methylation likely contribute to infantile YST development, which differs from adult germ cell tumours.

pmid-16371112.summary_ja: 北欧諸国の精巣がん罹患率の近年の動向を記述的に解析した。全体として罹患率は上昇し、出生コホートごとに増加していた。デンマークでは過去5年間に減少がみられ、1943年頃と1968年頃の出生コホートで低い傾向があった。セミノーマと非セミノーマに共通の病因があることが示唆された。
pmid-16371112.summary_en: This descriptive study reports recent trends in testicular cancer incidence across the Nordic countries, with a focus on the recent decline in Denmark. Incidence has risen overall, with increases in each successive birth cohort. Denmark showed a decline over the past five years, and men born around 1943 and 1968 had lower incidence than neighbouring cohorts. These birth-cohort effects were seen for both seminoma and non-seminoma tumours. The authors conclude that birth cohort strongly influences testicular tumour incidence and that seminoma and non-seminoma likely share aetiological factors.

pmid-16373161.summary_ja: 1972年から2002年に治療された小児仙尾部奇形腫25例の経験を検討した。長期の整容的結果は半数以上で不良で、臀部の変形が最も多い晩期合併症であった。膀胱・肛門直腸・性機能の早期評価をフォローアップに組み込み、臀部閉鎖法の改善が必要と結論づけている。女性では帝王切開の可能性も留意すべきとしている。
pmid-16373161.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated 25 children treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma over 30 years, from 1972 to 2002, to assess progress in treatment. Records were reviewed for histology, clinical course, bladder, anorectal and sexual function, and outcome, with a particular focus on long-term cosmetic results. Follow-up ranged from 1 day to 396 months. More than half of the patients had unsatisfactory cosmetic outcomes in the buttock region, which was the most common long-term complication. The authors recommend improved buttock closure techniques, early assessment of organ function within long-term follow-up, and awareness of cesarean delivery in female survivors.

pmid-16387001.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の再発に対しBEP療法を受けた患者に、治療10週後に両眼の網膜虚血と左眼の網膜新生血管が生じた症例報告である。汎網膜光凝固を行ったが視力は回復しなかった。シスプラチン関連化学療法による不可逆的な眼毒性を医師が認識し、患者に警告すべきであると述べている。
pmid-16387001.summary_en: A man with testicular germ cell tumor who received BEP (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for recurrence developed bilateral retinal ischemia and left retinal neovascularization ten weeks after treatment. Panretinal laser photocoagulation was performed, but vision did not recover. The authors highlight that cisplatin-based chemotherapy can cause irreversible ocular toxicity that is underrecognized, and that retinal neovascularization has not previously been reported with cisplatin. Clinicians should warn patients about these risks.

pmid-16390498.summary_ja: 正常精巣と精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるSpanXタンパク質の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。セミノーマでは核に、胎児性癌では細胞質へと染色パターンが変化した。SpanXは減数分裂後に限局せず、腫瘍は上皮内癌細胞に由来する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16390498.summary_en: The authors immunohistochemically examined SpanX protein family expression in normal testes and testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas and embryonal carcinomas. Normal spermatogonia and primary spermatocytes showed strong nuclear staining, while post-meiotic cells showed cytoplasmic signal. Most seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and one teratocarcinoma were positive, with nuclear staining in seminomas and a shift toward cytoplasmic staining in embryonal carcinomas. SpanX is not exclusively post-meiotic, and these tumors may arise from SpanX-positive carcinoma in situ cells.

pmid-16391810.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NCCITをラミニン上で培養し、シスプラチンを作用させた研究です。ラミニンはシスプラチン誘導アポトーシスを増強しました。シスプラチンはFAKの発現を早期に低下させ、c-IAP-2とXIAPの発現を減少させてカスパーゼ活性を抑制できませんでした。生存シグナル分子を標的とすることで、化学療法抵抗性の克服が期待されます。
pmid-16391810.summary_en: This study examined testicular germ cell tumor cell line NCCIT treated with cisplatin while adhered to laminin. Laminin enhanced cisplatin-induced apoptosis. Cisplatin reduced FAK expression early, which lowered c-IAP-2 and XIAP expression and failed to suppress caspase activation. Laminin signaling thus promotes apoptosis partly by downregulating survival molecules, suggesting that targeting these molecules could overcome chemoresistance in testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-16395710.summary_ja: 欧州22か国の精巣がんの罹患率と死亡率を、年齢・時代・コホート解析で評価しました。罹患率はすべての対象国で増加しました。死亡率は1980～90年代に北欧・西欧を中心に年3～6%低下しました。一方、南欧・東欧の一部では死亡率が横ばいまたは上昇しており、最適な治療の提供の遅れが示唆されます。
pmid-16395710.summary_en: Age-period-cohort modeling of testicular cancer incidence and mortality in 22 European countries. Incidence rose consistently in every studied country, while mortality fell 3 to 6% annually during the 1980s and 1990s, mainly in Northern and Western Europe. Some Southern and Eastern countries showed stable or rising mortality, reflecting slower access to optimal care. Men born after major treatment advances may be the first to benefit.
