The authors note that only six gastric yolk sac tumors had been previously reported, five with adenocarcinoma components, making this the second report of a pure form.

pmid-15723218.summary_ja: 14歳女児が行動異常から急速に昏睡へ進行し、髄液細胞増多を認めた。10週後に未熟卵巣奇形腫が発見された。腫瘍摘出後に症状はわずかに改善したが、リハビリテーション中に死亡した。進行性の辺縁系症状と髄液細胞増多を示す思春期女児では、卵巣奇形腫を背景とする傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎を考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-15723218.summary_en: This report describes a 14-year-old girl whose behavioral disturbance rapidly progressed to coma, with CSF pleocytosis and no or only mild MRI abnormality. An immature ovarian teratoma was identified ten weeks later. Her symptoms improved slightly after tumor excision, but she died during rehabilitation. The authors emphasize that paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis should be considered in teenage girls with progressive limbic symptoms and CSF pleocytosis, and that an underlying ovarian teratoma should be sought.

pmid-15727610.summary_ja: 9歳児が肺内奇形腫に起因する喀毛症(トリコプトイシス)を呈した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で嚢胞成分と充実成分を含む不均一な腫瘤が認められ、病理組織学的検査で奇形腫と確定した。小児で肺実質から生じる奇形腫は極めて稀であり、胸部奇形腫の好発部位は縦隔前部である。画像所見と鑑別診断を論じている。
pmid-15727610.summary_en: A 9-year-old child presented with trichoptysis caused by an intrapulmonary teratoma. CT and MRI showed a heterogeneous mass with cystic and solid components, and histopathological examination confirmed teratoma. The authors note that teratomas arising in lung parenchyma are extremely rare in childhood, whereas the anterior mediastinum is the most common thoracic site. The report discusses the imaging findings and the differential diagnosis of thoracic teratomas.

pmid-15731746.summary_ja: 早産で出生した男児が出生直後に右陰嚢の腫脹を示した。手術で、分化の高い奇形腫と出血性梗塞を伴う腟膜外捻転が判明し、精巣摘除術が施行された。奇形腫を伴う下降精巣の子宮内捻転の初報告である。12か月間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。新生児の陰嚢腫脹の鑑別診断に精巣腫瘍を含めるべきと強調している。
pmid-15731746.summary_en: This case report describes a preterm male newborn with right hemiscrotal swelling immediately after birth. Surgery revealed extravaginal torsion of a descended testis containing a highly differentiated teratoma with hemorrhagic infarction, and orchiectomy was performed. The authors state this is the first report of intrauterine torsion of a descended testis with a teratomatous tumor. No recurrence was found over twelve months of follow-up. They emphasize that testicular tumors should be included in the differential diagnosis of neonatal scrotal swelling.

pmid-15734016.summary_ja: 生後10か月の女児が進行性の眼球突出と眼球運動麻痺で受診し、CTで眼窩尖端部に腫瘤を認めた。生検で胎児性癌と診断され、多剤併用化学療法により7年後も腫瘍は認められていない。眼窩原発の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は、若年児の眼球突出の鑑別診断に含めるべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-15734016.summary_en: A 10-month-old girl presented with progressive proptosis and ophthalmoplegia. Computed tomography showed an orbital apex mass, and biopsy revealed embryonal carcinoma, a non-gonadal germ cell tumor. She was treated with multimodality chemotherapy and remained tumor-free at 7 years, with mild amblyopia and microesotropia. The authors review intracranial and intraorbital GCT cases and argue that orbital GCTs should be considered in the differential diagnosis of young children with proptosis, since accurate identification and treatment markedly improve survival.

pmid-15734211.summary_ja: セミノーマ19例のDNAについてCDKN2プロモーターの変異を解析した。1例で位置-1973へのアデニン挿入が同定され、免疫組織化学染色でp16INK4Aタンパク発現の消失と相関した。既知の機序に加え、一部のセミノーマにおけるp16INK4A発現異常の一因となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15734211.summary_en: Seminoma DNAs from 19 patients were screened for CDKN2 promoter mutations to explain aberrant p16INK4A expression in male germ-cell tumors. PCR-SSCP and sequencing identified an adenine insertion at position -1973 in one patient. Immunohistochemistry showed that this promoter mutation correlated with loss of p16INK4A protein expression. The authors suggest that this mutation may contribute to altered p16INK4A expression in at least some seminomas, in addition to previously described mechanisms.

pmid-15735668.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍ではHERV-K由来のrec転写産物が高発現している。HERV-K recを誘導的に発現させたマウスでは胚細胞の発生が障害され、19か月齢までに古典的セミノーマの前駆病変である上皮内癌様の変化を示すことがあった。内在性レトロウイルス遺伝子が臓器特異的な発がんに寄与しうることを示す初の直接的証拠である。
pmid-15735668.summary_en: Patients with germ cell tumors often have serum antibodies against HERV-K proteins, and HERV-K env and rec transcripts are highly expressed in these tumors. The authors generated mice with inducible expression of HERV-K rec. These mice showed disturbed germ cell development and, by 19 months of age, some developed changes resembling carcinoma in situ, the precursor lesion of classic seminoma. This provides direct evidence that an endogenous retroviral gene can contribute to organ-specific tumorigenesis.

pmid-15738984.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍は臓器別に分類されてきたが、本総説では異なる解剖学的部位に生じうる5つの病型からなる一つの疾患として捉えることが提案されている。各病型の発生能は起源となる胚細胞の成熟段階とインプリンティング状態で決まる。この枠組みは、予測困難な進展や治療感受性の高さの理解に役立つとされる。
pmid-15738984.summary_en: This review proposes that germ cell tumors, traditionally classified by organ, are a single disease expressed as five entities that can arise at different anatomical sites. The developmental potential of each entity is determined by the maturation stage and imprinting status of the originating germ cell. The authors argue that this framework helps explain the unpredictable behavior of these tumors and their exceptional sensitivity to therapy.

pmid-15739106.summary_ja: 女性新生児が卵巣捻転と卵巣類皮嚢腫を伴い、先天性腹水、胸水、呼吸窮迫を呈した。症状は非定型Meigs症候群に合致し、片側卵巣摘出術により改善した。先天性卵巣疾患を伴う新生児のこの症候群の報告は初めてとされ、新生児期でも類皮嚢腫が捻転の原因となりうることが示された。
pmid-15739106.summary_en: A female neonate presented with ovarian torsion associated with ovarian follicular and dermoid cysts, along with congenital ascites, pleural effusions, and respiratory distress. Her symptoms were consistent with atypical Meigs' syndrome, and they resolved after unilateral oophorectomy. The authors report this as the first case of this syndrome in a neonate associated with congenital ovarian disease, highlighting that ovarian dermoid cysts can cause torsion even in the neonatal period.

pmid-15742862.summary_ja: 25歳未婚女性が下腹部痛と悪心で受診し、超音波検査で9.7cmの左卵巣腫瘤を認めた。腹腔鏡下に捻転を解除し嚢胞摘出術を行い、病理で嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。妊孕性を温存する保存的治療は安全であり、妊娠可能年齢の女性に推奨されるとしている。
pmid-15742862.summary_en: A 25-year-old woman presented with lower abdominal pain and nausea. Ultrasonography showed a 9.7 cm left ovarian mass, and laparoscopy revealed a torsed left ovary. After detorsion and cystectomy, pathology confirmed a cystic teratoma. The authors argue that conservative management with detorsion and ovary-sparing cystectomy is safe and should be encouraged in women of reproductive age to preserve fertility and ovarian function.

pmid-15743802.summary_ja: リンパ管マーカーであるpodoplaninの発現を検討し、卵巣ディスジャーミノーマや顆粒膜細胞腫瘍を含む胚細胞腫瘍および扁平上皮癌で強発現することを示した。市販抗体D2-40がヒトpodoplaninを特異的に認識することも確認され、組織切片での染色法として有用であることが示された。腫瘍進行やリンパ管新生への関与が示唆される。
pmid-15743802.summary_en: This study examines podoplanin, a lymphatic endothelial marker, and shows it is strongly expressed in squamous cell carcinomas and germ cell tumors, including ovarian dysgerminomas and granulosa cell tumors. The authors also generated a human podoplanin-Fc fusion protein and validated the commercial D2-40 antibody for specific staining of human podoplanin in archival tissue. Expression was largely absent from normal epidermis but induced in most squamous carcinomas, suggesting a role in tumor progression and lymphangiogenesis.

pmid-15745745.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株が分泌するhCGの糖鎖型を、糖鎖の少ない抗体断片を用いたレクチン免疫測定法で解析した。従来のIgGに比べてレクチン結合を約90%減少させ、妊娠尿や絨毛癌患者由来hCGの既知の糖鎖パターンと整合する結果を得た。糖タンパク質解析への汎用性も示された。
pmid-15745745.summary_en: The authors developed lectin immunoassays using carbohydrate-free antibody fragments to capture human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). These fragments reduced lectin binding by about 90% compared with intact IgG. Using this method, they characterized hCG glycoforms secreted by three human choriocarcinoma cell lines, which showed lectin binding patterns consistent with glycans reported in hCG from pregnancy urine and from choriocarcinoma patients. The approach may be broadly applicable to lectin-based analysis of glycoproteins.

pmid-15747103.summary_ja: ターナー症候群の5例についてY染色体配列をPCRで検出し、性腺芽腫や胚細胞腫瘍のリスク同定に用いる可能性を検討した。Y由来物質を持つモザイク症例3例のうち、性腺腫瘍が3例に認められた。性腺摘出標本の段階的切片作製による微小病変の検出も推奨されている。
pmid-15747103.summary_en: The study screened five patients with Ullrich-Turner syndrome for Y chromosomal sequences by PCR to identify those at risk of gonadoblastoma or germ cell tumors. Three patients had mosaicism with Y-derived material, and gonadal tumors were found in three patients, including gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma. The authors suggest Y-sequence screening as an additional tool for risk identification, and recommend thorough step sectioning of gonadectomy specimens to detect small lesions.

pmid-15749271.summary_ja: 卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍（ステージIc）と未熟奇形腫（ステージIa）の妊婦2例に、術後に妊娠中期以降で BEP 療法を施行した。6年および2年の観察で再発はなく、児に奇形や神経発達の異常は認められなかった。妊娠中の化学療法の実行可能性を示す報告である。
pmid-15749271.summary_en: The authors report two pregnant women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors: a stage Ic yolk sac tumor and a stage Ia immature teratoma. Both received bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin during the second or third trimester after surgery. Neither had recurrence at 6 and 2 years of follow-up, and their babies showed no malformations and normal neurodevelopment. The report suggests this regimen may be feasible for pregnant women with ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-15750196.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移3例に対し、ガンマナイフ定位放射線手術を施行した。全例で化学療法と全脳照射を先行し、2例は全身再発に対して大量化学療法を追加した。中央値63カ月の観察で全例生存し、神経脱落なく腫瘍制御が得られた。
pmid-15750196.summary_en: The authors evaluated gamma knife radiosurgery in three patients with brain metastases from testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, all of whom had prior chemotherapy and whole brain radiotherapy. Two patients received high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell rescue for systemic recurrence. All remained alive with a median follow-up of 63 months, without neurological deficits, and tumor control was achieved. Delayed imaging changes occurred, and the authors conclude radiosurgery is effective and safe, with whole brain radiotherapy given in 1.8 Gy fractions to reduce long-lasting changes.

pmid-15750271.summary_ja: 17歳の男性の縦隔セミノーマの症例報告。化学療法と縦隔照射の後、大量シクロホスファミド併用の自家末梢血幹細胞移植を受けた。大量シクロホスファミド投与の6日後に心筋症を発症した。シクロホスファミド誘発性心筋症の予測因子は明確でなく、既往の縦隔照射が発症に関与した可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-15750271.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old man with mediastinal seminoma who received chemotherapy and mediastinal irradiation, then high-dose cyclophosphamide with autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. Six days after high-dose cyclophosphamide, he developed cardiomyopathy. Predictive factors for cyclophosphamide-induced cardiomyopathy are not well established. The authors suggest that prior mediastinal irradiation contributed to the onset of the cardiac toxicity.

pmid-15750911.summary_ja: 生後7日の乳児にみられたIV型仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。尿閉を主訴に受診した。尿道カテーテル留置後も両側水腎症が改善せず、緊急手術が必要となった。診断経過と外科的治療を解説し、稀な提示様式において速やかな手術の重要性を強調している。
pmid-15750911.summary_en: This report describes a 7-day-old infant with a type IV sacrococcygeal teratoma who presented with urinary retention. Bilateral hydronephrosis persisted despite urinary catheterization, requiring urgent surgery. The authors review the diagnostic workup and surgical management. They emphasize that prompt surgery is necessary in this rare presentation of a fetal neoplasm that is usually benign but may contain malignant components.

pmid-15755005.summary_ja: 60歳女性の卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した悪性黒色腫の稀な症例。手術と化学療法を受けたが、4か月で死亡した。S-100およびHMB-45陽性から黒色腫と診断され、卵巣外原発は認められなかった。子宮、対側卵巣、大網、リンパ節に転移していた。文献的考察も含まれる。
pmid-15755005.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of malignant melanoma arising within an ovarian cystic teratoma in a 60-year-old woman who died four months after surgery and chemotherapy. Immunohistochemistry for S-100 and HMB-45 confirmed melanocytic origin. No extra-ovarian primary was identified, so the tumor was diagnosed as primary ovarian melanoma with metastases to the uterus, contralateral ovary, omentum, and a lymph node. A literature review is included.

pmid-15755015.summary_ja: 同一卵巣内に卵巣甲状腺腫(奇形腫の一型)とブレンナー腫瘍が併存した症例報告。免疫組織化学で甲状腺濾胞細胞とブレンナー巣の移行上皮様細胞の双方がサイログロブリン陽性であった。ブレンナー腫瘍の起源には議論があり、奇形腫成分を伴う例は胚細胞由来の可能性があると考察されている。
pmid-15755015.summary_en: This case report describes struma ovarii, a teratoma subtype, coexisting with a Brenner tumor in the same ovary. Immunohistochemistry showed thyroglobulin positivity in both thyroid follicular cells and transitional cells of the Brenner nests. The authors discuss the controversial histogenesis of Brenner tumors. Brenner tumors associated with teratomatous elements may originate from germ cells, whereas pure Brenner tumors likely arise from the ovarian surface epithelium.

pmid-15757440.summary_ja: 精巣の低病期非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割をまとめた総説。病期分類の正確な手段となり、化学療法の必要性の判断に役立つ。脈管侵入や胎児性癌成分優位などの高リスク例では単独治療でも高い治癒率が得られる。奇形腫は化学療法抵抗性のため、原発性の後腹膜リンパ節郭清が適する場合がある。
pmid-15757440.summary_en: This review examines retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. RPLND serves as an accurate staging tool, guides the need for chemotherapy, and can cure patients with high-risk features such as lymphovascular invasion or embryonal predominance. Teratoma is chemoresistant and may warrant primary RPLND. Surveillance is an option for motivated patients, while the oncologic control of laparoscopic RPLND remains uncertain.

pmid-15757445.summary_ja: 精巣がんの治療進歩をまとめた総説。予後良好な転移性疾患ではブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン3サイクルで約90〜95%が治癒する一方、中・不良リスク群の成績は劣る。長期生存者では二次性悪性腫瘍や心血管疾患のリスクが問題となり、病期Iの管理として、セミノーマの放射線療法や非セミノーマの補助療法の必要性が再検討されている。
pmid-15757445.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in treating testicular cancer. Combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin cures about 90 to 95 percent of patients with good-prognosis metastatic disease, while intermediate- and poor-risk patients fare less well. Long-term survivors face increased risks of second malignancy and cardiovascular disease, prompting re-evaluation of management for stage I disease, including the role of radiotherapy in stage I seminoma and adjuvant therapy in stage I nonseminoma. Advances in imaging and prognostic markers are expected to refine these decisions.

pmid-15761466.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を年齢と組織型で分類し、起源と分子生物学的特徴を整理した総説。成人型は12p染色体の等染色体(i(12p))と異数性が特徴で、前駆病変は未分類型精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（IGCNU）とされる。停留精巣などがリスク因子として挙げられる。小児型は奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍が多く二倍体で、i(12p)を欠く。
pmid-15761466.summary_en: This review describes the origins and molecular biology of testicular germ cell tumors, grouped into infantile or prepubertal tumors, adolescent and young adult tumors, and spermatocytic seminoma. Postpubertal tumors are characterized by i(12p) and aneuploidy, with IGCNU as the precursor, and risk factors include cryptorchidism, in utero estrogen exposure and gonadal dysgenesis. Prepubertal tumors, which are teratomas or yolk sac tumors, tend to be diploid and lack i(12p), while spermatocytic seminoma shows chromosome 9 losses. The pathogenesis of prepubertal germ cell tumors and spermatocytic seminoma remains poorly understood.

pmid-15761467.summary_ja: 性腺胚細胞腫瘍の病理診断における鑑別の難しさと論争点を選択的にまとめた総説。卵巣と精巣の奇形腫の発生機序や悪性転化の違い、ジャーミノーマの紛らわしい亜型、有用な免疫染色マーカーを解説する。精母細胞性セミノーマ、多胚芽腫、burnt-out型腫瘍などの稀な腫瘍も扱う。
pmid-15761467.summary_en: A selective review of gonadal germ cell tumors focusing on diagnostic pitfalls and contested issues. It covers the pathogenesis of teratomas in the ovary versus the testis, with postpubertal testicular teratomas arising from malignant germ cells, and the differing malignant transformation patterns in each gonad. Diagnostic challenges such as germinoma variants mimicking yolk sac tumor or embryonal carcinoma are discussed, along with useful immunohistochemical markers including PLAP, CD117 and OCT3/4. Rare entities such as spermatocytic seminoma, polyembryoma and burnt-out tumors are also reviewed.

pmid-15761863.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株でシスプラチン感受性株と耐性株を比較し、ゲノムおよび発現プロファイルを解析した研究。一貫したコピー数変化は見つからなかったが、耐性株すべてで16q22-23領域の過剰発現が認められた。この領域の遺伝子がシスプラチン耐性に関与し、新たな治療標的となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15761863.summary_en: This study compared three cisplatin-sensitive testicular germ cell tumor cell lines with their paired cisplatin-resistant derivatives using comparative genomic hybridization and expressed sequence hybridization. No consistent copy-number changes were found across the pairs, but a region at 16q22-23 was consistently overexpressed in all resistant lines. The authors suggest that genes in this region may contribute to cisplatin resistance and could represent novel therapeutic targets.

pmid-15767805.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と紛らわしい嚢胞状・微小嚢胞状・管状の形態を示す精巣セミノーマ28例の検討。腫瘍細胞は典型的なセミノーマの細胞像を保ち、OCT-3/4、胎盤型ALP、CD117が陽性で、サイトケラチンおよびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は陰性であった。鑑別には不規則な管腔形態などの所見と、免疫染色パネルが有用とされる。
pmid-15767805.summary_en: A study of 28 testicular seminomas showing unusual cystic, microcystic and tubular patterns that often mimic yolk sac tumor. Tumor cells retained typical seminoma cytology, and the tumors were positive for OCT-3/4, placental alkaline phosphatase and CD117 while negative for cytokeratin and alpha-fetoprotein. The authors highlight features that distinguish these spaces from yolk sac tumor, such as irregular channels and cell morphology, and recommend an immunostain panel of AE1/AE3, OCT-3/4 and AFP for problematic cases.

pmid-15771638.summary_ja: 閉経後の72歳女性に生じた、後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の粘液性腺癌の症例報告。後腹膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が腺癌へ悪性転化することは極めて稀で、特に高齢者での発生は注目に値する。本抄録では画像所見や治療経過の詳細は記載されていない。著者らは、後腹膜病変における悪性転化を記録する目的でこの稀な症例を提示している。
pmid-15771638.summary_en: This case report describes a 72-year-old postmenopausal woman with mucinous adenocarcinoma arising from a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma. Malignant transformation of a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma to adenocarcinoma is extremely rare, particularly at this age. The abstract is brief and gives no detailed information on imaging, treatment or outcome. The authors present this rare case to document malignant transformation in a retroperitoneal lesion in an elderly patient.

pmid-15772802.summary_ja: 44歳女性の尾骨傍奇形腫の症例です。成熟奇形腫内に原発性腺癌が認められました。後方アプローチで尾骨切除を伴う完全切除を行い、予後のため尾骨の一括切除と切除断端陰性の確保が重要と強調されています。術後7年間無病で経過しています。
pmid-15772802.summary_en: This case report describes a 44-year-old woman with a paracoccygeal teratoma in which the mature teratoma contained a primary adenocarcinoma. The mass was completely excised with coccygectomy through a posterior approach, and en bloc removal of the coccyx was emphasized as essential for prognosis. The patient has remained disease-free for seven years after surgery. The authors stress that clear-margin excision is the key to managing this rare entity.

pmid-15773370.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の2症例で、血清AFPが持続的に高値を示しました。症例1は慢性肝炎を合併したセミノーマで、縦隔転移に化学療法を行い、AFPと肝酵素は低下し無病となりました。症例2は胎児性癌と奇形腫を含む腫瘍で、化学療法後もAFP高値が持続しましたが、LCA分画により生存腫瘍はないと示唆されました。
pmid-15773370.summary_en: This report describes two men with testicular tumors whose serum AFP stayed persistently elevated. In case 1, a seminoma with mediastinal metastasis was treated with chemotherapy, and AFP and transaminases decreased during follow-up despite underlying chronic hepatitis. In case 2, a mixed tumor containing embryonal carcinoma and teratoma had an AFP of 45 ng/ml that stayed high after two chemotherapy cycles without new lesions. LCA subfractionation suggested no viable tumor. Both patients are disease-free.

pmid-15777496.summary_ja: 大型の精巣セミノーマに対し、斜切開による単一の鼠径陰嚢切開で精巣摘除術を行った症例報告と文献レビューです。鼠径部からの大きな陰嚢内腫瘤の摘出が可能で、腫瘍の漏出や鞘膜の損傷の懸念を減らせます。標準的な高位鼠径精巣摘除術と既報の併用アプローチと比較しています。
pmid-15777496.summary_en: This case report describes a large testicular cancer, a seminoma, removed through a single oblique inguinoscrotal incision. The approach allows inguinal delivery of a large scrotal mass without a separate scrotal incision and reduces concerns about tumor spillage and violation of the tunica vaginalis. The authors review standard high inguinal orchiectomy and compare it with a previously described combined inguinal and scrotal approach. They conclude that the single-incision technique is a feasible option for giant testicular tumors.

pmid-15777886.summary_ja: 原発不明の肝様悪性腫瘍を総説し、腹膜播種を伴う70代女性の症例を報告しています。肝様結節の凍結切片を契機に超音波検査を行い、肝内病変はありませんでした。腹膜腫瘍は卵黄嚢腫瘍の肝様亜型と結論され、同時性の大腸腺癌2病変との衝突腫瘍とされました。転移性腺癌との鑑別の難しさが強調されています。
pmid-15777886.summary_en: This paper reviews hepatoid malignancies of unknown origin and reports a septuagenarian woman with peritoneal carcinomatosis. Frozen section of liver-like nodules prompted intraoperative ultrasound, which showed no intrahepatic lesions. Two synchronous colonic adenocarcinomas were found alongside a serosal hepatoid nodule. Based on immunohistochemistry, opisthoplasia analysis, and chemotherapy response, the authors conclude that the peritoneal tumor was a hepatoid variant of yolk sac tumor and a collision tumor with two primaries. The case emphasizes the difficulty of differentiating these tumors from metastatic adenocarcinoma.

pmid-15780169.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）の、精巣摘除後の管理を検討した文献です。選択肢は後腹膜リンパ節郭清、監視、化学療法です。予後因子に基づくリスク適応的治療を提唱しています。低リスク例は積極的監視から開始でき、高リスク例には手術または初回化学療法が推奨されます。
pmid-15780169.summary_en: This review addresses management of clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT) after orchiectomy. The options include retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, surveillance, and chemotherapy. The authors advocate risk-adapted treatment based on prognostic factors to reduce overall treatment burden while maintaining survival. Low-risk patients can start with active surveillance, while high-risk patients are usually offered surgery or primary chemotherapy. Delayed therapy can salvage many patients who progress.

pmid-15780395.summary_ja: FSH治療を1年間受けた不妊男性が、両側の精巣腫瘍を呈した症例報告です。血清β-hCGと乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)が上昇していました。両側精巣のセミノーマ（pT1N0M0）と診断され、術後放射線療法が行われました。ホルモン治療が腫瘍発生を促進した可能性があり、不妊治療でホルモン療法を受けた男性には慎重なフォローアップが必要と述べています。
pmid-15780395.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old infertile man who received follicle-stimulating hormone for one year and later presented with bilateral palpable testicular tumors. Serum beta-hCG and LDH were elevated. Pathology revealed a pure seminoma in each testis (pT1N0M0), and adjuvant radiotherapy was given. The authors suggest the hormonal treatment may have promoted tumor development. They recommend careful testicular follow-up in men who received hormone therapy for infertility.

pmid-15782074.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣奇形腫の未熟性を胎児発生の段階に基づいて評価する新たな分類法を提案する。切除された充実性卵巣奇形腫25例を、CD30、CD34、CD99、bcl-2、AFP、PLAPの免疫染色で解析した。未熟奇形腫は受精後8週未満の胚段階、成熟奇形腫はそれ以降の胎児段階に相当すると考えられた。
pmid-15782074.summary_en: This study proposes a histologic-ontogeny framework for grading ovarian teratomas. Using immunohistochemical markers (CD30, CD34, CD99, bcl-2, AFP, PLAP), the authors examined 25 resected solid ovarian teratomas and compared their components with fetal developmental stages. Immature teratomas corresponded to embryonic stages before 8 weeks of fertilization age, while mature teratomas corresponded to later fetal stages. The markers helped identify immature neuroepithelial tubules and cartilage. The authors propose that this ontogeny-based grading system could be more scientific and reproducible across the teratoma spectrum.

pmid-15788213.summary_ja: 症例報告である。37歳男性の仙尾部奇形腫内に発生した、臨床的に悪性の高分化型内分泌癌(カルチノイド)の症例である。初診時にすでに骨盤リンパ節、肝、骨への転移があった。仙骨前部カルチノイドとしてこのような攻撃的な経過の報告はなく、尾部腸嚢胞の胚発生から後腸由来が考察されている。
pmid-15788213.summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with a clinically malignant well-differentiated endocrine carcinoma (carcinoid) arising within a sacrococcygeal teratoma. At initial diagnosis, the tumor had already metastasized to pelvic lymph nodes, liver, and bone. The authors note that such aggressive behavior has not previously been described in presacral carcinoid tumors. They discuss a hindgut origin, relating these lesions to embryologic development of tailgut cysts. The report also reviews the literature on presacral carcinoid tumors, which are usually benign.

pmid-15788293.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ80例を対象に、傍大動脈照射野の頭側縮小の効果を検討した。中央値7.1年の追跡で5年再発非発生生存率は95%であった。照射体積は中央値16%減少し、再発率の増加は認められず、晩期放射線障害の軽減が期待できると結論づけた。
pmid-15788293.summary_en: This analysis of 80 patients with stage I testicular seminoma assessed whether narrowing the para-aortic radiotherapy field cranially to the T11/T12 junction affects outcomes. Patients received a median dose of 20 Gy and were followed with CT. At a median follow-up of 7.1 years, five-year relapse-free survival was 95%, and no relapses occurred within the reduced cranial volume. The reduction decreased treatment volume by a median of 16% without increasing relapse rates. The authors recommend this approach to limit late radiation effects.

pmid-15790466.summary_ja: 症例報告である。30歳女性の外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍で、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常でも鼠径リンパ節転移を認めた。局所切除、シスプラチン併用化学療法、放射線療法により90か月無病生存を得た。血清AFPはフォローアップの指標として感度が低い可能性が指摘された。
pmid-15790466.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman had a vulvar yolk sac tumor with inguinal lymph node metastasis, despite a normal serum AFP level. Treatment consisted of local excision, cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and pelvic and groin radiotherapy. She remained disease-free 90 months after diagnosis. The authors suggest that local excision with adjuvant cisplatin chemotherapy is justified, that inguinal lymphadenectomy should be considered because metastasis may occur early, and that serum AFP may not be a sensitive follow-up marker for this tumor.

pmid-15790467.summary_ja: 症例報告である。子宮外妊娠を疑われた26歳女性の大網に、7cm大の絨毛癌が見つかった。DNAの遺伝子多型解析で腫瘍に夫由来のHLA抗原が含まれ、妊娠性の原発性と確認された。化学療法6コースで臨床的寛解が得られた。
pmid-15790467.summary_en: A 26-year-old nulligravid woman underwent laparoscopy for suspected ectopic pregnancy and was found to have a 7-cm hemorrhagic tumor on the greater omentum. Histology showed choriocarcinoma, and HLA gene polymorphism analysis of tumor DNA confirmed both the patient's and her husband's HLA antigens, establishing gestational origin. The tumor was therefore considered primary to the omentum rather than metastatic. Six courses of chemotherapy achieved clinical remission. The authors report this as the first case of omental choriocarcinoma of confirmed gestational origin by DNA polymorphism analysis.

pmid-15790478.summary_ja: 症例報告である。閉経後女性の良性卵巣甲状腺腫で、偽Meigs症候群、甲状腺機能亢進症、CA125高値を伴った。卵巣癌との鑑別が困難な骨盤内腫瘤を呈した。腹水・胸水があり細胞診陰性の患者では、卵巣甲状腺腫を鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べている。
pmid-15790478.summary_en: A postmenopausal woman presented with a benign struma ovarii, a teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. The case was complicated by pseudo-Meigs syndrome, hyperthyroidism, and elevated CA125. A large complex right pelvic mass mimicked ovarian cancer. The authors note that struma ovarii is a rare cause of ascites, hydrothorax, elevated CA125, and hyperthyroidism. They recommend considering it in the differential diagnosis of patients with ascites and pleural effusion when cytology is negative.

pmid-15791662.summary_ja: 出生前の超音波検査とMRIで骨盤正中の嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、クロアカ奇形との鑑別が問題となった症例。MRI所見から仙尾部奇形腫が疑われ、妊娠中絶後の病理検査で確認された。直腸内メコニウムのT1高信号の欠如は、腫瘤による圧迫で直腸が空虚になっていることでも説明しうると指摘している。
pmid-15791662.summary_en: This report describes a female fetus with a pelvic midline cystic mass that mimicked a cloacal anomaly on prenatal imaging. Ultrasonography and MRI at 27 to 27.5 weeks showed a cystic mass with ureteral and renal pelvic dilatation, and absence of rectal T1 hyperintensity from meconium. The MRI findings suggested a sacrococcygeal teratoma, and pregnancy was terminated. Postmortem pathology confirmed the diagnosis. The authors note that absence of rectal meconium signal may reflect an empty rectum compressed by the mass, not necessarily a cloaca.

pmid-15793744.summary_ja: 9歳女児が、縦隔ジャーミノーマによる気管圧迫で窒息をきたし、生命を脅かす気道閉塞を呈した。全身麻酔下で体外循環の準備のもと緊急に腫瘍減量切除を行い、術後の補助化学療法と放射線治療で奏効した。再発の証拠はなく生存している。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が救急で発症しうることを示す。
pmid-15793744.summary_en: A 9-year-old girl presented with life-threatening airway obstruction from a mediastinal germinoma compressing the trachea and causing asphyxia. Emergent surgical debulking was performed under general anesthesia with extracorporeal circulation immediately available. After surgery, the tumor responded to adjuvant chemotherapy and irradiation. The patient survived without evidence of recurrence. The report underscores that mediastinal germ cell tumors can present as an emergency and that airway-compromising masses require urgent multidisciplinary management.

pmid-15803003.summary_ja: 35年間に早期精巣セミノーマ73例に術後放射線療法を施行した単施設研究。傍大動脈・骨盤領域への低用量照射により、15年の中央値追跡期間で20年時点の局所制御率は95%、疾患特異的生存率は96%であった。晩期合併症は少なく、縦隔照射群で心血管合併症の増加は認められなかった。
pmid-15803003.summary_en: This 35-year single-institution study reviewed 73 patients with early-stage testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant low-dose radiotherapy to the paraaortic and pelvic fields, with one-third also receiving prophylactic mediastinal and supraclavicular irradiation. With a median follow-up of 15 years, 20-year local control was 95% and cause-specific survival 96%. Late toxicities were minimal, including gastrointestinal reflux in 11 patients and one peptic ulcer, and mediastinal irradiation did not increase cardiovascular complications. The authors conclude that low-dose adjuvant radiotherapy yields excellent long-term cure with minimal late complications.

pmid-15803215.summary_ja: 17歳男性の精巣腫瘍例で、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値を示した。手術後にブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を施行。組織学的に成熟奇形腫、未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ポリエンブリオーマを含む精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。治療後5か月以上AFPは正常範囲で、良好な経過である。同時期の兄も5年前に同様の腫瘍を切除されていた。
pmid-15803215.summary_en: A case report of a 17-year-old male with a testicular tumor and elevated alpha-fetoprotein, treated with surgery followed by bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor with mature and immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and polyembryoma. He remained well with normal AFP levels more than five months after treatment. Notably, his brother had a similar testicular tumor removed five years earlier, suggesting familial occurrence.

pmid-15803493.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣癌の22例で、術前に放射性標識薬を注射し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清時に放射線誘導下でセンチネルリンパ節をマッピングした。22例中21例(95%)で検出され、大部分は大静脈や大動脈付近に位置した。2例はセンチネルリンパ節のみに微小転移を認めた。標準的な後腹膜リンパ節郭清の省略の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15803493.summary_en: Twenty-two men with clinical stage I testicular carcinoma received preoperative injection of technetium-labeled phytate, followed by radical orchiectomy and laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with radio-guided sentinel node mapping. Sentinel nodes were detected in 21 of 22 patients (95%), mostly near the vena cava or aorta, and two patients had micrometastases confined to sentinel nodes. Two patients with seminoma later developed lymph node recurrences. The authors suggest that focused sentinel node examination may allow standard retroperitoneal lymph node dissection to be avoided in most patients.

pmid-15809752.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍でRB遺伝子の発現が低下する機序を、セミノーマ細胞株JKT-1を用いて検討した。RBのmRNAおよびタンパク質量は他の細胞株より低値であった。プロモーター解析では、hGABP/E4TF1結合部位が肺腺癌細胞A549では正の調節因子として働く一方、JKT-1では機能しないことが示された。RB遺伝子は転写レベルで抑制されている可能性がある。
pmid-15809752.summary_en: This study examined why retinoblastoma (RB) gene expression is reduced in testicular germ cell tumors, using the JKT-1 seminoma cell line. RB mRNA and protein were lower in JKT-1 cells than in other cell lines. Promoter reporter assays showed that the hGABP/E4TF1 site acts as a positive element in A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells but not in JKT-1 cells, where mutating it had no effect. The authors suggest that RB is transcriptionally downregulated in seminoma cells.

pmid-15818173.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における前臨床および臨床の最新動向をまとめた総説です。疫学では地域差や、セミノーマと非セミノーマの割合の変化が示されています。発現解析により多能性や組織型に関連する因子が同定されつつあります。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)による残存病変評価や、化学療法・放射線療法・手術の毒性と有効性に関する知見も紹介されています。
pmid-15818173.summary_en: This review summarizes recent preclinical and clinical developments in germ cell tumors. Epidemiological studies show geographic and ethnic variation and a changing incidence of seminoma versus nonseminoma. Expression profiling is identifying factors linked to pluripotency and histologic subtypes. Research continues on novel serum tumor markers and the prognostic value of traditional markers. PET is emerging for evaluating residual seminoma lesions, and evolving data on chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery clarify their efficacy and toxicities in managing these tumors.

pmid-15818593.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍とその前駆病変の診断マーカーとして、OCT3/4の免疫組織化学染色の有用性を検討した研究です。200例以上の精巣腫瘍と80例以上の生検標本で、上皮内癌、セミノーマ、胎児性癌の同定に有用であることが示されました。単クローン抗体は多クローン抗体と同等の性能を示し、組織の前処理や保存法にも頑健であり、日常診断への応用が期待されます。
pmid-15818593.summary_en: This study evaluates OCT3/4 as a diagnostic immunohistochemical marker for testicular germ cell tumors and their precursor lesions. Across more than 200 testicular tumors and over 80 biopsies, OCT3/4 staining reliably identified carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma. A monoclonal antibody performed as well as the established polyclonal antibody in immunohistochemistry and western blot. The antibodies remain robust across different tissue pretreatment and storage methods, supporting routine diagnostic use.

pmid-15821122.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の共通前駆細胞である上皮内癌(CIS)について臨床的に総括したレビューです。胎生期の原始胚細胞に由来する起源が示唆され、停留精巣などの精巣異形成症候群との関連が述べられています。確実な診断には精巣生検が必要です。片側例では精巣摘除術、両側例では局所放射線照射が管理の選択肢となります。対側にCISが存在する症例が少なくとも5%あるため、精巣摘除時の対側生検が推奨されています。
pmid-15821122.summary_en: This clinical review examines carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis, the common precursor of testicular germ cell tumors. Gene expression similarity to embryonic stem cells supports a prenatal origin from fetal gonocytes. CIS is linked to cryptorchidism and other components of testicular dysgenesis syndrome. Testicular biopsy is the only reliable diagnostic method. Management includes orchidectomy for unilateral CIS or localized irradiation for bilateral cases. Because at least 5% of patients have contralateral CIS, contralateral biopsy at orchidectomy is recommended.

pmid-15821489.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)の有病率を、健康と推定される男性1,388例の剖検標本で検討した研究です。TINは6例(0.43%)で認められ、そのうち2例には微小浸潤性セミノーマが併存していました。この有病率はドイツにおける胚細胞腫瘍の生涯リスクと一致しており、TINが胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変であるという説を支持しています。
pmid-15821489.summary_en: This autopsy-based study assessed the prevalence of testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN), the precursor of testicular germ cell tumors, in 1,388 presumably healthy men. TIN was found in 6 cases, a prevalence of 0.43%, and two of these also showed microinvasive seminoma. The authors report that this prevalence is consistent with the lifetime risk of germ cell tumors in Germany. The findings support TIN as the precursor lesion of germ cell tumors at the population level.

pmid-15823130.summary_ja: 左卵巣の未熟奇形腫を発症した17歳女性の症例報告です。初回手術の3か月後に、膠芽腫に類似した切除不能な悪性神経上皮性腹膜腫瘍として再発しました。試験開腹術の3週間後に死亡しています。初回手術後に化学療法を拒否したことが、極めて急速な経過の一因と考えられています。未治療の未熟卵巣奇形腫が急速に致死的となりうることを示す症例です。
pmid-15823130.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old girl with an immature teratoma of the left ovary. Three months after the initial surgery, the tumor recurred as an inoperable malignant neuroepithelial peritoneal tumor resembling glioblastoma. She died three weeks after a second exploratory operation. The authors attribute the very aggressive course to her refusal of chemotherapy after the initial operation. The report highlights the rapid lethal progression that can follow untreated immature ovarian teratoma.

pmid-15823405.summary_ja: 古典的純粋セミノーマと正常精巣を対象とした定量RT-PCRにおいて、内在性対照として用いられるハウスキーピング遺伝子を検討した研究です。セミノーマではユビキチンCが低下し、GAPDH、β-アクチン、18S rRNA、PBGDが上昇していました。いずれの遺伝子も標的遺伝子データの正規化には適さないことが示されました。これらの遺伝子は腫瘍代謝に重要である可能性があり、多くの実験に適用できる標準化戦略を提案しています。
pmid-15823405.summary_en: This study examined housekeeping genes used as endogenous controls in quantitative RT-PCR of classical pure seminoma and normal testis. Ubiquitin C was down-regulated, while GAPDH, beta-actin, 18S rRNA, and PBGD were up-regulated in seminoma. None of the investigated housekeeping genes was suitable for normalizing target gene data in seminoma. The findings suggest that these genes may be essential for tumor metabolism. The authors developed a standardization strategy applicable to many experimental investigations.

pmid-15826249.summary_ja: 81歳男性で移行上皮癌と診断されていた症例の剖検において、膀胱原発の絨毛癌が確認された症例報告である。腫瘍は出血壊死性で、両肺への転移と前立腺への直接浸潤を認め、他臓器に原発は認められなかった。膀胱原発絨毛癌は極めて稀で、移行上皮癌に比べて予後が著しく不良であるため、両者を明確に鑑別することの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-15826249.summary_en: This autopsy case reports a primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder in an 81-year-old man who had been diagnosed with transitional cell carcinoma. The tumor was hemorrhagic and necrotic, with lung metastases and direct prostatic invasion, and no other primary site was identified. The authors emphasize that primary bladder choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, has a much poorer prognosis than transitional cell carcinoma, and must be clearly distinguished from it.

pmid-15828957.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者21例の血清で、レンズマメ凝集素(LCA)反応性αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を測定し、腫瘍活動性マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍ではAFPが10 ng/mLを超える全例でLCA反応性AFPが検出されたが、セミノーマでは検出されなかった。総AFPが正常化した後も残存した3例は全例で再発し、総AFPの上昇が低い症例での有用性が示唆された。
pmid-15828957.summary_en: This study evaluated lens culinaris agglutinin (LCA)-reactive alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) as a marker of testicular tumor activity in 21 patients, 15 with non-seminomatous germ cell tumor and six with pure seminoma. LCA-reactive AFP was detected in all NSGCT patients with AFP above 10 ng/mL and in none of the seminoma patients with elevated AFP. In three patients it persisted after total AFP normalized, and all three later relapsed. The authors suggest it may help monitor tumor activity when total AFP is low.

pmid-15828968.summary_ja: 精巣原発のカルチノイド腫瘍に奇形腫成分を伴い、傍大動脈リンパ節に転移した症例の報告である。精巣摘除術後に血清・尿中の5-HIAAが上昇し、シスプラチン・エトポシド・ブレオマイシンによる化学療法は転移巣に無効であった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清により5-HIAAは正常化し、郭清後25か月時点で再発なく生存している。
pmid-15828968.summary_en: This case report describes a primary testicular carcinoid tumor containing teratoma that metastasized to a para-aortic lymph node. Elevated serum and urinary 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid levels were observed after orchiectomy. Cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy was ineffective against the metastases, but retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy normalized 5-HIAA levels. The patient remained alive without recurrence 25 months later.

pmid-15828969.summary_ja: 再発セミノーマに対して大量化学療法と骨盤への放射線療法を受けてから7年後に、長期寛解中であった60歳男性が壊死性筋膜炎と連鎖球菌性毒素性ショック症候群を発症した症例報告である。包皮から始まり、集中治療にもかかわらず入院後18時間で死亡した。陰茎皮膚を主病変とする壊死性筋膜炎の初めての報告とされ、精巣がん治療後の稀な晩期合併症として示されている。
pmid-15828969.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old man with necrotizing fasciitis and streptococcal toxic shock syndrome that began on the foreskin, seven years after high-dose chemotherapy and pelvic radiotherapy for relapsed seminoma. He died 18 hours after admission despite intensive care. The authors describe this as the first report of necrotizing fasciitis primarily affecting penile skin, highlighting a rare late complication in a testicular cancer survivor.

pmid-15832097.summary_ja: 28例の頸部奇形腫のうち、甲状腺組織を伴う先天性の原発性甲状腺奇形腫11例を検討した。全例が切除され、中央値17年の追跡期間中に再発は認められなかった。多くの腫瘍では神経膠組織が優位であった。甲状腺組織と奇形腫成分が密に混在し、偽被膜を伴うことが多く、甲状腺起源を示唆した。先天性症例では組織学的未熟性が予後不良を予測しないとした。著者らは、原発性甲状腺奇形腫を診断するための形態学的基準を提案している。
pmid-15832097.summary_en: Eleven cases of congenital primary thyroid teratomas in children were reviewed from a series of 28 cervical teratomas. All thyroid teratomas were congenital, resected, and showed no recurrence over a median follow-up of 17 years. Neuroglial tissue predominated in most tumours. Intimate admixture of thyroid tissue with teratoma components, often with a pseudocapsule, suggested a thyroid origin. Histologic immaturity did not predict adverse behaviour in congenital cases. The authors propose these morphologic criteria for diagnosing primary thyroid teratoma.

pmid-15836960.summary_ja: hCGを過剰発現させたトランスジェニックマウスの研究。雌では卵巣の黄体腫から奇形腫などの胚細胞腫瘍が生じ、下垂体腫瘍や乳がんも認められた。雄の変化は軽微だった。性腺摘出により性腺外腫瘍は抑制され、hCGの直接作用ではなく卵巣内分泌異常が原因と考えられた。
pmid-15836960.summary_en: Transgenic mice overexpressing the hCG beta-subunit developed multiple gonadal and extragonadal neoplasms. Females showed ovarian luteomas progressing to germ cell tumours (teratomas), pituitary macroprolactinomas, and breast cancers, whereas males had only minor changes and fetal-type Leydig cell adenomas. Gonadectomy prevented extragonadal tumours despite persistent hCG elevation, indicating they arose from hCG-driven aberrant ovarian endocrine function rather than direct hCG action. The authors suggest the mouse phenotypes may mirror responses to pathological hormone elevation in humans.

pmid-15837411.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマで化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する評価可能な52例を対象に、FDG PETとCT（3cmのカットオフ）による生存腫瘍の予測を比較した前向き多施設研究である。3cm以上の病変では、PETの特異度は100%、CTは73%であり、感度はそれぞれ80%と73%であった。陽性PETは生存腫瘍を強く予測し、陰性PETは大きな残存病変における疾患を除外した。著者らは、PETが3cm以上の病変に対する不必要な追加治療を回避するのに役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-15837411.summary_en: A prospective multicentre study of 52 evaluable patients with metastatic seminoma and residual masses after chemotherapy compared FDG PET with CT (3 cm cutoff) for predicting viable tumour. For lesions 3 cm or larger, PET specificity was 100% versus 73% for CT, and sensitivity was 80% versus 73%. A positive PET strongly predicted viable tumour, and a negative PET excluded disease in larger residuals. The authors conclude that PET can help avoid unnecessary additional treatment for lesions of 3 cm or greater.

pmid-15837993.summary_ja: 1989～2002年に原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍453例の解析。1999年以降、術後腫瘍マーカー高値や病期IIBを除外したことで低容量病変が増え、補助化学療法を受けなかった例の4年無増悪生存率が83%から96%に改善した。腫瘍マーカー高値、病期、治療時期が再発の独立予測因子だった。
pmid-15837993.summary_en: Analysis of 453 patients who underwent primary RPLND for clinical stage I to IIB nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer between 1989 and 2002. After 1999, excluding patients with elevated postorchiectomy serum tumour markers or stage IIB disease increased low-volume retroperitoneal disease and improved 4-year progression-free probability in patients not given adjuvant chemotherapy, from 83% to 96%. Elevated markers, clinical stage, and pre-1999 treatment predicted progression. The authors support primary RPLND for patients with normal markers and stage I to IIA disease.

pmid-15842635.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における抗アポトーシス因子Mcl-1の発現を、免疫組織化学とRT-PCRで検討した。胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌、奇形腫を含む全組織型でMcl-1が過剰発現していた。マイクロダイセクション後のmRNA量も非腫瘍性胚細胞より高値だった。Mcl-1の過剰発現が腫瘍発生に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15842635.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry and RT-PCR examined Mcl-1, an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member, in testicular germ cell tumours. Mcl-1 was overexpressed in all tumour types studied, including embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumour, choriocarcinoma and teratoma. Microdissected tumour tissue showed higher Mcl-1 mRNA levels than non-neoplastic germ cells. The authors conclude that Mcl-1 overexpression may enhance germ cell survival and contribute to tumorigenesis.

pmid-15845047.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマに対して補助放射線療法を受けた男性の症例報告。治療直後に妊娠したため、照射後の精子による受精となった。残存精巣の推定線量は30 cGyと見積もられた。著者らは父親の挙児前照射による遺伝的リスクを概説し、妊孕性のある男性には治療後最長6か月の妊娠延期を勧めるべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-15845047.summary_en: This report describes a man treated with adjuvant radiotherapy for stage I seminoma whose partner conceived shortly after his radiotherapy, so the pregnancy involved irradiated sperm. The estimated dose to the remaining testis was 30 cGy. The authors review data on heritable risks of paternal preconception irradiation, noting that animal studies suggest postmeiotic sperm may carry greater genetic risk, and attempt to quantify risk for this case. They conclude that potentially fertile men should delay conception for up to 6 months after radiotherapy, and that this advice should be reinforced.

pmid-15846060.summary_ja: 活性型（S1981リン酸化）ATMに対するリン酸化特異的抗体を作製し、正常ヒト組織および精巣腫瘍の免疫組織化学に用いた。ほとんどの正常組織は不活性型のATMのみを示したが、骨髄リンパ球や成人の一次精母細胞ではリン酸化ATMが検出された。精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、胎児性癌で最も強く、セミノーマでは弱く、奇形腫および上皮内癌では軽度であった。この所見はがんにおけるDNA損傷シグナルの持続的活性化を支持し、臨床検体でのATM活性化のモニタリングに役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-15846060.summary_en: The authors generated phospho-specific antibodies against activated (S1981-phosphorylated) ATM and used them for immunohistochemistry across normal human tissues and testicular tumors. Most normal tissues showed only inactive ATM, while phosphorylated ATM appeared in bone marrow lymphocytes and adult primary spermatocytes, where programmed DNA breaks occur. Among testicular germ cell tumors, aberrant constitutive phospho-ATM was strongest in embryonal carcinomas, weaker in seminomas, and modest in teratomas and carcinoma in situ. The findings support ongoing DNA damage signaling in cancer and may aid monitoring of ATM activation in clinical specimens.

pmid-15852294.summary_ja: 11歳の女児が発熱、呼吸困難、咳で受診し、左胸水、腹水、恥骨上部の腫瘤を認めた。外科的切除で病期Icの卵巣悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。腫瘍の完全切除後に胸水と腹水は自然に消失し、偽Meigs症候群と考えられた。胚細胞腫瘍に伴う胸水や腹水は良性で、腫瘍切除により改善しうる。
pmid-15852294.summary_en: An 11-year-old girl presented with fever, dyspnea, and cough. Examination showed a left pleural effusion, ascites, and a suprapubic mass. Surgical resection revealed a stage Ic malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary. After complete tumor resection, the pleural effusion and ascites resolved spontaneously, consistent with pseudo-Meigs syndrome. The case shows that effusions and ascites associated with ovarian germ cell tumors may be benign and resolve after tumor removal, which is important to recognize to avoid mistaking them for metastatic disease.

pmid-15856041.summary_ja: 精巣の上皮内癌(CIS)細胞をセミノーマおよび非セミノーマと比較し、顕性の胚細胞腫瘍への進展に関わる遺伝子発現マーカーを網羅的に探索した。候補マーカーは複数の検体でRT-PCRとin situ hybridizationにより検証され、患者間のばらつきも認められた。マーカーの組み合わせによりセミノーマと非セミノーマを識別できる可能性が示された。非セミノーマではDNMT3BとDNMT3Lが高発現しており、組織型間のエピジェネティックな違いが示唆された。
pmid-15856041.summary_en: Genome-wide expression profiling compared testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) cells with seminomas and nonseminomas to identify markers of progression to overt germ cell tumours. Candidate markers were verified by RT-PCR and in situ hybridisation across multiple TGCT samples, with some interpatient variability. A combination of markers could discriminate seminomas from nonseminomas. DNMT3B and DNMT3L were overexpressed in nonseminomas, suggesting epigenetic differences between the two histological types.

pmid-15857020.summary_ja: 40歳の未経妊女性が、子宮摘出術後も持続した侵入奇胎に伴う多発性の肺転移と膣転移を有していた。予後不良因子があったものの、2週間ごとのメトトレキサートを8サイクル投与したところ、全転移病巣が反応し、1年の経過観察で良好な状態であった。著者らは文献を検討し、転移性侵入奇胎に対して単剤化学療法が妥当な初回治療となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-15857020.summary_en: A 40-year-old nullipara with invasive hydatidiform mole and multiple pulmonary and vaginal metastases, after hysterectomy for persistent bleeding, was treated with eight cycles of biweekly single-agent methotrexate despite poor-prognosis criteria. All metastases responded, and she remained well at one year of follow-up. The authors review the literature and suggest monochemotherapy may be a reasonable primary option for metastatic invasive mole, while emphasising histological confirmation and careful staging.

pmid-15857032.summary_ja: フィンランドで1975年から2001年の間に胞状奇胎1,659例を同定した、住民ベースの疫学研究である。発生率は女性100万人あたり73例、分娩100万件あたり984例であった。発生率は期間中ほぼ一定で、20歳未満と39歳以上で高かった。絨毛癌の約半数は先行する胞状奇胎に続発し、奇胎後の絨毛癌リスクは2.2%であった。他の西欧諸国と同様の傾向とされる。
pmid-15857032.summary_en: A population-based Finnish study identified 1,659 hydatidiform mole cases from 1975 to 2001, giving an incidence of 73 per million women or 984 per million deliveries. Incidence was stable over the period and higher in women under 20 and over 39. Nearly half of choriocarcinomas were preceded by a mole, with a 2.2% risk of choriocarcinoma after mole. The findings resemble those of other Western countries.

pmid-15860404.summary_ja: 縦隔に発生した巨大な胚細胞腫瘍を、経胸壁心エコー検査の修正断面で偶発的に発見した稀な症例を報告している。診断はCTと切除後の組織学的所見により確定された。心臓以外の腫瘤の検出において心エコー検査が有用であることを示している。
pmid-15860404.summary_en: The authors report a rare large mediastinal germ cell tumour detected incidentally by modified transthoracic echocardiography views. CT scanning and histopathology after resection confirmed the diagnosis. The report underscores the diagnostic value of echocardiography for detecting extracardiac masses, which may otherwise be overlooked during cardiac evaluation.

pmid-15863169.summary_ja: 初回治療に抵抗性を示したか再発した高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の女性26例を後方視的に検討した。EMA-CO不応例ではEMA-EPまたはBEPで多くが完全奏効を得て、メトトレキサート/アクチノマイシンD不応例でもBEP、VIP、ICEで多くが完全奏効した。全生存期間(全生存率)は61.5%であった。二次治療開始時のhCG値と転移部位が生存に影響し、メトトレキサート抵抗性では白金製剤を含むレジメンが推奨されると結論づけている。
pmid-15863169.summary_en: This retrospective review of 26 women with high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who failed primary therapy or relapsed evaluated secondary chemotherapy. Platinum-etoposide regimens and BEP achieved complete responses in most patients who had failed EMA-CO, and BEP, VIP or ICE worked in most who had failed methotrexate/actinomycin D. Overall survival was 61.5%. Hormonal level and metastatic sites influenced survival, and platinum-based combinations are recommended after methotrexate resistance.

pmid-15863179.summary_ja: 妊娠32週の初産婦に卵管原発の絨毛癌と肺転移が見つかった症例である。帝王切開で児を娩出した後、左卵管摘出と腫瘍切除を行い、化学療法4コースでβ-hCG値は正常化した。母体と児は16か月後も再発なく経過している。生存中の妊娠に卵管絨毛癌が併存した初めての報告とされる。
pmid-15863179.summary_en: The authors describe a 31-year-old primigravida at 32 weeks' gestation with primary tubal choriocarcinoma and pulmonary metastasis. Cesarean delivery was followed by left salpingectomy and tumour resection. After four cycles of chemotherapy, serum beta-hCG normalised. The mother and infant remained disease-free at 16 months. This is reported as the first case of tubal choriocarcinoma coexisting with a viable pregnancy, with survival of both mother and baby.

pmid-15863182.summary_ja: 25歳女性の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫(ディスジャーミノーマ)に、腹水と胸水を伴う偽Meigs症候群が併発した症例である。術前にテストステロン、アンドロステンジオン、コルチゾールが高値を示した。左卵管卵巣摘出術と右卵巣楔状切除により、間質黄体化を伴うディスジャーミノーマと診断された。若年女性の骨盤内腫瘤と胸腹水では、ディスジャーミノーマを鑑別診断に挙げるべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-15863182.summary_en: The authors present a 25-year-old woman with an ovarian dysgerminoma complicated by pseudo-Meigs' syndrome, with ascites and pleural effusion. Preoperative testosterone, androstenedione, and cortisol were elevated. Left salpingo-oophorectomy and right ovarian wedge resection showed dysgerminoma with stromal luteinization. The authors note this is the first such case with pseudo-Meigs' syndrome. Dysgerminoma should be considered in young patients with a pelvic mass and effusions.

pmid-15863190.summary_ja: 分娩後7か月でβ-hCG値の上昇を認めた22歳女性の症例報告である。CTとMRIでは病変を指摘できなかったが、PET/CTで骨盤内に代謝活性の集積を認め、開腹術で左広間膜への転移性絨毛癌が確認された。従来の画像検査で検出できない潜在性絨毛癌の評価にPET/CTが有用である可能性を示した。
pmid-15863190.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with persistent gestational trophoblastic disease after a molar pregnancy. She presented with vaginal bleeding and elevated beta-hCG seven months after a normal delivery. CT and MRI showed no evidence of disease, but PET/CT revealed a metabolically active focus in the left pelvis. Exploratory laparotomy confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma in the left broad ligament. The authors conclude that PET/CT may help detect occult choriocarcinoma when conventional imaging fails to identify metastatic disease.

pmid-15863599.summary_ja: 正期産後に発症したFIGO stage IIIの転移性妊娠性絨毛癌の症例である。静脈内抗がん剤が使用できない戦闘環境下で、経口メトトレキサートを投与し、その後に子宮全摘術と両側卵管卵巣摘出術を行い、完全奏効が得られた。非常に限られた状況では、経口メトトレキサートと子宮摘出の併用が有効な選択肢となり得ることを示した。
pmid-15863599.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with FIGO stage III metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma after a term pregnancy. Intravenous agents were unavailable in a combat environment, so she received oral methotrexate for one course, followed by abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. She achieved a complete response and received two further oral methotrexate courses after beta-hCG normalized. The authors conclude that oral methotrexate combined with hysterectomy can be an option for stage III GTN in very limited situations.

pmid-15863604.summary_ja: 補助化学療法を行わずに卵巣成熟奇形腫を切除された思春期女性の症例である。CT、骨盤超音波検査、腫瘍マーカーによるフォローアップ中に再発し、2回の開腹術で成熟奇形腫の成分のみからなる再発腫瘍が確認された。growing teratoma syndromeは稀な病態であり、再発病変の外科的切除が必要であると論じている。
pmid-15863604.summary_en: This case report describes an adolescent girl with a primary mature cystic ovarian teratoma who did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy. Follow-up with CT, pelvic ultrasonography and serum tumor markers was performed. Two subsequent laparotomies confirmed recurrent tumor composed solely of mature teratomatous elements. The authors describe growing teratoma syndrome as an uncommon condition. They emphasize that surgical resection of recurrent lesions is needed to prevent obstruction and compression, and to evaluate for malignant degeneration.

pmid-15868376.summary_ja: CDK阻害薬フラボピリドールを胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞株で評価した前臨床研究である。GCT株は他の固形腫瘍由来株より約5倍感受性が高く、細胞周期停止を伴わずにアポトーシスを誘導した。シスプラチンとの交差耐性は認められず、低濃度では相加的な細胞傷害性を示した。シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした臨床試験の実施を提案している。
pmid-15868376.summary_en: This preclinical study evaluated flavopiridol, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor, in germ cell tumour-derived cell lines NT2, 2102 EP and NCCIT, compared with ovarian, breast and cervical cancer lines. GCT lines were roughly fivefold more sensitive, and flavopiridol induced apoptosis without cell cycle arrest, likely reflecting RB deficiency. No cross-resistance with cisplatin was observed, and low-dose combinations showed additive cytotoxicity. The authors suggest that a clinical trial in cisplatin-refractory GCT is warranted.

pmid-15868451.summary_ja: 1971〜1995年のフィンランド人男性コホートを用い、精巣がんの発症と職業由来の化学物質曝露との関連を検討した。4つの職種で発症リスクの上昇が認められた。農薬、繊維粉じん、炭化水素、一部の有機溶剤では主にセミノーマを反映した曝露-反応傾向が有意であり、セミノーマのリスクとの関連が示唆された。
pmid-15868451.summary_en: This cohort study followed economically active Finnish men born 1906-1945 for 19.7 million person-years during 1971-1995, identifying 387 testicular cancer cases through registry linkage. Occupational chemical exposures were estimated with a job-exposure matrix. Elevated risk was observed in four occupations, including railway traffic supervisors and programmers. A significant exposure-response trend, mainly from seminoma, was found for pesticides, textile dust, hydrocarbons and some organic solvents, suggesting possible links to seminoma risk.

pmid-15868589.summary_ja: 胎児に発生した巨大縦隔奇形腫の2症例を報告した。妊娠23週で水腫を伴った1例は子宮内で腫瘍切除を受け、25週で帝王切開により分娩された。妊娠36週で羊水過多を呈した別の1例は、EXIT(子宮外分娩下治療)手技で気道確保と腫瘍切除が行われた。両児とも経過は良好で、病態に応じた周産期管理の戦略を示した。
pmid-15868589.summary_en: This report presents two cases of massive fetal mediastinal teratoma, a rare congenital germ cell tumor. One fetus with hydrops at 23 weeks underwent in utero resection, followed by cesarean delivery at 25 weeks, and improved despite bronchopulmonary dysplasia. Another with severe polyhydramnios at 36 weeks underwent an ex utero intrapartum therapy procedure to secure the airway and resect the tumor. Both infants were doing well at follow-up, illustrating strategies tailored to hydrops or airway compression.

pmid-15870693.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍84例のマイクロアレイ解析から、主要な組織型を予測する遺伝子発現分類器を作成した。146の転写産物により純粋型を93%の精度で分類し、混合型では主要成分を93%で予測できた。CGBは絨毛癌、LCN2は奇形腫、BMP2は卵黄嚢腫瘍、POU5F1は胎児性癌で高発現を示した。
pmid-15870693.summary_en: This study built a gene expression classifier to predict the predominant histology of non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCTs), using microarrays from 84 tumors including mixed samples. Using 146 transcripts, the classifier identified pure histologies with 93% accuracy and assigned a predominant component to mixed tumors in 93% of cases. Predictive genes included CGB in choriocarcinoma, LCN2 in teratoma, BMP2 in yolk sac tumor, and POU5F1 in embryonal carcinoma, supporting differentiation-related biology.

pmid-15875087.summary_ja: 標準的一次治療に失敗した再発GCT患者12例を対象に、GCP併用化学療法の第II相試験を行った。奏効率は50%で、生存期間中央値は16ヵ月であった。多くの症例でグレード3-4の血液毒性がみられたが、感染性合併症は比較的少なかった。期待より低い有効性が示され、シスプラチン用量の重要性が示唆されている。
pmid-15875087.summary_en: This phase II study tested gemcitabine, cisplatin and paclitaxel (GCP) as first salvage chemotherapy in 12 patients with relapsed germ cell tumors who had failed standard first-line treatment. Six patients (50%) responded, and two remained alive at 38+ and 29+ months. Median survival was 16 months. Most patients had grade 3-4 hematological toxicity, but infections were uncommon. The authors conclude GCP is an active regimen with acceptable toxicity, yet efficacy was lower than expected, raising questions about cisplatin dosing.

pmid-15876774.summary_ja: 新生児の口蓋扁桃に発生した奇形腫の症例報告である。新生児期の呼吸困難や哺乳障害の原因として、中咽頭の腫瘍は極めてまれである。本症例は、チアノーゼを伴う間欠的な窒息発作で発症した。気道障害を来す新生児の中咽頭腫瘤では、奇形腫を鑑別に挙げる必要性が示されている。
pmid-15876774.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a teratoma arising in the palatine tonsil. Oropharyngeal tumors are very rare causes of respiratory distress and feeding difficulty in the neonatal period. This patient presented with intermittent choking attacks accompanied by cyanosis, a particularly unusual manifestation. The report highlights the importance of considering teratoma in the differential diagnosis of neonatal oropharyngeal masses that compromise the airway.

pmid-15876777.summary_ja: 膣に生じたまれな卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。患者は根治的手術を受けた後、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を認めて受診した。小児の卵黄嚢腫瘍は化学療法に感受性が高く、化学療法単独で治癒することも多い。本症例の管理と文献的考察が示されている。
pmid-15876777.summary_en: This case report describes a yolk sac tumor arising in the vagina, a rare site. The patient had undergone radical surgery and presented afterwards with elevated alpha-fetoprotein. Yolk sac tumors in children are chemosensitive and often curable with chemotherapy alone, so radical surgery is frequently unnecessary. The authors discuss management of this case and review the relevant literature, highlighting the risk that vaginal yolk sac tumors may be unrecognized or overtreated surgically.

pmid-15880464.summary_ja: 5歳未満の小児GCT 24例などを対象に、アレイCGHで染色体異常を解析した研究である。奇形腫は概ね正常プロファイルを示したが、卵黄嚢腫瘍では1p欠失や3p・20q増加が認められた。アレイCGHは新生児・乳児GCTの反復性異常の同定に適しており、新規マーカーの発見につながる可能性が示された。
pmid-15880464.summary_en: This study applied genomewide array comparative genomic hybridization to 24 germ cell tumors from patients under 5 years and seven from older children. Most teratomas in younger patients had normal profiles apart from minor recurrent changes. Yolk sac tumors showed recurrent losses at 1p35-pter and gains at 3p21-pter and 20q13. Older patients had gains of 12p and whole chromosomes 7 and 8. The authors conclude array CGH is well suited to detecting recurrent aberrations that may yield novel diagnostic or prognostic markers in neonatal and infant germ cell tumors.

pmid-15880570.summary_ja: ターナー症候群171例を対象に、Y染色体由来物質の有無を分子解析で評価した研究である。Y染色体由来物質陽性で性腺摘出を受けた症例の33.3%に性腺芽腫が認められた。16歳未満でも性腺芽腫が発生し得るため、Y染色体の分子スクリーニングと早期の予防的性腺摘出が推奨されている。
pmid-15880570.summary_en: This study of 171 karyotyped patients with Ullrich-Turner syndrome assessed Y-chromosome material by SRY and DYZ3 PCR, with follow-up of 2-22 years. Y-chromosome material was found in 14 patients, and 12 of these underwent gonadectomy. Four girls under 16 had gonadoblastoma, one of whom also had immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Gonadoblastoma prevalence among gonadectomized Y-positive patients was 33.3%. The authors conclude malignant change may occur early, supporting molecular screening and early prophylactic gonadectomy.

pmid-15880939.summary_ja: 中耳奇形腫が実在する疾患かを検討した論文である。3胚葉由来の良性組織からなる腫瘍と定義され、新生児期から乳児早期に発症する。完全切除で根治が期待できるが、未熟成分や悪性成分の混在を除外するため、詳細な組織学的検討が推奨されている。
pmid-15880939.summary_en: This review considers whether middle ear teratoma is a true entity. Middle ear teratomas are defined as tumors composed of benign tissues from all three germ layers. They are rare and typically present in the neonatal period and early infancy. Complete surgical excision is generally curative. The authors recommend thorough histologic examination of the specimen to exclude immature or frankly malignant components admixed with the benign teratomatous elements.

pmid-15886246.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JArにCGβアンチセンス遺伝子を導入するとhCG産生と増殖が低下し、アポトーシスが増加した。hCGはLH/CG受容体を介して増殖促進・アポトーシス抑制に働き、同遺伝子の阻害が絨毛癌治療の候補となり得ることが示された。
pmid-15886246.summary_en: In choriocarcinoma JAr cells, transfection with an antisense CGβ gene construct reduced hCG production, suppressed proliferation, and increased apoptosis compared with controls. LH/CG receptor expression also decreased, and exogenous hCG restored receptor expression and viability. The authors conclude that hCG acting via LH/CG receptors promotes proliferation and inhibits apoptosis in these cells, suggesting antisense CGβ inhibition as a potential strategy against choriocarcinoma growth.

pmid-15888538.summary_ja: 辺縁系脳炎の7例で、海馬や小脳の神経網に対するVGKC以外の新規抗体が検出された。縦隔奇形腫や卵巣奇形腫を含む腫瘍を伴う症例があり、免疫療法や腫瘍切除で多くが改善した。VGKC抗体例と比べ、髄液炎症や奇形腫・胸腺腫の合併が多かった。
pmid-15888538.summary_en: Seven patients with subacute limbic encephalitis had novel neuropil antibodies targeting hippocampal or cerebellar antigens distinct from VGKC. Tumors, including mediastinal and ovarian teratomas, were found in several patients. Combining MRI and FDG-PET revealed temporal and extra-temporal abnormalities. Most patients responded to immunotherapy or tumor resection. Compared with VGKC-antibody patients, they showed more CSF inflammation and systemic tumors, including teratoma and thymoma.

pmid-15891960.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成症の5例に性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、成熟奇形腫などが認められた。思春期の発達遅滞や性器の曖昧さがみられ、一部で血清テストステロンやエストラジオールが検出された。異形成性の性腺は悪性転化を防ぐため早期に摘出すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-15891960.summary_en: This report describes five patients aged 12 to 18 years with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis who developed gonadoblastomas, dysgerminomas, a mature teratoma, and testicular intraepithelial neoplasia. Most had ambiguous or female-appearing external genitalia and delayed puberty with discordant breast and pubic hair development. Serum testosterone or estradiol was detectable in several patients. Immunostaining showed that immature gonadoblastoma cells lacked steroid receptor and hormone reactivity, while Leydig-like cells stained for testosterone. The authors conclude that dysgenetic gonads should be removed early to prevent malignant transformation.

pmid-15892800.summary_ja: 1983年から2002年に診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍を前向きに解析した研究である。この期間に病期I症例は59%から78%へ、セミノーマは43%から58%へと増加した。原発腫瘍の大きさも5cmから4cmに縮小した。増加の理由は明確ではないが、認知向上による早期診断が寄与した可能性がある。
pmid-15892800.summary_en: This study prospectively examined how testicular germ cell tumours presented between 1983 and 2002, divided into three diagnostic periods. Over this interval, the proportion of patients presenting with stage I disease rose from 59% to 78%, and the proportion with seminoma rose from 43% to 58%. Primary tumour size also decreased, from a mean of 5 cm to 4 cm. The authors suggest that earlier diagnosis, possibly through greater awareness, may contribute, although the reasons remain unclear.

pmid-15895292.summary_ja: 新生児の頸部に生じた悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。当初は頸部リンパ管腫と診断され、生後9日目に切除されたが、性腺外未熟奇形腫と判明した。後に頸部転移とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇がみられ、追加手術と化学療法が行われた。7年間再発なく経過している。
pmid-15895292.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with malignant cervical teratoma. Initially diagnosed as a neck hygroma, the lesion was excised at nine days old and found to be an extragonadal immature teratoma. Cervical metastases and rising alpha-fetoprotein later changed the diagnosis to malignant teratoma, requiring further surgery and chemotherapy. The child has remained disease-free for seven years. The authors emphasize diagnostic difficulty, the need for complete surgical excision, and long-term follow-up to detect recurrence.

pmid-15896468.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍、正常精巣、精子形成障害のある精巣でサバイビンの発現をPCRで検討した。未分化な腫瘍と正常精巣では高発現だが、成熟奇形腫と胚細胞無形成では消失していた。発現は腫瘍の分化度と相関し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生や悪性度に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-15896468.summary_en: Survivin expression was measured by PCR in testicular germ cell tumours, normal testes, and testes with defective spermatogenesis. Survivin mRNA was high in undifferentiated tumours and normal testes but absent in mature teratomas and germ cell aplasia. Because survivin expression tracks with tumour differentiation, the authors propose it may be involved in the tumorigenesis and malignant potential of testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-15897417.summary_ja: 三次医療施設で頸部腫瘤を有する胎児8例を後方視的に検討した。奇形腫の4例では気道閉塞が疑われ、EXIT手技で全例が出生し、3例で気管切開が必要であった。リンパ管奇形の4例は合併症なく経腟分娩した。出生前画像により気道リスクを把握し、分娩時の緊急事態を予防できると結論づけている。
pmid-15897417.summary_en: This retrospective study of eight fetuses with neck masses at a tertiary centre evaluated prenatal imaging and fetal surgery. Four had cervical teratomas with suspected airway obstruction, and all were delivered by ex utero intrapartum treatment, with three newborns needing tracheotomy. The other four had lymphatic malformations without airway obstruction and delivered uneventfully. The authors conclude that prenatal imaging can identify airway risk and allow planning to prevent delivery emergencies.

pmid-15900112.summary_ja: 本総説は、形態と臨床像が多様な妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織病理学的診断における最近の進歩をまとめたものです。早期の臨床診断を背景とした診断基準の変化や、p57などの新しい抗体による診断精度の向上を取り上げています。新たに提唱された類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍について、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍や扁平上皮癌との鑑別診断を論じ、遺伝学的研究の役割と今後の展望にも言及しています。
pmid-15900112.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in the histopathologic diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic disease, a spectrum of placental trophoblastic proliferative disorders with variable morphology and clinical behavior. It highlights revised diagnostic criteria influenced by earlier clinical diagnosis and the diagnostic value of newer antibodies such as p57. The authors discuss epithelioid trophoblastic tumor, a newly recognized subtype, and its differential diagnosis from placental-site trophoblastic tumor and squamous cell carcinoma. The article concludes with the role of genetic studies in clarifying the nature of these lesions and future research directions.

pmid-15902260.summary_ja: 本研究は、マウスのTer変異が、ゼブラフィッシュのdead end遺伝子のオーソログであるDnd1に終止コドンを生じる点変異であることを明らかにした。この変異は原始生殖細胞の喪失を引き起こし、129系統の背景では自然発生性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率を著しく高める。生き残った胚細胞の一部は胎児性癌細胞へと形質転換し、腫瘍組織を生じる。DND1はRNA認識モチーフを有し、自然発生的腫瘍形成の遺伝性原因として直接関与することが示された最初のタンパク質である。ヒト小児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のモデルとしても意義がある。
pmid-15902260.summary_en: This study identifies the Ter mutation in mice as a point mutation creating a premature stop codon in Dnd1, the orthologue of zebrafish dead end. The mutation causes primordial germ cell loss and, in the 129 strain background, markedly increases spontaneous testicular germ cell tumour incidence. The authors show that some surviving germ cells transform into embryonal carcinoma cells that give rise to tumour tissues. DND1 is an RNA-binding protein with a recognition motif, and it is the first such protein directly implicated as a heritable cause of spontaneous tumorigenesis. The findings offer insight into testicular tumour pathogenesis and a model for pediatric human testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-15902997.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、双側精巣セミノーマを有する29歳の日本人男性を対象としたものです。PCRとDNA直接塩基配列解析により、エクソン17にc-KIT遺伝子D816H変異を一方のアレルに認めました。この変異は左側のセミノーマにのみ存在し、右側には認められませんでした。日本人の双側精巣胚細胞腫瘍でc-KIT変異を報告した初めての例であり、治療管理への有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-15902997.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old Japanese man with bilateral testicular seminomas. Using PCR and direct DNA sequencing, the authors identified a c-KIT D816H mutation in exon 17 on one allele. The mutation was present in the left but not the right seminoma, suggesting heterogeneity between tumors. The authors describe it as the first report of a c-KIT mutation in a Japanese patient with bilateral testicular germ cell tumor. They suggest that c-KIT mutational analysis may provide useful information for managing testicular germ cell tumor patients in Japan as well as Europe.

pmid-15904595.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、49歳の無症状の女性が定期検診で骨盤内腫瘍を指摘された症例です。当初は右卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、腹腔鏡手術が行われました。術中には両側卵巣から離れた子宮仙骨靭帯に強固に付着した嚢胞性腫瘍が認められ、腹腔鏡下に切除されました。病理診断は子宮仙骨靭帯由来の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、この部位の腹腔鏡治療成功例は初めての報告です。
pmid-15904595.summary_en: This report describes a 49-year-old asymptomatic woman in whom a pelvic tumor, initially suspected to be a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, was found during routine examination. Laparoscopic surgery revealed a cystic mass firmly attached to the uterosacral ligament, separate from both ovaries. Laparoscopic excision was performed, and histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma arising in the uterosacral ligament. The authors state this is the first literature report of successful laparoscopic treatment for this location. The case highlights the importance of considering extragonadal sites in the differential diagnosis of pelvic teratomas.

pmid-15907716.summary_ja: 本総説は、低病期の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療における後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割を検討したものです。後腹膜リンパ節郭清は正確な病期分類ツールとして化学療法の必要性を判断する役割を持ち、適切に行えば後腹膜を再発部位から除外できます。リンパ管侵襲や胎児性癌優位などの高リスク因子を有する症例では、単独で高い治癒率が得られます。奇形腫は化学療法抵抗性で、初回の後腹膜リンパ節郭清が適すると述べられています。
pmid-15907716.summary_en: This update reviews the role of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in treating low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. RPLND is presented as an accurate staging tool that guides the need for chemotherapy and, when performed properly, eliminates the retroperitoneum as a relapse site. Low-stage disease with high-risk features, such as lymphovascular invasion or embryonal predominance, can be cured by RPLND alone. Teratoma is chemoresistant and may be best treated with primary RPLND. The authors also discuss primary chemotherapy, observation with rigorous follow-up, and the unresolved oncologic control of laparoscopic RPLND.

pmid-15912681.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、停留精巣に生じ転移した悪性奇形腫が急性肺塞栓症として発症した症例です。化学療法後、停留していた右精巣を切除し、下大静脈から右心房へ進展した腫瘍も摘出されました。腫瘍は索状の先端で右心房内を自由に浮遊していました。精巣腫瘍の提示・診断・治療をまとめるとともに、軍人の精巣腫瘍に関する文献も検討されています。
pmid-15912681.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic malignant teratoma arising from an undescended testis that presented with acute pulmonary embolism. After chemotherapy, the undescended right testis was resected together with a tumor extending from the inferior vena cava into the right atrium, where it floated freely at the end of the tumor cord. The authors describe the presentation, diagnosis and treatment of testicular tumors and review the literature on testicular tumors in military personnel. The case illustrates an unusual intracardiac extension of a testicular tumor.

pmid-15912783.summary_ja: 本研究は、化学療法後にマーカー陰性の残存腫瘤を有した胚細胞腫瘍患者25例を最長10年追跡した報告です。性腺セミノーマの残存腫瘤はすべて観察され、1例に再発しました。性腺非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、5cm未満の残存腫瘤は切除せず、切除例を含め再発は認められませんでした。性腺外例では切除を行った4例中3例に再発がみられ、残存腫瘤の切除が推奨されています。
pmid-15912783.summary_en: This Japanese study followed 25 patients with germ cell tumors who had marker-free residual masses after chemotherapy for up to 10 years. All residual masses in gonadal seminoma were observed, with one recurrence. In gonadal non-seminomatous tumors, residual masses of 5 cm or more were resected, and no recurrence occurred. Recurrence occurred in three of four resected extragonadal non-seminomatous tumors. The authors conclude that unnecessary resection of gonadal non-seminomatous residual masses under 5 cm should be avoided, whereas residual masses in extragonadal non-seminomatous tumors should be resected.

pmid-15914041.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織からAFPのエクソン1を欠く新規mRNAアイソフォーム（AFP-C）を同定した。RT-PCRで卵黄嚢腫瘍と肝細胞癌細胞に存在することを確認し、AFP陰性細胞株での発現解析では約65kDaのタンパク質が分泌されず細胞質に局在した。従来のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とは異なる生理的・病的役割を持つ可能性が示唆される。
pmid-15914041.summary_en: This study identifies a novel AFP mRNA isoform, termed AFP-C, lacking exon 1 in human ovarian yolk sac tumor tissue. Using RT-PCR, the authors detected the isoform in yolk sac tumor and hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Expression analysis in an AFP-negative cell line showed a protein of about 65 kDa that was not secreted, unlike conventional AFP, and localized to the cytoplasm. The findings suggest AFP-C may play physiologic or pathogenic roles distinct from traditional AFP in yolk sac tumor and hepatocellular carcinoma.

pmid-15917269.summary_ja: 乳児仙尾部奇形腫と構成的t(12;15)転座をもつ患者において、SENP1とMESDC2が分断され融合遺伝子が形成されることを報告した。融合遺伝子は腫瘍由来細胞で転写され、異常なタンパク質をコードする。SEME融合タンパク質は小胞体への局在を失い、WNT共受容体の分子シャペロンとしての機能が低下する可能性がある。新生児・乳児の胚細胞腫瘍発生の候補遺伝子として提唱された。
pmid-15917269.summary_en: This study examines a patient with an infantile sacrococcygeal teratoma carrying a constitutional t(12;15)(q13;q25) translocation. The translocation disrupts SENP1 and MESDC2, producing reciprocal fusion genes that are transcribed in tumor-derived cells and encode aberrant proteins. The SEME fusion protein loses endoplasmic reticulum targeting, which may impair its chaperone function for WNT co-receptors. The MESE protein retains desumoylation activity similar to wild-type SENP1. The authors propose SENP1 and MESDC2 as candidate genes for neonatal and infantile germ cell tumor development.

pmid-15918045.summary_ja: 5年間に経験した後腹膜奇形腫10例（4日齢～12歳）の検討である。腫瘍内の石灰化や骨様構造は10例中9例で超音波検査またはコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で認められた。9例は全摘出され、未熟奇形腫grade IIIの1例は術後化学療法を受けた。補助療法を受けなかった1例は6か月後に局所再発し、再切除と化学療法で治療された。全例で無病生存が得られた。
pmid-15918045.summary_en: This review examined retroperitoneal teratomas in 10 patients aged 4 days to 12 years over five years. Calcification or bony structure within the tumor was seen on ultrasound or CT in nine of ten. Nine patients underwent total excision. One patient with grade III immature teratoma received postoperative chemotherapy. One patient without adjuvant chemotherapy had local recurrence at 6 months and was treated with repeated excision and chemotherapy. All patients were disease-free at 8 months to 5 years. The authors recommend aggressive postoperative chemotherapy for grade III immature teratoma or malignancy.

pmid-15920749.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの既往がある患者が耳下腺腫瘤を呈し、当初は原発性唾液腺腫瘍が疑われました。切除生検と免疫組織化学（胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ）により、耳下腺への転移性精巣セミノーマと確定されました。これは文献上初の報告とされ、珍しい部位の腫瘤では転移を鑑別に挙げるべきだと強調しています。
pmid-15920749.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a remote history of testicular seminoma who presented with a parotid mass initially presumed to be a primary salivary tumor. Excisional biopsy and immunohistochemistry, including placental alkaline phosphatase staining, established metastatic testicular seminoma in the parotid gland, believed to be the first such published case. The authors emphasize that seminoma can mimic granulomatous carcinomas and epithelioid sarcomas, and that metastatic lesions in unusual sites should be considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-15921773.summary_ja: 病期I、病期IIa、病期IIbの精巣セミノーマ164例を対象に、精巣摘除後の放射線療法の晩期有害事象を後方視的に解析した研究です。縦隔への1回線量が心合併症と有意に関連し、消化管合併症とは関連がありませんでした。前縦隔への過剰線量を抑えることが心毒性の軽減に重要と結論づけています。
pmid-15921773.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 164 patients treated for stage I, IIa, or IIb testicular seminoma with post-orchidectomy radiotherapy evaluates late adverse effects. Half received infradiaphragmatic irradiation alone, while the rest also received prophylactic supradiaphragmatic mediastinal and left supraclavicular fields. Cardiac morbidity was significantly associated with the dose per fraction from the anterior field to the anterior mediastinum, while gastrointestinal morbidity was not. The authors recommend limiting excessive dose to the anterior mediastinum to reduce cardiac toxicity.

pmid-15922442.summary_ja: 左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた病期II扁平上皮癌の52歳女性の症例報告です。病理学的にはガンマ型浸潤を伴う低分化扁平上皮癌で、この浸潤形式は予後不良と関連します。補助化学療法を受けましたが、進行性疾患により死亡しました。浸潤様式は病期や悪性度とともに再発や予後の予測因子になり得ると論じています。
pmid-15922442.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old woman with stage II squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the left ovary. Pathology showed poorly differentiated carcinoma with gamma mode of tumor infiltration, a pattern linked to poor prognosis. Despite adjuvant chemotherapy, the patient died of progressive disease. The authors argue that the mode of infiltration, alongside stage and grade, may predict recurrence and survival in malignant transformation of mature teratomas.

pmid-15923438.summary_ja: 若年男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍である胚細胞腫瘍の管理におけるFDG-PETの役割をまとめた総説です。シスプラチン導入以降に治癒率が大きく向上したこと、管理が引き続き改善していることを述べています。FDG-PETに関する最近の進歩を包括的に整理し、本疾患における応用の可能性を示しています。
pmid-15923438.summary_en: This review examines the role of FDG-PET in managing germ cell tumor, the most common malignancy in young men. It notes that cure rates have risen substantially since the introduction of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and that management continues to improve. The authors comprehensively summarize recent advances in FDG-PET and outline its potential applications in this setting. The article offers a clinical overview for oncologists considering functional imaging in germ cell tumor care.

pmid-15924879.summary_ja: 本研究は、AFPを産生する悪性胚細胞腫瘍である卵黄嚢腫瘍におけるC/EBP-βの役割を検討した。ヒト卵黄嚢腫瘍で核内のC/EBP-β発現が認められた。ラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株AT-2-TCでC/EBP-βを過剰発現させると、主に異種移植片において、AFPや他の血漿タンパク質および肝臓で豊富な転写因子が増加した。この結果は、C/EBP-βが卵黄嚢腫瘍の血漿タンパク質産生に寄与することを示唆している。
pmid-15924879.summary_en: This study investigates the role of C/EBP-beta in yolk sac tumor, a malignant germ cell tumor that produces AFP. Nuclear C/EBP-beta was detected in human yolk sac tumor samples. Overexpressing it in the rat yolk sac tumor cell line AT-2-TC increased AFP and other plasma proteins, along with liver-enriched transcription factors, mainly in xenografts. The findings suggest C/EBP-beta contributes to plasma protein production in yolk sac tumors.

pmid-15925400.summary_ja: 性交歴も妊娠歴もない32歳女性に生じた原発性非妊娠性子宮頸部絨毛癌の症例報告です。FIGO IV期で、集中化学療法と子宮摘出術を受けましたが、12か月後に薬剤抵抗性の病勢で死亡しました。胚細胞腫瘍または上皮組織由来の可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-15925400.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with primary non-gestational choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix, a very rare site in a patient with no pregnancy history. She presented with vaginal bleeding and was staged FIGO IV. Despite intensive chemotherapy and hysterectomy, she died of drug-resistant disease 12 months later. Histology, immunohistochemistry and molecular studies confirmed the diagnosis, suggesting origin from germ cell or epithelial tissue.

pmid-15928672.summary_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する補助化学療法として、BOPレジメンをBEPと比較した前向き試験です。115例、中央値70か月の追跡で5年無再発率は98.3%でした。脱毛は減少しましたが、BEPに対する明確な優位性は脱毛回避に限られるとされています。
pmid-15928672.summary_en: This prospective MRC TE17 trial evaluated the BOP regimen (bleomycin, vincristine, cisplatin) as adjuvant treatment for high-risk clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumours, as an alternative to BEP. With 115 patients and median follow-up of 70 months, the 5-year relapse-free rate was 98.3%. Vincristine reduced alopecia but caused low rates of significant neuropathy. The authors conclude BOP and BEP have no clear advantage except regarding alopecia.

pmid-15928937.summary_ja: 新生児期に未熟胃奇形腫を切除された症例が、後に卵黄嚢腫瘍として再発した症例報告です。胃奇形腫が悪性病変として再発した報告は初めてです。未熟胃奇形腫では再発を考慮し、フォローアップ中にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)を定期的に測定すべきと提言されています。
pmid-15928937.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a resected immature gastric teratoma who later developed recurrence as a yolk sac tumor. Gastric teratomas are rare and usually benign, and recurrence as a malignant lesion had not previously been reported. The authors recommend considering recurrence in immature gastric teratomas and performing periodic alpha-fetoprotein monitoring during follow-up.

pmid-15940259.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の胎児性癌細胞において、シスプラチンは46遺伝子を誘導し5遺伝子を抑制した。誘導遺伝子の多くはp53の標的であり、p53をノックダウンすると応答が減弱し耐性が増した。p53の強い活性化が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法感受性と高い治癒率に寄与すると考えられ、新たな候補標的も同定された。
pmid-15940259.summary_en: Using gene-expression arrays, this study identified 46 genes upregulated and five repressed by cisplatin in testicular germ cell tumor-derived human embryonal carcinoma cells. Many upregulated genes are p53 targets, and p53 knockdown blunted the response and increased cisplatin resistance. The authors propose that robust p53 activation underlies the hypersensitivity of testicular germ cell tumors to chemotherapy, which may explain their high curability. The study also identifies new candidate p53 targets.

pmid-15942691.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者41例について、末梢血中のβ-hCG mRNAを動態蛍光RT-PCR法で定量し、対照66例と比較した。特異度は90.9%、感度は82.9%で、血清腫瘍マーカー（48.72%）を上回った。低病期の病期分類を補完しうる有望な方法であるが、臨床的な位置づけにはさらなる検証が必要である。
pmid-15942691.summary_en: This study evaluated whether kinetic fluorescence RT-PCR quantification of beta-hCG mRNA in peripheral blood can supplement conventional staging in testicular germ cell tumor patients. Blood from 41 patients across clinical stages was analyzed against 66 controls. The assay showed 90.9% specificity and 82.9% sensitivity, exceeding the serum tumor marker sensitivity of 48.72%. Quantitative RT-PCR may therefore improve staging of low-stage testicular germ cell tumors, although its clinical role requires validation in larger cohorts.

pmid-15942796.summary_ja: 呼吸困難のある新生児女児で、下垂体重複と上咽頭奇形腫を認めた症例である。CTおよびMRIの所見を病理組織学的所見と対比し、奇形腫の診断を確認した。頭蓋底および中枢神経系の奇形も併存していた。著者らは、この稀な組み合わせの発生学的な発症機序について考察している。
pmid-15942796.summary_en: This report describes a newborn girl with respiratory difficulty who had a nasopharyngeal (epipharyngeal) teratoma together with pituitary duplication.
