KIT overexpression occurred independently of gain and was stronger in cases with gain. Activating exon 17 mutations were found in 13% of seminomas. The findings suggest KIT contributes to progression from carcinoma in situ to seminoma, and may offer a basis for less toxic targeted therapy.

pmid-16168501.summary_ja: 全トランス型レチノイン酸は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞である胎児性癌細胞の腫瘍形成能を失わせる。その過程で12p染色体上のNanogやCD9、GDF3などの多能性関連遺伝子群が抑制される。Oct4のsiRNAによる抑制もNanogなどの発現を低下させた。多能性の強制と悪性化の関連が示唆され、分化誘導の分子機構を解明する研究である。
pmid-16168501.summary_en: Investigates how all-trans retinoic acid (RA) causes loss of tumorigenicity in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem cells of testicular germ cell tumours. As tumorigenic potential is lost, RA represses a cluster of chromosome 12p genes, including Nanog, CD9, EDR1, GDF3, Stella and Glut3, along with Oct4 on chromosome 6. Oct4 knockdown reduces expression of several of these genes. The authors propose that these pluripotency genes link enforced pluripotency to transformation in testicular tumour genesis.

pmid-16169622.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマに対する補助的放射線療法で、従来の矩形傍大動脈照射野とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)に基づく共形照射野を10例で比較した。CT計画では血管を含む標的体積への線量カバーが改善したが、照射野は広くなり、腎臓の一部へ高線量が及んだ。辺縁部の照射不足を減らせる可能性が示された。
pmid-16169622.summary_en: Compares traditional rectangular para-aortic fields with CT-based conformal fields for adjuvant radiotherapy in 10 patients with Stage I seminoma. CT-based plans gave better dose coverage of the vessel-based target volume (D95 24.7 vs 23.6 Gy, P=0.002), though fields were wider and some small kidney volumes received higher doses. The authors suggest CT planning may reduce under-dosage and marginal misses, which contribute to relapse.

pmid-16170162.summary_ja: 一次治療で完全寛解を得た精巣原発の再発転移性胚細胞腫瘍46例に、TIP療法(パクリタキセル+イホスファミド+シスプラチン)を二次治療として施行した。70%が完全寛解し、中央値69か月の追跡で63%が持続的な完全寛解を維持した。2年無増悪生存率は65%だった。従来量の救援化学療法に代わる有効な選択肢として示された。
pmid-16170162.summary_en: Evaluates paclitaxel added to ifosfamide and cisplatin (TIP) as second-line therapy in 46 patients with relapsed metastatic testicular germ cell tumours who had a testis primary and a prior complete response to first-line treatment. 70% achieved complete response, and 63% had a durable CR at a median follow-up of 69 months. The two-year progression-free survival rate was 65%. Four cycles of TIP achieved a high durable remission rate.

pmid-16174054.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、クラインフェルター症候群を有する22歳男性の後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマ)の例を記述している。14×12cmの腫瘍が上腸間膜動脈を取り囲んでいた。BEP療法による導入化学療法の後、TIP療法による救援化学療法を受け、腫瘍は著明に縮小して境界不明瞭な板状病変を残した。まれな併存例であり、救援療法への反応を示している。
pmid-16174054.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with Klinefelter's syndrome who had a large 14 x 12 cm retroperitoneal seminoma encasing the superior mesenteric artery. He received induction BEP chemotherapy followed by salvage TIP chemotherapy. The tumor shrank considerably, leaving a poorly defined plaque, and he remained free of progression during follow-up. The report highlights an unusual combination of a retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor with Klinefelter syndrome and demonstrates a response to salvage therapy.

pmid-16174255.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と未熟奇形腫からなる卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍が、両側卵巣の間に橋渡し状に広がっていた21歳女性の症例報告です。卵巣、卵管、子宮を温存する最大限の妊孕性温存手術を行い、その後ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を4コース施行しました。AFPは3コース後に陰性化し、現在も経過観察中です。まれな局在の若年患者において妊孕性を温存した点が示されています。
pmid-16174255.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with an unusual intra-abdominal mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary, composed of endodermal sinus tumor and immature teratoma components. The tumor formed a bridge between both ovaries and was managed with maximal fertility-sparing surgery preserving the ovaries, tubes and uterus. Four courses of BEP chemotherapy followed, and alpha-fetoprotein became negative after three courses. The patient remains under observation. The report emphasizes fertility preservation in a young patient with a rare tumor location.

pmid-16174857.summary_ja: ヨーロッパと北米の14の人口ベース腫瘍登録から、精巣がんの1年生存者40,576例を対象とした大規模コホート研究です。治療後少なくとも35年間、二次充実性がんのリスクが有意に上昇していました。特に胃、膵臓、膀胱、悪性中皮腫でリスクが高く、放射線療法、化学療法、両者併用のいずれでも上昇がみられました。1975年以降に治療された非セミノーマ患者ではリスクが低めでした。生存者の長期的なフォローアップの必要性を示す研究です。
pmid-16174857.summary_en: This large population-based cohort study followed 40,576 one-year survivors of testicular cancer from 14 registries in Europe and North America. Second solid cancers were significantly increased for at least 35 years after treatment, with the highest relative risks for stomach, pancreas, bladder and malignant mesothelioma. Risks were elevated with radiotherapy alone, chemotherapy alone, and combined treatment. Seminoma and nonseminoma patients showed similar overall patterns, and nonseminoma patients treated after 1975 had lower risks. Findings support long-term surveillance of survivors.

pmid-16175749.summary_ja: 地域の絨毛性疾患専門施設で経験した、妊娠後期の胎盤内絨毛癌4例の報告です。肉眼的には胎盤に明らかな異常はなく、組織学的検査で初めて診断されました。文献レビューでは、母体や児に影響のない偶発的な病変から、約半数で認められる転移性の母体病変、致死的な乳児性絨毛癌まで、臨床像に幅があることが示されています。胎盤の詳細な病理検査の重要性を強調する論文です。
pmid-16175749.summary_en: This report describes four cases of intraplacental choriocarcinoma found in third-trimester pregnancies at a regional trophoblastic disease unit. Placentas looked grossly unremarkable, and the tumor was detected only on histopathology. The authors review the literature, noting that these lesions can range from incidental findings with no adverse effect to metastatic maternal disease in about half of cases, and fatal disseminated infantile choriocarcinoma. The paper highlights the importance of thorough placental pathological examination.

pmid-16176507.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢腫と誤診された、大網に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の36歳女性の症例報告です。腫瘍は5×4×4cmで、病理組織学的に未熟性や悪性所見はありませんでした。術前の腫瘍マーカーではCA125、CA19-9、CEAが中等度上昇し、左卵巣は萎縮していました。大網奇形腫は極めてまれであり、卵巣由来と考えられる腫瘤の術前診断は困難な場合があることを示しています。
pmid-16176507.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with a 5 x 4 x 4 cm mature cystic teratoma of the greater omentum that was misdiagnosed as an ovarian cyst. Histopathology showed no immaturity or malignancy. Preoperative tumor markers showed moderate elevations of CA125, CA19-9 and CEA, and the left ovary was atrophic, suggesting possible autoamputation of ovarian tissue. The authors note that omental teratomas are very rare and that preoperative diagnosis can be difficult when the mass is thought to arise from the ovary.

pmid-16178029.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に伴い、精神症状、けいれん、記憶障害、意識障害、中枢性低換気を呈した若年女性4例の報告です。脳脊髄液には炎症所見がありました。患者の血清やCSFは海馬ニューロン膜を染色し、標的抗原としてEFA6Aが同定されました。EFA6A由来の抗体で同様の染色が再現され、抗体が直接病態に関与する可能性が示されています。腫瘍治療や免疫抑制で多くは回復するため、早期の認識が重要です。
pmid-16178029.summary_en: This report describes four young women with ovarian teratoma who developed paraneoplastic encephalitis with acute psychiatric symptoms, seizures, memory deficits, reduced consciousness, and central hypoventilation, with CSF inflammatory changes. Three recovered after tumor treatment or immunosuppression; one died. Patient serum and CSF immunolabeled hippocampal neuronal membranes, and the target antigen was identified as EFA6A, which interacts with a two-pore-domain potassium channel. Antibodies against EFA6A reproduced the staining, supporting an antibody-mediated mechanism.

pmid-16179625.summary_ja: 精巣の類表皮嚢胞または奇形腫と診断された8例の超音波所見と組織所見を比較した研究です。典型的な類表皮嚢胞はタマネギ輪状のパターンを示しますが、非典型例では認められませんでした。奇形腫の3例は、扁平上皮と円柱上皮で覆われた嚢胞構造のため、典型的な類表皮嚢胞に類似した超音波像を示しました。両者の超音波所見には重複が大きく、タマネギ輪状所見のみでは確定できないと結論づけています。
pmid-16179625.summary_en: This pathologic-sonographic study compares eight testicular tumors that were epidermoid cysts or teratomas. Classic epidermoid cysts show an onion-ring pattern, but some atypical epidermoid cysts lack this appearance. Three teratomas mimicked classic epidermoid cysts on ultrasound because their cystic walls contained both squamous and columnar epithelium. The authors conclude that sonographic overlap is substantial, so an onion-ring pattern alone is not reliable: epidermoid cysts may be enucleated, but teratomas require radical orchiectomy.

pmid-16183585.summary_ja: 南アフリカ・クワズール・ナタール州の婦人科・腫瘍科合同外来で5年間に管理された妊娠性絨毛性疾患98例を対象とした後方視的研究です。内訳は奇胎妊娠51%、絨毛癌46%、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍2%でした。多くは地区または地域病院からの紹介で、eThekwini地区の患者が52%を占め、北部地区からの紹介は少数でした。また、多くの患者は正期妊娠の既往があり、紹介が北部地域に偏るという傾向は認められませんでした。
pmid-16183585.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 98 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease managed over five years at a combined gynecology-oncology clinic in KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. Molar pregnancy accounted for 51%, choriocarcinoma 46%, and placental site trophoblastic tumour 2%. Most patients were referred by district or regional hospitals, and about half came from the eThekwini district, while few came from northern districts. Most had a previous term pregnancy. The authors found no evidence that referrals were predominantly from the northern regions.

pmid-16184264.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の26歳妊婦の症例報告。高度のhCG上昇により不顕性の甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した。エトポシド、メトトレキサート、ダクチノマイシンによる併用化学療法を行い、尿路敗血症を合併したものの、甲状腺機能は正常化し、10コース後に寛解を得た。
pmid-16184264.summary_en: A case report of a 26-year-old pregnant woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma to both lungs. Markedly elevated hCG caused subclinical hyperthyroidism. Combination chemotherapy with etoposide, methotrexate, and dactinomycin was given; the course was complicated by urosepsis, but the thyroid function normalized and the patient achieved remission after ten cycles.

pmid-16184443.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を総説した論文。20～35歳男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍であり、臨床試験を活用した集学的治療により全体生存率は90%超に達したと述べる。手術の適応、手術の組み込みに関する論争、代替治療戦略を扱う。
pmid-16184443.summary_en: A review of the management of testicular germ cell tumors. It notes that testicular cancer is the most common malignancy in men aged 20 to 35, and that multidisciplinary care based on clinical trials has achieved overall survival above 90%. The review covers indications for surgery, controversies over surgical integration, and alternative management strategies.

pmid-16185296.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ男性が肺結節を生じた症例報告。切除標本は横紋筋肉腫様成分を伴う体細胞型悪性腫瘍を含む奇形腫であり、その後自動縫合器ラインに再発した。腫瘍マーカーは正常のままで、再発後に補助化学療法を開始した。肺の横紋筋肉腫様病変では転移性胚細胞腫瘍を鑑別に挙げるべきと結論する。
pmid-16185296.summary_en: A case report of a man with prior testicular mixed germ cell tumor who developed a pulmonary nodule. Resection revealed a teratoma with somatic-type rhabdomyosarcomatous malignancy, which later recurred at the staple line. Tumor markers stayed normal. Adjuvant chemotherapy was started after recurrence, and the authors advise including metastatic germ cell tumor in the differential diagnosis of pulmonary rhabdomyosarcoma-like lesions.

pmid-16188233.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるKITの発現、c-kit機能獲得型変異、および下流のPI3K-Akトシグナルを検討した。KITはセミノーマの88%、非セミノーマの44%で発現していた。KIT発現セミノーマの41%に変異が認められ、KITおよびPI3K-Akt経路は構成的に活性化していた。著者らは、この経路が治療標的となりうることを示唆している。
pmid-16188233.summary_en: Examines KIT expression, c-kit gain-of-function mutations, and downstream PI3K-Akt signaling in testicular germ cell tumors. KIT was expressed in 88% of seminomas and 44% of non-seminomas. Mutations were found in 41% of KIT-expressing seminomas, and KIT and PI3K-Akt were constitutively activated, suggesting the pathway as a therapeutic target.

pmid-16189164.summary_ja: 虫垂が正常で、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来した腹膜偽粘液腫の症例報告。通常は虫垂の粘液性腺腫に由来すると考えられているため、非典型的な発生源である。臨床像、病理組織学的所見、治療選択肢を述べる。
pmid-16189164.summary_en: A case report of pseudomyxoma peritonei arising from a mature ovarian cystic teratoma, with a normal appendix. This is an unusual origin, since disseminated peritoneal adenomucinosis is generally thought to arise from an appendiceal mucinous adenoma. The report describes the presentation, histopathology, and treatment options.

pmid-16192587.summary_ja: 一次化学療法で完全寛解後に晩期再発した胚細胞腫瘍を検討。救援化学療法を受けた29例の生存期間中央値は23.9か月。完全寛解が得られたのはパクリタキセル、イホスファミド、シスプラチンの併用例のみであった。晩期再発は551例中3%に生じ、化学療法抵抗性で予後不良とされる。
pmid-16192587.summary_en: Examines late-relapse germ cell tumor (GCT) after complete response to first-line chemotherapy. Among 29 patients treated with salvage chemotherapy, the median survival was 23.9 months. Paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin produced the only complete responses. Late relapse occurred in 3% of 551 patients, and the authors describe it as chemoresistant with poor prognosis.

pmid-16193184.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を合併し、思春期早発と前縦隔腫瘤を呈した4歳男児の症例報告。血清AFPとhCGが軽度上昇し、完全切除により未熟奇形腫と診断された。本症候群の男性はGCTの発症率が非罹患男性の約50倍であり、思春期早発と縦隔GCTを呈する男児では本症候群の除外を勧める。
pmid-16193184.summary_en: A case report of a 4-year-old boy with Klinefelter syndrome who presented with precocious puberty and an anterior mediastinal mass. Serum AFP and hCG were mildly elevated, and complete resection showed an immature teratoma. Males with Klinefelter syndrome have roughly 50 times the GCT risk of unaffected males, so the authors recommend evaluating such boys for the syndrome.

pmid-16197597.summary_ja: カナダの単一施設で、放射線腫瘍医7名を対象に病期Iセミノーマの治療方針をアンケート調査した研究です。サーベイランスと補助的放射線療法はいずれも標準的選択肢として提示されていました。過去15年間でサーベイランスを選ぶ患者が有意に増え、現在はほぼ半数に達しています。
pmid-16197597.summary_en: A survey of all radiation oncologists at a single Canadian cancer centre examined their approach to stage I seminoma. All seven eligible physicians responded. Surveillance and adjuvant radiotherapy were both regarded as standard options and were routinely offered to patients. Institutional data show that over 15 years the proportion of stage I seminoma patients choosing surveillance rose significantly, and it is now almost half. The authors conclude that practice is uniform and consistent with recent literature.

pmid-16201988.summary_ja: 初回治療後2年以上経過してから再発した胚細胞腫瘍の6例を検討した臨床研究です。純粋セミノーマでは中央値30か月、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では75.5か月で晩期再発していました。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、再発腫瘤の完全切除により3例が無病生存を得ています。長期フォローアップの必要性が強調されています。
pmid-16201988.summary_en: This clinical study reviews six patients with germ cell tumors who relapsed more than two years after initial successful treatment. Late relapse occurred at a median of 30 months for pure seminoma and 75.5 months for non-seminomatous tumors. Two seminoma patients with relapses outside irradiation fields achieved remission with chemotherapy. Among non-seminomatous cases, complete resection cured three patients, while two receiving salvage chemotherapy had persistently elevated tumor markers. The authors emphasize the need for long-term follow-up.

pmid-16206293.summary_ja: 多能性に関わるホメオボックス遺伝子NANOGのヒト胚細胞および胚細胞腫瘍における発現を検討しました。胎児精巣の胚細胞に加え、上皮内癌(CIS)、胎児性癌、セミノーマで高発現し、奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍では認められませんでした。未分化な胚細胞腫瘍の分子マーカーとなり、分類に役立つ可能性があります。
pmid-16206293.summary_en: This study investigated expression of the pluripotency homeobox gene NANOG in human germ cells and germ cell tumors. NANOG protein was found in fetal gonocytes, and by immunohistochemistry and quantitative PCR it was highly and specifically expressed in carcinoma in situ, embryonal carcinoma, and seminoma, but not in teratoma or yolk sac tumor. The findings link germ cell tumors to the embryonic cells from which they arise, and suggest NANOG is a molecular marker of undifferentiated germ cell tumors that could aid classification.

pmid-16211371.summary_ja: 33歳男性の左側精巣胎児性癌（血管浸潤あり）の症例報告。片側精巣摘除術と化学療法の後も妊孕性が保たれ、後に健康な子どもをもうけたことを報告している。タイトルでは治療後の4回の妊娠と2回の分娩が示されており、適切な症例では妊孕性を温存できる可能性を示す。
pmid-16211371.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man with left-sided testicular embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion. He underwent unilateral orchiectomy followed by chemotherapy. Despite treatment, he retained fertility and later fathered healthy children. The title also reports four pregnancies and two deliveries after treatment, suggesting that fertility can be preserved in selected patients after unilateral orchiectomy and chemotherapy.

pmid-16217294.summary_ja: 精液検査異常を伴う不妊男性3,847例を後方視的に検討し、10例に精巣腫瘍（全例セミノーマ型胚細胞腫瘍）を認めた。SEERデータと比較した標準化発生比は22.9で、停留精巣の既往を除くと18.3であった。不妊男性では精巣がんの発生リスクが約20倍高く、患者と医師の認識が重要と結論づけている。
pmid-16217294.summary_en: A retrospective review of more than 3,800 men with infertility and abnormal semen analysis found 10 with testicular tumors, all seminomatous germ cell tumors. The standardized incidence ratio compared with SEER controls was 22.9, falling to 18.3 after excluding men with a history of cryptorchidism. The authors conclude that infertile men with abnormal semen analyses have about a 20-fold higher risk of testicular cancer, and that patients and physicians should be aware of this.

pmid-16221056.summary_ja: 進行精巣セミノーマにおけるシスプラチン併用化学療法後の残存腫瘤の管理をまとめた総説。約80%の症例で残存腫瘤が認められ、管理は議論が続いている。外科的切除は3cmを超える境界明瞭な腫瘤に限るべきとされ、放射線療法の有用性は乏しい。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)は活性腫瘍の評価によるリスク層別化に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-16221056.summary_en: This review examines management of residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for advanced testicular seminoma. Up to 80% of patients have a radiographically detectable residual mass, and management remains controversial. Surgical resection is technically difficult because of desmoplasia, and retrospective data support resection only for discrete masses over 3 cm. Radiation therapy offers little benefit and may limit salvage chemotherapy. PET may improve risk stratification by identifying viable tumor.

pmid-16222307.summary_ja: 難治性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）に対する大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞支持療法を、3施設の11例で後方視的に検討した。2例で完全なhCG奏効が4か月と12か月持続し、3例で部分的な腫瘍マーカー奏効が得られた。有効性は未確立であり、高リスク例を対象とした更なる研究が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-16222307.summary_en: This retrospective series reports high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell support for refractory gestational trophoblastic neoplasia in 11 patients treated at three centers. Conditioning regimens included Carbo-EC-T, CEM, or ICE. Two patients achieved complete hCG responses lasting 4 and 12 months, and three had partial marker responses. The authors conclude that the approach remains unproven and needs further study, perhaps in high-risk patients who fail first salvage treatment.

pmid-16228988.summary_ja: 本研究は、ヒト胚性幹細胞遺伝子(OCT4、NANOG、STELLAR、GDF3)のセミノーマにおける発現を、リアルタイムPCRと免疫組織化学を用いて正常精巣と比較した。GDF3はほとんどのセミノーマで上昇し、NANOGとOCT4は他のマーカーより高かった。減数分裂期マーカーは検出されず、DAZLとVASAは低下していた。同じ幹細胞プロファイルは乳癌とMCF7細胞でも確認された。DAZLとVASAの発現はセミノーマの胚細胞起源を示すと結論づけている。
pmid-16228988.summary_en: This study examined expression of human embryonic stem cell genes (OCT4, NANOG, STELLAR, GDF3) in seminoma versus normal testis using real-time PCR and immunohistochemistry. GDF3 was elevated in most seminomas, and NANOG and OCT4 were highest in seminoma compared with other markers. Meiotic markers BOULE and TEKT1 were undetectable, while DAZL and VASA were reduced. The same core stem cell profile was also found in breast carcinoma and MCF7 cells. The authors conclude that DAZL and VASA expression marks the germ cell origin of seminoma.

pmid-16229380.summary_ja: 精巣がんの陰茎転移による持続勃起症（プリアピズム）の症例報告。持続勃起症は低流量型と高流量型に区別され、治療法が異なるため鑑別が重要であると述べられている。本症例は原因が精巣がんの陰茎転移であり、一見して原発性の持続勃起症と区別しにくかった。転移は稀だが、持続勃起症の鑑別診断として念頭に置く必要性が示された。
pmid-16229380.summary_en: A case report describing priapism caused by penile metastasis of testicular cancer. The authors distinguish priapism into low-flow and high-flow types, which require different treatments, and emphasize the importance of separating them. In this case the priapism was clinically indistinguishable from the usual forms, so the metastatic cause was not obvious initially. The report highlights that penile metastasis of testicular cancer should be considered in the differential diagnosis of priapism.

pmid-16230368.summary_ja: 15例の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍をSNPマイクロアレイで解析し、全例で大規模な染色体ホモ接合性を認めた。その多くは相対的な染色体欠失を伴わず、この遺伝子型はセミノーマや他の腫瘍と区別された。特定の染色体の非ランダムな関与から、関連領域の遺伝子が非セミノーマの発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。著者らは精子融合による起源を仮説として提唱している。
pmid-16230368.summary_en: Using single nucleotide polymorphism microarray analysis of 15 tumors, the authors found large-scale chromosomal homozygosity in all nonseminomas, mostly without relative chromosome loss. This genotype distinguished nonseminomas from seminomas and other human tumors. Nonrandom involvement of certain chromosomes suggests that genes in these regions contribute to nonseminoma development. The authors hypothesize that nonseminomas may originate through sperm fusion, which could explain their embryonal morphology.

pmid-16238141.summary_ja: 本総説は臨床病期Iセミノーマの治療選択肢を検討している。セミノーマ型精巣胚細胞腫瘍の約80%を占める病期である。選択肢は根治的精巣摘除術後の監視療法、単剤カルボプラチン、放射線療法で、多くの患者で腸骨照射は不要とされる。再発の危険因子である精巣網浸潤と原発腫瘍径4cm超は、監視療法または補助療法の対象選択に役立つ。最終的な決定は、危険因子、フォローアップの実施能力、患者の希望に依存する。
pmid-16238141.summary_en: This review discusses management options for clinical stage I seminoma, which accounts for about 80% of seminomatous testicular germ cell cancers. Options include surveillance after radical orchiectomy, single-agent carboplatin, and radiotherapy, with iliac irradiation considered unnecessary in many patients. Risk factors for relapse, namely rete testis invasion and primary tumour size over 4 cm, can help select patients for surveillance or adjuvant treatment. Final decisions depend on risk, follow-up capacity, and patient preference.

pmid-16243246.summary_ja: 9歳女児の頬粘膜に生じた良性奇形腫の症例報告と文献的考察。奇形腫は三胚葉すべての組織を含む腫瘍で、頭頸部では5%未満と稀である。口腔内奇形腫はさらに稀で、英語文献では21例のみが報告されていた。著者らは本症例の非典型的な発症様式を報告し、限られた口腔内奇形腫の報告例の中に位置づけている。
pmid-16243246.summary_en: A case report of a benign teratoma of the buccal mucosa in a 9-year-old girl, with a literature review. Teratomas are tumors containing tissues from all three germ layers and are rare in the head and neck, accounting for under 5% of cases. Oral teratomas are even rarer, with only 21 cases reported in the English literature at the time. The authors describe the unusual presentation and place it within this limited published experience.

pmid-16244754.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療がどのように変化したかをまとめた総説。根治的精巣摘除術後の選択肢として、短期化学療法が加わった。放射線療法は晩期毒性への懸念から支持が低下したが、低線量化の無作為化試験も示された。再発リスクに基づく層別化により、個々の患者に合わせた治療選択が可能になっている。
pmid-16244754.summary_en: A review of how management of clinical stage I testicular germ cell tumors has changed. Stage I seminomas and nonseminomas can now be treated with a brief course of chemotherapy in addition to surveillance, radiotherapy, or retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Concern about radiation-related late toxicity has reduced enthusiasm for radiotherapy, though recent randomized trials support lower doses and smaller fields. Risk stratification now allows treatment to be tailored to each patient's relapse risk after radical orchiectomy.

pmid-16246161.summary_ja: 胎児性癌(EC)細胞は奇形癌の幹細胞で、胚性幹(ES)細胞の悪性対応物とされる。ヒトES細胞は長期培養で核型異常を獲得し、EC細胞と類似した性質を示す。培養中のES細胞の変化は、EC細胞の腫瘍進展に似ていると考察している。
pmid-16246161.summary_en: This review compares embryonic stem (ES) cells with embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, the stem cells of teratocarcinomas. Prolonged in vitro culture causes human ES cells to acquire karyotypic changes also seen in human EC cells. When adapted ES cells were grown as tumors in SCID mice, they produced teratocarcinomas containing histologically recognizable stem cells that resembled malignant EC cells. The authors suggest that ES cells may develop in culture in ways that mimic EC tumour progression.

pmid-16248122.summary_ja: 三次医療機関で10年間に診察された原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍14例を検討した。成熟奇形腫11例、卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、セミノーマ1例であった。臨床像、病理組織学的特徴、治療、予後の違いについて考察している。
pmid-16248122.summary_en: This 10-year single-institution review at a tertiary hospital examined 14 primary mediastinal germ cell tumors. Most cases were mature teratomas (11 patients), with two yolk sac tumors and one seminoma. The authors describe differences in clinical presentation, histopathology, treatment, and prognosis. Mediastinal germ cell tumors typically arise in the anterior mediastinum, and teratomas are the most common type. Primary mediastinal malignant non-seminomatous germ cell tumors are rare.

pmid-16249853.summary_ja: 47歳男性の原発性成熟悪性後腹膜奇形腫の症例である。術前化学療法後に残存腫瘍を切除し、組織学的に内胚葉・外胚葉・間葉成分を含む悪性奇形腫と確認された。切除後13か月時点で無病生存中である。まれな症例として、化学療法後の手術が成人の後腹膜奇形腫の治療における役割を示している。
pmid-16249853.summary_en: A 47-year-old man with a primary mature malignant retroperitoneal teratoma received neoadjuvant chemotherapy before the residual tumor was resected. Histopathological examination confirmed a malignant teratoma with endodermal, ectodermal, and mesenchymal structures. At 13 months after resection, the patient was alive and disease free. This rare case illustrates the role of postchemotherapy surgery in managing retroperitoneal teratomas in adults.

pmid-16250313.summary_ja: 生後3か月の女児で、出生時から反復する無呼吸とチアノーゼがあった。CTで右上咽頭に25×24mmの腫瘤が見つかり、病理学的に良性奇形腫と診断された。全身麻酔下で摘出後、呼吸症状は完全に消失した。新生児の原因不明の喘鳴や反復無呼吸では、咽頭の腫瘤も考慮すべきと述べている。
pmid-16250313.summary_en: A three-month-old girl born as one of twins at 37 weeks presented with recurrent apnea and cyanosis since birth. Computed tomography showed a 25x24 mm mass in the right nasopharynx, and pathology revealed a benign teratoma. After excision under general anesthesia, respiratory distress and apnea resolved completely. The authors emphasize considering oropharyngeal and nasopharyngeal masses in neonates with unexplained stridor and recurrent apnea.

pmid-16253775.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者などを含む放射線治療患者11例で、末梢血リンパ球の放射線誘発性転座を36か月追跡した。11例中9例で転座頻度が有意に低下し、月あたり約4.4%の減少であった。過去の被ばく線量推定では、この経時的減少を考慮すべきと結論している。
pmid-16253775.summary_en: Radiation-induced translocations were measured by fluorescence in situ hybridization in peripheral lymphocytes of 11 partially irradiated tumor patients over 36 months. Nine were testicular seminoma patients treated with radiotherapy alone. Most patients showed a significant monthly decline of about 4.4%, indicating that translocations are not stable over time. The authors conclude that this temporal decline must be considered in retrospective dose estimation.

pmid-16254883.summary_ja: 超音波検査で偶然発見された胎児後頸部腫瘤2例に磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を施行した。1例目は頸部奇形腫と診断され、気管浸潤の評価をもとに子宮外分娩時治療(EXIT)を計画した。2例目は奇形皮様腫などが疑われたが、病理学的に過誤腫性血管リンパ管腫であった。
pmid-16254883.summary_en: Fetal MRI was used in two cases of fetal nuchal tumors detected incidentally on ultrasound. In the first, MRI aided diagnosis and prenatal multidisciplinary planning of a cervical teratoma with possible tracheal involvement, leading to an ex-utero intrapartum treatment plan. In the second, a lesion initially thought to be a cervical teratodermoid was found postmortem to be a hamartomatous hemangiolymphangioma, and the parents opted for termination. The report highlights MRI's value in prenatal counseling and management.

pmid-16258281.summary_ja: 本研究は、成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫の個々の組織成分を遺伝子解析し、奇形腫の起源を検討した。成熟奇形腫の大半では全組織成分で一貫したホモ接合性がみられた一方、未熟奇形腫の組織はヘテロ接合型であった。未熟奇形腫内の成熟組織はホモ接合性を示した。未熟奇形腫と一部の成熟奇形腫は減数分裂前の細胞に由来し、成熟組織への分化には減数分裂が必要である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-16258281.summary_en: This study examined the genetic origin of teratomas by analyzing individual tissue components from mature and immature teratomas. Most mature teratomas showed consistent homozygous alleles across all components, while immature teratoma tissue was heterozygous. Mature components within immature teratomas were homozygous. These findings suggest that immature teratomas and some mature teratomas arise from premeiotic germ cells, and that meiosis may be required for differentiation into mature tissues.

pmid-16260698.summary_ja: 1999〜2003年に精巣摘除術後の臨床病期Iセミノーマ314例を前向きに登録し、リスクに応じた治療戦略の有効性を評価した。リスク因子のない患者はサーベイランスとし、腫瘍径4cm超や精巣網浸潤のある患者にはカルボプラチンによる補助化学療法を2コース実施した。両群とも再発率は低く、再発例はすべてエトポシドとシスプラチンで治癒した。リスク適応戦略は安全で実施可能と結論づけられた。
pmid-16260698.summary_en: This Spanish cooperative group study evaluated a risk-adapted strategy for 314 patients with clinical stage I seminoma after orchiectomy, enrolled from 1999 to 2003. Patients without risk factors were managed with surveillance, while those with large tumors or rete testis involvement received two courses of adjuvant carboplatin. Relapse rates were low in both groups, and all relapses were salvaged with etoposide plus cisplatin. Five-year overall survival was 100%. The authors conclude that adjuvant carboplatin reduces relapse and that risk-adapted management is safe and feasible.

pmid-16260890.summary_ja: 妊娠17週の超音波検査で発見された臍帯ヘルニア（exomphalos）に伴う臍帯奇形腫の症例報告である。妊娠は終結され、胎児病理検査で臍帯奇形腫と確認された。胎児は13トリソミーであった。臍帯の嚢胞性病変の鑑別として、この非常にまれな病態を念頭に置くべきと著者らは強調している。
pmid-16260890.summary_en: This case report describes an umbilical cord teratoma associated with exomphalos, detected by ultrasound at 17 weeks of gestation. The pregnancy was terminated, and fetopathological examination confirmed an umbilical cord teratoma. Trisomy 13 was diagnosed. The authors highlight this very rare entity as a differential diagnosis for cystic lesions of the cord, and note that large teratomas with abdominal wall defects may carry a poor fetal prognosis.

pmid-16261899.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常精巣16例、萎縮精巣8例、精巣セミノーマ6例において、免疫組織化学によりTEIFおよびhTERTの発現を検討した。TEIFはすべての検体で発現し群間差はなかった一方、hTERTは萎縮精巣で正常精巣およびセミノーマより低かった。TEIFとhTERTの共発現は正常および悪性組織で認められたが、萎縮精巣では認められなかった。著者らは、TEIFが精巣マーカーとなりうること、テロメラーゼが胚細胞の増殖維持に関与する可能性を示唆している。
pmid-16261899.summary_en: This study examined expression of telomerase transcriptional elements-interacting factor (TEIF) and hTERT by immunohistochemistry in 16 normal testes, 8 atrophic testes, and 6 testicular seminomas. TEIF was expressed in all specimens without group differences, while hTERT was lower in atrophic testes than in normal testes and seminomas. Co-expression of TEIF and hTERT was seen in normal and malignant tissue but not in atrophic testes. The authors suggest TEIF may be a testis marker and that telomerase may maintain germ cell proliferation.

pmid-16264178.summary_ja: 1980〜1994年にノルウェーで片側精巣がんと診断された男性を対象とした多施設の全国調査で、治療後の父親となる割合を検討した。15年時点の累積父親率は71%で、大量化学療法群の48%からサーベイランス群の92%まで差がみられた。乾性射精が最も強い負の予測因子であった。治療強度が妊孕性に反映されることから、将来の生殖能力についての説明に役立つと結論づけられた。
pmid-16264178.summary_en: This Norwegian national multicenter follow-up survey assessed post-treatment paternity in 1,433 assessable men treated for unilateral testicular cancer between 1980 and 1994. The 15-year actuarial paternity rate was 71%, ranging from 48% after high-dose chemotherapy to 92% after surveillance. Dry ejaculation was the strongest negative predictor, and assisted reproductive technologies were used by 22% of couples attempting conception. The authors conclude that paternity reflects treatment intensity, which can inform counseling about future fertility.

pmid-16264857.summary_ja: 37歳男性が左顔面のしびれ、運動失調、複視で受診し、MRIで小脳脚に造影される腫瘤を認めた。鼠径部と後腹膜の腫瘤があり、リンパ節生検と傍腫瘍性抗体の検査が行われた。精巣摘除術、放射線療法、副腎皮質ステロイドで治療された。CNS外の胚細胞腫瘍に伴う神経症状の症例である。
pmid-16264857.summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with left facial numbness, ataxia, vertigo, and diplopia, and MRI showed an enhancing mass in the left middle cerebellar peduncle. Lymph node biopsy and abdominal and pelvic CT evaluated inguinal and retroperitoneal masses, and paraneoplastic antibodies were tested. The working diagnosis was possible paraneoplastic demyelination. Treatment comprised orchiectomy, radiation therapy, and corticosteroids, consistent with a testicular germ cell tumor. The case illustrates a neurological presentation of a non-CNS germ cell tumor.

pmid-16276020.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫に腹膜神経膠腫症を合併した症例を報告した。腹膜や大網に成熟グリア組織が粟粒状に播種する稀な病態で、画像所見と病理所見の対応を示している。画像上は腹膜癌腫症と類似しうるため、卵巣奇形腫患者の腹膜病変の評価において本病態を認識することの重要性を示している。
pmid-16276020.summary_en: This case report describes a mature ovarian teratoma associated with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare condition in which mature glial tissue implants on the peritoneum or omentum. The authors present imaging findings and their pathological correlation to support recognition of this entity. The case illustrates how ovarian teratomas may be linked to peritoneal glial implants, which can mimic peritoneal carcinomatosis on imaging. Recognizing this association can guide evaluation and management of patients with ovarian teratomas and peritoneal lesions.
